branches.name: 已知概率下的风险选择
branches.question: 彩票概率已知时，哪些选择能够用期望效用解释？概率和结果又可能以什么方式进入评价？
branches.boundary: 比较已知概率彩票的排序。未知概率属于模糊线；风险基准选用期刊原典 Herstein–Milnor，另有 von Neumann–Morgenstern 的专著传统。

papers.title: An Axiomatic Approach to Measurable Utility
papers.note: 在混合空间引入偏好公理，使混合选项的效用可按混合权重线性表示。
papers.noteEn: Preference axioms on a mixture space yield a utility representation that is linear in the mixture weights.

papers.title: Prospect Theory: An Analysis of Decision under Risk
papers.note: 以相对参照点的收益与损失为对象，用决策权重和参照依赖的价值函数解释彩票选择。
papers.noteEn: Decision weights and a reference-dependent value function explain lottery choices in terms of gains and losses relative to a reference point.

papers.title: A Theory of Anticipated Utility
papers.note: 按结果好坏排序，再变换累计概率；单个结果的权重因此依赖其在整种彩票中的位置。
papers.noteEn: Outcomes are ranked before cumulative probabilities are transformed, so an outcome's weight depends on its position in the lottery.

papers.title: “Expected Utility” Analysis without the Independence Axiom
papers.note: 在偏好对分布足够光滑时建立局部效用分析，使部分风险比较免于依赖全局独立性。
papers.noteEn: For preferences sufficiently smooth in distributions, local utility analysis permits some risk comparisons without global independence.

papers.title: Advances in Prospect Theory: Cumulative Representation of Uncertainty
papers.note: 分别在收益域和损失域累积加权，使参照依赖模型能处理多个结果；论文也处理不确定性。
papers.noteEn: Separate cumulative weighting for gains and losses extends reference-dependent choice to multiple outcomes. The paper also treats uncertainty.

papers.title: Le comportement de l'homme rationnel devant le risque : critique des postulats et axiomes de l'école américaine
papers.note: 两组彩票共享同一后果，却因共同后果被替换而出现选择反转，暴露独立性公理的经验困难。
papers.noteEn: Replacing a common consequence can reverse choices between lotteries, posing an empirical challenge to independence.

papers.title: The Dual Theory of Choice under Risk
papers.note: 用货币支付的混合取代概率混合来定义独立性，得到对支付线性、对累计概率非线性的评价。
papers.noteEn: Independence for mixtures of payments yields linearity in outcomes with nonlinear cumulative probability weights.

papers.title: A Generalization of the Quasilinear Mean with Applications to the Measurement of Income Inequality and Decision Theory Resolving the Allais Paradox
papers.note: 用结果依赖的权重构造广义均值，使彩票排序能产生 Allais 型选择。
papers.noteEn: An outcome-weighted generalization of the quasilinear mean accommodates Allais-type choices.

papers.title: A Theory of Disappointment Aversion
papers.note: 用一个额外参数赋予低于彩票确定性等价的结果更大权重，并包含期望效用作为特例。
papers.noteEn: One extra parameter overweights outcomes below the lottery's certainty equivalent and nests expected utility.

papers.title: Risk Aversion and Expected-Utility Theory: A Calibration Theorem
papers.note: 若对终身财富使用同一凹效用，小额赌注上持续拒赌会蕴含极端的大额风险厌恶。
papers.noteEn: A single concave utility of wealth turns persistent modest-stakes gamble rejection into extreme large-stakes risk aversion.

papers.title: Salience Theory of Choice Under Risk
papers.authors: Pedro Bordalo, Nicola Gennaioli & Andrei Shleifer
papers.note: 把每种状态下的支付与同时可选彩票中的支付比较，相对突出的状态获得较高决策权重。
papers.noteEn: States with payoffs that stand out against those of competing lotteries receive greater decision weight.

papers.title: The Probability Weighting Function
papers.note: 用复合概率比较的公理刻画若干权重函数，说明小概率高估和大概率低估可如何共存。
papers.noteEn: Axioms on comparisons involving compounded probabilities characterize weighting functions that can overweight small probabilities and underweight large ones.

papers.title: Temporal Resolution of Uncertainty and Dynamic Choice Theory
papers.authors: David M. Kreps & Evan L. Porteus
papers.note: 两种彩票可以有相同的最终结果分布，却因不确定性揭晓的时点不同而有不同价值。
papers.noteEn: Two lotteries with the same distribution of final outcomes can differ in value because uncertainty resolves at different times.

papers.title: Cautious Expected Utility and the Certainty Effect
papers.authors: Simone Cerreia-Vioglio, David Dillenberger & Pietro Ortoleva
papers.note: 分别用多个效用函数计算彩票的确定性等价，再取最小值，给出偏好确定结果的公理表示。
papers.noteEn: The decision maker takes the lowest certainty equivalent across a set of utility functions, giving an axiomatic account of attraction to certainty.

papers.title: The Realization Effect: Risk-Taking after Realized versus Paper Losses
papers.note: 在研究所考察的环境中，相同损失若已经结算，随后风险承担下降；保持账面损失时则观察到更多冒险。
papers.noteEn: In the settings studied, risk taking falls after a loss is realized but rises if the same loss remains on paper.

edges.label: 改变评价对象
edges.note: 把最终彩票的线性混合评价改为围绕参照点编码并对概率加权。
edges.noteEn: Linear evaluation of mixtures of final lotteries gives way to coding outcomes relative to a reference point and weighting probabilities.

edges.label: 改变概率权重
edges.note: 放宽对概率的线性处理，让同一结果的权重取决于其他结果的排序。
edges.noteEn: Relaxing linearity in probabilities allows the weight on an outcome to depend on the ranks of the other outcomes.

edges.label: 放松独立性
edges.note: 比较两种保持风险分析的方法：全局混合线性，或在分布附近以光滑性作局部近似。
edges.noteEn: Risk can be analyzed through global mixture linearity or a smooth local approximation around a given distribution.

edges.label: 累积化
edges.note: 保留参照点和收益损失分域，把单个结果的非线性权重改成分域累计权重。
edges.noteEn: The gains and losses domains and reference point remain, while separate cumulative weighting replaces nonlinear weights on individual outcomes.

edges.label: 接入排序加权
edges.note: 累计表示给出了概率变换工具，前景理论再允许收益与损失使用不同的权重函数。
edges.noteEn: The cumulative representation supplies a probability transformation, while prospect theory permits different weighting functions for gains and losses.

edges.label: 从悖论到决策权重
edges.note: 共同后果实验所挑战的线性混合评价，成为决策权重试图解释的对象。
edges.noteEn: The common-consequence challenge to linear evaluation is one pattern decision weights seek to explain.

edges.label: 区分效用与概率曲率
edges.note: 排序加权保留的概率非线性，在对支付施加线性后可单独承载风险态度。
edges.noteEn: Once evaluation is linear in payments, rank-based probability weights alone can carry risk attitudes.

edges.label: 改变混合评价
edges.note: 允许不同后果进入均值的权重不同，松动混合空间中的期望效用表示。
edges.noteEn: Outcome-specific weights relax the expected utility representation on a mixture space.

edges.label: 引入内生基准
edges.note: 基准随整种彩票变化，使坏结果的额外权重可以解释共同后果反转。
edges.noteEn: The lottery itself determines the benchmark against which disappointing outcomes receive extra weight.

edges.label: 检验跨尺度预测
edges.note: 给期望效用加上最终财富解释后，小额观察会对大额赌注施加强约束。
edges.noteEn: Interpreting outcomes as final wealth ties small-stakes choices tightly to predictions for large gambles.

edges.label: 内生化决策权重
edges.note: 彩票所处的比较环境可以改变权重，即使单张彩票的概率与支付均不变。
edges.noteEn: The comparison lottery can shift weights even when the original lottery's payoffs and probabilities stay fixed.

edges.label: 给权重形式增加检验
edges.labelEn: Testing the shape of decision weights
edges.note: 累积前景理论允许非线性权重；复合概率的选择进一步限制这条曲线的形状。
edges.noteEn: Cumulative prospect theory allows nonlinear weights. Choices among compounded probabilities further restrict their shape.

edges.label: 区分结果与揭晓时间
edges.note: 仅记录最终概率分布会丢失信息树，递归评价使对早揭晓或晚揭晓的偏好可见。
edges.noteEn: Recording only terminal distributions discards the information tree. Recursive evaluation makes preferences over early or late resolution observable.

edges.label: 把不对称性放在确定结果上
edges.note: 用围绕确定结果的较弱独立性取代完整独立性，可在已知概率下得到不同于单一效用曲率的风险态度。
edges.noteEn: A weaker independence condition around certainty permits attitudes toward known risks beyond the curvature of one utility function.

edges.label: 识别何时结清旧赌局
edges.labelEn: Identifying when a prior gamble closes
edges.note: 仅知道经历了损失不够，是否已经结算改变受试者面对下一张彩票的行为。
edges.noteEn: A loss history alone is insufficient: closing the earlier gamble changes choices over the next one.

resources.title: Thirty Years of Prospect Theory in Economics: A Review and Assessment

branches.questionEn: When lottery probabilities are known, which choices can expected utility explain, and how else might probabilities and outcomes enter the evaluation?
branches.boundaryEn: This branch compares lotteries with known probabilities. Unknown probabilities belong to the ambiguity branch. Herstein and Milnor provide the journal benchmark alongside the book tradition of von Neumann and Morgenstern.

branches.name: 主观概率与模糊偏好
branches.question: 不能用一个已知概率分布描述事件时，哪些偏好反映信念，哪些反映对模糊的态度？
branches.boundary: 原始对象是状态依存的行动及其排序。这里区分一阶风险、先验集合与二阶概率；应用中的稳健合约另属合约设计。

papers.title: Risk, Ambiguity, and the Savage Axioms
papers.note: 通过已知与未知构成的赌局展示一组直观选择，它们与单一加性主观概率的表示发生冲突。
papers.noteEn: Bets on urns of known and unknown composition generate intuitive choices that conflict with representation by a single additive subjective probability.

papers.title: A Definition of Subjective Probability
papers.authors: F. J. Anscombe · R. J. Aumann
papers.note: 让每一状态的后果本身是客观彩票，在一组偏好公理下导出主观概率与期望效用。
papers.noteEn: Allowing each state's consequence to be an objective lottery yields subjective probabilities and expected utility under preference axioms.

papers.title: Maxmin Expected Utility with Non-Unique Prior
papers.note: 对一组加性先验分别计算期望效用，按其中最低值排序行动。
papers.noteEn: Evaluate expected utility under each prior in a set of additive priors and rank acts by the lowest value.

papers.title: A Smooth Model of Decision Making under Ambiguity
papers.authors: Peter Klibanoff · Massimo Marinacci · Sujoy Mukerji
papers.note: 先按每个候选先验求期望效用，再对这些值作非线性变换并按二阶信念平均。
papers.noteEn: Calculate expected utility under each candidate prior, transform those values nonlinearly, then average using second-order beliefs.

papers.title: Ambiguity Aversion, Robustness, and the Variational Representation of Preferences
papers.authors: Fabio Maccheroni · Massimo Marinacci · Aldo Rustichini
papers.note: 最小化先验下的期望效用加先验惩罚；适当惩罚可得到多先验最小值和乘子偏好。
papers.noteEn: Minimize expected utility plus a prior-specific penalty. Suitable penalties yield maxmin and multiplier preferences.

papers.title: Subjective Probability and Expected Utility without Additivity
papers.note: 同序独立性允许用非加性容量对效用作 Choquet 积分。
papers.noteEn: Comonotonic independence permits a Choquet integral of utility against a nonadditive capacity.

papers.title: Ambiguity Made Precise: A Comparative Foundation
papers.note: 从选择者之间的比较定义模糊厌恶及不含模糊的行动，并应用于 Ellsberg 实验。
papers.noteEn: Comparisons across decision makers define ambiguity aversion and unambiguous acts, with an application to Ellsberg choices.

papers.title: Differentiating Ambiguity and Ambiguity Attitude
papers.authors: Paolo Ghirardato, Fabio Maccheroni & Massimo Marinacci
papers.note: 从偏好抽取一个无需诉诸模糊态度的比较关系，由此恢复表示感知模糊的一组先验。
papers.noteEn: A comparison relation derived from preference identifies a set of priors representing perceived ambiguity apart from attitude.

papers.title: Recursive Multiple-Priors
papers.note: 动态一致性联系起递归评价、先验集合的矩形性以及逐先验贝叶斯更新。
papers.noteEn: Dynamic consistency links recursive evaluation, rectangular sets of priors, and prior-by-prior Bayesian updating.

papers.title: Vector Expected Utility and Attitudes Toward Variation
papers.note: 在基准期望效用上加入由行动对若干不确定性因子的暴露决定的修正项。
papers.noteEn: A correction to baseline expected utility depends on the act's exposure to uncertainty factors.

papers.title: The Rich Domain of Uncertainty: Source Functions and Their Experimental Implementation
papers.authors: Mohammed Abdellaoui, Aurélien Baillon, Laetitia Placido & Peter P. Wakker
papers.note: 先在每类不确定性来源内确定主观概率，再估计将其转化为下注意愿的函数。
papers.noteEn: Within-source choices identify subjective probabilities, then source functions translate those probabilities into willingness to bet.

papers.title: Recursive Smooth Ambiguity Preferences
papers.authors: Peter Klibanoff, Massimo Marinacci & Sujoy Mukerji
papers.note: 将平滑模糊模型推广到多期行动，在递归表示中分别描述信念与模糊态度。
papers.noteEn: A recursive representation extends smooth ambiguity to multistage acts while preserving the distinction between beliefs and ambiguity attitudes.

papers.title: Knightian Decision Theory. Part I
papers.note: 取消偏好完备性，并以现状为基准；多先验未就改进达成一致时，决策者可以不转换。
papers.noteEn: Dropping completeness allows multiple priors to disagree on an improvement. Inertia then permits a decision maker to retain the status quo.

papers.title: Uncertainty Averse Preferences
papers.authors: Simone Cerreia-Vioglio, Fabio Maccheroni, Massimo Marinacci & Luigi Montrucchio
papers.note: 对单调、凸的完整偏好给出一般表示，把若干常用的模糊评价准则纳入同一体系。
papers.noteEn: A general representation for complete, monotone, convex preferences encompasses several common ambiguity criteria.

papers.title: Objective and Subjective Rationality in a Multiple Prior Model
papers.authors: Itzhak Gilboa, Fabio Maccheroni, Massimo Marinacci & David Schmeidler
papers.note: 用两个偏好关系区分可以说服他人接受的比较，以及当事人自身愿意做出的比较。
papers.noteEn: Two preference relations distinguish comparisons defensible to others from those the individual is prepared to make.

edges.label: 从单一到集合
edges.note: 在状态依存彩票上弱化独立性等条件，使选择者可按一组先验的最坏期望评价。
edges.noteEn: Weakening independence and related conditions on state-contingent lotteries permits evaluation by worst-case expected utility over a set of priors.
edges.labelEn: From one prior to a set

edges.label: 解释回避模糊
edges.note: 对未知构成容许多个先验，可以表示经典赌局中的模糊厌恶。
edges.noteEn: Multiple priors over an unknown composition can represent ambiguity aversion in classic urn bets.

edges.label: 另一种解释
edges.note: 通过二阶信念及变换函数，把对可能概率的看法与对概率不确定性的态度分开。
edges.noteEn: Second-order beliefs and a transformation distinguish beliefs about possible probabilities from attitudes toward uncertainty about probabilities.

edges.label: 给先验定价
edges.note: 从集合外完全排除的先验，推广为可带有限惩罚进入最小化的先验。
edges.noteEn: Priors previously excluded from the set can enter the minimization with a finite penalty.

edges.label: 缩小独立性的范围
edges.note: 只在行动的状态排序一致时要求特定的混合独立性，就能保留积分表示而放开概率可加性。
edges.noteEn: Restricting independence to comonotonic acts retains an integral representation without additive probabilities.

edges.label: 从单一反例到比较标准
edges.note: 比较谁更回避模糊，可以把一次瓮赌选择推广为对整组行动的行为判据。
edges.noteEn: A comparison of ambiguity aversion extends the urn observation to a criterion over a domain of acts.

edges.label: 识别先验集合
edges.note: 多个先验不一定要求最坏情形决策；可另从选择识别感知到的模糊，再讨论如何评价。
edges.noteEn: A set of perceived priors can be identified separately from whether the decision maker uses their worst case.

edges.label: 加入时间与更新
edges.note: 将静态最坏先验评价分解到多期，对跨期可能先验的组合方式施加限制。
edges.noteEn: Decomposing static worst-prior evaluation across dates restricts how conditional priors can be combined.

edges.label: 给期望加入变动项
edges.note: 状态效用的基准平均值之外，行动对特定模糊方向的暴露也影响评价。
edges.noteEn: Beyond a baseline mean, the act's exposure to specific directions of ambiguity changes its evaluation.

edges.label: 把瓮赌扩展到多种来源
edges.note: 把已知与未知瓮的定性差异推广为可对不同来源分别估计的响应曲线。
edges.noteEn: A qualitative difference between known and unknown urns becomes a response curve estimated separately for each source.

edges.label: 把二阶评价带入延续价值
edges.labelEn: Introducing second-order evaluation into continuation values
edges.note: 静态模型比较今天的行动；递归模型还必须规定每个历史上的延续行动如何比较。
edges.noteEn: The static model ranks acts today. Its recursive extension must specify how continuation acts compare after each history.

edges.label: 放开的公理是完备性
edges.note: 同一组候选先验既能支持保留不可比性，也能通过额外规则产生对所有行动的完整排序。
edges.noteEn: A set of priors can preserve incomparability. Ranking every act requires an additional choice rule.

edges.label: 识别共同公理
edges.note: 在扩大表示类别后，可区分不确定性厌恶本身的含义与特定先验惩罚形式的额外含义。
edges.noteEn: Broadening the representation separates implications of uncertainty aversion from those of a particular prior penalty.

edges.label: 比较两种决策标准
edges.note: 同一组先验可约束客观上能论证的比较，同时支持主观上对其余行动作决定。
edges.noteEn: A common set of priors restricts objectively defensible comparisons while leaving room for subjective decisions about other acts.

branches.questionEn: When one known probability distribution cannot describe events, which preferences reveal beliefs, and which reveal attitudes toward ambiguity?
branches.boundaryEn: The primitives are state-contingent acts and their ranking. The branch distinguishes first-order risk, sets of priors, and second-order probabilities. Robust contracts belong to contract design.

branches.name: 跨期选择、承诺与自控
branches.question: 为什么人会事先限制未来选择？是未来偏好会变化，还是抵抗诱惑本身有成本？
branches.boundary: 一个分支观察跨期消费和行动时点，另一个直接观察当事人对不同菜单的排序。两种原始数据支持的检验不同。

papers.title: A Note on Measurement of Utility
papers.note: 将不同时点的瞬时效用以时间权重汇总，为跨期消费比较给出贴现效用基准。
papers.noteEn: Weighting instantaneous utilities across dates gives a discounted utility benchmark for comparing consumption streams.

papers.title: Myopia and Inconsistency in Dynamic Utility Maximization
papers.note: 当相对贴现随评价时点改变时，原先拟定的消费计划可能被未来的自己推翻。
papers.noteEn: When relative discounting changes with the date of evaluation, a future self may overturn the original consumption plan.

papers.title: Golden Eggs and Hyperbolic Discounting
papers.note: 在存在当下偏好的储蓄模型中，牺牲资产流动性可以约束未来消费。
papers.noteEn: In a savings model with present bias, sacrificing asset liquidity can constrain future consumption.

papers.title: Doing It Now or Later
papers.note: 区分对未来当下偏好的预见程度，研究成本或收益即时发生时行动时点如何改变。
papers.noteEn: Different degrees of foresight about future present bias change when a person acts if costs or benefits are immediate.

papers.title: Temptation and Self-Control
papers.note: 用对选择集合的偏好识别诱惑和自控成本；即使最终选项相同，菜单价值也可以不同。
papers.noteEn: Preferences over choice sets identify temptation and the cost of self-control. Two menus can differ in value even if the same option is ultimately chosen.

papers.title: Dynamic Choices of Hyperbolic Consumers
papers.role: 随机收入下的动态储蓄
papers.note: 在随机收入和借贷限制下求解有双曲贴现的消费者，给出跨期自我之间的均衡条件。
papers.noteEn: A hyperbolic consumer faces stochastic income and a borrowing constraint, yielding equilibrium conditions across successive selves.

papers.title: Choice and Procrastination
papers.note: 部分预见自控问题的人可能总打算完成更有吸引力的任务，结果连原本会做的任务也没有完成。
papers.noteEn: A partially naive person may plan a better task that is never completed and leave an otherwise feasible task undone.

papers.title: Self-Control and the Theory of Consumption
papers.note: 把菜单上的诱惑与自控扩展到多期消费选择，用递归偏好分析消费与储蓄。
papers.noteEn: A recursive preference model extends temptation and self-control over menus to dynamic consumption and saving.

papers.title: Tying Odysseus to the Mast: Evidence from a Commitment Savings Product in the Philippines
papers.authors: Nava Ashraf, Dean Karlan & Wesley Yin
papers.note: 在菲律宾随机提供带提款限制的账户，记录谁愿意接受自我约束以及随后存款余额的变化。
papers.noteEn: A randomized offer of a withdrawal-restricted account in the Philippines measures take-up of commitment and subsequent savings balances.

papers.title: Working over Time: Dynamic Inconsistency in Real Effort Tasks
papers.authors: Ned Augenblick, Muriel Niederle & Charles Sprenger
papers.note: 比较事先与当期安排同一组任务，发现真实努力比跨期货币支付更明显地表现出当下偏好。
papers.noteEn: Comparing advance and immediate schedules reveals clearer present bias in real effort than in monetary allocations.

papers.title: An Experiment on Time Preference and Misprediction in Unpleasant Tasks
papers.note: 让参与者先预测未来在不同工资下愿意做多少任务，再与到时的实际选择比较。
papers.noteEn: Forecasts of future transcription effort at different wages are compared with subsequent choices.

papers.title: A Dual-Self Model of Impulse Control
papers.note: 前瞻的长期自我付出控制成本来影响只重视当期收益的短期自我，产生可随环境变化的自控行为。
papers.noteEn: A forward-looking self pays a cost to influence a short-run self concerned with current rewards, producing context-dependent self-control.

papers.title: Commitment vs. Flexibility
papers.authors: Manuel Amador, Iván Werning & George-Marios Angeletos
papers.note: 未来的口味信息使灵活性有价值，当下偏好又使限制选择有价值；模型研究为何最优菜单包含最低储蓄要求。
papers.noteEn: Future taste information rewards flexibility while present bias rewards commitment. The optimal menu includes a minimum saving requirement in the model.

papers.title: Time Consistency: Stationarity and Time Invariance
papers.note: 通过分别移动报酬日期和作答日期，实验区分时间一致性、平稳性和时间不变性。
papers.noteEn: Shifting payoff dates and decision dates separately distinguishes time consistency, stationarity, and time invariance experimentally.

papers.title: Estimating Time Preferences from Convex Budgets
papers.note: 让实验参与者在两个日期间连续分配支付，利用相对价格变化联合估计贴现与即时效用曲率。
papers.noteEn: Continuous allocation of payments across two dates and variation in their relative prices permit joint estimation of discounting and utility curvature.

edges.label: 改变评价时点
edges.note: 对同一计划分别在今天与未来求最优，使跨期一致性成为可研究的约束。
edges.noteEn: Optimizing the same plan today and again in the future makes consistency across dates an explicit restriction.

edges.label: 承诺进入资产市场
edges.note: 把未来自我可能改变计划的问题具体化为流动与非流动资产的选择。
edges.noteEn: Future revisions to a plan become a concrete choice between liquid and illiquid assets.

edges.label: 预测未来自我
edges.note: 同一偏好冲突因当事人对未来行为的预见不同，可以引出不同的拖延或抢先行为。
edges.noteEn: Different beliefs about future behavior can translate the same preference conflict into delay or preemption.

edges.label: 更换可观测对象
edges.note: 两种机制都可产生对承诺的需求；菜单途径用多一个诱人选项本身的效用成本解释这种需求。
edges.noteEn: Both mechanisms can generate demand for commitment. The menu approach attributes this demand to the utility cost of adding a tempting alternative.

edges.label: 加入收入风险
edges.note: 确定消费计划的问题转为面对未来收入冲击与流动性约束时的储蓄规则。
edges.noteEn: A consumption plan becomes a saving policy contingent on income shocks and liquidity constraints.

edges.label: 增加任务菜单
edges.note: 任务由一项变成多项后，更好的未来选项可能使实际完成的任务变少。
edges.noteEn: With several tasks, adding a better future option may reduce what is actually completed.

edges.label: 菜单跨期延续
edges.note: 当前消费决定未来可行菜单，自控成本因此影响整个消费路径。
edges.noteEn: Current consumption determines later opportunity sets, letting self-control costs shape the entire consumption path.

edges.label: 观察对流动性限制的需求
edges.note: 把可牺牲流动性的资产做成可选择的银行产品，使承诺需求能够直接观察。
edges.noteEn: An optional withdrawal restriction makes the demand for a less liquid saving asset directly observable.

edges.label: 在任务安排中测量反转
edges.note: 固定工作日期、改变作决定的日期，可直接检验计划是否随评价时点改变。
edges.noteEn: Holding work dates fixed while varying the decision date tests whether a plan changes when reevaluated.

edges.label: 分别观测偏好与预测
edges.note: 承诺需求以外，个人对未来劳动选择的预测误差也能检验其是否了解自己的当下偏好。
edges.noteEn: Errors in forecasts of later work choices provide evidence about awareness of present bias beyond demand for commitment.

edges.label: 把菜单成本写成控制行为
edges.labelEn: Modeling self-control as a costly action
edges.note: 对诱惑的抵抗成本可以来自两个自我之间的控制问题，并联系到认知负担下的选择。
edges.noteEn: A control problem between selves provides a source of temptation costs and connects them to choice under cognitive load.

edges.label: 比较承诺的收益和代价
edges.note: 舍弃流动性可以保护消费者免受诱惑，也可能阻碍其利用后来获得的口味信息。
edges.noteEn: Sacrificing liquidity can protect consumers from temptation but prevent them from acting on later information about tastes.

edges.label: 辨认反转的来源
edges.note: 一次延迟导致的排序变化无法单独识别动态不一致，需要区分究竟移动了哪个日期。
edges.noteEn: A reversal after a delay alone does not identify dynamic inconsistency. Which dates move matters.

edges.label: 分离贴现与曲率
edges.note: 两日期的二元奖励比较可能混淆贴现与边际效用变化，凸预算提供额外取舍。
edges.noteEn: Binary dated-reward choices can confound discounting with marginal utility. Convex budgets reveal additional tradeoffs.

resources.title: Time Discounting and Time Preference: A Critical Review
resources.authors: Shane Frederick · George Loewenstein · Ted O’Donoghue

branches.questionEn: Why restrict future choices in advance? Will preferences change, or is resisting temptation itself costly?
branches.boundaryEn: One approach observes intertemporal consumption and the timing of actions. Another observes preferences over menus. Their different primitives support different tests.

branches.name: 显示偏好与需求可检验性
branches.question: 只观察有限个价格、预算和消费选择，能否排除效用最大化或一个特定偏好模型？
branches.boundary: 本线首先研究同一决策者跨预算的选择；当数据是不同个体的重复横截面，随机效用检验需要额外处理人群异质性。

papers.title: A Note on the Pure Theory of Consumer’s Behaviour
papers.note: 通过不同预算中实际选择与可负担的消费束，把需求的一致性写成可观察约束。
papers.noteEn: Demand consistency becomes observable by comparing chosen bundles with affordable alternatives across budgets.

papers.title: Revealed Preference and the Utility Function
papers.note: 把成对显示偏好的思想扩展到多步选择链，排除沿间接显示偏好返回原点的严格循环。
papers.noteEn: Pairwise revealed preference extends to chains of choices, ruling out strict cycles that return to their starting point through indirect revealed preference.

papers.title: The Construction of Utility Functions from Expenditure Data
papers.note: 以有限不等式判定一组支出记录能否由偏好合理化，并构造与记录相容的效用函数。
papers.noteEn: Finite inequalities determine whether preferences rationalize expenditure observations and construct a utility function consistent with them.

papers.title: The Nonparametric Approach to Demand Analysis
papers.note: 将一般显示偏好公理和 Afriat 型方法用于一致性检验、偏好恢复和未观察预算的需求界定。
papers.noteEn: The generalized axiom of revealed preference and Afriat-type methods test consistency, recover preferences, and bound demand at unobserved budgets.

papers.title: Testable Implications of Models of Intertemporal Choice: Exponential Discounting and Its Generalizations
papers.authors: Federico Echenique · Taisuke Imai · Kota Saito
papers.note: 把跨期消费数据作为原始观察，刻画指数贴现凹效用及若干推广的非参数检验条件。
papers.noteEn: Taking intertemporal consumption observations as primitives yields nonparametric tests for concave exponential discounted utility and several generalizations.

papers.title: Non-parametric Tests of Consumer Behaviour
papers.note: 给出不依赖函数形式的检验，区分效用最大化、位似性、可分性和特定配给模型。
papers.noteEn: Nonparametric tests distinguish utility maximization, homotheticity, separability, and a rationing model.

papers.title: Revealed Preference with a Subset of Goods
papers.note: 少观察一个商品时，即便单独知道其价格或数量，显示偏好对其余需求也几乎没有限制。
papers.noteEn: With one good omitted, even observing its price or its quantity alone leaves observed demand almost unrestricted.

papers.title: Nonparametric Engel Curves and Revealed Preference
papers.authors: Richard Blundell, Martin Browning & Ian Crawford
papers.note: 估计非参数恩格尔曲线，在不同价格体系下构造可比较的消费束，提高显示偏好检验的力量。
papers.noteEn: Estimated nonparametric Engel curves construct comparable bundles across price regimes and strengthen revealed preference tests.

papers.title: Best Nonparametric Bounds on Demand Responses
papers.authors: Richard Blundell, Martin Browning & Ian Crawford
papers.note: 利用价格制度下的扩展路径和显示偏好限制，对新价格与支出下的需求求界。
papers.noteEn: Expansion paths at observed prices and revealed preference restrictions bound demand at counterfactual prices and expenditure.

papers.title: The Money Pump as a Measure of Revealed Preference Violations
papers.authors: Federico Echenique, Sangmok Lee & Matthew Shum
papers.note: 用沿显示偏好循环能从消费者抽取的金额度量违例严重程度，并讨论有误差观察下的统计检验。
papers.noteEn: The money extractable along a revealed preference cycle measures violation severity and informs testing under observation error.

papers.title: Stochastic Revealed Preferences with Measurement Error
papers.note: 在价格或消费量可能测错的面板中，用对误差的矩限制检验效用模型，避免把一切表面违例都解释为非理性。
papers.noteEn: Moment restrictions on measurement errors yield utility tests for consumption panels with imperfectly observed prices or quantities.

papers.title: Habits Revealed
papers.note: 给出消费历史影响当前效用时的必要充分经验条件，并说明哪些模型特征能由面板数据界定。
papers.noteEn: Necessary and sufficient empirical conditions for rational habit formation also set-identify features of the model from panel data.

papers.title: Afriat's Theorem for General Budget Sets
papers.note: 将 Afriat 的有限数据定理推广到一类非线性、非凸预算集合，并给出构造合理化偏好的方法。
papers.noteEn: Extends Afriat's finite-data theorem to a class of nonlinear, nonconvex budgets and constructs rationalizing preferences.

papers.title: Consistency and Heterogeneity of Individual Behavior under Uncertainty
papers.authors: Syngjoo Choi, Raymond Fisman, Douglas Gale & Shachar Kariv
papers.role: 个人风险选择的一致性
papers.note: 用图形界面构造许多投资组合预算，先检验个人选择是否一致，再估计风险偏好的个体差异。
papers.noteEn: Graphical portfolio budgets generate many choices per subject, permitting individual tests of consistency before estimating heterogeneous risk preferences.

papers.title: Who Is (More) Rational?
papers.authors: Syngjoo Choi, Shachar Kariv, Wieland Müller & Dan Silverman
papers.note: 在大样本实验中用效用最大化一致性衡量选择质量，并估计这一指标与财富等个体特征的关系。
papers.noteEn: A large experiment measures choice quality through consistency with utility maximization and relates it to characteristics including wealth.

edges.label: 从两点到链条
edges.note: 用多次预算选择的传递链检验成对比较看不到的循环。
edges.noteEn: Chains of budget choices can reveal cycles that pairwise comparisons miss.

edges.label: 有限可行性
edges.note: 把显示偏好一致性问题落到有限次价格与数量观察上，再用可解的不等式构造合理化。
edges.noteEn: Consistency is checked on finitely many observed prices and quantities, and a rationalization is constructed by solving inequalities.

edges.label: 从存在到预测
edges.note: 利用能合理化样本的偏好集合，对新预算下可能出现的需求作界定。
edges.noteEn: The preferences that rationalize the sample bound possible demand at a new budget.

edges.label: 加上跨期结构
edges.note: 可由某个效用函数合理化只是起点；指数贴现等具体模型还限制不同时点消费的相对评价。
edges.noteEn: Rationalizability by some utility function is a starting point. Exponential discounting and related models further restrict the relative evaluation of consumption at different dates.

edges.label: 增加可拒绝的结构
edges.note: 有限预算数据除了一般合理化，还能检验带额外结构的效用或预算约束。
edges.noteEn: Finite budgets test additional utility or rationing restrictions beyond basic rationalizability.

edges.label: 检验数据完整性
edges.note: Afriat 型可检验性依赖可负担集合的观察；遗漏一个商品足以改变这一结论。
edges.noteEn: Afriat-type tests need observed affordability, and omitting one good can remove almost all restrictions.

edges.label: 补足预算交叉
edges.note: 收入扩展路径提供更多虚拟支出水平，使原本缺乏交叉的预算可以比较。
edges.noteEn: Expansion paths supply additional expenditure levels at which formerly uninformative budgets can be compared.

edges.label: 收紧预测区间
edges.note: 把不同收入下的需求信息一并使用，可缩小未观察预算的可理性化选择集合。
edges.noteEn: Incorporating demand at multiple incomes narrows the rationalizable choices on a new budget.

edges.label: 给循环计价
edges.note: 严格循环从二元的拒绝条件变成可按金额比较的偏离程度。
edges.labelEn: Putting a price on a cycle
edges.noteEn: A strict cycle becomes a monetarily graded departure from consistency instead of a binary rejection.

edges.label: 区分误差与违例
edges.note: 有限数据不等式若套在含误差的观察上容易过度拒绝，因而需要给真实选择与记录之间建模。
edges.noteEn: Finite inequalities applied directly to noisy observations can overreject, motivating a model of the gap between true and recorded choices.

edges.label: 把滞后消费纳入效用
edges.note: 跨预算检验增加了消费历史，允许区分当期需求的一致性与跨期习惯形成。
edges.noteEn: Adding consumption histories to budget comparisons distinguishes static demand consistency from intertemporal habit formation.

edges.label: 放宽预算几何形状
edges.note: 在折线或非凸机会集合上，价格向量不足以描述全部可行选择，必须保留预算集合本身。
edges.noteEn: For nonlinear or nonconvex opportunities, prices need not describe all feasible choices. The full budget set matters.

edges.label: 改变预算的商品含义
edges.note: 把商品写成不同状态下的支付后，跨预算的一致性也能检验风险决策。
edges.noteEn: When goods are payments in different states, cross-budget consistency becomes a test of risk choices.

edges.label: 从拒绝到个体比较
edges.labelEn: From rejection to comparisons across people
edges.note: 测量每个人偏离显示偏好的程度后，可研究其与社会经济变量的相关性，而不仅是总体能否通过。
edges.noteEn: Individual degrees of consistency permit comparisons with socioeconomic characteristics beyond an aggregate pass-or-fail test.

resources.title: New Developments in Revealed Preference Theory: Decisions Under Risk, Uncertainty, and Intertemporal Choice

branches.questionEn: Can a finite set of observed prices, budgets, and consumption choices reject utility maximization or a specific preference model?
branches.boundaryEn: This branch begins with one decision maker choosing across budgets. With repeated cross sections of different people, random utility tests must also account for population heterogeneity.

branches.name: 随机选择与有限注意
branches.question: 选项被选择的频率为何会随菜单变化？有多少变动可以用稳定的随机偏好或有限注意解释？
branches.boundary: 观察对象是菜单条件下的选择概率。随机偏好、随机注意和抽样误差是不同层次，只有在各自的限制下才可区分。

papers.title: A Representation Theorem for Finite Random Scale Systems
papers.note: 在有限选项全集上刻画哪些按菜单观察到的选择概率可由一组随机效用表示。
papers.noteEn: Characterizes which menu-specific choice probabilities on a finite universe of alternatives admit a random utility representation.

papers.title: Random Expected Utility
papers.note: 当选项本身是彩票，随机选择规则可由在期望效用偏好上抽取类型来表示，并获得相应公理刻画。
papers.noteEn: When the alternatives are lotteries, axioms characterize random choice rules generated by draws from expected utility preferences.

papers.title: Nonparametric Analysis of Random Utility Models
papers.note: 基于重复横截面需求数据，构造无需给出偏好分布参数形式的随机效用假设检验。
papers.noteEn: Repeated cross-sectional demand data support a random utility test without a parametric specification of the distribution of preferences.

papers.title: A Random Attention Model
papers.authors: Matias D. Cattaneo · Xinwei Ma · Yusufcan Masatlioglu · Elchin Suleymanov
papers.note: 在单调注意限制下，选择者的偏好排序固定，但每次考虑的选项子集可以随机变化。
papers.noteEn: Under monotonic attention the preference ordering is fixed, but the subset considered can vary randomly across choices.

papers.title: Random Utility and Limited Consideration
papers.authors: Victor H. Aguiar · Maria Jose Boccardi · Nail Kashaev · Jeongbin Kim
papers.note: 把不同人的偏好异质性和随机考虑集合放在同一框架，并借助菜单与注意环境的变化比较模型。
papers.noteEn: Preference heterogeneity and random consideration are modeled together, with variation in menus and attention conditions used to compare models.

papers.title: Falmagne and the Rationalizability of Stochastic Choices in Terms of Random Orderings
papers.note: 以在确定排序上的抽签重新刻画哪些菜单选择概率可被合理化，并给出对 Falmagne 结果的另一证明。
papers.noteEn: A lottery over deterministic orderings provides an alternative derivation of the characterization of rationalizable menu probabilities.

papers.title: Stochastic Choice and Consideration Sets
papers.note: 每个选项以自身的概率进入考虑集，再按固定偏好选择；模型给出由选择频率恢复注意参数的条件。
papers.noteEn: Options enter consideration with item-specific probabilities, followed by maximization of a fixed preference. Choices identify attention parameters under the model.

papers.title: Menu-Dependent Stochastic Feasibility
papers.role: 菜单依存的随机可行性
papers.note: 以随机出现的可行子集和确定偏好解释选择，刻画菜单相关的可行性分布如何受到数据限制。
papers.noteEn: A random feasible subset and a fixed preference explain choice, with observed behavior restricting menu-dependent feasibility distributions.

papers.title: Monotone Stochastic Choice Models: The Case of Risk and Time Preferences
papers.note: 比较常用随机选择规则能否保证，风险厌恶等偏好参数按同一方向改变相关选项的选择概率。
papers.noteEn: Examines whether standard stochastic specifications preserve the predicted direction of choice probabilities as risk or time preference parameters vary.

papers.title: Random Choice and Private Information
papers.role: 私有信息诱发随机选择
papers.note: 分析者看不到决策者的信号，因而看到随机选择；在模型的条件下可由选择反推信息结构。
papers.noteEn: An unobserved private signal generates stochastic choices, from which the analyst can identify information under the model's assumptions.

papers.title: Nonparametric Counterfactuals in Random Utility Models
papers.note: 在允许任意不可观测偏好异质性的重复横截面中，为反事实选择概率及需求分布给出紧界。
papers.noteEn: Repeated cross sections with unrestricted unobserved taste heterogeneity yield tight bounds on counterfactual probabilities and demand distributions.

papers.title: Dynamic Random Utility
papers.authors: Mira Frick, Ryota Iijima & Tomasz Strzalecki
papers.role: 随时间演化的随机偏好
papers.note: 利用动态菜单上的选择区分学习与口味持续性等在静态随机选择中难以区别的机制。
papers.noteEn: Choice over dynamic menus distinguishes learning and persistent tastes that can be observationally indistinguishable on a static domain.

papers.title: Stochastic Choice and Revealed Perturbed Utility
papers.authors: Drew Fudenberg, Ryota Iijima & Tomasz Strzalecki
papers.note: 把概率向量本身当作选择，以期望效用和非线性扰动之和评价，并给出对应的可观察条件。
papers.noteEn: Choice probabilities themselves solve an optimization problem combining expected utility with a nonlinear perturbation, with testable conditions for representation.

papers.title: Single-Crossing Random Utility Models
papers.authors: Jose Apesteguia, Miguel A. Ballester & Jay Lu
papers.note: 将潜在排序限制为满足单交叉的一族，推导单调性和中心性等可检验条件并研究识别。
papers.noteEn: Restricting latent rankings to satisfy single crossing yields testable monotonicity and centrality conditions and identification results.

papers.title: Random Categorization and Bounded Rationality
papers.note: 决策者随机选取一个心理类别，再从菜单与该类别的交集中挑选最偏好的选项。
papers.noteEn: A random mental category is selected, and the best option is chosen from its intersection with the menu.

edges.label: 约束潜在排序
edges.note: 在彩票空间上要求潜在排序具备期望效用结构，从而增加可检验内容。
edges.noteEn: Requiring latent rankings over lotteries to satisfy expected utility imposes additional testable restrictions.

edges.label: 从表示到抽样检验
edges.note: 在消费需求环境下把总体选择概率的随机合理化问题变成有限样本下的统计检验。
edges.noteEn: Random rationalizability of population choice probabilities becomes a finite-sample statistical testing problem in a demand setting.

edges.label: 改变随机性的来源
edges.note: 从偏好排序的随机性转向考虑集合的随机性，得到另一组菜单间限制。
edges.noteEn: Replacing random preference rankings with random consideration sets yields different restrictions across menus.

edges.label: 加入人群异质性
edges.note: 二者都允许考虑不完全；进一步放开不同个体的偏好排序，可以同时比较多种有限考虑模型。
edges.noteEn: Both approaches permit incomplete consideration. Allowing preferences to differ across people permits comparison of several limited-consideration models.

edges.label: 从尺度到排序
edges.note: 把潜在随机效用换写为排序上的概率分布，使有限选项上的可观察限制更直接。
edges.noteEn: Expressing latent utility as a distribution over orderings clarifies the observable restrictions for finite alternatives.

edges.label: 放宽独立考虑
edges.note: 随机注意模型可用单调性约束替代逐项独立进入，保留不同菜单间的可检验含义。
edges.noteEn: Monotonic attention replaces independent item inclusion with broader restrictions across menus.

edges.label: 比较考虑集限制
edges.note: 不同考虑模型的差别在于菜单变化如何约束子集的出现概率。
edges.noteEn: Alternative consideration models impose different links between menu changes and subset probabilities.

edges.label: 检验概率比较静态
edges.note: 随机化有结构的偏好并不自动保证直观的概率单调性，需要单独核查噪声机制。
edges.noteEn: Structured preferences alone do not ensure monotone choice probabilities under every noise specification.

edges.label: 把随机性归于信号
edges.note: 用未观测的信念变化而非偏好类型抽取解释选择频率，从而转向信息识别。
edges.noteEn: Unobserved belief changes provide a source of choice frequencies distinct from draws of preference types.

edges.label: 从检验到反事实
edges.note: 数据可与随机效用相容时，同一组可行的类型分布还能限制一个新预算下的需求。
edges.noteEn: When data pass random utility tests, the compatible type distributions also restrict choices on a new budget.

edges.label: 增加选择的时间维度
edges.labelEn: Adding a time dimension to choice
edges.note: 一次菜单看不到随机偏好跨期如何关联，动态数据对这种关联施加额外限制。
edges.noteEn: A single menu hides how preference draws are related over time. Dynamic observations restrict those links.

edges.label: 从抽取排序到选择概率
edges.labelEn: From drawing rankings to choosing probabilities
edges.note: 同样观察到随机选择，还可以直接限制其概率向量的目标函数，而不用先指定随机排序。
edges.noteEn: Instead of first positing random rankings, the model puts restrictions directly on the objective generating choice probabilities.

edges.label: 给异质性排序
edges.note: 一般随机效用允许偏好类型任意分散；单交叉约束使类型之间的顺序也进入数据限制。
edges.noteEn: Single crossing orders types within the random population, imposing restrictions absent with unrestricted rankings.

edges.label: 允许共同进入考虑集
edges.labelEn: Allowing options to enter consideration together
edges.note: 类别中的多个备选项会同时进入考虑范围，给逐个独立注意的机制提供了不同预测。
edges.noteEn: A shared category makes alternatives enter consideration jointly, unlike independent item-level attention.

branches.questionEn: Why do choice frequencies change with the menu, and how much can stable random preferences or limited attention explain?
branches.boundaryEn: The observations are menu-conditional choice probabilities. Random preferences, random attention, and sampling error operate at different levels and require different restrictions to distinguish them.

branches.name: 公平、分配与互惠
branches.question: 为什么有人愿意付钱帮助、惩罚他人或减少不平等？关键是最终分配，还是别人原本可以怎样行动？
branches.boundary: 一类模型观察物质收益分布；另一类还需要可行的替代行动及对对方意图的信念。实验可设计出分配相同但选择历史不同的情形。

papers.title: Incorporating Fairness into Game Theory and Economics
papers.note: 用对他人善意的判断及信念进入收益，给善意回报和报复以博弈论表示。
papers.noteEn: Beliefs and judgments about others' kindness enter payoffs, representing the desire to repay kindness or retaliate.

papers.title: A Theory of Fairness, Competition, and Cooperation
papers.note: 个人效用随自身物质收益增加，但受自己与他人之间有利及不利收益差距的影响。
papers.noteEn: Utility increases with one's own material payoff and responds to advantageous and disadvantageous payoff differences relative to others.

papers.title: ERC: A Theory of Equity, Reciprocity, and Competition
papers.note: 用自身物质收益与自身收益占群体总收益的份额刻画行为，将两人以外的分配比较写入模型。
papers.noteEn: Own payoff and its share of group payoff represent behavior and make distributional comparisons possible beyond two players.

papers.title: Understanding Social Preferences with Simple Tests
papers.note: 设计分配实验比较不平等厌恶、对总收益和低收益者的关心，以及互惠动机。
papers.noteEn: Allocation experiments compare inequality aversion, concern for total payoffs and for the worst off, and reciprocity.

papers.title: A Theory of Sequential Reciprocity
papers.note: 在扩展式博弈的不同历史上更新对善意的判断，刻画序贯互惠均衡。
papers.noteEn: Judgments of kindness are updated at histories of an extensive-form game, yielding a sequential reciprocity equilibrium.

papers.title: Giving According to GARP: An Experimental Test of the Consistency of Preferences for Altruism
papers.note: 改变转移给他人的价格，用广义显示偏好公理检验个体的给予能否由稳定的偏好解释。
papers.noteEn: Varying the price of a transfer tests whether individual giving is consistent with stable preferences under GARP.

papers.title: A Theory of Reciprocity
papers.note: 善意取决于分配后果和行动意图；回报或惩罚由对善意的评估决定。
papers.noteEn: Both consequences and intentions determine perceived kindness, which in turn motivates rewards or punishments.

papers.title: On the Nature of Fair Behavior
papers.authors: Armin Falk, Ernst Fehr & Urs Fischbacher
papers.note: 保持实际报价相同，只改变提议者本来能报什么；接受者的拒绝率随替代报价变化。
papers.noteEn: Holding an offer fixed while changing its foregone alternative changes rejection in a mini-ultimatum game.

papers.title: Individual Preferences for Giving
papers.authors: Raymond Fisman, Shachar Kariv & Daniel Markovits
papers.note: 用图形化预算反复观察个人分配，在涉及第三人时进一步区分给予动机和对他人间分配的关切。
papers.noteEn: Repeated graphical budget choices recover individual giving tradeoffs. A third recipient helps separate giving from concern about distribution among others.

papers.title: The Pluralism of Fairness Ideals: An Experimental Approach
papers.authors: Alexander W. Cappelen, Astri Drange Hole, Erik Ø. Sørensen & Bertil Tungodden
papers.note: 先让参与者投入生产再分配产出，用可选择的投入与外生生产率区分不同公平理想。
papers.noteEn: Production before allocation separates competing fairness ideals using chosen investments and exogenous productivity.

papers.title: Avoiding the Ask: A Field Experiment on Altruism, Empathy, and Charitable Giving
papers.authors: James Andreoni, Justin M. Rao & Hannah Trachtman
papers.note: 改变超市入口被募捐者接触的可能性，同时记录是否绕行与是否捐款。
papers.noteEn: Randomizing exposure to fundraisers at supermarket entrances measures both giving and avoidance.

papers.title: Just Luck: An Experimental Study of Risk-Taking and Fairness
papers.authors: Alexander W. Cappelen, James Konow, Erik Ø. Sørensen & Bertil Tungodden
papers.note: 让参与者决定如何在有过风险选择和实现结果的人之间分配，区分对事前机会与事后差距的关心。
papers.noteEn: Allocation after risky choices and outcomes distinguishes concern for ex ante opportunities from concern for ex post inequality.

papers.title: Exploiting Moral Wiggle Room: Experiments Demonstrating an Illusory Preference for Fairness
papers.authors: Jason Dana, Roberto A. Weber & Jason Xi Kuang
papers.note: 二元独裁者实验改变参与者是否知道行动给他人带来的结果，考察能否通过保持无知回避公平压力。
papers.noteEn: Binary dictator treatments vary knowledge of others' consequences, testing whether decision makers stay ignorant to avoid pressure to act fairly.

papers.title: Incentives and Prosocial Behavior
papers.note: 奖励使旁观者更难分辨善行出于利他还是逐利，从而可能挤出行为的声誉收益。
papers.noteEn: Rewards make altruism harder to distinguish from material self-interest, potentially crowding out the reputational return to helping.

papers.title: Dictating the Risk: Experimental Evidence on Giving in Risky Environments
papers.authors: J. Michelle Brock, Andreas Lange & Erkut Y. Ozbay
papers.note: 让独裁者分配不确定的支付；实验模式难以用只比较事前机会或只比较事后结果的单一准则概括。
papers.noteEn: Dictators allocate risky payments, producing patterns inconsistent with comparisons based exclusively on either ex ante chances or ex post outcomes.

edges.label: 从同时到序贯
edges.note: 把依赖对方意图的公平动机带入动态博弈，使一个后续行动可取决于先前历史。
edges.noteEn: Fairness motives that depend on intentions enter a dynamic game, allowing later actions to depend on earlier history.

edges.label: 比较参照对象
edges.note: 同属分配结果途径，但前者按对各他人的收益差计量，后者以自己在总收益中的份额为参照。
edges.noteEn: Both models use payoff distributions. One uses payoff differences relative to each other player, while the other uses one's share of total payoffs.

edges.label: 设计判别实验
edges.note: 使牺牲自己收益、缩小差距和提高最低收益产生不同选择，以区分竞争性解释。
edges.noteEn: Choices that distinguish sacrificing one's payoff, narrowing inequality, and increasing the lowest payoff separate competing explanations.

edges.label: 分离意图与结果
edges.note: 改变对方可选行动与先前行为，检验额外的互惠动机是否有助解释相同分配下的行为。
edges.noteEn: Varying another player's opportunities and earlier behavior tests whether reciprocity helps explain choices over otherwise identical allocations.

edges.label: 从指定效用到预算检验
edges.note: 给自己的钱和给他人的钱面对相对价格时，可先检验稳定偏好，再比较具体公平模型。
edges.labelEn: From specified utility to budget tests
edges.noteEn: Relative prices for own and others' payoffs permit testing consistency before imposing a particular fairness model.

edges.label: 把后果并入意图判断
edges.note: 相同结果若来自不同可行选择，可诱发不同互惠反应，分配差异也进入比较。
edges.noteEn: The same outcome can elicit different reciprocal responses across opportunity sets, while distributional differences also matter.

edges.label: 单独操纵可选意图
edges.note: 改变未被选择的报价让同一分配传递不同善意，从而可检验信念依赖的公平动机。
edges.noteEn: Changing the unchosen offer makes identical allocations convey different intentions, testing belief-dependent fairness.

edges.label: 从组间均值到个人偏好
edges.note: 为同一人提供多条预算线，可进一步识别分配效率与平等之间的个人取舍。
edges.noteEn: Multiple budgets per person reveal individual tradeoffs between equality and distributional efficiency.

edges.label: 引入所得的来源
edges.note: 同样的总收益可由努力或外生生产率产生，因而提供单纯分配题没有的公平比较。
edges.noteEn: The same surplus can reflect effort or exogenous productivity, creating fairness comparisons absent in pure allocation tasks.

edges.label: 观察是否进入分配情境
edges.note: 即使面对面时会给钱，有人仍愿意绕行；是否回避请求为仅看分配结果的模型提供新观察。
edges.noteEn: A person may give when asked yet avoid being asked. Avoidance supplies an observation unavailable from final allocations alone.

edges.label: 把风险来源写进权利判断
edges.labelEn: Introducing the source of risk into entitlements
edges.note: 同一收入差距可能源于选择了不同风险，也可能源于同样风险下的运气，使公平观可进一步区分。
edges.noteEn: The same income gap can reflect different risks chosen or different realizations of the same risk, separating fairness views.

edges.label: 让信息本身可回避
edges.note: 分配时的慷慨与是否愿意知道分配后果是两种观察，有助于辨认公平动机。
edges.noteEn: Giving under transparency and willingness to learn consequences provide separate evidence about fairness motives.

edges.label: 从判断他人到被他人判断
edges.labelEn: From interpreting others to being interpreted
edges.note: 关注点由他人的善意转向他人如何解释自己的动机，改变激励政策的预测。
edges.noteEn: Shifting attention to how observers interpret one's motives changes the predicted effect of material incentives.

edges.label: 把确定收益换成彩票
edges.note: 面向确定分配的不平等厌恶未回答如何评价相同期望而风险分布不同的转移。
edges.noteEn: Inequality aversion over certain allocations leaves open how to evaluate transfers with equal means but different payoff risk.

resources.title: Social Preferences: Fundamental Characteristics and Economic Consequences

branches.questionEn: Why pay to help or punish others or to reduce inequality? Do people respond to the final allocation or to what others could have done?
branches.boundaryEn: Some models use the distribution of material payoffs. Others also require feasible alternatives and beliefs about intentions. Experiments can hold the final allocation fixed while varying its history.

branches.name: 错误信念、反馈与模型错设
branches.question: 如果真实环境不在决策者考虑的模型中，长期观测能纠正什么？行动本身会改变哪些证据能被看到？
branches.boundary: 模型族排除真相、路径外事件未被观测是两种不同的信息障碍。仅有错误预测并不足以判定发生了哪一种。

papers.title: Limiting Behavior of Posterior Distributions when the Model is Incorrect
papers.note: 在独立同分布等条件下研究真相不在模型中时的后验集中；极限可集中在最佳逼近的集合而非单一点。
papers.noteEn: Under conditions including independent, identically distributed observations, a misspecified posterior can concentrate on a set of best approximations rather than a single point.

papers.title: Self-Confirming Equilibrium
papers.note: 参与者可以在自己实际观察到的路径上预测正确，同时对未观察到的行动保留错误信念。
papers.noteEn: Players can predict correctly along the paths they observe while retaining mistaken beliefs about unobserved actions.

papers.title: Berk–Nash Equilibrium: A Framework for Modeling Agents With Misspecified Models
papers.note: 策略对主观信念最优，同时信念支持集中于在均衡行为产生的数据下加权相对熵最小的参数。
papers.noteEn: Strategies optimize given subjective beliefs, whose support minimizes weighted relative entropy under the data generated by equilibrium behavior.

papers.title: Active Learning with a Misspecified Prior
papers.authors: Drew Fudenberg · Gleb Romanyuk · Philipp Strack
papers.note: 在连续时间学习模型中研究行动选择与信息获取相互作用时，错设先验下的长期信念和行为。
papers.noteEn: In continuous time, actions and information acquisition interact to determine long-run beliefs and behavior under a misspecified prior.

papers.title: Unrealistic Expectations and Misguided Learning
papers.authors: Paul Heidhues · Botond Kőszegi · Philipp Strack
papers.note: 个体坚持对自身能力的错误信念，可能把行动反馈错误归因于环境，并让行动与错误解释彼此强化。
papers.noteEn: A persistent mistaken belief about one's ability can misattribute feedback to the environment, causing actions and mistaken explanations to reinforce each other.

papers.title: Cursed Equilibrium
papers.role: 低估行动与类型的相关性
papers.note: 参与者预测对手行动的边际分布，却低估这些行动与对方私有信息的相关程度。
papers.noteEn: Players predict opponents' marginal action distributions but underestimate their correlation with opponents' private information.

papers.title: Behavioral Equilibrium in Economies with Adverse Selection
papers.note: 在逆向选择环境中用行动所产生的反馈约束信念，区分能推断选择效应的参与者与忽略它的参与者。
papers.noteEn: In adverse-selection environments, feedback disciplines beliefs differently for agents who understand selection and those who neglect it.

papers.title: Bayesian Networks and Boundedly Rational Expectations
papers.note: 个体依照一个主观有向无环图分解长期数据的联合分布，错误因果结构会产生系统性预测偏差。
papers.noteEn: A subjective directed acyclic graph factorizes the long-run joint distribution, with a mistaken graph inducing systematic predictions.

papers.title: Equilibrium in Misspecified Markov Decision Processes
papers.note: 决策者用有误的受控转移模型评价当前行动；长期状态与行动频率决定哪组主观转移最符合经验。
papers.noteEn: A misspecified controlled transition model guides actions, while long-run state-action frequencies determine which subjective transitions best fit experience.

papers.title: Limit Points of Endogenous Misspecified Learning
papers.authors: Drew Fudenberg, Giacomo Lanzani & Philipp Strack
papers.note: 给出内生数据与错设先验下长期结果的必要条件，并证明某些严格均衡在适当初始信念下可高概率出现。
papers.noteEn: Provides necessary conditions on long-run outcomes under endogenous misspecified learning and high-probability attainability results for uniformly strict equilibria.

papers.title: Misinterpreting Others and the Fragility of Social Learning
papers.authors: Mira Frick, Ryota Iijima & Yuhta Ishii
papers.note: 参与者从他人行动学习时，对人群组成的微小误判可能改变长期学习结果。
papers.noteEn: Small errors about population composition can change long-run outcomes when agents learn from others' actions.

papers.title: Belief Convergence under Misspecified Learning: A Martingale Approach
papers.authors: Mira Frick, Ryota Iijima & Yuhta Ishii
papers.note: 排列主观模型的预测精度，使部分鞅收敛论证可用于真实模型不在支持集内的学习环境。
papers.noteEn: An order on the predictive accuracy of subjective models recovers martingale arguments in learning environments that exclude the truth.

papers.title: Learning and Model Validation
papers.note: 决策者用当前模型制定政策，定期检验模型是否失配，拒绝后再换模型；论文研究哪个模型长期占主导。
papers.noteEn: An agent using a model for policy tests its specification and switches models upon rejection. The analysis characterizes long-run model dominance.

papers.title: Overconfidence and Prejudice
papers.authors: Paul Heidhues, Botond Kőszegi & Philipp Strack
papers.note: 对自身能力过度自信的人同时解释多个群体的成就时，模型预测系统性的内群体偏向。
papers.noteEn: An overconfident learner interpreting achievements across multiple groups develops systematic in-group bias in the model.

papers.title: Mislearning from Censored Data: The Gambler's Fallacy and Other Correlational Mistakes in Optimal-Stopping Problems
papers.note: 好结果出现后便停止，使往届记录只留下特定连续序列；赌徒谬误会将这种选择性误解为未来抽样更差。
papers.noteEn: Stopping after good draws censors histories. Learners expecting systematic reversals interpret the selected sequences too pessimistically.

edges.label: 让数据由行动产生
edges.note: 当行动影响所见样本时，用策略诱导的观察频率加权概率模型的拟合误差。
edges.noteEn: When actions determine the sample, observation frequencies induced by strategy weight the model's fitting errors.

edges.label: 容许路径内也错
edges.note: 模型族受限时，再多路径内数据也未必能被精确拟合，最优逼近取代完全匹配。
edges.noteEn: A restricted model may fail to fit even abundant on-path data, so best approximation replaces exact matching.

edges.label: 从被动到主动
edges.note: 选择者可以改变接下来的数据生成过程，后验的长期表现和实验决策须一起分析。
edges.noteEn: A decision maker can change the next data-generating process, requiring long-run beliefs and experimentation to be analyzed together.

edges.label: 落实一类错设
edges.note: 对自身能力的错误确信给出具体错设来源，由行动产生的反馈使人对外部基本面形成系统性偏见。
edges.noteEn: A mistaken conviction about one's ability supplies a concrete misspecification. Action-generated feedback then distorts beliefs about external fundamentals.

edges.label: 区分错误出现的位置
edges.note: 即使观察到的行动频率正确，行动所揭示的类型信息仍可能被系统低估。
edges.noteEn: Correct action frequencies can coexist with a systematic underestimation of what actions reveal about types.

edges.label: 内生样本选择
edges.note: 交易是否发生取决于对方掌握的信息，实际成交样本因而限制参与者能学到的内容。
edges.noteEn: Whether trade occurs depends on private information, making the sample of transactions selective.

edges.label: 限制因果解释
edges.note: 即使客观数据很丰富，错用条件独立关系也会使因果预测出错。
edges.noteEn: Even rich data can generate mistaken causal predictions when the agent imposes incorrect conditional independences.

edges.label: 由静态结果到转移概率
edges.note: 把一次行动的结果分布改为受控马尔可夫转移，使当前行为也改变未来的取样环境。
edges.noteEn: Replacing a one-shot outcome distribution by controlled Markov transitions makes actions change future sampling conditions.

edges.label: 区分均衡和学习极限
edges.note: 均衡的一致性条件尚未说明学习能否到达它；稳定性与初始信念给出进一步限制。
edges.noteEn: Equilibrium consistency alone does not establish learning convergence. Stability and initial beliefs further restrict attainable outcomes.

edges.label: 误认他人改变社会学习
edges.note: 用错设模型解释观察到的行为时，学习偏差可经由他人随后采取的行动反复传递。
edges.noteEn: When observed actions are interpreted through a misspecified model, later actions propagate the resulting learning error.

edges.label: 从固定样本到多类学习
edges.labelEn: From fixed sampling to varied learning environments
edges.note: 后验集中问题可通过比较候选模型的相对预测精度处理，包括个体学习与社会学习。
edges.noteEn: Comparing relative accuracy among candidate models gives convergence criteria for both individual and social learning.

edges.label: 允许学习者主动换模型
edges.labelEn: Allowing the learner to switch models
edges.note: 除在固定模型族内更新权重外，逐步检验与替换模型也能塑造长期决策。
edges.noteEn: Sequential testing and replacement add a path to long-run behavior distinct from updating weights within a fixed model.

edges.label: 从能力错设到社会判断
edges.note: 把自己与他人的观测成绩共同用于学习，固定的能力误判便会扭曲对群体的评价。
edges.noteEn: When own and others' successes jointly inform beliefs, a fixed mistake about ability distorts judgments about groups.

edges.label: 让收集证据的时点内生
edges.note: 当事人的停止规则决定后人能否看到下一次抽取，继而放大对跨期相关性的错判。
edges.noteEn: Predecessors' stopping determines whether the next draw is observed, amplifying errors about intertemporal correlation.

resources.title: Misspecified Models in Learning and Games
resources.authors: J. Aislinn Bohren · Daniel N. Hauser

branches.questionEn: When the true environment lies outside the models under consideration, what can long-run observations correct, and how do actions shape the evidence available?
branches.boundaryEn: Excluding the truth from the model class and failing to observe off-path events are distinct informational obstacles. A mistaken forecast alone does not distinguish them.

branches.name: 理性忽视与内生考虑集
branches.en: Rational inattention and endogenous consideration sets
branches.question: 当处理信息有机会成本，人会主动忽略哪些差别？只观察状态与行动，能否区分有成本的最优注意与任意的选择错误？
branches.boundary: 决策者自己选择信息。香农互信息只是成本的一种形式；一般成本的显示偏好检验、广义 logit 和内生考虑集的结论各有适用条件。

papers.title: Implications of Rational Inattention
papers.note: 以有限的信息处理容量约束决策，让主体有选择地追踪经济状态，推导最优行为可能呈现迟滞与平滑反应。
papers.noteEn: A capacity constraint makes agents track economic states selectively. Optimal behavior can exhibit delays and smoothed responses.

papers.title: Rational Inattention to Discrete Choices: A New Foundation for the Multinomial Logit Model
papers.note: 在香农信息成本下推出广义 logit 形式，选择概率既受实际收益影响，也受取决于先验和整个菜单的无条件选择权重影响。
papers.noteEn: Shannon information costs yield generalized logit probabilities that depend on realized payoffs and unconditional choice weights determined by the prior and the full menu.

papers.title: Revealed Preference, Rational Inattention, and Costly Information Acquisition
papers.note: 刻画哪些跨决策问题的状态依赖随机选择可以被某种有成本的最优信息获取解释，并界定可由这些选择恢复的信息成本。
papers.noteEn: Characterizes state-dependent stochastic choices across decision problems that can be explained by optimal costly information acquisition, and bounds the information costs recoverable from choice.

papers.title: Rational Inattention, Optimal Consideration Sets, and Stochastic Choice
papers.authors: Andrew Caplin · Mark Dean · John Leahy
papers.note: 在理性忽视模型中刻画何时某个选项在所有状态下都以零概率被选择，以及收益、先验和其余备选项如何共同决定考虑集。
papers.noteEn: Characterizes when an option has zero choice probability in every state and how payoffs, priors, and the other alternatives determine the consideration set.

papers.title: Information-Constrained State-Dependent Pricing
papers.note: 企业凭关于收益状态的不精确信息决定何时复查价格，信息成本改变价格调整出现的时间。
papers.noteEn: A firm uses an imprecise assessment of its payoff state when deciding whether to review prices, so information costs affect adjustment timing.

papers.title: Rationally Inattentive Seller: Sales and Discrete Pricing
papers.note: 卖家观察单位成本的能力有限；最优反应可能只使用少数价格，即使不存在调价成本。
papers.noteEn: Limited information about unit costs can make a small set of prices optimal even without adjustment costs.

papers.title: Rationally Inattentive Behavior: Characterizing and Generalizing Shannon Entropy
papers.authors: Andrew Caplin, Mark Dean & John Leahy
papers.note: 用局部后验不变性等行为条件区分几种后验可分成本，刻画香农成本的推广。
papers.noteEn: Behavioral conditions including locally invariant posteriors distinguish classes of posterior-separable costs generalizing Shannon entropy.

papers.title: Posterior Separable Cost of Information
papers.note: 刻画可被不确定性度量的期望下降解释的信息成本，给出从选择非参数识别与估计成本的方法。
papers.noteEn: Characterizes costs equal to the expected reduction of an uncertainty measure and shows how to identify and estimate them from choices.

papers.title: Discrete Choice and Rational Inattention: A General Equivalence Result
papers.authors: Mogens Fosgerau, Emerson Melo, André de Palma & Matthew Shum
papers.note: 对给定先验，适当的广义信息成本可以生成加性随机效用离散选择模型的概率。
papers.noteEn: For a given prior, suitable generalized information costs reproduce probabilities from additive random utility models.

papers.title: Rational Inattention When Decisions Take Time
papers.note: 令决策者动态积累证据并选择停止时间，使反应时与选择概率共同反映信息处理成本。
papers.noteEn: Dynamic evidence accumulation links stopping times and choice probabilities to the costs of precise decisions.

papers.title: Optimal Sticky Prices under Rational Inattention
papers.roleEn: Attention to idiosyncratic and aggregate shocks
papers.note: 定价企业在总量和自身冲击间分配有限注意，由此可以对个体变化反应迅速、对总量变化反应迟缓。
papers.noteEn: Price setters allocate scarce attention across aggregate and idiosyncratic shocks, permitting fast idiosyncratic but slow aggregate adjustment.

papers.title: Rational Inattention Dynamics: Inertia and Delay in Decision-Making
papers.authors: Jakub Steiner, Colin Stewart & Filip Matějka
papers.note: 对不断变化的状态重复购买信息时，最优随机行动偏向只依赖既往行动历史的默认规则。
papers.noteEn: Repeated costly learning about an evolving state biases optimal choices toward a default rule depending only on past actions.

papers.title: Coordination with Flexible Information Acquisition
papers.note: 协调博弈的参与者自行选择信息的数量与种类，熵成本因而也影响他们追踪基本面的哪些特征。
papers.noteEn: Players in a coordination game choose both the amount and the type of information, so entropy costs shape which features of fundamentals they track.

papers.title: Optimal Inattention to the Stock Market with Information Costs and Transactions Costs
papers.authors: Andrew B. Abel, Janice C. Eberly & Stavros Panageas
papers.note: 观察财富有成本，在消费账户与投资账户间调拨资金也有成本，最优策略因此可包含规律性的不查看区间。
papers.noteEn: With costs of observing wealth and moving funds between a consumption account and a portfolio, recurrent intervals without observation can be optimal.

edges.label: 将带宽约束用于离散选择
edges.note: 把信息处理的收益成本权衡落到有限菜单上的行动概率，得到不同于简单固定权重 logit 的限制。
edges.noteEn: The cost-benefit tradeoff in processing information restricts choice probabilities over a finite menu beyond a logit with fixed weights.
edges.labelEn: Applying a capacity constraint to discrete choice

edges.label: 从规定成本到检验成本存在
edges.note: 不预先指定一条香农成本曲线，改用多次选择的数据检验是否存在一种信息成本可将这些选择合理化。
edges.noteEn: Data from multiple decisions test whether some information cost rationalizes observed choice without imposing a Shannon specification in advance.
edges.labelEn: From specifying costs to testing their existence

edges.label: 研究零概率选项
edges.note: 进一步研究哪些备选项的无条件权重为零，将菜单筛选作为最优注意配置的内生结果。
edges.noteEn: Zero unconditional weights make menu screening an endogenous consequence of optimal attention allocation.

edges.label: 将注意配置用于复查
edges.note: 有限注意直接影响是否检查现价，使调价频率成为模型预测。
edges.noteEn: Limited awareness governs whether the current price is reviewed, making adjustment frequency an outcome.

edges.label: 解释离散价格
edges.note: 信息容量限制直接约束对成本冲击的反应，产生有别于机械调价成本的离散性。
edges.noteEn: A capacity constraint restricts responses to cost shocks and can produce discrete prices without mechanical adjustment frictions.

edges.label: 由成本存在到成本形状
edges.note: 不同决策问题之间的后验变化，能检验共同成本函数还具备哪些限制。
edges.noteEn: Posterior responses across decision problems test further restrictions on the common information cost.

edges.label: 检验一个特定的成本表示
edges.note: 可由某种成本合理化的选择未必满足后验可分性；后者带来额外且可检验的行为条件。
edges.noteEn: Rationalization by some cost does not imply posterior separability, which adds testable restrictions.

edges.label: 超越香农与 logit
edges.note: 把香农成本下的多项 logit 等价推广到更广的成本与随机效用组合。
edges.noteEn: The Shannon-logit correspondence expands to a larger family of information costs and random utility specifications.

edges.label: 从行动概率到反应时
edges.note: 在状态依赖的选择之外，看到作答耗时可进一步约束积累证据的过程。
edges.labelEn: From choice probabilities to response times
edges.noteEn: Observing decision times as well as state-dependent choices places further restrictions on evidence accumulation.

edges.label: 让冲击争夺同一容量
edges.note: 信道容量有限不仅影响反应速度，还决定哪些类型的变化得到更精确的追踪。
edges.noteEn: A shared capacity constraint determines which shocks are tracked precisely, in addition to the speed of response.

edges.label: 让今天的行动成为明天的历史
edges.labelEn: Making current actions part of future history
edges.note: 静态的无条件行动权重被依赖历史的默认规则取代，因而可产生惯性与延迟。
edges.noteEn: A history-dependent default generalizes static unconditional action weights, producing inertia and delayed adjustment.

edges.label: 引入协调收益
edges.note: 最值得了解的信号可能取决于其他人关注什么，使注意配置本身成为博弈的一部分。
edges.noteEn: What is worth learning can depend on others' attention, making information acquisition part of the strategic interaction.

edges.label: 把查看成本与调仓成本分开
edges.note: 即使观测后可以选择不交易，获知财富状态本身仍可能有成本，这改变注意和交易的时间安排。
edges.noteEn: Learning one's wealth can be costly even without trading afterward, changing the timing of both attention and portfolio adjustment.

resources.title: Rational Inattention: A Review
resources.authors: Bartosz Maćkowiak · Filip Matějka · Mirko Wiederholt

branches.questionEn: When processing information has an opportunity cost, which distinctions are optimally ignored? Can states and actions distinguish costly optimal attention from arbitrary mistakes?
branches.boundaryEn: The decision maker chooses information. Shannon mutual information is one specification. Revealed preference tests for general costs, generalized logit, and endogenous consideration each require their own assumptions.

branches.name: 未曾设想的可能与意识扩展
branches.question: 如果决策者连某种情况可能发生都没有想到，应该怎样描述她的选择、信念和与他人的互动？
branches.boundary: 风险和模糊通常以决策者已能描述的状态集合为起点。不知晓允许不同参与者使用不同表达空间；意识增长进一步要求连接发现前后的选择行为。

papers.title: Awareness and Partitional Information Structures
papers.note: 以意识及其逻辑性质检验标准信息分割，研究对一个命题及其否定的意识应满足什么一致性。
papers.noteEn: Uses awareness and its logical properties to test standard information partitions and asks how awareness of a proposition should relate to awareness of its negation.

papers.title: Standard State-Space Models Preclude Unawareness
papers.authors: Eddie Dekel · Barton L. Lipman · Aldo Rustichini
papers.note: 在标准状态空间上，若知识和未意识到事件的算子满足一组看似温和的公理，就无法表示有实质内容的不知晓。
papers.noteEn: On a standard state space, apparently mild axioms on knowledge and unawareness operators preclude a nontrivial representation of unawareness.

papers.title: Interactive Unawareness
papers.authors: Aviad Heifetz · Martin Meier · Burkhard C. Schipper
papers.note: 采用按表达能力组织的多个状态空间及其投影，建立能同时描述多人不同层次意识和知识的模型。
papers.noteEn: Several state spaces ordered by expressive power, with projections between them, represent different agents' levels of awareness and knowledge.

papers.title: Unawareness, Beliefs, and Speculative Trade
papers.authors: Aviad Heifetz · Martin Meier · Burkhard C. Schipper
papers.note: 把概率信念嵌入互动不知晓结构，显示仅有共同先验不足以排除所有状态下的投机交易，并给出推广的无投机条件。
papers.noteEn: Adding beliefs to interactive unawareness shows why a common prior alone need not exclude speculative trade at all states and yields extended no-trade conditions.

papers.title: “Reverse Bayesianism”: A Choice-Based Theory of Growing Awareness
papers.note: 从可选行动的集合扩张和跨阶段偏好的公理出发，研究当新的可能性进入视野时，主观概率如何调整。
papers.noteEn: Axioms on expanding sets of acts and preferences across stages characterize adjustments to subjective probabilities as new possibilities come to mind.

papers.title: Belief, Awareness, and Limited Reasoning
papers.note: 将意识算子与信念算子分开，使主体可以不能显性相信所有逻辑后果。
papers.noteEn: Separate awareness and belief operators allow agents to lack explicit belief in all logical consequences.

papers.title: Alternative Semantics for Unawareness
papers.note: 比较不同不知晓模型的语义，说明改变语言解释怎样影响意识公理和信息分割能否共存。
papers.noteEn: Compares semantics for unawareness and shows how the interpretation of formulas affects compatibility with partitional information.

papers.title: Interactive Unawareness Revisited
papers.authors: Joseph Y. Halpern & Leandro Chaves Rêgo
papers.note: 对互动不知晓模型给出对应不同有效性概念的公理化，并与另外两种意识语义比较。
papers.noteEn: Two axiomatizations for different notions of validity compare interactive unawareness with alternative awareness semantics.

papers.title: Inductive Reasoning about Unawareness
papers.note: 行动者可根据过去的发现或其他人的局限，归纳推断仍有未想到的可能性。
papers.noteEn: Past discoveries and other players' limitations provide inductive support for the possibility of one's own unawareness.

papers.title: Games with Unawareness
papers.note: 用一组标准博弈描述每个参与者看见什么规则、又认为别人看见什么，定义相应的扩展均衡。
papers.noteEn: A collection of standard games represents each player's perceived rules and perceptions of others, supporting an extended equilibrium concept.

papers.title: Awareness of Unawareness: A Theory of Decision Making in the Face of Ignorance
papers.note: 个体可以预见未来会发现后果，却不能说出那些后果是什么；选择揭示其主观发现概率。
papers.noteEn: Decision makers can anticipate discovering consequences they cannot describe, with choices revealing subjective discovery probabilities.

papers.title: Unawareness and Partitional Information Structures
papers.note: 构造允许参与者不能完整描述所有状态的信息模型，回应早期标准知识分割难以容纳部分不知晓的问题。
papers.noteEn: An information model lets agents lack a complete description of states, addressing the difficulty of representing partial unawareness in ordinary partitions.

papers.title: Dynamic Unawareness and Rationalizable Behavior
papers.authors: Aviad Heifetz, Martin Meier & Burkhard C. Schipper
papers.role: 可设想行动与动态推理
papers.note: 在参与者对行动可能不具备相同意识的扩展式博弈中定义并证明某种扩展式可理性化行为存在。
papers.noteEn: Defines extensive-form rationalizability and establishes existence in generalized games whose players can differ in awareness of actions.

papers.title: Discovery and Equilibrium in Games with Unawareness
papers.note: 行动中发现新选项会改变参与者心中的博弈；论文构造发现过程，研究何时抵达自我证实的博弈。
papers.noteEn: Discovering an action changes the perceived game. A discovery process characterizes how play can reach a self-confirming game.

papers.title: Awareness-Dependent Subjective Expected Utility
papers.role: 不知晓事件的选择检验
papers.note: 在分层意识空间上建立主观期望效用表示，并说明未意识事件与其否定可同时在选择中呈现为空。
papers.noteEn: Builds subjective expected utility on awareness structures and characterizes unawareness by an event and its negation both being behaviorally null.

edges.label: 一般化表示限制
edges.note: 对知识分割的困难进一步提升为标准状态空间的一组公理之间的不相容。
edges.noteEn: Difficulties with information partitions become an incompatibility among axioms on a standard state space.

edges.label: 更换状态空间
edges.note: 用表达程度不同且彼此关联的空间避开单一标准状态空间的表示障碍。
edges.noteEn: Linked spaces with different degrees of expressiveness circumvent the representational limits of a single standard space.

edges.label: 引入概率和交易
edges.note: 在互动意识结构上加入概率信念，重新检验共同先验和无投机交易命题。
edges.noteEn: Probability beliefs in an interactive awareness structure allow common-prior and no-speculation results to be reconsidered.

edges.label: 比较研究对象
edges.note: 表示多人对哪些事可设想，与从一个人发现新可能前后的选择刻画信念变化，分别提供互动和行为两种视角。
edges.noteEn: Modeling what interacting agents can conceive provides one perspective. Characterizing an individual's beliefs from choices before and after discovery provides another.

edges.label: 比较意识与知识
edges.note: 把逻辑上的可表达性与信息分割里的知识区分开，才可询问何种分割能描述不知晓。
edges.noteEn: Separating logical awareness from partitional knowledge makes it meaningful to ask which partitions can represent unawareness.

edges.label: 改变对公式的解释
edges.note: 原有分割的困难可通过明确哪些公式在某个世界有意义来重新分析。
edges.noteEn: Which formulas are meaningful at a world changes how the partitional representation problem is analyzed.

edges.label: 分辨有效性的定义
edges.note: 同一互动结构中，改变公式的有效性标准会改变能够得到的公理系统。
edges.noteEn: Changing validity within an interactive structure changes its corresponding axiomatization.

edges.label: 从描述到归纳
edges.note: 跨人和跨时点的意识差异提供证据，使人能推断自己还有未知，而不必列举它们。
edges.noteEn: Differences across people and dates let agents infer the existence of unknown possibilities without naming them.

edges.label: 引入策略和行动
edges.note: 将不同表达空间中的意识差异落实到可感知的策略集合，便可比较均衡行为。
edges.noteEn: Differences in awareness become differences in perceived strategic possibilities with equilibrium consequences.

edges.label: 把预期的发现带入当前选择
edges.note: 研究对象从实际发现后的更新，延伸至发现尚未发生时如何评价选项。
edges.labelEn: Bringing anticipated discovery into current choice
edges.noteEn: The object extends from updating after an actual discovery to evaluating acts before a possible discovery.

edges.label: 使可描述内容因状态而异
edges.labelEn: Allowing descriptions to vary by state
edges.note: 保留分割式信息的部分结构，同时明确一件事在哪些状态可以被谈及。
edges.noteEn: The construction preserves aspects of partitional information while specifying where a proposition can be expressed.

edges.label: 在树上追踪可设想的行动
edges.labelEn: Tracking conceivable actions through a game tree
edges.note: 只有当参与者能设想某次偏离时，基于该偏离的序贯推理才有意义。
edges.noteEn: Sequential reasoning based on a deviation requires that the player can conceive of that deviation.

edges.label: 让博弈本身随经验变化
edges.labelEn: Allowing experience to change the perceived game
edges.note: 即使行为在当前认知下最优，一次发现也可能使这一博弈不再是下一轮的环境。
edges.noteEn: An action that is optimal in today's perceived game can reveal a possibility that changes tomorrow's game.

edges.label: 把逻辑意识映射为选择
edges.note: 偏好对事件和其补集的敏感性提供了可观察线索，单看事件概率为零则不足以区分。
edges.noteEn: Sensitivity of preferences to an event and its complement provides evidence that assigning zero probability to the event alone cannot supply.

branches.questionEn: If a decision maker has not conceived of a possibility, how should we describe her choices, beliefs, and interactions with others?
branches.boundaryEn: Risk and ambiguity usually start from states the decision maker can describe. Unawareness permits different expressive spaces across agents. Growing awareness links choices made before and after a discovery.

branches.name: 参照依赖、损失厌恶与禀赋效应
branches.en: Reference dependence and the endowment effect
branches.question: 为什么同一件物品，持有者愿意接受的卖价会高于买家愿意支付的价格？所有权和预期分别起什么作用？
branches.boundary: 围绕确定性消费束、交换与估值展开；预期可以是结果的概率分布。风险彩票的概率加权另见风险选择分支。

papers.title: Toward a Positive Theory of Consumer Choice
papers.note: 从放弃已有物品与错过购买机会的区别出发，解释为何相同金额的实际支出和机会成本可能得到不同权重。
papers.noteEn: Distinguishing giving up an owned object from forgoing a purchase can explain why equal out-of-pocket and opportunity costs receive different weights.

papers.title: Experimental Tests of the Endowment Effect and the Coase Theorem
papers.authors: Daniel Kahneman, Jack L. Knetsch & Richard H. Thaler
papers.note: 随机分配杯子后，交易量低于无摩擦基准；作为对照，具有实验指定价值的代币实现了预期交易量。
papers.noteEn: After mugs are randomly endowed, trading falls short of the frictionless benchmark. In a control, tokens with induced values trade at the predicted volume.

papers.title: Loss Aversion in Riskless Choice: A Reference-Dependent Model
papers.note: 把每种属性的变化相对于参照点计量，同幅损失比收益更重要；移动参照点可以逆转两个确定性消费束的排序。
papers.noteEn: Each attribute is evaluated relative to a reference point, with losses mattering more than equal gains. Moving the reference can reverse the ranking of deterministic bundles.

papers.title: The Willingness to Pay-Willingness to Accept Gap, the "Endowment Effect," Subject Misconceptions, and Experimental Procedures for Eliciting Valuations
papers.note: 结合匿名、训练与激励相容的估值程序，在其杯子实验中没有检出显著买卖价差，提示机制理解也会改变测量结果。
papers.noteEn: With anonymity, training, and incentive-compatible elicitation, the mug experiments find no significant valuation gap, suggesting that understanding the mechanism also matters.

papers.title: A Model of Reference-Dependent Preferences
papers.note: 用近期对结果的理性预期作为参照分布；个人均衡要求给定预期的最优选择能够实现这些预期。
papers.noteEn: Recent rational expectations about outcomes supply the reference distribution. Personal equilibrium requires optimal behavior given expectations to realize those expectations.

papers.title: Expectations as Endowments: Evidence on Reference-Dependent Preferences from Exchange and Valuation Experiments
papers.authors: Keith M. Marzilli Ericson & Andreas Fuster
papers.note: 保持最初持有物不变，随机改变以后获得交换机会的概率；预期较少有机会交换的人更常保留最初的物品。
papers.noteEn: Holding the original endowment fixed, the experiment varies the probability of a later exchange opportunity. Those less likely to be able to trade more often keep their endowment.

papers.title: The Endowment Effect and Evidence of Nonreversible Indifference Curves
papers.note: 随机赋予不同实物后，多数参与者保留原物；交换方向影响可由观察推断的物物估值。
papers.noteEn: Most participants keep their randomly assigned good, so inferred valuations depend on the direction of exchange.

papers.title: Does Market Experience Eliminate Market Anomalies?
papers.note: 在真实交易场所比较交易经验不同的参与者；更丰富经验与较弱的禀赋效应相关，实验进一步考察经验的作用。
papers.noteEn: Field-market comparisons link greater trading experience to weaker endowment effects, with experiments probing the role of experience.

papers.title: Reference-Dependent Risk Attitudes
papers.note: 把预期依赖的得失效用用于货币彩票，分析选择与后果之间的时间如何改变小额风险态度。
papers.noteEn: Expectations-based gain-loss utility applied to monetary gambles explains how timing between choice and outcomes affects modest-stakes risk attitudes.

papers.title: Reference Points and Effort Provision
papers.authors: Johannes Abeler, Armin Falk, Lorenz Goette & David Huffman
papers.note: 操纵参与者对最终报酬的预期，检验在真实努力任务上选择何时停止工作会否随预期改变。
papers.noteEn: A real-effort experiment manipulates expected earnings to test whether expectations shift the decision to stop working.

papers.title: A Structural Analysis of Disappointment Aversion in a Real Effort Competition
papers.note: 在顺序真实努力竞赛中，用对手努力对后来者的劝退作用检验并估计预期参照下的失望厌恶。
papers.noteEn: A sequential real-effort tournament uses discouragement by a rival's effort to test and estimate expectations-based disappointment aversion.

papers.title: Is the Endowment Effect an Expectations Effect?
papers.note: 分别操纵物品指派与经测量的预期；在这些实验中，指派能改变选择，预期的解释力较小。
papers.roleEn: Experimental limits of the expectations account
papers.noteEn: Separating assignment from elicited beliefs, these experiments find effects of assignment and a limited role for expectations.

papers.title: Loss Aversion and Seller Behavior: Evidence from the Housing Market
papers.role: 住房出售中的参考价格
papers.note: 波士顿公寓的买入价高于当前估值时，业主往往要价更高，成交也更慢。
papers.noteEn: Boston condominium owners facing a nominal loss relative to their purchase price set higher asking prices and sell more slowly.

papers.title: New York City Cab Drivers' Labor Supply Revisited: Reference-Dependent Preferences with Rational-Expectations Targets for Hours and Income
papers.note: 纽约出租车司机每趟结束后的停工决策，同时受其预期工时和收入目标影响。
papers.noteEn: A model of New York cabdrivers’ stopping decisions allows expected hours and expected income to serve as separate reference points.

papers.title: Is Tiger Woods Loss Averse? Persistent Bias in the Face of Experience, Competition, and High Stakes
papers.authors: Devin G. Pope & Maurice E. Schweitzer
papers.role: 职业高尔夫中的损失规避
papers.note: 控制推杆位置等因素后，职业球员为保标准杆而推的进球率高于争取小鸟球时的进球率。
papers.noteEn: Conditional on putting position and other factors, professional golfers make par putts more often than birdie putts.

papers.title: Do Workers Work More if Wages Are High? Evidence from a Randomized Field Experiment
papers.roleEn: Temporary pay and effort within shifts
papers.note: 随机临时加薪使自行车信使多上班，但每班投递努力下降；文中检验了收入目标这一解释。
papers.noteEn: A randomized temporary wage increase raises the number of shifts bicycle messengers work but lowers effort per shift. The authors investigate income targeting as an explanation.

edges.label: 将禀赋随机化
edges.note: 随机决定谁先得到杯子，并比较真实消费品与指定价值代币的成交量，让持有状态产生可观察的预测。
edges.noteEn: Random assignment of mugs and a comparison with induced-value tokens yield observable predictions about ownership and trading volume.

edges.label: 把得失写入偏好
edges.note: 将相对持有状态的得失扩展成多属性消费束上的参照依赖，使不同起点下的选择反转有了正式表示。
edges.noteEn: Gains and losses relative to a holding become reference dependence over multiattribute bundles, formally representing choice reversals across starting points.
edges.labelEn: Incorporating gains and losses into preferences

edges.label: 检验程序解释
edges.note: 买卖价差还可能随参与者对报价机制的理解而变化，因此需要在控制训练与操作程序后重新估计。
edges.noteEn: Because understanding the bidding mechanism can affect valuation gaps, the gap is reestimated with training and procedural controls.

edges.label: 用预期生成参照点
edges.note: 参照点从给定状态变为关于未来消费结果的内生分布，受个人预期和最优行为一致性的约束。
edges.noteEn: A fixed reference state becomes an endogenous distribution of future consumption constrained by consistency between beliefs and optimal behavior.

edges.label: 操纵预期而固定禀赋
edges.note: 通过随机改变交换机会检验，实际所有权相同时，对未来持有的预期是否仍然改变选择。
edges.noteEn: Random variation in the opportunity to exchange tests whether expected future holdings change behavior even under identical ownership.
edges.labelEn: Varying expectations at a fixed endowment

edges.label: 从机会成本到实物交换
edges.note: 在两种实物间直接互换，可观察初始持有是否改变最终选择。
edges.noteEn: Direct barter tests whether initial possession changes which good a person ends up selecting.

edges.label: 分辨初学者与熟练者
edges.note: 市场中的重复交易经历提供了检验实验室禀赋效应外推范围的环境。
edges.noteEn: Variation in market experience tests how far endowment effects from laboratory markets generalize.

edges.label: 从购买转向风险
edges.note: 当参照点是可能结果的分布时，选择时对未来的预期进入货币风险评价。
edges.noteEn: With a distribution of outcomes as the reference, prior expectations affect evaluations of monetary risk.

edges.label: 把预期带进劳动供给
edges.note: 实验处理改变先验报酬预期，使劳动停止时点成为检验参照点的结果变量。
edges.noteEn: Manipulating expected pay turns the stopping decision into a test of an expectations-based reference point.

edges.label: 让他人努力改变参照
edges.note: 先行动者的努力改变后行动者的胜率预期，从而影响继续努力的激励。
edges.noteEn: The first mover's effort changes expected success for the follower, altering effort incentives.

edges.label: 分开指派与预期
edges.note: 另一组实验将受试者的概率信念与名义归属区分开，检验预期结果对设计是否敏感。
edges.noteEn: A complementary design separates verified probabilistic beliefs from nominal assignment to test how robust the expectations effect is.

edges.label: 买入价作为参照
edges.note: 房屋的历史买入价提供了可观测的参考点，可以把同一出售市场中的潜在损失与定价、成交联系起来。
