edges.noteEn: Historical purchase prices supply an observable benchmark for relating potential losses to pricing and sales in the same housing market.

edges.label: 预期参照进入停工决策
edges.note: 当预期既决定收入目标也决定工时目标时，司机接近两个目标的先后顺序会改变继续载客的收益。
edges.noteEn: When both income and hours have expectations-based targets, the order in which a driver approaches them changes the return to another fare.

edges.label: 规则给出的参照
edges.note: 以球洞的标准杆划分得失，让研究者比较竞技环境中距离相近、得分意义不同的推杆。
edges.noteEn: Par supplies a publicly defined gain–loss benchmark, making it possible to compare similarly situated putts with different scoring implications.

edges.label: 区分排班和班内反应
edges.note: 把劳动力供给拆成是否上班和班内努力，揭示了单看总工时会掩盖的、与收入参照相容的反应。
edges.noteEn: Separating shift take-up from effort per shift reveals a response consistent with an income reference point that aggregate hours alone would conceal.

resources.title: The Endowment Effect
resources.authors: Keith M. Marzilli Ericson & Andreas Fuster

branches.questionEn: Why might someone demand more to sell an item than a buyer will pay for it? What roles do ownership and expectations play?
branches.boundaryEn: The focus is on deterministic bundles, exchange, and valuation. Expectations can be distributions over outcomes. Probability weighting for risky lotteries belongs to the risk branch.

branches.name: 有限考虑、满意化与选择程序
branches.question: 看到某人从菜单中选了 A，如何分辨她更喜欢 A，还是她没看到 B、已经停止搜索，或找不到选择 B 的理由？
branches.boundary: 对象是菜单、搜索或筛选程序和最终选择。研究者可以观察搜索过程，也可以仅凭最终选择做部分推断；信息成本最优化另有分支。

papers.title: A Behavioral Model of Rational Choice
papers.note: 当逐一评价全部备选项超出决策能力时，可设定可接受标准，按顺序搜索达到标准的备选项。
papers.noteEn: When evaluating every alternative exceeds decision capacity, one can set an aspiration level and search sequentially until an option meets it.

papers.title: Sequentially Rationalizable Choice
papers.note: 对每个菜单依次使用相同的若干条比较准则淘汰备选项，刻画可由两条或三条准则生成的选择。
papers.noteEn: The same ordered criteria eliminate alternatives from each menu, yielding a characterization of choices generated by two or three rationales.

papers.title: Search and Satisficing
papers.authors: Andrew Caplin, Mark Dean & Daniel Martin
papers.note: 用搜索实验观察逐项考察与停止；许多受试者在遇到超过保留效用的选项后停下，阈值与搜索顺序随环境改变。
papers.noteEn: Experiments observe sequential inspection and stopping. Many subjects stop at an option above reservation utility, and thresholds and search order vary with the environment.

papers.title: Revealed Attention
papers.authors: Yusufcan Masatlioglu, Daisuke Nakajima & Erkut Y. Ozbay
papers.note: 假设删去未考虑项时考虑集保持不变，利用移除一个选项是否改变选择，推断部分注意范围与偏好。
papers.noteEn: Assuming removal of an unconsidered item leaves the consideration set unchanged, changes in choice after an item's removal partially reveal attention and preferences.

papers.title: Choice by iterative search
papers.note: 让每一步搜索受当前考虑集限制，给出可观察的选择条件，并研究何时能同时推断搜索路径与偏好。
papers.noteEn: The current consideration set constrains each search step. Observable choice restrictions indicate when paths and preferences can be inferred together.

papers.title: Rationalization
papers.authors: Vadim Cherepanov, Timothy Feddersen & Alvaro Sandroni
papers.note: 先用可接受的理由确定哪些备选项可以得到辩护，再从这些选项中挑出个人最偏好的一个。
papers.noteEn: Acceptable rationales determine which choices can be justified, after which the decision maker selects her most preferred justifiable option.

papers.title: A Model of Choice from Lists
papers.note: 给出选择规则的公理，使决策者按一个排序选择最优项，并用列表中最早或最晚出现的位置处理并列。
papers.noteEn: Axioms characterize choosing a best alternative with ties resolved by its first or last occurrence in a list.

papers.title: (A, f): Choice with Frames
papers.note: 把数据单位写成菜单和框架的组合，可分别观察同一菜单在不同呈现方式下的选择。
papers.noteEn: Taking a menu-frame pair as the primitive allows choices from a fixed menu to vary with presentation.

papers.title: When More Is Less: Limited Consideration
papers.authors: Juan Sebastián Lleras, Yusufcan Masatlioglu, Daisuke Nakajima & Erkut Y. Ozbay
papers.note: 考虑范围受到菜单规模的系统影响，较大的集合可能降低最终所选项的福利。
papers.noteEn: Systematic changes in consideration with menu size can make a larger feasible set reduce welfare.

papers.title: Reason-Based Choice: A Bargaining Rationale for the Attraction and Compromise Effects
papers.note: 借助多个评价维度之间的序数议价，为吸引效应与妥协效应给出选择论解释。
papers.noteEn: Ordinal bargaining across reasons provides a choice-theoretic account of attraction and compromise effects.

papers.title: Behavioral Implications of Shortlisting Procedures
papers.note: 对具有特定格结构的初筛规则，给出先筛选再按二元关系选优的可观察充要条件。
papers.noteEn: For a lattice-structured class of filters, necessary and sufficient conditions characterize screening followed by binary-relation maximization.

papers.title: Beyond Revealed Preference: Choice-Theoretic Foundations for Behavioral Welfare Economics
papers.note: 从多种选择情境抽出无歧义选择关系，在选择有冲突时保留仍可支持的福利判断。
papers.noteEn: An unambiguous choice relation retains welfare comparisons that survive conflicting choices across conditions.

papers.title: A Simple Model of Two-Stage Choice
papers.note: 对连续两轮使用传递性理由淘汰选项的选择规则，给出可以从菜单选择观察到的刻画。
papers.noteEn: The paper characterizes menu choices generated by eliminating inferior alternatives in two rounds, each governed by a transitive rationale.

papers.title: Consideration Sets and Competitive Marketing
papers.note: 企业付费使用营销手段以进入消费者的考虑集，消费者再按其偏好从看见的商品中选择。
papers.noteEn: Competing firms purchase marketing devices that affect which products consumers consider before choosing according to their preferences.

papers.title: Costly Information Acquisition: Experimental Analysis of a Boundedly Rational Model
papers.authors: Xavier Gabaix, David Laibson, Guillermo Moloche & Stephen Weinberg
papers.note: 实验记录被试逐格查看收益信息的过程，检验用下一步信息的近似价值来安排搜索的模型。
papers.noteEn: The experiment traces which payoff entries subjects inspect and tests whether an approximation to the value of the next observation directs their search.

papers.title: Search, Choice, and Revealed Preference
papers.note: 作者把思考过程中随时可报告的暂定选择纳入数据，以刻画哪些观察和逐步搜索相容。
papers.noteEn: Choice-process data record provisional alternatives during deliberation and reveal which observations can be rationalized by sequential search.

edges.label: 观察停止时点
edges.note: 将满意化的保留效用转换成搜索顺序和停止行为上的预测，用逐步选择数据检验。
edges.noteEn: Retention thresholds under satisficing predict search order and stopping, which sequential choice data can test.

edges.label: 从阈值转向多重准则
edges.note: 另一种节省比较的方式是用固定顺序的准则逐步淘汰选项；这对不同菜单之间的选择提出了约束。
edges.noteEn: Sequentially applying fixed rationales to eliminate alternatives economizes on comparisons and restricts choices across menus.

edges.label: 区分淘汰与忽略
edges.note: 顺序准则淘汰较差项，注意力模型则允许一些可行项根本未进入比较，并以删项后的选择变化来识别。
edges.noteEn: Sequential criteria eliminate inferior options. Under inattention, some feasible options never enter the comparison, and removing alternatives can reveal this.

edges.label: 纳入搜索路径
edges.note: 将有限考虑写成多个搜索阶段，使从数据中恢复偏好与推断搜索路径成为两个可区分的问题。
edges.noteEn: Dividing limited consideration into search stages distinguishes recovery of preferences from inference about search paths.

edges.label: 换成可辩护性筛选
edges.note: 在阶段性筛选的另一种表示中，选项先要能由某个理由支持，决策者才会在可辩护项中比较偏好。
edges.noteEn: In another representation of sequential screening, an alternative first needs support from an acceptable rationale before it enters the final preference comparison.

edges.label: 把展示顺序当作数据
edges.note: 除了可行集合，还观察选项出现的先后，有助于区分不同程序规则。
edges.noteEn: Observing presentation order in addition to feasibility separates procedural rules.

edges.label: 让程序线索可观察
edges.note: 将比较次序等外部线索作为框架记录，比单凭菜单反推程序提供更多观察。
edges.noteEn: Recording external cues as frames adds information beyond menu-only inference about procedures.

edges.label: 允许扩张菜单损害选择
edges.note: 把删减菜单时的注意限制用于过载问题，分析更小菜单何时改善福利。
edges.labelEn: Allowing menu expansion to hurt choice
edges.noteEn: Restrictions on consideration across nested menus help explain when a smaller menu improves welfare.

edges.label: 改变多个理由的组合规则
edges.note: 多重准则不仅能依次淘汰，还可形成折中选择，使新增选项改变原有项的吸引力。
edges.noteEn: Multiple criteria can bargain over a compromise, allowing a newly added alternative to change the appeal of existing ones.

edges.label: 统一多种初筛
edges.note: 把顺序筛选放入一类两阶段程序，可用同一结构比较不同初筛机制的限制。
edges.noteEn: Embedding sequential screening in a two-stage family allows distinct first-stage rules to be compared within one framework.

edges.label: 从正面解释到福利判断
edges.note: 不同展示方式可能改变所选项，因而要明确哪些跨情境一致的比较能够支撑福利结论。
edges.labelEn: From positive accounts to welfare judgments
edges.noteEn: When procedures change selections, welfare analysis must identify which comparisons persist across conditions.

edges.label: 两轮理由都传递
edges.note: 在依次按理由筛选的模型中，对每个理由加上传递性，能进一步约束哪些情境效应可以同时出现。
edges.noteEn: Requiring transitivity at both stages of sequential rationalization restricts which context effects can occur together.

edges.label: 谁能影响入围
edges.note: 先筛选再选择的程序中，企业可以影响第一阶段，因而产生了即使消费者偏好固定也会发生的营销竞争。
edges.noteEn: Once firms can influence the shortlist, a two-stage choice procedure generates marketing competition even with fixed consumer preferences.

edges.label: 从有限计算到搜索路径
edges.labelEn: From bounded computation to search paths
edges.note: 把认知成本放进每一次查阅信息的决定后，有限理性对查阅顺序和停止时点都有了可观测含义。
edges.noteEn: Pricing each information lookup gives bounded reasoning observable implications for both the order of inspection and the stopping decision.

edges.label: 把过程加入选择数据
edges.note: 观察选择如何随思考时间改变，可以检验仅凭最后选中哪一个无法区分的搜索机制。
edges.noteEn: Tracking how provisional choices change over deliberation tests search mechanisms that final choices alone cannot distinguish.

branches.questionEn: If A is chosen from a menu, can we tell whether A is preferred, B went unnoticed, search stopped, or B could not be justified?
branches.boundaryEn: The objects are menus, search or screening procedures, and final choices. Search can be observed directly or partially inferred from final choices. Information-cost optimization has a separate branch.

branches.name: 家庭谈判与集体决策
branches.question: 即使家庭总收入相同，收入归谁支配是否改变谁工作、谁消费？只看到家庭支出和成员劳动供给时，哪些分配与福利信息可以恢复？
branches.boundary: 把家庭视为有各自偏好的多个成员。成员间的协商决定婚内分配；把许多不同家庭加总成市场需求则是另一层问题。

papers.title: Marriage and Household Decision-Making: A Bargaining Analysis
papers.note: 以合作谈判分析婚姻的收益如何分配，婚姻之外的选择影响谈判地位，使家庭总资源与各成员所得之间多出一个分配环节。
papers.noteEn: Cooperative bargaining determines how marital gains are shared. Outside options affect bargaining positions, mediating the division of total household resources.

papers.title: Rational Household Labor Supply
papers.note: 在双成员家庭中只要求配置帕累托有效，在只观察两人的劳动供给和总消费时推导可证伪限制，并区分利己与利他偏好。
papers.noteEn: For a two-person household, Pareto efficiency alone gives falsifiable restrictions on labor supply and total consumption, with distinct implications under selfish and altruistic preferences.

papers.title: Collective Labor Supply and Welfare
papers.note: 在文中条件下，可将有效配置表示为先分享非劳动收入再各自选劳动和消费；劳动供给反应能识别分享规则至多相差一个常数。
papers.noteEn: Under the paper's conditions, an efficient allocation first divides nonlabor income, after which members choose consumption and work. Labor supply identifies the sharing rule up to a constant.

papers.title: Efficient Intra-Household Allocations: A General Characterization and Empirical Tests
papers.note: 对双决策者家庭，补偿需求导数矩阵可分为一个对称项与一个至多秩一的调整项，从而能用家庭需求数据检验集体效率。
papers.noteEn: With two decision makers, compensated demand derivatives decompose into a symmetric term and an adjustment of rank at most one, making collective efficiency testable with household demand data.

papers.title: Collective Labor Supply with Children
papers.authors: Richard Blundell · Pierre-André Chiappori · Costas Meghir
papers.note: 将家庭公共消费引入集体劳动供给；结合劳动供给与公共品需求，在可分性或存在分配因素等条件下识别个人福利与决策过程。
papers.noteEn: Adding household public consumption to collective labor supply permits identification of individual welfare and decision making under conditions such as separability or the existence of distribution factors.

papers.title: Separate Spheres Bargaining and the Marriage Market
papers.note: 以婚姻关系内的非合作均衡而非离婚作为分歧点，给出不同的转移和收入分配预测。
papers.noteEn: A noncooperative equilibrium within marriage serves as the disagreement point and changes predictions for transfers and household distribution.

papers.title: Do Husbands and Wives Pool Their Resources? Evidence from the United Kingdom Child Benefit
papers.authors: Shelly J. Lundberg, Robert A. Pollak & Terence J. Wales
papers.note: 英国儿童福利改革改变父母中谁收到款项，提供检验资源池化假设的外部变动。
papers.noteEn: A reform of UK child benefit changed which parent received the transfer, providing variation to test income pooling.

papers.title: The Collective Model of Household Consumption: A Nonparametric Characterization
papers.authors: Laurens Cherchye, Bram De Rock & Frederic Vermeulen
papers.note: 用显示偏好方法给出集体消费模型的非参数刻画，从家庭总体消费中检验成员间有效配置。
papers.noteEn: Revealed preference yields a nonparametric characterization of collective consumption, testing efficient allocation from observed household choices.

papers.title: Estimating Consumption Economies of Scale, Adult Equivalence Scales, and Household Bargaining Power
papers.authors: Martin Browning, Pierre-André Chiappori & Arthur Lewbel
papers.note: 比较个人与共同生活下的消费，在给定假设下联合识别消费规模经济、无差异尺度及分享规则。
papers.noteEn: Under the model's assumptions, single and joint consumption identify scale economies, indifference scales, and resource sharing together.

papers.title: Children's Resources in Collective Households: Identification, Estimation, and an Application to Child Poverty in Malawi
papers.authors: Geoffrey R. Dunbar, Arthur Lewbel & Krishna Pendakur
papers.note: 利用可分配给个人的私人商品支出随家庭规模和收入的变化，在半参数条件下识别儿童与成人的资源份额。
papers.noteEn: Expenditure on assignable private goods across household sizes and incomes identifies children's and adults' resource shares under semiparametric restrictions.

papers.title: Household Intertemporal Behaviour: A Collective Characterization and a Test of Commitment
papers.note: 比较家庭能否预先承诺未来配置时的欧拉方程，从消费数据检验跨期承诺。
papers.noteEn: Comparing Euler equations with and without ex ante commitment yields a test of household commitment using consumption data.

papers.title: Marriage Market, Divorce Legislation, and Household Labor Supply
papers.authors: Pierre-André Chiappori, Bernard Fortin & Guy Lacroix
papers.note: 性别比与离婚法作为分配因素进入集体劳动供给模型，用来识别家庭内部的资源分享。
papers.noteEn: Sex ratios and divorce laws serve as distribution factors in a collective labor-supply model and help identify how couples share resources.

papers.title: Intra-Household Resource Allocation: An Inferential Approach
papers.note: 巴西家庭调查中，父母各自的非劳动收入与营养、健康结果的关系不同，作者也考察了收入测量误差。
papers.noteEn: In Brazilian household data, maternal and paternal unearned income have different associations with nutrition and health. The paper also examines income measurement error.

papers.title: Gender, Agricultural Production, and the Theory of the Household
papers.note: 同一家庭中女性管理的地块投入和产出较低，比较可比地块可直接检验家庭内部是否有效配置农业投入。
papers.noteEn: Women’s plots within the same household receive fewer inputs and have lower yields. Comparisons of similar plots test whether farm inputs are efficiently allocated within households.

papers.title: Household Sharing and Commitment: Evidence from Panel Data on Individual Expenditures and Time Use
papers.role: 从支出与用时估计承诺
papers.roleEn: Commitment in expenditure and time use
papers.note: 日本家庭面板追踪夫妻各自的消费和时间配置，用来区分结婚时谈定的分享与婚后重新议价。
papers.noteEn: Japanese panel data on individual spending and time use distinguish sharing shaped at marriage from subsequent renegotiation.

edges.label: 放宽谈判规则
edges.note: 由指定谈判解得到的分配转向所有帕累托有效配置共有的劳动供给限制。
edges.noteEn: A specified bargaining solution gives way to labor-supply restrictions shared by all Pareto-efficient allocations.

edges.label: 由可检验性到识别
edges.note: 劳动供给除了检验家庭是否有效，还可用来恢复家庭资源如何随工资和收入重新分配。
edges.noteEn: Labor supply both tests household efficiency and reveals how resources are reallocated as wages and income change.

edges.label: 从两份劳动供给到多商品需求
edges.note: 把效率对家庭行为的含义转写为需求系统的矩阵限制，允许与单一决策者的 Slutsky 对称性作经验区分。
edges.noteEn: A matrix restriction on household demand expresses efficiency in a form empirically distinguishable from a single decision maker's Slutsky symmetry.
edges.labelEn: From two labor supplies to many goods

edges.label: 容许共同消费
edges.note: 儿童相关支出等家庭公共品不能简单划归一人，识别需使用公共品需求及额外结构。
edges.noteEn: Household public goods such as child-related spending cannot simply be assigned to one member. Identification also requires public demand and additional structure.

edges.label: 改变谈判破裂后的结果
edges.note: 婚外机会相同时，婚内各自履行哪些职责仍会改变谈判地位。
edges.noteEn: Even at fixed outside opportunities, the division of roles in a noncooperative marriage can change bargaining positions.

edges.label: 检验转移的归属
edges.note: 给定家庭可用资源，观察转移改付另一成员后服装支出构成是否改变。
edges.noteEn: At given household resources, reassignment of the payment tests whether the composition of clothing expenditure changes.

edges.label: 从导数到离散观察
edges.note: 有限价格数量记录可取代光滑需求导数，成为检验集体理性的数据。
edges.noteEn: Finite price-quantity observations replace smooth demand derivatives as the data for testing collective rationality.

edges.label: 区分分享与共同节约
edges.note: 家庭消费的变化既可能来自资源再分配，也可能来自共同生活节省成本，模型将两者区分。
edges.noteEn: Joint consumption can reflect resource redistribution as well as savings from living together. The model distinguishes both.

edges.label: 以可归属消费识别儿童份额
edges.note: 将儿童作为资源份额的对象，利用个人衣着等支出估计家庭内部贫困。
edges.labelEn: Identifying child shares from assignable goods
edges.noteEn: Treating children as resource recipients permits within-household poverty measurement from items such as individual clothing.

edges.label: 从当期有效到跨期有效
edges.note: 每期帕累托有效不保证家庭能落实原订的跨期计划，两者对消费变化施加不同限制。
edges.noteEn: Period-by-period Pareto efficiency need not implement an ex ante plan, and the two assumptions restrict consumption changes differently.

edges.label: 给分享规则寻找外部变动
edges.labelEn: External variation in the sharing rule
edges.note: 把可能改变配偶谈判地位的外部因素代入分享规则，可检验夫妻劳动供给是否满足联立约束。
edges.noteEn: Outside factors that alter spouses’ bargaining positions shift the sharing rule and generate joint restrictions on their labor supplies.

edges.label: 谁控制收入可供检验
edges.note: 如果资源分配取决于家庭内部的控制权，那么即使家庭总收入相同，收入记在父亲或母亲名下也可能影响子女结果。
edges.noteEn: If control over resources matters for allocation, attributing a given amount of income to the mother or father may predict different outcomes for children.

edges.label: 用地块检验家庭效率
edges.note: 集体模型允许偏好不同却要求配置有效；同一家庭内地块间的投入差异为这一要求增加了生产侧的检验。
edges.noteEn: Collective models allow preferences to differ but impose efficiency. Input allocation across plots of the same family creates a production-side test of that condition.

edges.label: 观察何时重新议价
edges.note: 个人支出和用时随工资冲击的变化，可用于判断分享权重在何种条件下偏离了婚初约定。
edges.noteEn: Individual responses of spending and time use to wage shocks reveal when sharing weights depart from the allocation negotiated at marriage.

resources.title: Economics of the Family
resources.authors: Martin Browning · Pierre-André Chiappori · Yoram Weiss

branches.questionEn: At a fixed household income, does who controls it affect who works and consumes? What allocation and welfare information can household purchases and individual labor supplies reveal?
branches.boundaryEn: Households have multiple members with their own preferences. Bargaining affects allocation within marriage. Aggregating heterogeneous households into market demand is a different problem.

branches.name: 需求加总与代表性消费者
branches.en: Demand aggregation and the representative consumer
branches.question: 面对同一组价格的家庭，其收入分配要满足什么条件，才能把市场总需求写成一个消费者的需求？
branches.boundary: 区分三件事：总需求只依赖总收入；容许代表性收入依赖分配；给各类家庭估计一套满足需求理论限制的恩格尔曲线。

papers.title: Community Preference Fields
papers.note: 在其条件下，各消费者同价下的恩格尔曲线为斜率相同的直线时，收入如何在人之间重新分配不会改变按总收入预测的需求。
papers.noteEn: Under the stated conditions, affine Engel curves with identical slopes at common prices make demand predicted from total income invariant to redistribution.

papers.title: Community Preferences and the Representative Consumer
papers.note: 允许代表性收入或效用指标依赖收入分布，给出代表性需求存在的条件，扩展了只利用总收入的加总。
papers.noteEn: Representative income or utility may depend on the income distribution. Conditions for a representative demand then extend aggregation beyond total income alone.

papers.title: An Almost Ideal Demand System
papers.note: 基于 PIGLOG 支出函数构造预算份额方程，兼顾价格反应的灵活性、理论限制和一类精确加总表示。
papers.noteEn: A PIGLOG expenditure function yields budget-share equations with flexible price responses, theoretical restrictions, and a form of exact aggregation.

papers.title: Quadratic Engel Curves and Consumer Demand
papers.authors: James Banks · Richard Blundell · Arthur Lewbel
papers.note: 用家庭支出数据说明线性的对数支出份额关系可能过紧，构造满足可积性且包含对数支出二次项的秩三需求系统。
papers.noteEn: Household expenditure data suggest linearity of budget shares in log expenditure can be restrictive. An integrable rank-three system adds a quadratic log-expenditure term.

papers.title: On a Class of Preference Fields
papers.note: 从直线恩格尔曲线推导相应的偏好表示，使精确加总的收入条件能够用间接效用表达。
papers.noteEn: Linear Engel curves motivate the corresponding preference representation, expressing aggregation conditions through indirect utility.

papers.title: A Note on the Fundamental Theorem of Exact Aggregation
papers.note: 给出总需求可写成价格和若干对称收入、属性指标的充要条件。
papers.noteEn: Gives necessary and sufficient conditions for aggregate demand to depend on prices and symmetric indices of household incomes and attributes.

papers.title: Characterizing Some Gorman Engel Curves
papers.note: 刻画对收入及其一个共同变换都线性的效用导出需求系统，包含若干可加总的常用形式。
papers.noteEn: Characterizes utility-derived demands linear in income and a common transformation of income, encompassing familiar aggregable forms.

papers.title: The Rank of Demand Systems: Theory and Nonparametric Estimation
papers.note: 将恩格尔曲线的秩推广到一般需求系统，并发展不依赖指定函数形式的秩估计。
papers.noteEn: Extends Engel-curve rank to general demand systems and develops a nonparametric way to estimate it.

papers.title: Tricks with Hicks: The EASI Demand System
papers.note: 用隐式马歇尔需求构造 EASI，允许灵活恩格尔曲线，并在给定实际支出时保持份额方程对参数线性。
papers.noteEn: Implicit Marshallian demands give EASI flexible Engel curves while keeping shares linear in parameters given real expenditure.

papers.title: Individual Heterogeneity and Average Welfare
papers.authors: Jerry A. Hausman & Whitney K. Newey
papers.note: 不同家庭仅在各自价格与收入下被观察时，需求的边际分布与平均福利效应的识别程度不同。
papers.noteEn: Cross sections at distinct prices and incomes identify marginal demand distributions, with more limited identification of average welfare effects.

papers.title: Aggregation, Income Distribution and Consumer Demand
papers.note: 研究家庭恩格尔曲线的形状如何决定市场需求需要哪些有关收入分布的信息。
papers.noteEn: The shape of household Engel curves determines what information about the income distribution is needed to recover market demand.

papers.title: On the “Law of Demand”
papers.role: 收入分布与市场需求律
papers.note: 在共同需求函数等模型条件下，递减的收入密度足以使人均市场需求满足多商品需求律。
papers.noteEn: With a common demand function and the paper’s regularity conditions, a decreasing income density suffices for per-capita market demand to obey the multigood law of demand.

papers.title: Structural Change with Long-Run Income and Price Effects
papers.authors: Diego Comin, Danial Lashkari & Martí Mestieri
papers.role: 部门支出的长期收入效应
papers.roleEn: Long-run income effects on sectoral spending
papers.note: 非位似 CES 偏好允许各部门支出随收入以不同速率增长，借助家庭和国家数据分解结构转型的收入与价格渠道。
papers.noteEn: Nonhomothetic CES preferences let sectoral expenditures grow at different rates with income. Household and country data distinguish income from relative-price channels of structural change.

papers.title: A Unified Approach to Incorporating Demographic or Other Effects into Demand Systems
papers.role: 保证可积性的人口结构调整
papers.note: 修正函数可让家庭特征与价格及支出交互，作者给出了所得需求系统仍与效用最大化相容的条件。
papers.noteEn: Modifying functions let household characteristics interact with prices and expenditures under conditions that preserve the integrability of the resulting demand system.

edges.label: 改变代表性收入的定义
edges.note: 从检验重新分配后总收入是否足够，推广到允许收入分布通过一个代表性指标影响需求。
edges.noteEn: The question changes from whether total income suffices after redistribution to whether the distribution affects demand through a representative index.

edges.label: 给出可估计的函数形式
edges.note: 从加总条件走向具体预算份额方程，显式处理价格指数、支出和需求限制。
edges.noteEn: Aggregation conditions become concrete budget-share equations that explicitly incorporate prices, expenditure, and demand restrictions.

edges.label: 放宽恩格尔曲线
edges.note: AIDS 的份额对给定价格下的对数支出是线性的；QUAIDS 在维持需求理论一致性的同时加入二次项。
edges.noteEn: At fixed prices AIDS has shares linear in log expenditure. QUAIDS adds a quadratic term while maintaining consistency with demand theory.

edges.label: 把收入条件写进偏好
edges.note: 收入线性需求的限制可重新表述为间接效用对收入的特定形式。
edges.noteEn: Restrictions giving demands linear in income translate into a particular income dependence of indirect utility.

edges.label: 把单一指标扩展为多个
edges.note: 将代表性收入的想法推广为一组汇总指标，明确哪些人口异质性必须保留。
edges.noteEn: A vector of aggregate indices specifies which features of household heterogeneity must be retained.

edges.label: 允许非线性收入变换
edges.note: 在收入线性的基准上加入共同非线性项，同时检查需求能否由效用导出。
edges.noteEn: A common nonlinear term extends linear Engel curves subject to utility integrability.

edges.label: 衡量收入模式的维数
edges.note: 预算份额能显示多少种独立收入模式，可以用秩来比较，而非预先固定函数形状。
edges.labelEn: Measuring the dimension of income effects
edges.noteEn: Rank compares how many independent income patterns budget shares require without fixing an Engel-curve shape.

edges.label: 放开固定二次曲率
edges.note: 不必将实际支出作用限定为二次项，便可在可估计需求系统中容纳更高的秩。
edges.noteEn: A tractable demand system accommodates richer expenditure effects and higher rank than a fixed quadratic specification.

edges.label: 区分聚合需求与福利
edges.note: 观察到群体需求并不揭示同一家庭如何跨预算反应，因此平均福利变化可能只能求界。
edges.noteEn: Population demands need not reveal the same households' responses across budgets, so average welfare changes can remain only bounded.

edges.label: 超出平均收入
edges.note: 当不同收入水平的边际支出反应有别时，保持总收入不变的再分配也可以改变社会的消费结构。
edges.noteEn: When marginal expenditure responses differ across income levels, redistribution can change aggregate consumption patterns at fixed total income.

edges.label: 从精确加总到单调性
edges.note: 若只问市场需求是否单调，收入分布本身能给出条件，无须先把市场还原成具有特定偏好的单一家庭。
edges.noteEn: If the goal is aggregate monotonicity, an income-distribution condition can suffice without first representing the market as a single household with a prescribed preference structure.

edges.label: 把恩格尔曲线接入部门增长
edges.labelEn: From Engel curves to sectoral growth
edges.note: 允许预算份额随收入改变后，可以比较相对价格和收入增长对农业、工业、服务业支出变化的贡献。
edges.noteEn: Allowing budget shares to vary with income lets researchers compare price and income contributions to expenditure shifts among agriculture, industry, and services.

edges.label: 把家庭构成引入需求
edges.note: 在一个已满足需求理论约束的系统上加入人口变量，需要约束调整函数才能保留这些可检验性质。
edges.noteEn: Demographic adjustments to a theory-consistent demand system must satisfy restrictions to retain the system’s testable properties.

branches.questionEn: At common prices, under what conditions on the distribution of income across households can aggregate market demand be represented as one consumer's demand?
branches.boundaryEn: The branch distinguishes demand depending only on total income, representative income depending on the distribution, and estimation of theoretically consistent Engel curves for heterogeneous households.

branches.name: 生产者对偶、前沿与非参数检验
branches.en: Producer duality, frontiers and nonparametric tests
branches.question: 知道投入价格、投入数量和产出，能否判断企业在最小化成本或最大化利润？这些观测又能把可行技术限制到什么程度？
branches.boundary: 对偶法以成本等价值函数描述技术；非参数法从有限观测推导技术或行为限制。技术可行性、配置最优性和离前沿的距离需要分别检验。

papers.title: An Application of the Shephard Duality Theorem: A Generalized Leontief Production Function
papers.note: 用广义 Leontief 成本函数表示技术，通过价格导数推出投入需求，展示如何在价格空间选择方便估计的函数形式。
papers.noteEn: A generalized Leontief cost function represents technology. Price derivatives yield input demands, illustrating how to select an estimable functional form in price space.

papers.title: Testing the Assumptions of Production Theory: A Nonparametric Approach
papers.note: 把生产理论假设转化为投入产出观测之间的限制，使研究者可以先检验数据与技术假设的相容性，无需预选一个参数化生产函数。
papers.noteEn: Restrictions across input-output observations test whether data are compatible with technological assumptions without imposing a parametric production function.

papers.title: Efficiency Estimation of Production Functions
papers.note: 从观测到的生产活动构造非参数前沿并考察效率，允许观测活动处于前沿以内，从而区分技术边界和实际产出。
papers.noteEn: Observed production activities generate a nonparametric frontier. Allowing observations inside it distinguishes actual output from the technological boundary.

papers.title: The Nonparametric Approach to Production Analysis
papers.note: 以有限价格与数量观测检验利润最大化、成本最小化等行为，并用符合数据的技术集合给未观测生产可能性划界。
papers.noteEn: Finite price and quantity observations test profit maximization or cost minimization and bound unobserved production possibilities using technologies consistent with the data.

papers.title: The Measurement of Productive Efficiency
papers.note: 相对生产前沿区分技术效率与价格给定时的配置效率，使用投入空间的距离衡量损失。
papers.noteEn: Frontier distances in input space distinguish technical efficiency from allocative efficiency at given prices.

papers.title: Measuring the Efficiency of Decision Making Units
papers.authors: A. Charnes, W. W. Cooper & E. Rhodes
papers.note: 用线性规划给多投入多产出单位选择对其有利且对所有单位共同可行的权重，从而计算相对效率。
papers.noteEn: Linear programs assign favorable but commonly feasible weights to inputs and outputs to compute a unit's relative efficiency.

papers.title: Formulation and Estimation of Stochastic Frontier Production Function Models
papers.authors: Dennis Aigner, C. A. Knox Lovell & Peter Schmidt
papers.note: 将生产函数误差分为双侧随机噪声与单侧无效率项，允许前沿偏离源于不同过程。
papers.noteEn: A composed error separates two-sided noise from one-sided inefficiency in a stochastic production frontier.

papers.title: Some Models for Estimating Technical and Scale Inefficiencies in Data Envelopment Analysis
papers.authors: R. D. Banker, A. Charnes & W. W. Cooper
papers.note: 放松规模报酬不变，在包络模型中区分技术效率损失与企业所处生产规模引起的损失。
papers.noteEn: Relaxing constant returns in the envelopment model separates technical inefficiency from losses associated with operating scale.

papers.title: Profit, Directional Distance Functions, and Nerlovian Efficiency
papers.authors: Robert G. Chambers, Yangho Chung & Rolf Färe
papers.note: 把给定方向上的投入收缩与产出扩张同利润函数联系起来，用方向距离计算 Nerlove 意义的效率。
papers.noteEn: Directional contractions of inputs and expansions of outputs connect to the profit function and measure Nerlovian efficiency.

papers.title: Sensitivity Analysis of Efficiency Scores: How to Bootstrap in Nonparametric Frontier Models
papers.note: 为非参数生产前沿设计自助抽样方法，衡量更换有限样本后相对效率分数的不确定性。
papers.noteEn: A bootstrap designed for nonparametric frontiers assesses sampling variability in relative efficiency scores.

papers.title: Exact and Superlative Index Numbers
papers.note: 若一个指数对具有二阶近似能力的聚合函数是精确的，它便属于超越指数；费雪理想数量指数是其中的例子。
papers.noteEn: An index is superlative if it is exact for an aggregator that permits a second-order approximation. Fisher’s ideal quantity index is one example.

papers.title: Transcendental Logarithmic Production Frontiers
papers.authors: Laurits R. Christensen, Dale W. Jorgenson & Lawrence J. Lau
papers.note: 把产出、投入的对数及交叉项写入二次式，可以局部二阶逼近生产前沿，并检验齐次性等限制。
papers.noteEn: A quadratic in log outputs and inputs gives a local second-order approximation to a production frontier and permits tests of restrictions such as homogeneity.

papers.title: A Model for Technical Inefficiency Effects in a Stochastic Frontier Production Function for Panel Data
papers.authors: G. E. Battese & T. J. Coelli
papers.role: 企业特征与技术无效率
papers.note: 面板模型让企业特征和时间进入非负无效率项的分布，可与随机扰动一起估计。
papers.noteEn: In a panel frontier, firm characteristics and time enter the distribution of nonnegative inefficiency, which is estimated alongside statistical noise.

papers.title: The Dynamics of Productivity in the Telecommunications Equipment Industry
papers.role: 投资、退出与生产率识别
papers.note: 企业的投入和退出同时响应未观察生产率；用投资决策做代理变量，并对存续选择进行校正，可估计生产函数。
papers.noteEn: Input choices and exit respond to unobserved productivity. Investment as a proxy and a correction for survival selection permit estimation of production-function parameters.

edges.label: 改变对函数形式的要求
edges.note: 一条路线通过对偶函数导出可估参数系统，另一条直接检验有限观测是否容许所需技术。
edges.noteEn: One approach derives an estimable system from a dual function. Another directly tests whether finite observations permit the required technology.

edges.label: 把行为与数据理性化相连
edges.note: 非参数限制进一步用于区分哪些生产行为与假设组合能够解释已观察选择。
edges.noteEn: Nonparametric restrictions distinguish combinations of productive behavior and assumptions that can explain observed choices.

edges.label: 区分前沿估计与最优性检验
edges.note: 估计可行边界所需的数据与检验价格下的最优选择所需的数据不同；观察到价格时可以进一步约束支持选择的技术。
edges.noteEn: Estimating feasibility and testing choices at given prices require different data. Observed prices further constrain technologies that support those choices.
edges.labelEn: Distinguishing frontier estimation from optimality tests

edges.label: 从距离到经验前沿
edges.note: 以有效边界作为比较基准，促使研究者用可观察投入产出为未知前沿划界。
edges.noteEn: Using an efficient boundary as the benchmark raises the question of how observed activities delimit the unknown frontier.

edges.label: 把前沿比较写成规划
edges.note: 多维投入产出的效率比较可由对样本单位的一组共同不等式和优化问题完成。
edges.noteEn: A common set of inequalities across observed units makes multi-input, multi-output efficiency computationally operational.

edges.label: 允许前沿附近有噪声
edges.note: 观察点与边界的距离可包含测量误差或随机扰动，不能全部解释为无效率。
edges.noteEn: Distance from a fitted frontier can contain shocks or measurement noise as well as inefficiency.

edges.label: 放松规模报酬假设
edges.note: 改变生成可行技术集合的规模限制，会改变衡量技术与规模无效率的参照边界。
edges.labelEn: Relaxing assumptions on returns to scale
edges.noteEn: Changing the scale restrictions on the feasible set changes the benchmark for technical and scale efficiency.

edges.label: 从成本对偶到利润距离
edges.note: 双重表示也可以连接利润不足与物理方向上的前沿距离，从而衡量给定价格下的效率。
edges.labelEn: From cost duality to profit distance
edges.noteEn: Duality also connects a profit shortfall to a physical directional distance from the frontier at given prices.

edges.label: 把比较前沿本身视作估计量
edges.note: 企业相对效率取决于样本所生成的边界；估计该边界的不确定性会传入效率分数。
edges.labelEn: Treating the benchmark frontier as estimated
edges.noteEn: A unit's relative score depends on the sample frontier, so uncertainty in the estimated boundary carries over to efficiency.

edges.label: 从对偶函数到数量指数
edges.labelEn: From dual functions to quantity indices
edges.note: 一旦确定技术的局部灵活形式，便可询问哪个离散价格或数量指数与相应聚合函数精确相容。
edges.noteEn: Once a locally flexible functional form is available, one can ask which discrete price or quantity index is exact for the associated aggregator.

edges.label: 比较灵活函数形式
edges.note: 把数量与价格前沿分别写成超越对数形式，为灵活生产技术及其对偶表示提供了另一套可估计参数。
edges.noteEn: Translog quantity and price frontiers give an alternative parameterization for estimating flexible technology and its dual.

edges.label: 解释前沿以内的距离
edges.note: 把无效率项的条件均值写成可观察变量的函数，就能检验同一前沿下谁更接近技术可达的产出。
edges.noteEn: Making the location of the inefficiency distribution depend on observables makes it possible to test which firms operate closer to a common frontier.

edges.label: 内生投入与企业退出
edges.note: 由生产数据推断技术时，若企业观察到研究者看不到的生产率，就需要同时处理投入选择与样本中哪些工厂存活。
edges.noteEn: Inferring technology from production data requires handling both input choices and which plants survive when firms see productivity that the researcher cannot observe.

resources.title: Applied Production Analysis: A Dual Approach

branches.questionEn: Can input prices, input quantities, and outputs reveal whether a firm minimizes costs or maximizes profits? How tightly do these observations restrict feasible technologies?
branches.boundaryEn: Duality describes technology through value functions such as cost. Nonparametric analysis derives technological or behavioral restrictions from finite data. Feasibility, allocative optimality, and distance to the frontier require separate tests.

branches.name: 纳什均衡与精炼
branches.question: 均衡如何要求行动彼此最优？若一个威胁只在无人预期的历史出现，又如何检验它的可信性？
branches.boundary: 从有限战略式博弈的存在性走向扩展式博弈中行动与信念的一致性，最后区分单一均衡与稳定均衡集合。

papers.title: Equilibrium Points in n-Person Games
papers.note: 通过不动点论证有限博弈存在混合策略均衡，从而可在策略相互最优的基础上研究预测。
papers.noteEn: A fixed-point argument establishes a mixed-strategy equilibrium in every finite game, providing a basis for predictions from mutually optimal strategies.

papers.title: Reexamination of the Perfectness Concept for Equilibrium Points in Extensive Games
papers.note: 给每个行动引入微小失误概率，再考察扰动博弈的均衡极限，排除依赖某些行动绝无可能发生的均衡。
papers.noteEn: Give every action a small probability of being played by mistake and take limits of perturbed equilibria. This rules out equilibria that depend on some actions being impossible.

papers.title: Sequential Equilibria
papers.note: 在每个信息集同时给出行为策略和信念，以序贯理性与由完全混合策略诱导的信念一致性约束路径外行为。
papers.noteEn: Specify behavior and beliefs at every information set. Sequential rationality and consistency with beliefs induced by fully mixed strategies discipline off-path behavior.

papers.title: On the Strategic Stability of Equilibria
papers.note: 把稳健性施加于一组均衡，分析小扰动下这组均衡能否持续被附近均衡支撑，并考察策略表示的影响。
papers.noteEn: Stability is imposed on a set of equilibria. Small perturbations must leave an equilibrium nearby, and the representation of strategies matters.

papers.title: Refinements of the Nash Equilibrium Concept
papers.note: 正规均衡要求较差的纯策略以比收益较高策略更小一个数量级的概率被选中。
papers.noteEn: Proper equilibrium makes a worse pure strategy an order of magnitude less likely than a better one as trembles vanish.

papers.title: Signaling Games and Stable Equilibria
papers.note: 用不同发送者类型从意外信号获益的可能性，排除某些支撑混同结果的路径外信念。
papers.noteEn: Potential gains from a surprise signal rule out some off-path beliefs that support pooling.

papers.title: Equilibrium Selection in Signaling Games
papers.note: 用各类型可从意外信号获益的接收者反应集合比较偏离动机，定义神性均衡。
papers.noteEn: Divinity compares the sets of receiver responses that would make sending an unexpected signal profitable for different types.

papers.title: On Forward Induction
papers.note: 定义哪些策略与给定结果相容，再限制路径外信念。在收益一般的双人博弈中给出与策略式表示相关的充分条件。
papers.noteEn: The authors restrict beliefs to strategies relevant to a candidate outcome and derive a sufficient condition using strategic representations for generic two-player games.

papers.title: On the Existence of Pure and Mixed Strategy Nash Equilibria in Discontinuous Games
papers.role: 不连续收益下的存在性
papers.note: 在策略集紧且凸、收益对自身策略拟凹等条件下，以更优回应保障性替代通常的收益连续性，得到纯策略均衡。
papers.noteEn: With compact convex strategy sets and own-strategy quasiconcavity, better-reply security can replace payoff continuity in a pure-equilibrium existence theorem.

papers.title: Quantal Response Equilibria for Extensive Form Games
papers.authors: Richard D. McKelvey & Thomas R. Palfrey
papers.note: 让每个信息集上的行动概率随继续收益变化，而行动者预期其他人也可能犯错。
papers.noteEn: At each information set action probabilities respond to continuation payoffs, anticipating that others also make errors.

papers.title: Commitment and Observability in Games
papers.note: 在所研究的纯策略均衡中，即便对先手行动的观察误差极小，先动优势也会消失。
papers.noteEn: In the pure-strategy equilibria studied, even slight noise in observing the leader's action can erase the first-mover advantage.

papers.title: Stable Equilibria and Forward Induction
papers.note: 用玩家放弃外部选项后继续参与的博弈说明，战略稳定性可约束后来行动的解释。
papers.noteEn: Games in which a player forgoes an outside option illustrate how strategic stability constrains interpretations of subsequent play.

papers.title: Simple Forward Induction in Monotonic Multi-Sender Signaling Games
papers.authors: Péter Vida · Takakazu Honryo · Helmuts Āzacis
papers.note: 提出一种由一般有限多发送者博弈的战略稳定性蕴含的准则，并在文中的无限单调信号博弈中选出唯一的无扭曲结果。
papers.noteEn: A criterion implied by strategic stability in generic finite multi-sender games selects a unique undistorted outcome in the paper's infinite monotonic signaling games.

papers.title: Localized Perfection
papers.authors: Enxian Chen · Lei Qiao · Xiang Sun · Yeneng Sun
papers.note: 在连续统玩家博弈中限制行动分布的扰动范围，证明纯策略局部完美均衡存在，并给出与局部可容许性的等价。
papers.noteEn: For games with a continuum of players, perturbations are localized around the action distribution. A pure localized perfect equilibrium exists and is characterized by local admissibility.

edges.label: 检验微小失误
edges.note: 从原博弈中没有有利偏离，转向考察严格正的失误概率趋于零时哪些均衡仍成立。
edges.noteEn: Move from checking profitable deviations in the original game to asking which equilibria survive as strictly positive error probabilities vanish.

edges.label: 显式写出信念
edges.note: 两者都约束路径外行为；序贯均衡将每个信息集的信念纳入解，并单独检验序贯理性与一致性。
edges.noteEn: Both approaches restrict off-path behavior. Sequential equilibrium makes beliefs at each information set part of the solution and tests sequential rationality and consistency separately.

edges.label: 由点转向集合
edges.note: 对策略扰动的稳健性可以要求附近仍有某个均衡属于同一组预测，不要求一个固定均衡点抵抗所有扰动。
edges.noteEn: Robustness to strategic perturbations can require some nearby equilibrium in the same set of predictions without requiring a fixed point to survive every perturbation.

edges.label: 按损失给失误排序
edges.note: Selten 让每个行动都有失误机会；Myerson 进一步约束不同错误的相对概率。
edges.noteEn: Selten allows every action to be played by mistake. Myerson also restricts the relative probabilities of different errors.

edges.label: 从可一致的信念到有利可图的偏离
edges.note: 序贯均衡容许多种路径外信念；直观准则检查哪些类型即使得到有利反应也不可能获益。
edges.noteEn: Among beliefs consistent with sequential equilibrium, the intuitive criterion discounts types that could never gain even with a favorable response.

edges.label: 从稳定分支到神性
edges.note: 不满足神性检验的序贯均衡不可能属于稳定分支，从而给出信号博弈中可单独检验的条件。
edges.noteEn: A sequential equilibrium that fails divinity cannot belong to a stable component, yielding a test specific to signaling games.

edges.label: 以观察到的选择推断意图
edges.note: 把序贯理性的检验推进到前向归纳，问一次意外行动还能与哪些最优策略相容。
edges.noteEn: Beyond sequential optimality, forward induction asks which previously optimal plans could explain an unexpected move.

edges.label: 把存在性推进到不连续模型
edges.note: 从有限博弈的混合均衡基准转向有连续选择但收益可跳变的模型，须另检验有利偏离是否稳健。
edges.noteEn: The finite-game mixed-equilibrium benchmark gives way to continuous choices and possibly discontinuous payoffs, where robustness of profitable deviations matters.

edges.label: 用概率度量偏离
edges.note: 序贯最优的约束变成各信息集的随机反应，可同实验中的偶发偏离比较。
edges.noteEn: Stochastic responses at each information set make observed departures from exact sequential optimality empirically comparable.

edges.label: 扰动观察而非行动
edges.note: 当跟随者无法准确辨认先手选择时，还须检查其后验信念如何影响对承诺的反应。
edges.noteEn: When followers cannot distinguish the leader's choices exactly, their posterior beliefs change which commitments elicit a response.

edges.label: 用放弃的机会解释继续参与
edges.note: 比较进入后的候选结果与此前可得的收益，将均衡集合的稳定要求转化为前向归纳限制。
edges.noteEn: Comparing candidate continuation outcomes with a previously available payoff turns set stability into a forward-induction restriction.

edges.label: 让多个发送者可以同时传递类型
edges.note: 将一般前向归纳问题落实到多发送者环境，比较连续信号结果与有限博弈稳定结果的极限。
edges.noteEn: The multi-sender setting connects forward-induction outcomes under continuous signaling to limits of stable outcomes of finite games.

edges.label: 缩小失误分布的扰动范围
edges.note: 以当前行动分布附近的扰动检验大博弈均衡，改变了通常全支撑扰动所要求的稳健性。
edges.noteEn: Testing nearby distributions changes the robustness requirement used by standard full-support trembles.

branches.questionEn: How does equilibrium require actions to be optimal against one another? How can we test a threat that would arise only after an unexpected history?
branches.boundaryEn: The branch moves from existence in finite strategic-form games to consistency of actions and beliefs in extensive form, then distinguishes individual equilibria from stable sets.

branches.name: 不完全信息与全局博弈
branches.question: 其他人不知道什么，又怎样看待我所知道的事？高阶信念会选择哪一个协调结果？
branches.boundary: 涵盖贝叶斯类型、全局博弈的噪声结构及选择结果对类型空间的稳健性。与单个决策者的后验更新不同，核心是对彼此信念的推断。

papers.title: Games with Incomplete Information Played by “Bayesian” Players, I–III. Part I. The Basic Model
papers.note: 让自然先选类型，以类型及其主观条件分布描述玩家对收益、信息及他人类型的不确定性。
papers.noteEn: Nature chooses types first. Types and their conditional beliefs describe uncertainty over payoffs, information, and others’ types.

papers.title: Global Games and Equilibrium Selection
papers.note: 在所研究的二人二行动协调博弈中引入对收益参数的私人噪声，随着噪声消失，选择风险占优均衡。
papers.noteEn: In the two-player, two-action coordination games studied, privately noisy payoff parameters select the risk-dominant equilibrium as noise vanishes.

papers.title: Unique Equilibrium in a Model of Self-Fulfilling Currency Attacks
papers.note: 在投机者私人观察基本面的模型中推导唯一危机门槛，使攻击结果可由基本面和信号结构联合预测。
papers.noteEn: Private observations of fundamentals yield a unique crisis threshold. Fundamentals and the signal structure jointly predict speculative attacks.

papers.title: A Structure Theorem for Rationalizability with Application to Robust Predictions of Refinements
papers.note: 在足够丰富的收益环境中，任一可理性化行动都可成为附近类型的唯一可理性化行动，限制了对高阶信念稳健的精炼。
papers.noteEn: With sufficiently rich payoffs, any rationalizable action can be uniquely rationalizable for nearby types, limiting refinements robust to higher-order beliefs.

papers.title: The Electronic Mail Game: Strategic Behavior under “Almost Common Knowledge”
papers.note: 不完全可靠的电子邮件可产生任意高阶的彼此知道，却无法保证共同知识下的协调结果。
papers.noteEn: Unreliable messages can generate arbitrarily many orders of mutual knowledge without supporting the coordination outcome under common knowledge.

papers.title: The Robustness of Equilibria to Incomplete Information
papers.note: 用一类先验下罕见的收益扰动定义稳健性，给出均衡在所有这类扰动下都可近似实现的条件。
papers.noteEn: Robustness requires nearby equilibrium play for every admissible incomplete-information perturbation that rarely changes payoffs.

papers.title: Equilibrium Selection in Global Games with Strategic Complementarities
papers.authors: David M. Frankel · Stephen Morris · Ady Pauzner
papers.note: 在战略互补等条件下，将消失噪声时迭代支配的极限唯一性扩展至任意数量的玩家和行动。
papers.noteEn: With strategic complementarities and further conditions, limit uniqueness under iterated dominance extends to arbitrary numbers of players and actions.

papers.title: Crises and Prices: Information Aggregation, Multiplicity, and Volatility
papers.note: 金融价格汇总参与者的私人信息，使危机模型即使在私人噪声很小时也可能重新出现多重均衡。
papers.noteEn: A financial price aggregates private signals and can restore multiplicity even when private noise is small.

papers.title: The Theory of Global Games on Test: Experimental Analysis of Coordination Games with Public and Private Information
papers.authors: Frank Heinemann · Rosemarie Nagel · Peter Ockenfels
papers.note: 操纵收益信息是否公开，发现参与者采用门槛策略；共同信息下的门槛向收益占优均衡方向偏移。
papers.noteEn: An experiment varies public versus private payoff information. Subjects use thresholds, with common information shifting them toward the payoff-dominant outcome.

papers.title: Social Value of Public Information
papers.note: 行动兼顾基本面和与他人协调；共同看见的信号因此可能在均衡中过度影响行动。
papers.noteEn: Agents care about fundamentals and coordination, potentially giving a common signal excessive equilibrium influence.

papers.title: Approximating Common Knowledge with Common Beliefs
papers.note: 以共同 p 信念表达对某事及彼此对此信念的置信下界，研究它在何种意义上近似共同知识。
papers.noteEn: Common p-belief imposes a shared lower confidence bound through the hierarchy and specifies in what sense common beliefs approximate common knowledge.

papers.title: Common Belief Foundations of Global Games
papers.authors: Stephen Morris · Hyun Song Shin · Muhamet Yildiz
papers.note: 用玩家认为自身收益参数高于对手的概率刻画排序信念；对这些信念的近似共同确信可推出唯一可理性化行动。
papers.noteEn: Rank beliefs are probabilities players assign to having a higher payoff parameter than their opponent. Approximate common certainty of those beliefs can pin down a unique rationalizable action.

papers.title: Dynamic Global Games of Regime Change: Learning, Multiplicity, and the Timing of Attacks
papers.authors: George-Marios Angeletos · Christian Hellwig · Alessandro Pavan
papers.note: 把单次攻击改为重复的攻击机会；政权存续本身透露信息，可带来多重均衡和不同的攻击时点。
papers.noteEn: With repeated opportunities to attack, the regime's survival conveys information and can generate multiplicity and different attack dates.

papers.title: Adversarial Coordination and Public Information Design
papers.role: 最坏均衡下的信息设计
papers.roleEn: Information design under worst-case equilibrium selection
papers.note: 设计者按最坏均衡评价公共信号。在该全局博弈中，最优政策消除战略不确定性，却无需披露全部基本面。
papers.noteEn: A designer evaluates public signals under the worst equilibrium. The optimal policy eliminates strategic uncertainty without fully disclosing fundamentals.

edges.label: 约束类型的来源
edges.note: 私人信息由同一基本面的噪声观察产生，这一额外结构给高阶信念施加限制，进而支持均衡选择。
edges.noteEn: Private information comes from noisy observations of one fundamental. This extra structure restricts higher-order beliefs and supports selection.

edges.label: 从博弈矩阵到危机门槛
edges.note: 将私人噪声协调机制用于大量投机者的攻击决策，求解攻击的临界基本面。
edges.noteEn: Apply private-noise coordination to attacks by many speculators and derive the critical fundamental.
edges.labelEn: From a payoff matrix to a crisis threshold

edges.label: 放宽扰动方向
edges.note: 沿特定噪声结构的极限可以给出唯一预测；容许更广泛的高阶信念扰动，选择结论可能改变。
edges.noteEn: A particular noise structure can deliver a unique limit. A wider range of perturbations to higher-order beliefs can change the selection.

edges.label: 构造高阶信念差异
edges.note: 将类型的不确定性具体化为收到几次确认，展示最后一层确认缺失如何改变策略。
edges.noteEn: Types count message confirmations, making the strategic consequence of a missing final confirmation explicit.

edges.label: 改变允许的扰动
edges.note: 从特定噪声信号下选哪个结果，转向哪些预测能在一整类小概率扰动下维持。
edges.noteEn: Instead of selecting along one noisy-signal specification, test which outcomes survive an entire family of rare perturbations.

edges.label: 越过二人二行动
edges.note: 扩大行动和玩家集合后仍可得到极限唯一性，但所选结果一般可能取决于噪声结构。
edges.noteEn: Limit uniqueness survives the enlarged game, although which outcome is selected can depend on the noise structure.

edges.label: 让价格透露其他人的信息
edges.note: 危机门槛模型加入市场价格后，行动者还能推断他人所见，唯一性随信息反馈而改变。
edges.noteEn: Adding an informative market price to the crisis model changes what agents infer about others’ signals and can overturn uniqueness.

edges.label: 把均衡门槛带入实验
edges.note: 在控制基本面和收益的环境里比较信息处理组，从行为中检验全局博弈的选择预测。
edges.noteEn: Controlling fundamentals and payoffs allows treatment comparisons to test the selection prediction against observed behavior.

edges.label: 从均衡选择到信息福利
edges.note: 共同信号同时改变一阶与高阶预期，因此提高公开精度不总会改善福利。
edges.noteEn: A public signal moves both first- and higher-order beliefs, so precision need not always raise welfare.

edges.label: 给「几乎共同知道」一个概率标准
edges.labelEn: Give near-common knowledge a probability criterion
edges.note: 邮件博弈揭示有限阶知识的局限，共同 p 信念则提出可对所有阶同时施加的要求。
edges.noteEn: Finite levels of knowledge can fail in the email game. Common p-belief offers a probabilistic requirement applied at every order.

edges.label: 提取噪声选择背后的信念限制
edges.labelEn: Isolate the belief restriction behind noise selection
edges.note: 从给定的信号生成方式转向直接刻画信念层级中促成唯一预测的性质。
edges.noteEn: Rather than fixing a signal-generation process, identify a property of the belief hierarchy that delivers selection.

edges.label: 让上期未崩溃成为新观测
edges.labelEn: Learn from surviving the previous attack
edges.note: 单期危机门槛给出唯一性时，加入历史存续仍会改变高阶信念及未来门槛。
edges.noteEn: Even when the one-shot crisis threshold is unique, past survival can alter higher-order beliefs and future thresholds.

edges.label: 从评价公共信号转为选择信号
edges.note: 给定外生私人信息，设计者主动选择公开什么，并须预防参与者协调在对其最不利的均衡。
edges.noteEn: With exogenous private signals in place, the designer chooses what to disclose while anticipating adverse equilibrium selection.

branches.questionEn: What do others lack information about, and what do they think I know? Which coordination outcome do higher-order beliefs select?
branches.boundaryEn: The branch covers Bayesian types, noise in global games, and the robustness of selection to type spaces. The focus is on inferences about one another's beliefs.

branches.name: 重复博弈与声誉
branches.question: 同一行动如何通过未来奖励、惩罚或旁观者的学习改变今天的激励？
branches.boundary: 分别处理完全信息下的延续收益与对承诺类型的学习；二者对合作、长期收益和福利的预测可以不同。

papers.title: Rational Cooperation in the Finitely Repeated Prisoners’ Dilemma
papers.authors: David M. Kreps · Paul Milgrom · John Roberts · Robert Wilson
papers.note: 有限期囚徒困境中，对方可能遵守特定行为规则这一小概率，可以让理性玩家在早期选择合作。
papers.noteEn: In a finitely repeated prisoner's dilemma, a small probability that the opponent follows a particular rule can induce rational players to cooperate early.

papers.title: The Folk Theorem in Repeated Games with Discounting or with Incomplete Information
papers.note: 刻画耐心玩家可用历史依赖奖惩支持的收益；在相应维数等条件下，严格个体理性的可行收益可被支持。
papers.noteEn: History-dependent rewards and punishments characterize payoffs for patient players. Subject to dimensionality and other conditions, strictly individually rational feasible payoffs can be sustained.

papers.title: Reputation and Equilibrium Selection in Games with a Patient Player
papers.note: 耐心的长期玩家面对一串短期对手时，模仿一个有正先验概率的承诺类型可为其均衡收益提供下界。
papers.noteEn: Facing successive short-lived opponents, a patient long-lived player can obtain an equilibrium payoff lower bound by imitating a commitment type with positive prior probability.

papers.title: Bad Reputation
papers.note: 构造声誉动机耗尽交易剩余的例子。为了显得可靠，长期玩家的行动偏离对当期客户最有价值的选择。
papers.noteEn: Reputation can exhaust gains from trade. To appear reliable, a long-lived player acts against the interests of the current customer.

papers.title: Reputation in Continuous-Time Games
papers.note: 在布朗噪声公共信号下用微分方程刻画声誉均衡，并给出以公众后验为状态的唯一马尔可夫均衡的条件。
papers.noteEn: With noisy Brownian public signals, differential equations characterize reputational equilibria. The paper gives conditions for a unique Markov equilibrium with public beliefs as its state.

papers.title: The Folk Theorem with Imperfect Public Information
papers.authors: Drew Fudenberg · David K. Levine · Eric Maskin
papers.note: 在公共信号满足适当秩条件、玩家充分耐心时，即使行动无法直接观察，也可支持广泛的可行且个体理性收益。
papers.noteEn: Under suitable rank conditions on public signals, sufficiently patient players can support a broad set of feasible, individually rational payoffs despite unobserved actions.

papers.title: Imperfect Monitoring and Impermanent Reputations
papers.authors: Martin W. Cripps · George J. Mailath · Larry Samuelson
papers.note: 在其不完美监督模型中，策略型玩家不能永久维持自己会遵守不可信承诺的声誉。
papers.noteEn: In their imperfect-monitoring environment a strategic player cannot indefinitely sustain a reputation for noncredible commitment behavior.

papers.title: Toward a Theory of Discounted Repeated Games with Imperfect Monitoring
papers.authors: Dilip Abreu · David Pearce · Ennio Stacchetti
papers.note: 将当前行动、公共信号和延续收益的激励约束写成集合算子，分析不完美监督下的均衡收益。
papers.noteEn: An operator combines current actions, public signals, and incentive-compatible continuation payoffs to analyze equilibrium payoff sets.

papers.title: When Is Reputation Bad?
papers.authors: Jeffrey C. Ely · Drew Fudenberg · David K. Levine
papers.note: 刻画一类短期玩家可拒绝参与的博弈：诱使其参与的行动也可能被误解为不良类型的证据。
papers.noteEn: In a class of games with optional participation, actions that encourage entry can also be mistaken for evidence of a bad type.

papers.title: Bad Reputation Due to Incompetent Expert
papers.note: 无信息的推荐人为保住专家形象而扭曲建议，足够强的声誉动机可使市场崩溃。发表于 Journal of Economic Theory。
papers.noteEn: An uninformed recommender's concern for a reputation for expertise can cause complete market breakdown. Published in the Journal of Economic Theory.

papers.title: Reputation for Quality
papers.note: 企业可投资改变未来品质，消费者根据信号更新声誉；好消息与坏消息学习带来不同投资激励。
papers.noteEn: Firms invest in future quality while consumers learn from signals. Good-news and bad-news learning give different investment incentives.

papers.title: Reputation and Imperfect Information
papers.note: 在有限期连锁店博弈中，潜在进入者不确定在位企业是否强硬，能使策略型企业在早期抵抗进入。
papers.noteEn: Uncertainty over whether an incumbent is tough can sustain early resistance to entry in a finite chain-store game.

papers.title: The Folk Theorem for Irreducible Stochastic Games with Imperfect Public Monitoring
papers.note: 以首次返回当前状态为递归节点，在不可约状态转移与适当的公共信号条件下给出民间定理。
papers.noteEn: Using the next return to the current state as a recursive stopping point yields a folk theorem under irreducibility and suitable public monitoring conditions.

papers.title: Reputation for Playing Mixed Actions: A Characterization Theorem
papers.role: 混合承诺与相互依赖价值
papers.note: 当长期玩家的信息关系到对手收益时，模仿随机行动本身不能保证混合承诺收益，论文刻画相应的声誉保证条件。
papers.noteEn: When the long-lived player's information affects opponents’ payoffs, imitation alone need not guarantee a mixed commitment payoff. The paper characterizes when reputation can secure it.

papers.title: Trust and Betrayals: Reputational Payoffs and Behaviors without Commitment
papers.note: 每种长期玩家都有严格为正的私人背叛收益。刻画各类型最高均衡收益，并证明均低于混合承诺基准。
papers.noteEn: Every long-lived type gains strictly from betrayal. The paper characterizes each type's highest equilibrium payoff and shows that it falls below its mixed Stackelberg benchmark.

edges.label: 一般化承诺类型
edges.note: 从有限次囚徒困境中的合作，走向一般阶段博弈里耐心长期玩家可以保证的收益。
edges.noteEn: Move from cooperation in a finite prisoner's dilemma to payoffs that a patient long-lived player can secure in a general stage game.

edges.label: 改换持续参与者
edges.note: 民间定理研究多个参与者之间的延续激励；面对连续更替的短期对手，长期玩家通过改变外界对类型的信念赢得收益。
edges.noteEn: Folk theorems study continuation incentives among ongoing participants. With successive short-lived opponents the long-lived player gains by changing beliefs about her type.
edges.labelEn: Change who stays in the game

edges.label: 福利反例
edges.note: 长期玩家的私人声誉激励不保证有效交易，可构造双方失去全部剩余的环境。
edges.noteEn: Private reputational incentives need not lead to efficient trade. Both parties can lose all the surplus.

edges.label: 引入连续噪声
edges.note: 从声誉的收益界深入到信念路径，研究行动被连续带噪观察时均衡如何演化。
edges.noteEn: Move from reputational payoff bounds to belief paths and study how equilibrium evolves when actions are continuously observed with noise.

edges.label: 以带噪信号代替行动历史
edges.labelEn: Replace observed actions with noisy signals
edges.note: 惩罚必须依据信号实施；识别不同玩家的偏离是民间定理能否成立的关键。
edges.noteEn: Punishments must condition on signals, so the ability to distinguish deviations by different players becomes central.

edges.label: 区分贴现收益与最终学习
edges.labelEn: Separate discounted returns from eventual learning
edges.note: 耐心可以提升贴现收益下界；固定折现率后沿无限历史考察，则声誉本身可以消退。
edges.noteEn: Patience raises a discounted payoff guarantee, yet along an infinite history at a fixed discount factor the reputation itself may vanish.

edges.label: 把奖惩写为集合不动点
edges.note: 从构造耐心玩家可达到的收益，转向在给定贴现率下递归检验候选收益集合。
edges.noteEn: Move from constructing patient-player payoffs to recursively testing candidate sets at a given discount factor.

edges.label: 从反例到适用条件
edges.note: 将原例中的逆向声誉激励推广到容许多种承诺类型的博弈，识别短期对手的参与选择所起的作用。
edges.noteEn: The original perverse incentive extends to a wider set of commitment types when short-lived opponents can choose whether to participate.

edges.label: 由行动类型转向识别专业能力
edges.note: 即使有信息的专家只关心当期，消费者长期参与，无信息类型的声誉动机仍可破坏交易。
edges.noteEn: Even with a myopic informed expert and a long-lived consumer, the uninformed type's reputational incentives can destroy trade.

edges.label: 由固定类型到内生质量
edges.note: 声誉不仅揭示给定类型，也改变影响未来真实质量的投入。
edges.labelEn: From fixed types to endogenous quality
edges.noteEn: Reputation concerns also govern investments that change actual quality rather than just beliefs about fixed types.

edges.label: 从互惠合作转向阻止进入
edges.note: 同为小概率类型支撑的声誉，在位企业靠公开的早期行为影响后来不同进入者的选择。
edges.noteEn: The same logic of a low-probability type now operates through early public actions that influence successive entrants.

edges.label: 让延续激励跨越随机状态
edges.note: 给定状态下的信号既影响惩罚又伴随状态演化，须追踪直到该状态再次出现的激励。
edges.noteEn: Signals influence punishment while the state evolves, requiring incentives to be tracked until the process revisits the state.

edges.label: 改变行动传递的信息
edges.labelEn: Change the informational content of imitation
edges.note: 模仿既影响对行为类型的判断，也影响对收益状态的判断，二者不必朝同一方向移动。
edges.noteEn: Imitation now influences inferences about payoff states as well as behavioral types, and those inferences need not move together.

edges.label: 让所有类型都能策略性背叛
edges.labelEn: Make betrayal strategic for all types
edges.note: 以持久但私有的经济激励替代机械承诺类型，得到与固定规则声誉不同的收益界。
edges.noteEn: Persistent private incentives replace mechanical commitment types, changing the payoff bound from reputation.

resources.title: Repeated Games and Reputations: Long-Run Relationships

branches.questionEn: How can the prospect of rewards, punishments, or learning by observers change the incentive to act today?
branches.boundaryEn: The branch distinguishes continuation payoffs under complete information from learning about commitment types. Their implications for cooperation, long-run payoffs, and welfare can differ.

branches.name: 理性化与认知博弈
branches.question: 仅知道玩家理性及其对他人理性的信念，可以排除哪些行动？什么时候还能推出纳什均衡？
branches.boundary: 研究的是一组行动可以由什么信念支撑，既可分析共同理性的推论，也可加上猜测一致性等额外要求。

papers.title: Rationalizable Strategic Behavior
papers.note: 迭代保留对合理对手行为的某种信念最优的策略，说明共同理性仍可容许多个相互不构成均衡的行动。
papers.noteEn: Iteratively retain best responses to some belief about reasonable opposing behavior. Common rationality can allow choices that do not jointly form an equilibrium.

papers.title: Rationalizable Strategic Behavior and the Problem of Perfection
papers.note: 独立发展可理性化概念，并考察扩展式博弈的历史信息及关于玩家谨慎程度的额外推断。
papers.noteEn: Independently develops rationalizability and considers what histories in extensive-form games and assumptions of caution imply.

papers.title: Epistemic Conditions for Nash Equilibrium
papers.note: 区分二人与多人博弈，给出有关收益、理性及策略猜测的知识条件，说明何时猜测本身构成纳什均衡。
papers.noteEn: For two-player and multiplayer games, knowledge conditions on payoffs, rationality, and conjectures identify when the conjectures constitute a Nash equilibrium.

papers.title: Interim Correlated Rationalizability
papers.authors: Eddie Dekel · Drew Fudenberg · Stephen Morris
papers.note: 为私人类型定义中期相关可理性化；具有相同信念层级的类型拥有同样的可理性化结果集合。
papers.noteEn: Interim correlated rationalizability is defined for private types. Types with identical belief hierarchies have the same set of rationalizable outcomes.

papers.title: Rationalizability and Correlated Equilibria
papers.note: 证明相关可理性化与事后均衡之间的等价，后者是主观相关均衡的一种精炼。
papers.noteEn: Correlated rationalizability is equivalent to a posteriori equilibrium, a refinement of subjective correlated equilibrium.

papers.title: Strong Belief and Forward Induction Reasoning
papers.note: 以观察历史后的信念修正定义强信念，为扩展式可理性化与信号博弈的直观准则给出认知刻画。
papers.noteEn: Strong belief restricts revisions after observed histories and yields epistemic characterizations of extensive-form rationalizability and the intuitive criterion.

papers.title: Backward Induction and Common Knowledge of Rationality
papers.note: 在其完全信息动态博弈的认知模型中，理性的共同知识蕴含逆向归纳结果。
papers.noteEn: In the paper's epistemic model of perfect-information games, common knowledge of rationality implies the backward-induction outcome.

papers.title: On Rationalizability in Extensive Games
papers.note: 用对玩家更新系统的限制刻画 Pearce 的扩展式可理性化；在一般收益的完美信息博弈中得到逆向归纳路径。
papers.noteEn: Restrictions on updating characterize Pearce's extensive-form rationalizability and yield the backward-induction path in generic perfect-information games.

papers.title: Bayes Correlated Equilibrium and the Comparison of Information Structures in Games
papers.note: 给定基础信息结构，以服从约束刻画在玩家获得额外信息后可由贝叶斯纳什均衡实现的联合结果。
papers.noteEn: Obedience characterizes the joint outcomes attainable in Bayes–Nash equilibrium when players may receive information beyond a given structure.

papers.title: Robust Predictions in Games With Incomplete Information
papers.role: 信息结构未知时的预测
papers.note: 在给定收益环境下，允许所有额外信息结构，用贝叶斯相关均衡刻画可实现分布。
papers.noteEn: Across all additional information structures, Bayes correlated equilibrium characterizes attainable distributions in a given payoff environment.

papers.title: Hierarchies of Conditional Beliefs and Interactive Epistemology in Dynamic Games
papers.note: 构造一致的无限条件信念层级，以表述玩家在不同历史下如何看待他人的条件信念和理性。
papers.noteEn: Coherent infinite hierarchies of conditional beliefs represent what players believe about others’ updated beliefs and rationality at different histories.

papers.title: Admissibility in Games
papers.authors: Adam Brandenburger · Amanda Friedenberg · H. Jerome Keisler
papers.role: 迭代可容许性的认知基础
papers.note: 以字典序信念处理谨慎性，区分有限层次与共同假设理性，分析它们对弱支配策略迭代删除的含义。
papers.noteEn: Lexicographic beliefs represent caution. The paper separates finite orders of assumption of rationality from common assumption and examines their implications for iterated admissibility.

papers.title: Topologies on Types
papers.authors: Eddie Dekel · Drew Fudenberg · Stephen Morris
papers.note: 以各博弈行动达到近似中期相关可理性化所需的最小误差刻画类型收敛；逐阶信念收敛并不足够。
papers.noteEn: Convergence of types is defined through the smallest errors needed for interim correlated rationalizability across games and actions. Coordinatewise convergence of beliefs alone is insufficient.

papers.title: Correlated Equilibrium as an Expression of Bayesian Rationality
papers.roleEn: Common priors and distributions of play
papers.note: 把行动看作玩家在不同信息下的理性选择，在共同先验等认知条件下导出相关均衡分布。
papers.noteEn: When actions are rational choices at different information states, a common prior and the paper's epistemic assumptions imply a correlated-equilibrium distribution.

edges.label: 两条平行路线
edges.note: 同年两篇独立论文提出相近思想，Pearce 进一步讨论扩展式历史信息与谨慎性。
edges.noteEn: Two independent papers introduced related ideas in the same year. Pearce also studied extensive-form histories and caution.

edges.label: 加强认知条件
edges.note: 从最佳反应可被某套信念解释，转向识别何种共同或相互知识能使玩家的猜测组成均衡。
edges.noteEn: Move from rationalizing best responses with some beliefs to identifying common or mutual knowledge under which conjectures form an equilibrium.

edges.label: 越过完全信息
edges.note: 把迭代最佳反应移到给定私人类型的中期阶段，并容许关于他人行为和状态的相关信念。
edges.noteEn: Apply iterated best responses at the interim stage given private types, allowing correlated beliefs over others’ actions and the state.

edges.label: 容许玩家猜测相关
edges.note: 把对对手行为的合理信念与主观相关均衡相连，展示两种表示得到相同的行动预测。
edges.noteEn: Allowing correlation in conjectures connects best-response reasoning to an equilibrium representation with the same action predictions.

edges.label: 解释收到意外信息后的推理
edges.note: 只要观察仍与他人理性相容，强信念就要求继续相信其理性，解释迭代删除背后的推理。
edges.noteEn: As long as observations remain compatible with others’ rationality, strong belief retains it, giving an epistemic interpretation of iterative elimination.

edges.label: 比较静态行动与到达的路径
edges.note: 与支撑纳什猜测的知识条件平行，这里分析树形博弈及其实际到达的结果。
edges.noteEn: Alongside conditions supporting Nash conjectures, this result concerns what path of play is reached in a game tree.

edges.label: 从删除步骤到信念系统
edges.note: 给迭代筛选行动配上嵌套的假设，使观察到的行动如何改变对对手的判断变得明确。
edges.noteEn: Nested hypotheses reinterpret iterative deletion by making the revision of beliefs about opponents explicit.

edges.label: 从中期可选行动到联合结果
edges.labelEn: From interim actions to joint outcomes
edges.note: 中期可理性化筛选每个类型的行动；贝叶斯相关均衡则在给定先验下检验状态和各方行动的联合分布。
edges.noteEn: Interim rationalizability screens each type's actions. Bayes correlated equilibrium tests a joint distribution of states and actions under a given prior.

edges.label: 由认知条件到结果集合
edges.note: 不固定参与者的完整信念层级时，服从建议的激励约束仍能限制可观察结果。
edges.labelEn: From epistemic premises to outcome sets
edges.noteEn: Even without pinning down belief hierarchies, obedience constraints bound observable outcomes.

edges.label: 为强信念提供类型空间
edges.labelEn: Supply a type space for strong belief
edges.note: 在要求意外历史后仍相信理性之前，必须能表示每个历史上的条件信念及其高阶版本。
edges.noteEn: Before imposing strong belief after a surprising history, one needs a representation of conditional beliefs and their higher orders at each history.

edges.label: 把谨慎性加入理性推理
edges.note: 可理性化以某个信念支持最佳反应，谨慎性还要求考虑看似极不可能的对手选择。
edges.noteEn: A rationalizable action needs some supporting belief. Caution also gives weight to opponents’ choices that appear extremely unlikely.

edges.label: 用行为衡量类型是否相近
edges.note: 逐一比较信念层级之外，还可以检验两个类型在所有博弈中是否给出相近的行动预测。
edges.noteEn: Beyond comparing belief hierarchies coordinate by coordinate, compare the action predictions of two types across all games.

edges.label: 比较主观与共同先验
edges.labelEn: Compare subjective beliefs with a common prior
edges.note: 共享先验给各玩家的信念加上联合一致性，改变相关可理性化行动与联合行为分布之间的联系。
edges.noteEn: A common prior imposes joint consistency on individual beliefs, changing the connection between rationalizable actions and the distribution of play.

branches.questionEn: Which actions can we rule out from rationality and beliefs about others’ rationality? When can we also obtain a Nash equilibrium?
branches.boundaryEn: The branch asks which beliefs can support a set of actions. It examines common rationality and additional conditions such as consistency of conjectures.

branches.name: 学习、进化与均衡选择
branches.question: 玩家根据样本、报酬或后悔调整行为时，长期会观察到什么？
branches.boundary: 区分个体当期策略的收敛、行动频率的收敛，以及长期稳态在罕见失误消失时集中于何处。

papers.title: Learning, Mutation, and Long Run Equilibria in Games
papers.authors: Michihiro Kandori · George J. Mailath · Rafael Rob
papers.note: 在有限人群的演化过程中容许随机变异，对含两个对称严格均衡的二乘二对称博弈得到风险占优选择。
papers.noteEn: Random mutations in a finite population select the risk-dominant equilibrium in symmetric two-by-two games with two strict symmetric equilibria.

papers.title: The Evolution of Conventions
papers.note: 让新参与者从有限历史抽样并作最佳反应，以小概率偏离；用小扰动下的长期分布研究哪些惯例持续。
papers.noteEn: New players sample a finite history and best respond, with a small chance of deviation. Long-run distributions under small perturbations identify persistent conventions.

papers.title: Learning Mixed Equilibria
papers.note: 对历史频率作渐近最佳反应时，若阶段策略收敛则其极限为纳什均衡；私人收益扰动为混合行为提供学习解释。
papers.noteEn: If stage strategies that are asymptotic best responses to historical frequencies converge, their limit is Nash. Private payoff perturbations give a learning interpretation of mixing.

papers.title: A Simple Adaptive Procedure Leading to Correlated Equilibrium
papers.note: 根据过去若将一个行动改成另一个行动本可增加的收益调整概率，使经验联合分布几乎必然逼近相关均衡集合。
papers.noteEn: Choice probabilities respond to the past gain from switching one action to another. The empirical joint distribution almost surely approaches the correlated-equilibrium set.

papers.title: Stochastic Evolutionary Game Dynamics
papers.note: 用持续但微弱的噪声下的长期占用概率定义随机稳定，并说明它可与进化稳定策略和确定性吸引子不同。
papers.noteEn: Long-run occupancy under small persistent noise defines stochastic stability, which can differ from evolutionary stability and deterministic attraction.

papers.title: Learning in Games with Unstable Equilibria
papers.authors: Michel Benaïm · Josef Hofbauer · Ed Hopkins
papers.note: 对若干类似虚拟博弈的学习过程，以时间均值刻画混合均衡不稳定时的非均衡行为。
papers.noteEn: For certain fictitious-play-like processes, time averages describe nonequilibrium behavior around unstable mixed equilibria.

papers.title: Uncoupled Dynamics Do Not Lead to Nash Equilibrium
papers.role: 非耦合动态的不可能性
papers.note: 构造反例，说明在所研究的非耦合动态类中，玩家只使用自身收益函数不能普遍保证策略收敛到纳什均衡。
papers.noteEn: Counterexamples rule out convergence to Nash equilibrium in every game for the class of uncoupled dynamics studied, where each player uses only her own payoff function.

papers.title: Learning, Local Interaction, and Coordination
papers.note: 比较随机全体匹配与邻里互动；局部匹配可大幅缩短达到风险占优惯例的等待时间。
papers.noteEn: Comparing population-wide matching to neighborhood interaction shows how local matching can sharply shorten the wait for risk-dominant coordination.

papers.title: The Statistical Mechanics of Strategic Interaction
papers.note: 让玩家在格点上仅与有限邻居互动，研究随机更新策略的平稳分布及近似最佳反应如何选择协调均衡。
papers.noteEn: With interactions limited to lattice neighbors, stationary distributions of stochastic revisions relate nearly optimal responses to equilibrium selection.

papers.title: Predicting How People Play Games: Reinforcement Learning in Experimental Games with Unique, Mixed Strategy Equilibria
papers.note: 用过去策略所得收益更新倾向，跨实验检验其对唯一混合均衡博弈中学习路径的预测。
papers.noteEn: Payoffs reinforce action propensities, yielding predictions across experiments in games with a unique mixed equilibrium.

papers.title: Calibrated Learning and Correlated Equilibrium
papers.authors: Dean P. Foster · Rakesh V. Vohra
papers.note: 玩家对经过校准的预测作最佳反应时，经验行动频率的极限点落在相关均衡集合中。
papers.noteEn: When players best respond to calibrated forecasts, limit points of empirical play lie in the correlated-equilibrium set.

papers.title: Learning by Trial and Error
papers.note: 玩家区分自己的试验与他人改变行为而导致的收益异常，在收益一般且存在纯均衡的有限博弈中实现纳什行为。
papers.noteEn: Players distinguish trials of their own from payoff surprises caused by others. Under generic payoffs and existence of a pure equilibrium, the rule implements Nash behavior.

papers.title: Evolutionary Implementation and Congestion Pricing
papers.note: 在道路网络中设计分散定价，使按照一类短视规则调整路线的人逐步达到有效流量，无须直接报告私人信息。
papers.noteEn: Decentralized route pricing guides travelers who follow a class of myopic revision rules toward efficient flows without directly reporting private information.

papers.title: The Harder Path: Last Iterate Convergence for Uncoupled Learning in Zero-Sum Games with Bandit Feedback
papers.authors: Côme Fiegel · Pierre Menard · Tadashi Kozuno · Michal Valko · Vianney Perchet
papers.role: 仅观测自身收益的末次策略
papers.note: 在零和矩阵博弈中给出无需相互通信的算法，并刻画仅观察所选行动回报时末次策略收敛比平均策略更慢的最优速率。发表于 ICML 2025 论文集。
papers.noteEn: For zero-sum matrix games with bandit feedback, uncoupled algorithms attain the optimal last-iterate rate, slower than the average-iterate rate. Published in the ICML 2025 proceedings.

edges.label: 比较调整规则
edges.note: 两个独立的模型使用不同的个体调整规则，都研究失误罕见时的随机稳定性。
edges.noteEn: Two independent models use different individual revision rules to study stochastic stability when mistakes are rare.

edges.label: 改变收敛对象
edges.note: 从各玩家混合策略是否收敛，转向更弱的经验联合分布收敛，并把基准改为相关均衡。
edges.noteEn: Replace convergence of individual mixed strategies with convergence of the empirical joint distribution to the correlated-equilibrium set.

edges.label: 寻找稀有变异选择的基准
edges.labelEn: Identify a benchmark for rare mutations
edges.note: 有限群体变异模型的长期选择，可回溯到更一般的随机扰动稳定性问题。
edges.noteEn: The finite-population mutation model specializes a broader question about stability under stochastic perturbations.

edges.label: 刻画不收敛的行为
edges.note: 混合策略不收敛时，仍可研究沿学习轨迹取平均后出现的规律。
edges.noteEn: When mixed strategies fail to converge, taking averages along the learning path can still yield a prediction.

edges.label: 把收敛目标改为纳什
edges.labelEn: Change the convergence target to Nash
edges.note: 后悔匹配可让经验分布趋近相关均衡；在同样强调分散信息时，策略本身趋向纳什是更强的要求。
edges.noteEn: Regret matching can bring empirical distributions to correlated equilibrium. Convergence of strategies to Nash under decentralized information is a stronger demand.

edges.label: 改变匹配范围
edges.note: 即使长期选择相同，接触哪些对手也会改变有限时间内观察到该结果的机会。
edges.noteEn: Even with the same long-run selection, the matching pattern changes how likely it is to be observed within a finite horizon.

edges.label: 由历史抽样到空间邻域
edges.labelEn: From sampled histories to spatial neighborhoods
edges.note: 把适应过程的局部信息具体化为空间邻居，而非从过去的总体行动中抽样。
edges.noteEn: Local information in the adaptive process comes from spatial neighbors rather than a sample of past population play.

edges.label: 区分均衡与到达路径
edges.note: 相同的混合均衡预测并不规定早期行动轨迹，强化机制用逐轮收益提供额外预测。
edges.noteEn: The same mixed-equilibrium prediction leaves early play open, while reinforcement predicts adjustments from realized payoffs.

edges.label: 用预测误差代替反事实后悔
edges.labelEn: Replace counterfactual regret with forecast error
edges.note: 校准检验预测频率是否吻合，后悔匹配检验更改过去选择的收益，二者殊途可达相关均衡。
edges.noteEn: Calibration tests forecast frequencies, whereas regret matching tests counterfactual gains from switching past actions. Both can lead to correlated equilibrium.

edges.label: 限制博弈并改变调整规则
edges.labelEn: Restrict the games and change the adjustment rule
edges.note: 通用非耦合收敛的不可能性仍在，但利用试错反馈并限定博弈类可以得到正面结果。
edges.noteEn: The general impossibility for uncoupled convergence leaves room for positive results with trial-and-error feedback on a restricted class of games.

edges.label: 从预测长期行为到设计长期行为
edges.labelEn: From predicting long-run play to designing it
edges.note: 把适应性调整当作制度约束，倒过来选择价格，使调整过程支持规划者要实现的流量。
edges.noteEn: Treat adaptive adjustment as an institutional constraint and choose prices so that it supports the planner's target flows.

edges.label: 区分一般不可能性与零和特例
edges.labelEn: Separate a general impossibility from a zero-sum result
edges.note: 限制收益结构后仍须区分最终策略和历史平均策略收敛；只观察部分收益时二者还能有不同的速率。
edges.noteEn: Even with zero-sum payoffs, convergence of the current policy differs from convergence of averages. Partial payoff feedback makes their rates differ.

resources.title: The Theory of Learning in Games

branches.questionEn: What do we observe in the long run when players adapt to samples, payoffs, or regret?
branches.boundaryEn: Distinguish convergence of current strategies, convergence of action frequencies, and concentration of the long-run stationary distribution as rare mistakes disappear.

branches.name: 谈判、延迟与声誉
branches.question: 买卖双方能创造共同剩余，为什么达成的协议依赖耐心、出价顺序和拒绝的含义？
branches.boundary: 从给定分歧点的公理化分配到明确规定报价协议的动态博弈；信息不对称与顽固类型可以引入延迟。

papers.title: The Bargaining Problem
papers.note: 用帕累托效率、对称性、效用单位不变性和无关选项独立性刻画相对分歧点收益增量的乘积最大解。
papers.noteEn: Pareto efficiency, symmetry, invariance to utility units, and independence of irrelevant alternatives characterize maximization of the product of gains over disagreement.

papers.title: Perfect Equilibrium in a Bargaining Model
papers.note: 让双方轮流报价并承受延迟成本；在标准贴现版本中，唯一子博弈精炼均衡立即成交，分配随耐心和先手身份变化。
papers.noteEn: The parties alternate offers and bear delay costs. With standard discounting, the unique subgame-perfect equilibrium reaches immediate agreement, with shares depending on patience and the first mover.

papers.title: The Nash Bargaining Solution in Economic Modelling
papers.authors: Ken Binmore · Ariel Rubinstein · Asher Wolinsky
papers.note: 考察由时间偏好或谈判破裂风险驱动的交替报价模型，说明在适当极限下如何为纳什谈判解及权重赋予协议解释。
papers.noteEn: Alternating offers with time preferences or breakdown risk explain the Nash bargaining solution and its weights in appropriate limits.

papers.title: A Bargaining Model with Incomplete Information about Time Preferences
papers.note: 让一方不知对方的时间偏好，刻画一类谈判序贯均衡，说明拒绝报价如何传递对方耐心的信息。
papers.noteEn: When one party does not know the other's time preference, a class of sequential equilibria shows how rejecting an offer can reveal patience.

papers.title: Bargaining and Reputation
papers.note: 容许顽固类型坚持既定要求，连续时间版本的唯一均衡包含等待，耐心参与者也可能推迟互利交易。
papers.noteEn: Stubborn types can insist on fixed demands. The unique continuous-time equilibrium involves waiting, so even patient parties can delay mutually beneficial trade.

papers.title: Other Solutions to Nash's Bargaining Problem
papers.note: 以个体单调性替换无关选项独立性，得到双方按各自最高可得收益增量同比例分配的解。
papers.noteEn: Replacing independence of irrelevant alternatives with individual monotonicity gives equal proportions of each party’s maximum feasible gain.

papers.title: The Role of Information in Bargaining: An Experimental Study
papers.authors: Alvin E. Roth · J. Keith Murnighan
papers.note: 在二人谈判实验中改变谁知道对方的奖品价值，辨别掌握何种支付信息会改变协议。
papers.noteEn: A two-person bargaining experiment varies who knows whose lottery prize to isolate how specific payoff information affects settlements.

papers.title: Strategic Delay in Bargaining
papers.note: 让双方自行选择何时还价，构造用等待显示强硬程度的均衡。允许随时出价的极限也可有延迟。
papers.noteEn: Endogenous offer timing permits equilibria in which delay signals bargaining strength, even as the minimum interval between offers vanishes.

papers.title: Bargaining under Incomplete Information
papers.note: 两人同时报价，报价相交才按给定规则成交；私有估值下，均衡报价可能让互利交易流失。
papers.noteEn: A simultaneous bid and ask lead to trade only if they cross. With private valuations, equilibrium bids can leave mutually beneficial trades unrealized.

papers.title: Testing Noncooperative Bargaining Theory: A Preliminary Study
papers.authors: Ken Binmore · Avner Shaked · John Sutton
papers.note: 以两阶段谈判实验比较有时限的报价和折价如何影响分配，为非合作协议给出实验检验。
papers.noteEn: A two-stage experiment tests how a deadline and discounting in an offer protocol shape negotiated divisions.

papers.title: Bargaining and Reputation: An Experiment on Bargaining in the Presence of Behavioural Types
papers.authors: Matthew Embrey, Guillaume R. Fréchette & Steven F. Lehrer
papers.note: 实验引入坚持给定要价的行为类型，检验其他参与者是否会模仿这类人的强硬姿态。
papers.noteEn: Laboratory bargaining introduces obstinate types and tests whether their strategic counterparts mimic their demands.

papers.title: Cheap Talk Can Matter in Bargaining
papers.role: 进入实质谈判前的谈话
papers.note: 双方可选择是否继续认真谈判时，事前无约束力的消息能在改善议价地位与促成后续谈判之间形成权衡。
papers.noteEn: When good-faith participation is endogenous, cheap talk trades off bargaining position against the chance of continued negotiation.

papers.title: Bargaining with Arrival of New Traders
papers.note: 把新交易者或信息的随机到来纳入出价模型；频繁报价极限下仍有延迟，且卖方收益等于等待外部事件的价值。
