papers.noteEn: Random arrivals of traders or information sustain delay even with frequent offers. The seller receives the payoff available from waiting for an arrival.

papers.title: Bargaining, Reputation, and Equilibrium Selection in Repeated Games with Contracts
papers.note: 两人反复互动且能就剩余博弈签订可执行合同，利用谈判和声誉研究均衡收益的选择。
papers.noteEn: Two players interact repeatedly and can sign enforceable contracts for the remaining game. Bargaining and reputation constrain equilibrium payoff selection.

papers.title: Reputational Bargaining with External Resolution Opportunities
papers.role: 有外部裁决的最后通牒
papers.note: 在法院或仲裁可用且强弱为私人信息时，弱方可能以最后通牒虚张声势；外部裁决机会既可能帮助也可能损害弱方。
papers.noteEn: When adjudication is available and claim strength is private, a weak party can bluff with an ultimatum. Access to resolution can help or hurt that party.

edges.label: 建立协议基础
edges.note: 把公理给定的分歧点与分配权重联系到动态协议中破裂风险或等待成本。
edges.noteEn: Connect the axiomatic disagreement point and bargaining weights to breakdown risk or waiting costs in a dynamic protocol.
edges.labelEn: Give the solution a protocol foundation

edges.label: 由单一协议到极限
edges.note: 从离散轮流报价的精确分配研究报价间隔趋小时的公理化表示。
edges.noteEn: Start from exact divisions under discrete alternating offers and study their axiomatic representation as time between offers vanishes.
edges.labelEn: Take a limit of the protocol

edges.label: 隐藏耐心
edges.note: 一旦贴现率不为对手所知，拒绝也能用于改变对手对类型的判断。
edges.noteEn: When discount rates are private, a rejection can alter the opponent's beliefs about type.

edges.label: 加入坚持姿态的类型
edges.note: 从完全信息基准的即时协议走向声誉与耗费剩余的延迟。
edges.noteEn: Replace immediate agreement in the complete-information benchmark with reputation building and delay that consumes surplus.

edges.label: 替换一条谈判公理
edges.note: 同一个可行集和分歧点，在改用机会扩张单调性后可选出不同协议。
edges.noteEn: The same feasible set and disagreement point can select a different agreement once monotonicity under expanding opportunities is imposed.

edges.label: 操纵被谈判者知道的收益
edges.labelEn: Vary what bargainers know about payoffs
edges.note: 将公理化问题中的效用机会落实为实验彩票，并控制支付信息的可见性。
edges.noteEn: Lottery prizes implement utility opportunities in the laboratory, where payoff information can be revealed selectively.

edges.label: 把还价时刻变成选择
edges.labelEn: Make the timing of counteroffers strategic
edges.note: 私有类型原本通过接受或拒绝显露；还价的时点也可传递类型。
edges.noteEn: With private types, not only rejection but also the timing of a counteroffer can carry information.

edges.label: 比较两类私有信息与协议
edges.note: 交替出价模型隐藏耐心；双向报价模型隐藏估值，未成交来自报价门槛而非等待本身。
edges.noteEn: Alternating offers conceal patience. In the simultaneous mechanism valuations are private and trade can fail at the bid–ask threshold.

edges.label: 把轮流出价缩为实验协议
edges.note: 用有限轮次使拒绝和反报价的后果可以预测，比较协议模型与实际分配。
edges.noteEn: A finite number of rounds makes rejection and counteroffers tractable, allowing a comparison of theoretical and observed divisions.

edges.label: 让坚定承诺可操纵
edges.note: 操纵强硬类型的存在，将折现导致的议价让步同建立声誉的激励区分开。
edges.noteEn: Varying the presence of obstinate types separates concessions driven by discounting from incentives to build a reputation.

edges.label: 在交易报价前加入沟通
edges.note: 保留双方私人保留价，但允许讨论是否值得继续谈，使可支持的交易行为改变。
edges.noteEn: With private reservation prices, allowing parties to discuss whether to proceed changes the bargaining behavior that can be supported.

edges.label: 区分信号性延迟与等待机会
edges.labelEn: Distinguish signaling delay from waiting for an opportunity
edges.note: 延迟不仅向现有对手传递强弱，也让外部交易机会有时间到来。
edges.noteEn: Delay can signal strength to the current opponent and allow time for an outside opportunity to arrive.

edges.label: 将分配谈判拓展为签订延续合约
edges.note: 可达成的协议同时影响未来行为及收益，因而必须将重复博弈的外部选择纳入声誉谈判。
edges.noteEn: An agreement governs future behavior and payoffs, bringing outside options from the repeated game into reputational bargaining.

edges.label: 让威胁可以触发外部裁决
edges.note: 除继续等待或作出让步外，谈判者还能用裁决机会塑造对方对索赔正当性的判断。
edges.noteEn: In addition to waiting or conceding, a party can use adjudication opportunities to influence beliefs about whether its claim is justified.

branches.questionEn: If buyers and sellers can create surplus, why does agreement depend on patience, the order of offers, and the meaning of rejection?
branches.boundaryEn: The branch moves from axiomatic divisions at a given disagreement point to dynamic games with explicit protocols. Asymmetric information and stubborn types can introduce delay.

branches.name: 联盟、核与价值分配
branches.question: 联盟能够共同偏离时，哪些分配可维持合作？如果要指定唯一分配，如何衡量每人的贡献？
branches.boundary: 以联盟能实现的总价值为原始数据，分别研究分配的稳定性、价值的公理化归属和沟通网络对联盟的限制。

papers.title: A Value for N-Person Games
papers.note: 以三条公理唯一刻画价值分配。每人的份额等于以随机顺序加入联盟时的平均边际贡献。此处链接 1952 年 RAND 论文 P-295，论文集版本刊于 1953 年。
papers.noteEn: Three axioms uniquely characterize a value. Each person's share equals their average marginal contribution in a random order of entry. This links to RAND Paper P-295 (1952). The collected version appeared in 1953.

papers.title: On Balanced Sets and Cores
papers.note: 用平衡联盟族刻画可转移效用博弈的核何时非空，为联盟阻挡提供可检验条件（另有 Bondareva 的独立贡献）。
papers.noteEn: Balanced families of coalitions characterize when a transferable-utility game has a nonempty core, giving a test for coalitional blocking. Bondareva obtained an independent result.

papers.title: The Assignment Game I: The Core
papers.note: 在两侧一对一且允许支付的指派市场中，核分配与最优配对线性规划的对偶解相对应，可由竞争价格支持。
papers.noteEn: In a one-to-one, two-sided assignment market with transfers, core payoffs correspond to dual solutions of the optimal matching program and can be supported by competitive prices.

papers.title: Graphs and Cooperation in Games
papers.note: 用图的连通分支限制可合作的联盟，再用效率与公平等条件刻画由受限博弈得到的分配规则。
papers.noteEn: Connected components restrict which coalitions can cooperate. Efficiency and fairness conditions then characterize a value for the restricted game.

papers.title: Cores of Convex Games
papers.note: 在边际贡献随联盟扩张而增加的凸博弈中，核是边际贡献向量的凸包，Shapley 值位于核内。
papers.noteEn: In a convex game, increasing marginal contributions make the core the convex hull of marginal vectors and place the Shapley value in the core.

papers.title: The Nucleolus of a Characteristic Function Game
papers.note: 将联盟主张超过实际分配的差额从大到小排列，依字典序最小化以选出唯一的核仁。
papers.noteEn: The nucleolus uniquely minimizes the ordered vector of coalition excesses lexicographically over imputations.

papers.title: Multilinear Extensions of Games
papers.note: 将联盟价值延拓为各人独立随机加入的期望价值，用偏导数的对角线积分表示 Shapley 值。
papers.noteEn: Independent inclusion probabilities extend coalition worth to a multilinear function, whose partial derivatives integrated along the diagonal recover the Shapley value.

papers.title: Monotonic Solutions of Cooperative Games
papers.note: 若一人的边际贡献在所有联盟中都提高，分得的价值不应下降。这一单调性配合对称性与效率刻画 Shapley 值。
papers.noteEn: A player's allocation should not decrease if all her marginal contributions rise. With symmetry and efficiency, strong monotonicity characterizes the Shapley value.

papers.title: A Concept of Egalitarianism under Participation Constraints
papers.note: 以洛伦兹序衡量联盟内的平等，要求潜在偏离也遵循该标准，证明其解至多一个。
papers.noteEn: Lorenz comparisons impose egalitarianism on proposed divisions as well as on coalitional deviations, yielding at most one allocation.

papers.title: Potential, Value, and Consistency
papers.note: 若各成员加入时的势函数增量之和恰等于大联盟价值，这些增量生成 Shapley 值。
papers.noteEn: When marginal increments of a potential sum to the grand coalition's value, those increments yield the Shapley value.

papers.title: Bargaining and Value
papers.note: 为多人联盟博弈建立非合作谈判程序，可转移效用情形导出 Shapley 值；纯谈判情形导出 Nash 谈判解。
papers.noteEn: A noncooperative n-player bargaining protocol yields the Shapley value with transferable utility and the Nash solution in pure bargaining situations.

papers.title: Conference Structures and Fair Allocation Rules
papers.note: 以可举行的会议描述联盟沟通，要求一次会议对所有出席者带来相等的增益，从而刻画公平分配规则。
papers.noteEn: Coalitional communication is described by feasible conferences. Requiring equal gains from a conference for all its members characterizes a fair allocation rule.

papers.title: Geometric Properties of the Kernel, Nucleolus, and Related Solution Concepts
papers.authors: Michael Maschler · Bezalel Peleg · Lloyd S. Shapley
papers.role: 核仁与预核的几何结构
papers.roleEn: Geometry of the nucleolus and prekernel
papers.note: 分析一族强 ε 核的几何形状，说明位于其中的预核部分如何由该集合的几何性质决定。
papers.noteEn: Varying strong epsilon-cores shows how their geometry determines the portion of the prekernel they contain.

papers.title: A Necessary and Sufficient Condition for Weighted Shapley Values in the Core
papers.role: 带权边际贡献的稳定性
papers.note: 为带权 Shapley 值位于核内给出充要条件，说明加权平均凸性一类充分限制还能怎样放宽。
papers.noteEn: A necessary and sufficient condition identifies when the weighted Shapley value belongs to the core, sharpening sufficient restrictions based on weighted average convexity.

edges.label: 限制联盟连通性
edges.note: 在给定沟通图上，每个联盟的价值由其连通分支决定，再考察边际贡献分配。
edges.noteEn: On a given communication graph, each coalition's worth depends on its connected components. Marginal contributions can then determine shares.

edges.label: 落到指派市场
edges.note: 核非空的一般问题在指派市场中有更具体的价格与线性规划对偶解释。
edges.noteEn: In assignment markets, the general question of core nonemptiness acquires a price and linear-programming duality interpretation.

edges.label: 从非空走向核的形状
edges.labelEn: From nonemptiness to the shape of the core
edges.note: 平衡性检验核是否非空，凸性还允许直接构造核的极点和一个稳定的价值分配。
edges.noteEn: Balancedness tests nonemptiness. Convexity also permits a construction of the extreme points and a value allocation in the core.

edges.label: 在稳定分配中进一步选择
edges.labelEn: Refine the set of stable allocations
edges.note: 核只检查联盟差额是否为正；核仁还比较最大差额及并列后的次大差额。
edges.noteEn: The core rules out positive excesses. The nucleolus also compares the largest excesses and then successive ties.

edges.label: 从排列平均到连续表示
edges.labelEn: From random orders to a continuous representation
edges.note: 随机进入顺序的平均边际贡献可以改写为对共同加入概率积分。
edges.noteEn: Average marginal contributions across random orders can instead be integrated over a common inclusion probability.

edges.label: 用单调性重新刻画价值
edges.note: 通过跨博弈比较每名玩家的边际生产力，给同一分配公式另一组公理。
edges.noteEn: Comparing a player's marginal productivity across games gives an alternative axiomatization of the same formula.

edges.label: 改变什么算作阻挡
edges.note: 给可偏离的联盟加上平等分配约束，得到与一般核不同的分配选择。
edges.noteEn: An egalitarian constraint on deviating coalitions changes which allocations survive relative to unrestricted core blocking.

edges.label: 由排列平均到势差
edges.note: 同一支付分配可以通过删除成员后的势差刻画，提供另一种计算和解释途径。
edges.labelEn: From permutation averages to potential differences
edges.noteEn: Removing players and taking potential differences offers an alternative characterization and calculation of the same allocation.

edges.label: 从分摊公理转向具体协议
edges.labelEn: From allocation axioms to a protocol
edges.note: 同一价值分配可由提案、回应及后续谈判的制度解释，并可比较不同效用结构下的结果。
edges.noteEn: Offers, responses, and continuation bargaining give the value a procedural foundation and permit comparisons across utility structures.

edges.label: 把两两连边推广为多人会议
edges.labelEn: Extend bilateral links to multilateral meetings
edges.note: 共同沟通的单位可是一组成员，公平性也须检验每一场会议对参与者的边际收益。
edges.noteEn: A group meeting becomes the unit of communication, so fairness compares the marginal gains from that meeting across its participants.

edges.label: 从字典序选择走向分配集合几何
edges.labelEn: From lexicographic choice to payoff geometry
edges.note: 对联盟异议施以共同容差后，可比较核、核仁与预核之间哪些联系来自可行区域的几何形状。
edges.noteEn: A common tolerance for coalitional excesses exposes geometric links among the core, nucleolus, and prekernel.

edges.label: 从凸性保证到精确条件
edges.labelEn: From a convexity guarantee to an exact condition
edges.note: 凸博弈中普通 Shapley 值的稳定性有充分保证；引入不同权重后需逐一评估联盟的阻挡能力。
edges.noteEn: Convexity guarantees stability of the ordinary Shapley value. With different weights, coalitional blocking must be evaluated for the weighted allocation.

resources.title: Game Theory
resources.authors: Michael Maschler · Eilon Solan · Shmuel Zamir

branches.questionEn: Which allocations sustain cooperation when coalitions can deviate together? If a single allocation is required, how should each person's contribution be measured?
branches.boundaryEn: Starting from the worth of each coalition, this branch studies stability of allocations, axiomatic assignment of value, and restrictions from communication networks.

branches.name: 网络形成、互动与干预
branches.question: 谁会付费建立联系？网络给定后，谁的位置最影响他人行为，政策又应改变谁的激励？
branches.boundary: 区分把连边当作个体决策的形成模型、把网络当作给定环境的行动博弈，以及规划者选择干预的政策问题。

papers.title: A Strategic Model of Social and Economic Networks
papers.note: 提出成对稳定性，在受益双方同意加边、任一方可断边的框架中说明私人建网激励和整体效率之间的冲突。
papers.noteEn: Pairwise stability requires both endpoints to agree to add a link and allows either to sever it. Private incentives to form links can conflict with overall efficiency.

papers.title: A Noncooperative Model of Network Formation
papers.note: 允许个体单方付费建立联系，考察信息或利益单向与双向流动时哪些网络结构可由非合作均衡支持。
papers.noteEn: Individuals can pay to form links unilaterally. Noncooperative equilibrium network structures depend on whether information or benefits flow in one or both directions.

papers.title: Who’s Who in Networks. Wanted: The Key Player
papers.authors: Coralio Ballester · Antoni Calvó-Armengol · Yves Zenou
papers.note: 在网络线性二次博弈中联系中心性与均衡行动，并用 intercentrality 找到移除后最能降低总行动的节点。
papers.noteEn: Linear-quadratic network games relate centrality to equilibrium actions. Intercentrality identifies the player whose removal reduces aggregate action most.

papers.title: Network Games
papers.authors: Andrea Galeotti · Sanjeev Goyal · Matthew O. Jackson · Fernando Vega-Redondo · Leeat Yariv
papers.note: 让玩家只观察网络的局部信息，在相应条件下研究均衡行为如何随邻居数量和度分布变化。
papers.noteEn: Players observe only local information. Under the model's conditions, equilibrium behavior varies with the number of neighbors and the degree distribution.

papers.title: Targeting Interventions in Networks
papers.authors: Andrea Galeotti · Benjamin Golub · Sanjeev Goyal
papers.note: 规划者可按节点改变私人行动收益，用网络特征向量分解干预的传播方向，比较不同方向的福利回报。
papers.noteEn: A planner can change incentives at individual nodes. Network eigenvectors decompose how an intervention propagates and the welfare return of each direction.

papers.title: Targeting network intervention with social norm
papers.note: 当偏离邻居平均行动会带来损失时，最优干预方向随预算增大趋于对每人等量干预，即使节点的中心性不同。发表于 Journal of Economic Theory，第 230 卷，2025 年 12 月。
papers.version: 正式发表 · Journal of Economic Theory 230, 106092
papers.noteEn: When agents incur a cost for deviating from their neighbors’ average action, large budgets favor equal intervention at every node, even across different centralities. Published in the Journal of Economic Theory, volume 230, December 2025.

papers.title: Meeting Strangers and Friends of Friends: How Random Are Social Networks?
papers.authors: Matthew O. Jackson · Brian W. Rogers
papers.note: 把随机结识陌生人与通过朋友引荐相结合，在增长网络中同时产生高局部聚类与度数差异。
papers.noteEn: Combining chance encounters with friends-of-friends meetings generates local clustering and degree heterogeneity in a growing network.

papers.title: Public Goods in Networks
papers.note: 当邻居的供给能替代自身供给时，网络中存在专业化均衡，其中一些人承担供给而另一些人完全搭便车。
papers.noteEn: When neighbors’ provision substitutes for one's own, specialized equilibria exist in which some agents provide and others free-ride entirely.

papers.title: Systemic Risk and Stability in Financial Networks
papers.authors: Daron Acemoglu · Asuman Ozdaglar · Alireza Tahbaz-Salehi
papers.note: 在银行债务网络中，分散连接可吸收小冲击，但超过阈值的冲击可沿同样的连接引发更广泛的违约。
papers.noteEn: Diversified interbank exposures can absorb small shocks yet propagate sufficiently large shocks into widespread defaults.

papers.title: Strategic Interaction and Networks
papers.authors: Yann Bramoullé · Rachel Kranton · Martin D'Amours
papers.note: 在一类网络博弈中，用最小特征值分析战略替代带来的放大，并刻画均衡的唯一性与稳定性。
papers.noteEn: For a class of network games, the smallest eigenvalue measures amplification from strategic substitutes and helps characterize uniqueness and stability.

papers.title: Targeting in Adaptive Networks
papers.note: 让被干预的网络重新调整。在全局替代作用强时，移除最不中心的玩家或少移除一些人反而可能最优。发表于 Journal of Economic Theory。
papers.noteEn: Allowing the network to adapt after an intervention can make removing the least central agent, or fewer agents than possible, optimal under strong global substitution. Published in JET.

papers.title: Identification of Peer Effects through Social Networks
papers.authors: Yann Bramoullé, Habiba Djebbari & Bernard Fortin
papers.role: 网络中的同伴效应识别
papers.note: 线性同伴模型中，群组不完全重合所产生的间接邻居变动有时可区分内生同伴效应与情境效应。
papers.noteEn: Variation from partially overlapping peer groups can distinguish endogenous from contextual effects in a linear network model.

papers.title: The Evolution of Social and Economic Networks
papers.note: 让个体逐步改动连边并偶尔犯错，分析长期更可能出现哪些网络，及其与静态稳定性的关系。
papers.noteEn: Sequential link changes and occasional mistakes determine which networks are likely in the long run and how they relate to static stability.

papers.title: The Network Origins of Aggregate Fluctuations
papers.authors: Daron Acemoglu · Vasco M. Carvalho · Asuman Ozdaglar · Alireza Tahbaz-Salehi
papers.note: 投入产出联系可使行业特有冲击传至总体；波动随经济细分而消失的速率取决于直接及间接供应商的重要性。
papers.noteEn: Input-output linkages propagate sector-specific shocks. The rate at which aggregate volatility vanishes depends on sectors’ importance as direct and indirect suppliers.

papers.title: Welfare and Distributional Effects of Joint Intervention in Networks
papers.authors: Ryan Kor · Yi Liu · Yves Zenou · Junjie Zhou
papers.roleEn: Joint interventions on nodes and links
papers.note: 规划者可改变个体收益和边权。在内点解下，某条边的最优权重调整与两端特征向量中心性的乘积成比例。
papers.noteEn: A planner can change individual incentives and link weights. At an interior optimum, the link-weight change is proportional to the product of the endpoints’ eigenvector centralities.

papers.title: The Law of the Few
papers.note: 玩家可付费收集信息，也可建边获取他人的信息；稳健均衡中少数人承担信息收集，多数人从他们处获取信息。
papers.noteEn: Agents acquire information or form links to access what others acquire. Robust equilibria concentrate information acquisition among a small group serving many others.

edges.label: 改变建边权利
edges.note: 从两人同意转为一人承担成本即可建边，稳定网络的预测随制度改变。
edges.noteEn: Moving from bilateral consent to unilateral costly linking changes which networks can be stable.
edges.labelEn: Change who can create a link

edges.label: 改变网络信息
edges.note: 前者利用给定网络定位关键节点，后者问只知道局部网络时个体能实施什么行动。
edges.noteEn: One paper locates key players on a given network. The other asks what actions players can take with only local knowledge.
edges.labelEn: Change what players know about the network

edges.label: 扩充政策工具
edges.note: 从移除一个关键节点变为在多个节点间连续配置干预强度。
edges.noteEn: Move from removing a single key node to allocating continuously varying intervention intensities across nodes.

edges.label: 把同伴总行动换成偏离均值的成本
edges.note: Galeotti、Golub 与 Goyal 用网络主成分刻画干预。Meng 改写个体收益，让偏离邻居平均行动产生损失；在其模型中，大预算下的最优方向趋于所有节点等量调整。
edges.noteEn: Galeotti, Golub, and Goyal characterize interventions using network principal components. Meng introduces a cost of diverging from the neighbors’ average action. In his model the optimal large-budget direction approaches equal adjustments at every node.
edges.labelEn: Replace total peer action with a cost of departing from the mean

edges.label: 让相遇机会产生网络结构
edges.labelEn: Model who has a chance to meet
edges.note: 成对稳定性检验已有网络中的加边意愿；增长模型则追踪有偏相遇如何累积成网络。
edges.noteEn: Pairwise stability tests incentives to add links in a given graph. Biased meetings trace how a graph emerges over time.

edges.label: 以局部公共品作完全信息基准
edges.labelEn: Use local public goods as a benchmark
edges.note: 给定并知晓整张网络时，公共品供给位置可从均衡刻画；局部网络信息则改变玩家能作出的推断。
edges.noteEn: A known graph allows one to characterize equilibrium provider locations. Under local information players must infer the missing links.

edges.label: 从行动溢出转向违约阈值
edges.labelEn: From action spillovers to default thresholds
edges.note: 线性行动反应中的关键节点与金融清偿中的系统风险都依赖网络，但违约阈值使传播依赖冲击规模。
edges.noteEn: Key players in linear responses and systemic risk in a clearing network both depend on connections, but default thresholds make propagation depend on shock size.

edges.label: 从中心性到均衡稳定条件
edges.note: 节点中心性给出特定内点均衡的行动；网络的谱也揭示该均衡何时失稳或出现多重均衡。
edges.noteEn: Centrality determines actions at certain interior equilibria. Spectral conditions also reveal instability or multiplicity.

edges.label: 撤掉节点后允许网络调整
edges.labelEn: Let the network adapt after removal
edges.note: 固定网络上的关键节点排序未计入他人重新连边与调整努力带来的反馈。
edges.noteEn: A key-player ranking on a fixed graph omits feedback from agents’ subsequent link and effort choices.

edges.label: 由行动反应到识别
edges.note: 网络传播的同一结构也决定，数据是否足以把同伴反应与共同背景分开。
edges.noteEn: The structure propagating actions also determines whether observations separate peer responses from contextual effects.

edges.label: 把成对稳定置于动态过程
edges.labelEn: Embed pairwise stability in a dynamic process
edges.note: 除了检查当前是否愿意改边，还要考虑经其他网络到达或离开当前网络的概率。
edges.noteEn: Beyond checking current link incentives, a dynamic selection criterion compares paths into and out of a network.

edges.label: 比较生产传播与金融传染
edges.labelEn: Compare production propagation with financial contagion
edges.note: 中间投入沿供应链传递冲击，金融网络则通过支付与违约传播，网络结构在两类机制中发挥不同作用。
edges.noteEn: Intermediate inputs transmit production shocks; payments and defaults transmit financial shocks. Network structure matters through different economic channels.

edges.label: 把网络本身纳入政策工具
edges.labelEn: Make the network itself a policy instrument
edges.note: 同时选节点与边可提高总福利，却可能扩大分配差距，因此还需考察中心性在个体间如何分布。
edges.noteEn: Joint intervention can raise aggregate welfare while increasing inequality, making the dispersion of centrality relevant for distributional effects.

edges.label: 让信息来源也由玩家选择
edges.note: 在单方建边之外加入个人信息生产，解释网络中少数信息源为何能内生出现。
edges.noteEn: Adding private information production to unilateral linking explains why a small set of sources can emerge endogenously.

branches.questionEn: Who pays to form a connection? Once the network is in place, whose position matters most for others’ behavior, and whose incentives should policy target?
branches.boundaryEn: Distinguish models where players form links, games where actions take place on a given network, and policy problems where a planner chooses interventions.

branches.name: 竞赛、奖项与锦标赛
branches.question: 奖金应如何在名次间分配？为什么奖励总投入与奖励最佳表现会导向不同赛事安排？
branches.boundary: 包括噪声绩效的排名工资、完全信息全支付基准以及私人能力下的竞赛设计；三类模型的信息与获胜规则不同。

papers.title: Rank-Order Tournaments as Optimum Labor Contracts
papers.note: 把名次工资差额写入努力选择：增加努力会改变胜率，而两人共同受到的同一加性冲击在相对名次中抵消。
papers.noteEn: Wage differences across ranks enter the effort decision. Effort changes the probability of winning, while a common additive shock cancels out of the relative ranking.

papers.title: The All-Pay Auction with Complete Information
papers.authors: Michael R. Baye · Dan Kovenock · Casper G. de Vries
papers.note: 在所有参赛者都须支付出价且估值为完全信息的环境中刻画均衡，明确非对称估值和并列最高估值的作用。
papers.noteEn: Characterizing equilibrium when all participants pay their bids and valuations are known reveals the roles of asymmetry and ties for the highest valuation.

papers.title: The Optimal Allocation of Prizes in Contests
papers.note: 在私人能力全支付竞赛中，最大化预期总努力时，线性或凹努力成本支持单奖；凸成本下多奖可能更优。
papers.noteEn: With private abilities and all-pay effort, a single prize maximizes expected total effort under linear or concave effort costs. Multiple prizes can be preferable under convex costs.

papers.title: Contest Architecture
papers.note: 在线性努力成本下最大化总努力选择一场大赛；若最大化最高努力且参赛者足够多，分两组后决赛可以最优。
papers.noteEn: With linear costs, one large contest maximizes total effort. With sufficiently many contestants, two preliminary groups and a final can maximize the highest effort.

papers.title: Caps on Political Lobbying
papers.note: 在两方估值不同的全支付游说竞赛中，支出上限可缩小强者优势，反而提高预期总支出。
papers.noteEn: In an asymmetric two-player all-pay lobbying contest, a spending cap can reduce the strong player's advantage and increase expected total spending.

papers.title: All-Pay Contests
papers.note: 容许多份相同奖品及获胜或失败时不同的成本技术，给出均衡收益闭式公式，并刻画参赛。
papers.noteEn: A closed-form payoff formula and participation results allow multiple identical prizes and different costs conditional on winning or losing.

papers.title: Large Contests
papers.note: 用一个具有连续类型的单代理人机制实现正向匹配，以此近似大量异质参赛者争夺多个奖品时的均衡分配。
papers.noteEn: A mechanism for a single agent with a continuum of types implements assortative allocation and approximates equilibrium outcomes of contests with many heterogeneous players and prizes.

papers.title: Performance-Maximizing Large Contests
papers.role: 大规模竞赛的最优奖项
papers.note: 利用大规模竞赛的近似，刻画最大化参赛者表现的奖品结构，比较不同努力成本与奖品效用。
papers.noteEn: A large-contest approximation characterizes performance-maximizing prize schedules across different effort costs and preferences over prizes.

papers.title: Rigging the Lobbying Process: An Application of the All-Pay Auction
papers.authors: Michael R. Baye · Dan Kovenock · Casper G. de Vries
papers.note: 政治家有时可通过排除对奖品估值最高的游说者提高全支付竞赛的预期总收入。
papers.noteEn: Excluding the lobbyist with the highest valuation can increase a politician's expected receipts in an all-pay contest.

papers.title: Optimal Crowdsourcing Contests
papers.authors: Shuchi Chawla, Jason D. Hartline & Balasubramanian Sivan
papers.note: 设计者关注表现最好的参赛作品，最优规则取决于参赛人数及能力分布。
papers.noteEn: A designer values the best submission, and the optimal rule depends on contestant numbers and the skill distribution.

papers.title: Optimal Design of Research Contests
papers.note: 在研发努力与质量不可验证、买方无法预收费用等条件下，一大类竞赛中的最优机制只邀请两家研发并竞报奖酬。
papers.noteEn: When innovation effort and quality are unverifiable and entry fees unavailable, inviting two suppliers to innovate and bid their rewards is optimal in a broad class of contests.

papers.title: Contests for Status
papers.authors: Benny Moldovanu · Aner Sela · Xianwen Shi
papers.note: 即使没有实物奖励，地位组别也能激励努力；最优分组取决于能力分布，最高地位组只有一人。
papers.noteEn: Status categories motivate effort without tangible prizes. Their optimal partition depends on the ability distribution, with a single contestant in the highest category.

papers.title: Quitters Never Win: The (Adverse) Incentive Effects of Competing with Superstars
papers.note: 职业高尔夫数据表明 Tiger Woods 参赛时其他球手平均成绩较差；论文检验并讨论媒体和风险选择等替代解释。
papers.noteEn: Other golfers score worse on average when Tiger Woods participates. The study examines alternatives including media attention and risk taking.

papers.title: Optimal Allocation of Multi-Dimensional Prizes in Contests with Heterogeneous Agents
papers.note: 两人对奖品各维度偏好足够不同时，若奖励不能因身份而异，最大化总努力要求败者也获得正奖励。
papers.noteEn: With sufficiently heterogeneous tastes for prize dimensions and no identity-dependent awards, maximizing total effort requires a positive reward for the loser.

edges.label: 从工资差额到奖项向量
edges.note: 把相对排名产生的激励进一步写成设计者的奖项分配问题，但能力与噪声的建模方式不同。
edges.noteEn: Turn incentives from relative rank into the designer's prize-allocation problem, while changing the way abilities and noise enter the model.
edges.labelEn: From wage gaps to a vector of prizes

edges.label: 由给定规则到奖项设计
edges.note: 完全信息全支付是战略投入的一个基准；引入私人能力后，可以研究给定奖池中各名次该拿多少。
edges.noteEn: Complete-information all-pay competition gives an effort benchmark. Adding private ability raises the question of how a fixed purse should be allocated across ranks.
edges.labelEn: From fixed rules to prize design

edges.label: 增加赛制选择
edges.note: 除了分配奖金，设计者还能先分组再晋级；总投入与最高投入对应不同最优赛事结构。
edges.noteEn: The designer can choose groups and advancement rules as well as prizes. Total effort and maximum effort can imply different optimal formats.
edges.labelEn: Add contest format as a choice

edges.label: 给出价加上限
edges.note: 全支付的规则保持不变，限制出价空间却会同时改变弱者参赛意愿和强者的应对。
edges.noteEn: Keeping bids payable even when they lose, a smaller bid space changes both the weaker bidder's incentive to compete and the stronger bidder's response.

edges.label: 从单个奖品到一般计分技术
edges.note: 将完全信息全支付拍卖作为特例，比较成本、先期投入和奖品数量不同的竞赛。
edges.noteEn: Complete-information all-pay auctions become one case of contests with different costs, prior investments, and prize counts.

edges.label: 取参赛人数的大样本极限
edges.labelEn: Take a limit in the number of contestants
edges.note: 由求解有限玩家的战略混合，转向近似排名和奖品如何随努力分配。
edges.noteEn: Instead of solving every player's finite-game mixing, approximate how ranks and prizes are allocated across effort levels.

edges.label: 在多名参赛者时设计奖项
edges.labelEn: Design a prize schedule at scale
edges.note: 有限私人能力模型的奖项分配问题，在大量参赛者环境中变成对整条名次奖励曲线的选择。
edges.noteEn: Prize allocation with private abilities becomes a choice over a whole rank–reward schedule when the field is large.

edges.label: 改变谁能参赛
edges.note: 估值不对称影响均衡出价，也使组织者可能通过排除强者增强竞争。
edges.noteEn: Asymmetry affects equilibrium bids and can make exclusion of a strong contestant attractive to the organizer.

edges.label: 改变竞赛产出指标
edges.note: 最大化最佳作品与最大化所有人总努力不同，会改变最优竞赛设计。
edges.noteEn: Rewarding the best submission rather than total effort changes the design objective.

edges.label: 把奖金分配变为采购机制
edges.labelEn: Turn prize allocation into procurement design
edges.note: 设计者除设置奖励，还选择邀请几家供应商以及如何让它们竞争实际支付的奖酬。
edges.noteEn: The buyer chooses how many suppliers to admit and how they bid for compensation, beyond simply dividing a fixed purse.

edges.label: 用相对地位代替物质奖品
edges.labelEn: Replace material prizes with relative status
edges.note: 从分配固定奖金扩展到决定哪些名次由社会视为同一地位，这个选择本身改变边际激励。
edges.noteEn: The designer chooses which ranks share a social status rather than only allocating money. That grouping directly changes marginal incentives.

edges.label: 检验面对超强对手时的表现
edges.labelEn: Test performance against an unusually strong rival
edges.note: 同一名次奖差对胜率接近和能力悬殊的选手未必有同样激励，比赛面板数据提供直接比较。
edges.noteEn: A rank-prize spread can induce different incentives for evenly matched and highly unequal contestants, a contrast examined in tournament panel data.

edges.label: 让相同奖品对不同人有不同含义
edges.labelEn: Allow contestants to value prize components differently
edges.note: 单一奖金的大小之外，奖品构成也能改变强者优势和弱者的努力回报。
edges.noteEn: Beyond the size of a monetary award, prize composition affects the strong contestant's advantage and the weaker contestant's return to effort.

branches.questionEn: How should prizes vary by rank? Why might maximizing total effort require a different contest structure from maximizing the best performance?
branches.boundaryEn: The branch covers rank-based wages with noisy performance, complete-information all-pay contests, and contest design with private abilities. Their information and allocation rules differ.

branches.name: 随机博弈与马尔可夫精炼均衡
branches.en: Stochastic games and Markov perfect equilibrium
branches.question: 今天的竞争会改变明天面对的状态。哪些历史必须进入最优策略，递归方程又能支持何种长期行为？
branches.boundary: 随机博弈规定状态转移；马尔可夫精炼均衡在相应状态上要求序贯最优。零和博弈价值的唯一性不能推导出一般和博弈的均衡唯一性。

papers.title: Stochastic Games
papers.note: 在有限两人零和随机博弈中，以包含终止概率的递归算子给出价值，并得到只依赖当前状态的最优策略。
papers.noteEn: In finite two-player zero-sum stochastic games, a recursive operator incorporating termination probabilities yields the value and optimal strategies depending only on the current state.

papers.title: Equilibrium in a Stochastic n-Person Game
papers.note: 在有限状态、有限行动、贴现的多人随机博弈中证明平稳均衡存在，把递归求值与各玩家的最优反应联系起来。
papers.noteEn: A stationary equilibrium exists in finite-state, finite-action discounted multiplayer stochastic games, linking recursive valuation with individual best responses.

papers.title: A Theory of Dynamic Oligopoly, II: Price Competition, Kinked Demand Curves, and Edgeworth Cycles
papers.note: 在企业轮流调价的动态双寡头中，马尔可夫均衡能够呈现折弯需求对应的价格刚性，也能出现 Edgeworth 价格循环。
papers.noteEn: In a dynamic duopoly with alternating price changes, Markov equilibria can exhibit rigid prices associated with kinked demand, or Edgeworth price cycles.

papers.title: Markov-Perfect Industry Dynamics: A Framework for Empirical Work
papers.note: 以企业状态向量描述行业，结合投资、进入和退出，使对未来行业演变的预期与企业最优决策在均衡中相容。
papers.noteEn: A vector of firm states describes the industry. Equilibrium makes forecasts of future industry evolution consistent with firms’ investment, entry, and exit decisions.

papers.title: Markov Perfect Equilibrium: I. Observable Actions
papers.note: 在行动可观察的博弈中，利用保留决策相关性的最粗历史划分正式定义马尔可夫策略，澄清简化状态表示所需的条件。
papers.noteEn: For games with observable actions, the coarsest partition of histories preserving decision relevance defines Markov strategies and clarifies when a state representation can be simplified.

papers.title: Stochastic Games Have a Value
papers.note: 在有限零和随机博弈中给出统一值：足够长的时域上，双方各有策略统一保障接近该值的平均收益。
papers.noteEn: Finite zero-sum stochastic games have a uniform value: each side can secure nearly that average payoff across all sufficiently long horizons.

papers.title: Computable Markov-Perfect Industry Dynamics
papers.note: 说明原产业动态模型的一般存在性需要容许混合进入退出，并用私人随机成本构造可计算的纯策略版本。
papers.noteEn: General existence in the original industry model requires allowing mixed entry and exit. Private cost shocks yield a computable pure-strategy specification.

papers.title: Avoiding the Curse of Dimensionality in Dynamic Stochastic Games
papers.note: 在常见状态转移设定下改用连续时间，降低计算未来状态期望时随状态变量数迅速上升的成本。
papers.noteEn: Under common transition laws, moving to continuous time cuts the rapidly growing cost of evaluating expectations over future states.

papers.title: Recursive Methods in Discounted Stochastic Games: An Algorithm for δ→1 and a Folk Theorem
papers.authors: Johannes Hörner · Takuo Sugaya · Satoru Takahashi · Nicolas Vieille
papers.roleEn: Payoff sets in the patient limit
papers.note: 对可观察状态、公共但可能不完美的监督建立递归算法，在适当条件下刻画耐心极限的公开完美均衡收益。
papers.noteEn: Recursive methods characterize limiting perfect public equilibrium payoffs under observable states, possibly imperfect public monitoring, and suitable conditions.

papers.title: Asymptotic Value of Monitoring Structures in Stochastic Games
papers.note: 在论文的不可约性等条件下，若公共信号按加权噪化序变得更有信息，耐心极限中的公开完美均衡收益集合扩大。发表于 Theoretical Economics。
papers.noteEn: Under the paper's irreducibility and related conditions, more informative signals in the weighted-garbling order expand the limiting perfect public equilibrium payoff set. Published in Theoretical Economics.

papers.title: Estimating Dynamic Models of Imperfect Competition
papers.authors: Patrick Bajari, C. Lanier Benkard & Jonathan Levin
papers.role: 从均衡策略估计动态模型
papers.note: 先估计市场状态转移与企业策略，再用偏离不能获利的不等式限制收益参数。
papers.noteEn: First estimate transitions and policies, then use no-profitable-deviation inequalities to restrict payoff parameters.

papers.title: Stationary Markov Perfect Equilibria in Discounted Stochastic Games
papers.note: 在状态转移核具有论文给出的可分解粗化结构时，建立平稳马尔可夫完美均衡的存在性，涵盖若干有噪声或内生冲击的模型。
papers.noteEn: A decomposable coarser structure for transition kernels yields existence of stationary Markov perfect equilibrium, covering models with noise and applications with endogenous shocks.

papers.title: A Folk Theorem for Stochastic Games
papers.role: 状态博弈的可行与威胁收益
papers.roleEn: Feasibility and threats in stochastic games
papers.note: 在使长期可行收益和威胁点满足相应条件的随机博弈中，把重复博弈的民间定理推广到内生状态转移。
papers.noteEn: For stochastic games satisfying conditions on long-run feasible payoffs and threats, a folk theorem extends repeated-game logic to endogenous state transitions.

papers.title: A Formula for the Value of a Stochastic Game
papers.note: 给出有限两人零和随机博弈贴现值与长期值的可处理公式，将这些值与静态矩阵博弈的计算联系起来。
papers.noteEn: Tractable formulas for the discounted and long-run values of finite two-player zero-sum stochastic games link their computation to static matrix games.

papers.title: Continuous-Time Stochastic Games with Imperfect Public Monitoring
papers.note: 有限状态与布朗公共信号下，分别刻画公开完美及马尔可夫完美收益集合，可处理非不可约状态及非耐心极限。所引为 2025 年 5 月工作论文。
papers.noteEn: With finite states and public Brownian signals, the paper characterizes public perfect and Markov perfect payoff sets, allowing reducible dynamics and nonvanishing discounting. The linked version is the May 2025 working paper.

edges.label: 从价值到均衡
edges.note: 零和问题中可递归计算共同价值；放宽到一般和，结果变成同时满足各人最优反应的平稳均衡存在。
edges.noteEn: A common value can be computed recursively in zero-sum games. With general-sum payoffs, stationary equilibrium instead requires simultaneous individual best responses.

edges.label: 引入行业状态
edges.note: 递归激励被用于企业投资、进入和退出，下一期的竞争环境由今日的多方选择共同决定。
edges.noteEn: Recursive incentives apply to investment, entry, and exit. Today's decisions by multiple firms jointly determine tomorrow's competitive environment.

edges.label: 追问状态定义
edges.note: 从指定价格状态的市场模型，转向对一般可观察行动博弈如何划分收益相关历史的形式化。
edges.noteEn: Move from a market model with a specified price state to defining payoff-relevant partitions of histories in general games with observable actions.

edges.label: 由给定折现率到长时域
edges.labelEn: From fixed discounting to long horizons
edges.note: Shapley 求给定折现率的值；统一保障要求同一策略对一整段长时域有效。
edges.noteEn: Shapley solves for a given discount factor. A uniform guarantee calls for one strategy that works across long horizons.

edges.label: 修正存在性与算法的衔接
edges.note: 原算法依赖纯策略，而进入退出可能需要混合；引入私人随机成本使两者相容。
edges.noteEn: The original algorithm requires pure strategies while entry and exit may require mixing. Private random costs reconcile the two.

edges.label: 改变计算的时间尺度
edges.note: 离散时间允许许多状态同时改变；连续时间的局部跳转可大幅减少每一步的枚举。
edges.noteEn: Many states can change simultaneously in discrete time. Local jumps in continuous time greatly reduce the enumeration needed at each step.

edges.label: 从平稳均衡到公开历史
edges.labelEn: From stationary play to public histories
edges.note: 平稳均衡证明保证一种依赖当前状态的解；公共信号历史支持的策略可以实现更大的收益集合。
edges.noteEn: Stationary existence gives one state-dependent solution. Conditioning on histories of public signals can support a larger payoff set.

edges.label: 让状态演化与监督质量共同决定收益
edges.labelEn: Combine state evolution with monitoring quality
edges.note: 从零和博弈给定监督下的单一值，转向一般和模型中不同公共监督制度可支持哪些均衡收益。
edges.noteEn: Move from a zero-sum value under fixed observation to the equilibrium payoff sets that alternative public monitoring systems sustain in general-sum games.

edges.label: 由求解到用数据检验
edges.note: 给定策略的延续收益可与模拟偏离比较，使马尔可夫均衡条件成为估计工具。
edges.noteEn: Comparing continuation values under observed policies and simulated deviations turns Markov equilibrium into an estimation tool.

edges.label: 从有限状态走向一般状态
edges.note: 有限状态下的递归存在定理不能直接处理一般状态。新的转移核条件使延续收益对应的条件期望能够用于存在性证明。
edges.noteEn: Finite-state recursive existence arguments do not directly extend to general states. The transition structure allows conditional expectations of continuation correspondences to support an existence proof.

edges.label: 区分状态转移与不完美监督
edges.labelEn: Separate state transitions from imperfect monitoring
edges.note: 在可观察的随机博弈中先处理状态依赖的偏离机会，后来递归分析还须处理公共信号中的噪声。
edges.noteEn: Observable stochastic games already require accounting for state-dependent deviations. Later recursive results must also account for noise in public monitoring.

edges.label: 从存在定理走向可计算公式
edges.labelEn: From value existence to a computable formula
edges.note: 统一值存在并不直接给出求值方法；新公式从博弈基本数据出发计算该值。
edges.noteEn: Uniform-value existence by itself gives no formula. The new characterization computes the value from the game's primitives.

edges.label: 保留初始状态与有限耐心
edges.labelEn: Retain initial states and finite patience
edges.note: 连续时间刻画保留收益对起始状态的依赖，也容许在给定贴现率下比较马尔可夫策略与完整公共历史。
edges.noteEn: The continuous-time characterization retains dependence on the initial state and compares Markov strategies with full public histories at a fixed discount rate.

branches.questionEn: Today's competition changes tomorrow's state. Which past events must optimal strategies remember, and what long-run behavior can recursive equations support?
branches.boundaryEn: Stochastic games specify state transitions. Markov perfection requires sequentially optimal play on the relevant states. A unique value in zero-sum games does not imply a unique equilibrium in general-sum games.

branches.name: 行为博弈与有限层级推理
branches.en: Behavioral game theory and bounded strategic reasoning
branches.question: 首次面对一个博弈时，观察到的选择可能来自有限步推理、对他人的异质认知，或收益敏感的随机反应。如何区分这些机制？
branches.boundary: 层级模型描述玩家相信谁在用什么规则；量化反应均衡要求带噪声的选择概率彼此一致。可拟合数据的能力与可证伪性需要分别考察。

papers.title: Unraveling in Guessing Games: An Experimental Study
papers.note: 用猜数字实验观察首次选择与有限步迭代推理的关系，并区分第一轮推理和反馈后的调整。
papers.noteEn: A guessing game relates initial choices to finite-step iterative reasoning and distinguishes first-round thinking from adjustments after feedback.

papers.title: On Players’ Models of Other Players: Theory and Experimental Evidence
papers.authors: Dale O. Stahl · Paul W. Wilson
papers.note: 用多组战略式博弈中的个体选择检验不同推理类型，其中较高类型会基于其对对手类型的模型求最佳反应。
papers.noteEn: Individual choices across strategic-form games test different reasoning types. Higher types best respond to their models of opponents.

papers.title: Quantal Response Equilibria for Normal Form Games
papers.authors: Richard D. McKelvey · Thomas R. Palfrey
papers.note: 将确定性最佳反应替换为对预期收益敏感的选择概率，并通过固定点要求这些随机选择彼此相容。
papers.noteEn: Replace deterministic best responses with probabilities sensitive to expected payoffs. A fixed point ensures consistency across players’ stochastic choices.

papers.title: A Cognitive Hierarchy Model of Games
papers.authors: Colin F. Camerer · Teck-Hua Ho · Juin-Kuan Chong
papers.note: 让第 k 层玩家对所有比自己低的层级的混合做最佳反应，并用层级分布形成对初次行动的总体预测。
papers.noteEn: Level-k players best respond to a mixture of all lower levels. A distribution over levels generates aggregate predictions for initial play.

papers.title: On the Empirical Content of Quantal Response Equilibrium
papers.authors: Philip A. Haile · Ali Hortaçsu · Grigory Kosenok
papers.note: 说明即便施加一些扰动限制，足够灵活的量化反应模型仍能解释单个战略式博弈中的任意行为分布，讨论附加可检验限制。
papers.noteEn: Even under some restrictions on disturbances, a sufficiently flexible quantal response model can explain any behavior distribution in a single strategic-form game. Additional restrictions restore testable implications.

papers.title: Identifying level-k reasoning in repeated games: Strategies, beliefs, and cognitive ability
papers.note: 在不定期结束的重复囚徒困境中，同时记录参与者选择的条件策略和他们对对手策略的信念，据此区分与一层或两层推理相符的行为。此处链接 2026 年 10 月 arXiv 预印本。
papers.noteEn: In an indefinitely repeated prisoner's dilemma, subjects report conditional strategies and beliefs about their opponents’ strategies. Together these distinguish behavior consistent with one or two reasoning steps. The linked version is the October 2026 arXiv preprint.

papers.title: Ten Little Treasures of Game Theory and Ten Intuitive Contradictions
papers.authors: Jacob K. Goeree · Charles A. Holt
papers.note: 对十个一次性博弈分别改变收益结构，每组都有一套收益使行为接近均衡预测，改变后则出现系统偏离。
papers.noteEn: Ten pairs of treatments contrast settings in which behavior follows game-theoretic predictions with nearby settings showing systematic departures.

papers.title: Cognition and Behavior in Two-Person Guessing Games: An Experimental Study
papers.authors: Miguel A. Costa-Gomes · Vincent P. Crawford
papers.note: 在 16 个可用支配关系求解的双人猜数博弈中记录初始行动和查阅收益信息的过程，用两类证据区分推理规则。
papers.noteEn: Initial choices and payoff-information searches in 16 dominance-solvable two-person guessing games jointly discriminate among decision rules.

papers.title: Level-k Auctions: Can a Nonequilibrium Model of Strategic Thinking Explain the Winner's Curse and Overbidding in Private-Value Auctions?
papers.note: 在共同价值和私人价值拍卖中分别推导有限层级的出价，考察赢家诅咒和过度出价是否与初始推理相容。
papers.noteEn: Level-k bidding predictions in common- and private-value auctions test whether bounded initial reasoning can account for the winner's curse and overbidding.

papers.title: Endogenous Depth of Reasoning
papers.note: 通过认知成本和进一步思考的收益决定停在哪一层，将自身认知界限与对对手思考能力的猜测区分开。
papers.noteEn: Cognitive costs and the benefit of thinking further determine when reasoning stops, separating one's own cognitive bound from beliefs about the opponent's bound.

papers.title: Regular Quantal Response Equilibrium
papers.authors: Jacob K. Goeree · Charles A. Holt · Thomas R. Palfrey
papers.note: 直接对选择概率函数施加内部性、连续性、响应性和单调性，在有限博弈中得到可比较的均衡限制。
papers.noteEn: Interiority, continuity, responsiveness, and monotonicity restrict the response probabilities directly and give equilibrium restrictions in finite games.

papers.title: Fatal Attraction: Salience, Naïveté, and Sophistication in Experimental “Hide-and-Seek” Games
papers.note: 在零和捉迷藏实验中，把直觉上显眼的藏身处作为低层级行为的起点，预测高层级如何回应。
papers.noteEn: Salient locations anchor low-level behavior in zero-sum hide-and-seek, predicting responses at higher reasoning levels.

papers.title: On the Persistence of Strategic Sophistication
papers.authors: Sotiris Georganas · Paul J. Healy · Roberto A. Weber
papers.note: 同一受试者在两类博弈中估计的推理层级不相关，其中一类里的高低排序也不能预测另一类里的排序。
papers.noteEn: Estimated reasoning levels for the same subjects are uncorrelated across two game families, and their ranking in one family fails to predict ranking in the other.

papers.title: Iterated Dominance and Iterated Best Response in Experimental p-Beauty Contests
papers.authors: Teck-Hua Ho · Colin Camerer · Keith Weigelt
papers.note: 改变猜数竞赛的目标比例等实验条件，对比迭代删除与逐层最佳反应解释首轮猜测及后续调整的能力。
papers.noteEn: Varying the target fraction and other conditions in beauty contests helps compare iterated-dominance and iterated-best-response explanations for guesses and adjustment.

papers.title: The 11–20 Money Request Game: A Level-k Reasoning Study
papers.role: 请求金额中的有限推理
papers.roleEn: Bounded reasoning in a money-request game
papers.note: 参与者选取 11 至 20 的整数，正好比对手少一单位可获奖金。该任务提供自然起点和可观察的逐层最佳反应。
papers.noteEn: Players request integers from 11 to 20 and receive a bonus for requesting exactly one less than their opponent. The task provides a natural starting point and a transparent best-response sequence.

papers.title: Information Paths and Learning in Games: Experimental Evidence
papers.authors: Peiran Jiao · Heinrich H. Nax · Jichuan Zong
papers.note: 通过古诺与门槛公共品实验，改变玩家何时获知自己的收益结构及他人以往的行为和收益，比较不同信息路径中的学习。
papers.noteEn: Cournot and threshold-public-good experiments vary when players learn their own payoff structure and others’ past actions and payoffs, comparing learning across information paths.

edges.label: 从单个实验到跨博弈类型
edges.note: 两条同期研究路线分别观察猜数字中的推理层数和多个不同博弈中同一个体呈现的推理类型。
edges.noteEn: Two contemporary research programs studied reasoning levels in guessing games and the types revealed by an individual's choices across different games.
edges.labelEn: From one experiment to types across games

edges.label: 扩大想象中的对手群
edges.note: 认知层级模型让高层玩家面对多个较低层的归一化混合，与只回应某一指定层次的规则可产生不同预测。
edges.noteEn: Higher types in cognitive hierarchy best respond to a normalized mixture of lower levels. This can predict different behavior from responding to one specified level.
edges.labelEn: Broaden the set of imagined opponents

edges.label: 检验扰动自由度
edges.note: 对随机反应的函数形式约束越少，可拟合的行为越多；单一博弈的拟合不能自动成为该理论的证据。
edges.noteEn: Fewer restrictions on stochastic responses allow more behavior to be fitted. Fit in a single game alone does not establish the model.

edges.label: 从猜一个数到选择整套应对策略
edges.note: Nagel 从当轮猜数推断迭代思考深度。Gill 与 Rosokha 将逐层最佳反应用于整个重复博弈的条件策略，并用参与者报告的信念检验对手类型的推断。
edges.noteEn: Nagel infers iterated reasoning from a current guess. Gill and Rosokha apply iterative best responses to strategies for the entire repeated game and use elicited beliefs to test inferences about opponent types.
edges.labelEn: From guessing a number to choosing a contingent plan

edges.label: 改变收益以区分预测
edges.note: 保持博弈结构而改变偏离的收益诱因，让实验行为可检验容许选择误差的模型。
edges.noteEn: Changing payoff incentives within a game structure makes observed behavior informative about models with decision errors.

edges.label: 用搜索过程检验层级
edges.labelEn: Test reasoning levels with search data
edges.note: 即使不同推理规则给出相同猜数，参与者查阅哪些参数仍可提供额外证据。
edges.noteEn: Even when decision rules yield similar guesses, the parameters subjects look up provide additional evidence.

edges.label: 加入中标事件的信息
edges.labelEn: Account for the information in winning
edges.note: 猜数中的逐层最佳反应进入拍卖时，需同时处理对手出价以及中标对价值的暗示。
edges.noteEn: Applying iterated best responses to bidding requires reasoning about opponents and what winning implies for value.

edges.label: 让层级随激励变化
edges.labelEn: Let reasoning depth respond to incentives
edges.note: 既有层级模型给定人口中的思考深度分布；内生化之后，收益变化还会改变思考深度本身。
edges.noteEn: Instead of taking the distribution of reasoning depths as given, payoff changes can alter how much reasoning is undertaken.

edges.label: 从随机收益转向反应函数公理
edges.note: 将原量化反应均衡的选择误差机制改写为约化形式，明确哪些性质产生可检验约束。
edges.noteEn: A reduced-form response function makes explicit which features of the original noisy-choice approach generate testable restrictions.

edges.label: 让起始规则取决于场景
edges.note: 把抽象猜数换成有突出位置的场景后，可以检验怎样指定层级推理的起点。
edges.labelEn: Making the anchor depend on context
edges.noteEn: Moving from numbers to salient locations tests how the starting point for iterated reasoning should be specified.

edges.label: 检验层级能否跨任务迁移
edges.labelEn: Test whether levels transfer across tasks
edges.note: 给行为配上推理类型之外，还需用同一个人在新任务中的表现判断类型能否稳定预测。
edges.noteEn: Beyond assigning a reasoning type to observed play, use the same person's choices in a different task to test its predictive stability.

edges.label: 改变猜数目标以区分推理规则
edges.labelEn: Vary the target to distinguish reasoning rules
edges.note: 在固定比例的猜数基准上增加参数变化，从而不只依据某一次猜测反推出思考层数。
edges.noteEn: Varying parameters across the original guessing-game design yields more diagnostic observations than backing out a reasoning level from one guess.

edges.label: 把猜测均值改为相差一单位
edges.labelEn: Replace guessing the mean with undercutting by one
edges.note: 新的收益规则让连续推理层数对应相邻行动，并可通过改变起点吸引力来测试层级解释。
edges.noteEn: The new payoff rule maps successive reasoning steps to adjacent actions, allowing the level interpretation to be tested by changing the anchor's appeal.

edges.label: 从主动查阅改为控制披露顺序
edges.labelEn: From voluntary search to controlled disclosure order
edges.note: 猜数实验用查阅记录辨别初始推理；新实验直接改变反馈顺序以检验重复行动中学习如何展开。
edges.noteEn: Guessing-game search records identify initial reasoning. Controlled feedback order instead tests how learning unfolds across repeated plays.

resources.title: Behavioral Game Theory: Experiments in Strategic Interaction

branches.questionEn: Initial choices may reflect finite reasoning, heterogeneous views about others, or noisy responses to payoffs. How can these mechanisms be distinguished?
branches.boundaryEn: Level models specify beliefs about who follows which rule. Quantal response equilibrium requires mutually consistent noisy choices. Fit and falsifiability must be examined separately.

branches.name: 战略互补与单调比较静态
branches.en: Strategic complements and monotone comparative statics
branches.question: 参数改变时，能否在没有唯一解、凹性或一阶条件的情况下，预测行动与均衡向哪个方向移动？
branches.boundary: 单个主体的最优化需要比较选择集；多主体相互作用还要讨论均衡的不动点、极端均衡以及选择规则。

papers.title: Minimizing a Submodular Function on a Lattice
papers.note: 利用格与次模性研究参数化最小化问题，给出最优选择随参数单调移动的充分条件。
papers.noteEn: Lattice structure and submodularity give sufficient conditions for optimal choices in parameterized minimization problems to move monotonically.

papers.title: Nash Equilibrium with Strategic Complementarities
papers.note: 在行动具有战略互补性的博弈中利用最佳反应的单调性证明纯策略均衡存在，并研究均衡集合的序结构。
papers.noteEn: In games with strategic complements, monotone best responses establish existence of pure-strategy equilibrium and reveal the order structure of the equilibrium set.

papers.title: Rationalizability, Learning, and Equilibrium in Games with Strategic Complementarities
papers.note: 在超模博弈中以最小和最大均衡约束可理性化行为和一类学习过程的长期行为，使多重均衡也具有预测内容。
papers.noteEn: In supermodular games, least and greatest equilibria bound rationalizable behavior and long-run outcomes of a class of learning processes, giving predictions even with multiplicity.

papers.title: Monotone Comparative Statics
papers.note: 以准超模性与单交叉等序数条件刻画最优选择集的单调性，允许多值最优解并明确比较集合所用的序。
papers.noteEn: Quasisupermodularity and single crossing characterize monotonicity of optimal choice sets, allowing multiple optima and specifying how to order sets.

papers.title: Single Crossing Properties and the Existence of Pure Strategy Equilibria in Games of Incomplete Information
papers.note: 对私人类型和行动施加单交叉性质及相应规则性条件，证明存在行动随类型单调的纯策略贝叶斯均衡。
papers.noteEn: Under single crossing in private types and actions and appropriate regularity conditions, a pure-strategy Bayesian equilibrium exists with actions monotone in type.

papers.title: Comparing Equilibria
papers.note: 研究不依赖可微性或唯一性的均衡比较条件，包括最小与最大均衡如何随外生参数移动。
papers.noteEn: Equilibrium comparisons need neither differentiability nor uniqueness under the paper's conditions, including comparisons of the least and greatest equilibria.

papers.title: Equilibrium Points in Nonzero-Sum n-Person Submodular Games
papers.note: 将格上的次模优化用于多玩家非零和博弈，用单调最佳反应构造均衡点。
papers.noteEn: Applying submodular optimization on lattices to nonzero-sum games yields equilibrium points via monotone best responses.

papers.title: The Comparative Statics of Constrained Optimization Problems
papers.note: 定义约束集的顺序并给出对应的目标函数条件，使集合变化时最优选择上移，应用于消费、生产和投资组合。
papers.noteEn: An ordering of constraint sets and corresponding conditions on objectives ensure that optima rise as the set changes, with applications to consumption, production, and portfolios.

papers.title: Monotone Comparative Statics under Uncertainty
papers.note: 刻画随机优化问题中哪些收益与概率分布条件能让期望收益保留单交叉或对数超模性质。
papers.noteEn: Conditions on payoffs and distributions preserve single crossing or log-supermodularity after integrating over uncertainty.

papers.title: Comparative Statics by Adaptive Dynamics and the Correspondence Principle
papers.note: 从旧均衡出发研究参数变化后的适应路径，说明战略互补博弈中动态调整与均衡比较静态之间的联系。
papers.noteEn: Starting from a pre-change equilibrium, adaptive paths link out-of-equilibrium adjustment to comparative statics in games with strategic complementarities.

papers.title: Robust Comparative Statics in Large Dynamic Economies
papers.note: 在受个体冲击的无限期经济中，刻画原始参数变化对稳态总量的方向性影响。
papers.noteEn: In infinite-horizon economies with idiosyncratic shocks, primitive changes can order steady-state aggregates.

papers.title: Aggregating the Single Crossing Property
papers.role: 单交叉在加总后的保留
papers.roleEn: Preservation of single crossing under aggregation
papers.note: 刻画一组函数的单交叉性质何时能在加总后维持，并给出多维加总的充分条件。
papers.noteEn: The paper characterizes when single crossing survives aggregation across functions and gives sufficient conditions for multidimensional aggregation.

papers.title: The Economics of Modern Manufacturing: Technology, Strategy, and Organization
papers.role: 生产与组织的协同选择
papers.note: 把灵活设备、产品多样性和快速响应等企业决策建成互补选择，解释为什么相关做法可能一起改变。
papers.noteEn: Complementarities among flexible equipment, product variety, and rapid response explain why manufacturing practices can change together.

papers.title: Finding All Equilibria in Games of Strategic Complements
papers.note: 利用互补博弈最佳反应的有序性，提出寻找所有纯策略纳什均衡的算法。
papers.noteEn: Order in best responses supports an algorithm for finding all pure-strategy Nash equilibria of games with strategic complements.

papers.title: Comparative Statics with Adjustment Costs and the Le Chatelier Principle
papers.authors: Eddie Dekel · John K.-H. Quah · Ludvig Sinander
papers.role: 调整成本与长短期反应
papers.roleEn: Adjustment costs and short- versus long-run responses
papers.note: 在序数互补条件及温和的成本单调性下，长期对冲击的反应不小于受调整成本约束的短期反应。
papers.noteEn: Under ordinal complementarity and mild monotonicity of adjustment costs, the long-run response to a shock is at least as large as the short-run response constrained by adjustment costs.

edges.label: 让对手行动成为参数
edges.note: 个体最优反应对他人行动有序，就能使用格不动点方法研究均衡。
edges.noteEn: Ordered individual responses to others’ actions allow lattice fixed-point methods to establish equilibrium.

edges.label: 约束学习过程
edges.note: 在极端均衡之外进一步研究理性化与适应性学习能否把行为带出这些边界。
edges.noteEn: Beyond identifying extremal equilibria, ask whether rationalizability and adaptive learning allow behavior to escape those bounds.

edges.label: 转向序数条件
edges.note: 以选择与收益比较的序结构替代单一的基数型充分条件，明确多值最优解的比较。
edges.noteEn: Order properties of choices and payoff comparisons replace a purely cardinal sufficient condition and clarify comparisons between sets of optima.

edges.label: 引入私人类型
edges.note: 将排序与单交叉思想带入贝叶斯博弈，还须使对手采用单调策略时自己的最佳反应具有相应性质。
edges.noteEn: Transferring order and single crossing to Bayesian games requires that best responses preserve monotonicity when opponents use monotone strategies.

edges.label: 越过单一互补博弈模型
edges.note: 抽离均衡比较所需的单调结构，研究适用范围超过原博弈学习模型的经济系统。
edges.noteEn: Isolating the order structure needed for comparative statics extends the analysis beyond a particular learning model.

edges.label: 由单人优化走向相互最优
edges.labelEn: From optimization to mutual best responses
edges.note: 参数单调的最优选择可用来刻画每个玩家对他人策略的反应，并进一步寻找不动点。
edges.noteEn: Monotone optimal choices become responses to other players’ strategies, making equilibrium a fixed-point problem.

edges.label: 使参数变化进入可行集
edges.labelEn: Move the parameter into the feasible set
edges.note: 从目标函数参数的单交叉比较进一步研究预算或技术约束自身改变时的最优选择。
edges.noteEn: Beyond single-crossing shifts in an objective, consider choices when budget or technology constraints themselves change.

edges.label: 对不确定性取期望
edges.note: 在每个状态下成立的排序未必经积分保留；该文给出使单调比较可用于期望目标的条件。
edges.noteEn: An ordering that holds state by state need not survive integration. The paper identifies when it does for expected objectives.

edges.label: 从极端均衡转向调整路径
edges.labelEn: Move from extremal equilibria to adjustment paths
edges.note: 比较参数变动前后的极端均衡，并不能直接说明经济从某个初始均衡如何移动；动态假设补上了这一步。
edges.noteEn: Comparing extremal equilibria alone does not determine movement from a particular initial equilibrium. An adjustment rule supplies that link.

edges.label: 把比较对象变为稳态
edges.note: 个体状态分布会随政策变化；比较静态必须同时处理最优政策和长期分布。
edges.noteEn: Because policies change the cross-sectional distribution, comparative statics must account for both behavior and its long-run distribution.

edges.label: 检验加总操作本身
edges.note: 各状态分别满足单交叉，并不保证积分或求和后的目标也满足；该文直接检验这一步。
edges.noteEn: Statewise single crossing does not ensure the property for an integrated or summed objective. The paper targets this aggregation step.

edges.label: 从玩家间互补转向企业内互补
edges.labelEn: Move from strategic to within-firm complementarity
edges.note: 不同企业实践之间存在增加差异时，改变一项技术也会影响采用其他实践的回报。
edges.noteEn: Increasing differences across business practices mean adopting one technology can raise the return to adopting others.

edges.label: 从极端均衡到内部均衡的计算
edges.labelEn: Compute interior as well as extremal equilibria
edges.note: 格不动点保证极端均衡后，还需要搜索和筛除候选项，才能找出其间的其他均衡。
edges.noteEn: Existence of extremal fixed points does not enumerate the other equilibria between them. Additional search and elimination do.

edges.label: 在单调优化中加入调整摩擦
edges.labelEn: Add adjustment frictions to monotone optimization
edges.note: 无成本选择的排序结论被用于比较变化速度不同的最优调整，并给出动态路径单调的附加条件。
edges.noteEn: The ordering of frictionless choices extends to responses under different speeds of adjustment, with additional conditions for a monotone dynamic path.

branches.questionEn: When a parameter changes, can we predict the direction of actions and equilibria without uniqueness, concavity, or first-order conditions?
branches.boundaryEn: Individual optimization requires comparing choice sets. With interacting agents one must also study fixed points, extremal equilibria, and selection rules.

branches.name: 信号与筛选
branches.question: 当能力、风险或支付意愿只有当事人知道，另一方如何从教育选择或所选合约中识别类型？
branches.boundary: 信号模型中知情者自行选择行动；筛选模型中不知情方先设计菜单。竞争保险和垄断定价的均衡对象也不同。

papers.title: Job Market Signaling
papers.note: 教育成本随能力而异时，求职者的教育选择可以在均衡中传递生产率信息，即使教育本身没有提高生产率。
papers.noteEn: When education costs vary with ability, education choices can reveal productivity in equilibrium even if schooling itself does not raise productivity.

papers.title: Equilibrium in Competitive Insurance Markets: An Essay on the Economics of Imperfect Information
papers.note: 保险人用保费和赔付额区分风险类型；某些风险人口构成下，潜在的偏离菜单会破坏竞争均衡的存在。
papers.noteEn: Insurers use premiums and coverage to separate risk types. For some population compositions a profitable deviation from the proposed contracts prevents a competitive equilibrium.

papers.title: Monopoly and Product Quality
papers.note: 垄断者按消费者对质量的私人评价设计价格与质量，筛选动机改变所供应的质量。
papers.noteEn: A monopolist offers qualities and prices to consumers who value quality differently. The need for self-selection distorts the qualities offered.

papers.title: Monopoly with Incomplete Information
papers.note: 刻画垄断者面对需求异质的消费者时如何选择数量与支付，并给出最优定价呈现数量折扣的条件。
papers.noteEn: The model characterizes quantities and payments offered to consumers with heterogeneous demand and gives conditions for optimal quantity discounts.

papers.title: The Market for “Lemons”: Quality Uncertainty and the Market Mechanism
papers.role: 质量不确定与逆向选择
papers.note: 买方按市场平均质量出价会压低高质量卖家的回报，优质商品可能退出。
papers.noteEn: Buyers price average quality, depressing returns to high-quality sellers and potentially driving their goods out.

papers.title: The Theory of “Screening,” Education, and the Distribution of Income
papers.note: 教育可以帮助用人单位识别能力，即使它的私人回报与社会生产率收益并不一致。
papers.noteEn: Education can help employers sort workers even when its private return diverges from its social productivity benefit.

papers.title: Informational Equilibrium
papers.role: 允许市场对偏离作出反应
papers.note: 反应性均衡允许新合约触发竞争者进一步报价；评估潜在偏离时必须计入这些反应。
papers.noteEn: Reactive equilibrium allows a contract to trigger subsequent rival offers, so a deviation's profitability must account for those responses.

papers.title: Signaling Games and Stable Equilibria
papers.note: 直观准则排除某些不可信的路径外推断，缩小由不同接收者信念支撑的信号均衡集合。
papers.noteEn: The intuitive criterion restricts implausible off-path inferences and narrows the set of signaling equilibria supported by different receiver beliefs.

papers.title: A Model of Insurance Markets with Incomplete Information
papers.note: 若新保单会使在售保单发生亏损，进入者预见到这些保单可能撤回，竞争均衡的存在结论因而改变。
papers.noteEn: An entrant anticipates withdrawal of policies rendered unprofitable by entry, changing competitive equilibrium existence.

papers.title: Perfect Competition in Markets With Adverse Selection
papers.note: 零利润条件决定价格，自由进入决定交易的合约。在所定义的完全竞争模型中，多维私人信息与均衡存在可以并存。
papers.roleEn: A competitive limit with multidimensional types
papers.noteEn: Zero profit determines prices and free entry determines traded contracts. The proposed competitive model admits equilibrium even with multidimensional private information.

papers.title: Estimating Welfare in Insurance Markets Using Variation in Prices
papers.authors: Liran Einav, Amy Finkelstein & Mark R. Cullen
papers.note: 保费变化同时改变投保人数和投保者平均成本，从而可联合估计需求、选择与效率损失。
papers.roleEn: Measuring the welfare cost of selection
papers.noteEn: Premium changes shift both take-up and average insured cost, permitting joint estimation of demand, selection, and welfare losses.

papers.title: The Role of Commitment in Dynamic Contracts: Evidence from Life Insurance
papers.note: 寿险保费被前置，形成部分锁定。保费路径的数据支持双方都能观察风险变化、只有保险人能承诺的模型。
papers.noteEn: Life policies front-load premiums and partially lock in buyers. Premium profiles fit a model with symmetric learning about risk and commitment only by the insurer.

papers.title: Dynamic Adverse Selection: A Theory of Illiquidity, Fire Sales, and Flight to Quality
papers.role: 用交易概率传递资产质量
papers.note: 高质量资产卖家接受较低成交概率以获得更高价格。投资者的私人信息分布同时影响价格与流动性。
papers.noteEn: Sellers of high-quality assets accept a lower probability of sale for a higher price. The distribution of private information shapes both prices and liquidity.

papers.title: Selection on Moral Hazard in Health Insurance
papers.authors: Liran Einav · Amy Finkelstein · Stephen P. Ryan · Paul Schrimpf · Mark R. Cullen
papers.note: 雇员数据与保单选择模型显示，消费者会按自己对保险慷慨程度的预期医疗利用反应选择保障。
papers.noteEn: Employee data and a plan-choice model show that consumers sort into coverage partly by their expected utilization response to insurance generosity.

edges.label: 机制对照
edges.note: 识别类型的行动从教育选择换成保单选择；保险人的竞争引入对候选均衡菜单的外部偏离。
edges.noteEn: Insurance choices replace education as the observable action. Competing insurers can deviate from a candidate equilibrium menu.

edges.label: 市场结构对照
edges.note: 双方都靠自选条款分离类型；垄断卖家的目标变为从整个菜单获利，竞争保险人的逐项盈亏约束不再相同。
edges.noteEn: Both models rely on self-selection. A monopolist earns profits across its menu, while individual policies face different break-even constraints under competition.

edges.label: 筛选工具扩展
edges.note: 将产品质量阶梯与成本、需求和数量有关的非线性定价放在同一自选择逻辑下比较。
edges.noteEn: Quality ladders and nonlinear prices that depend on demand, costs and quantities exploit the same self-selection logic.

edges.label: 从退出到发信号
edges.note: 当质量无法直接观察时，成本随类型变化的可见行动提供了另一条区分类型的路径。
edges.noteEn: When quality is unobservable, a visible action with type-dependent costs gives sellers another way to distinguish types.

edges.label: 加入分配问题
edges.note: 从求职者如何选择信号，进一步追问筛选制度如何影响工资差距与教育支出。
edges.noteEn: Move from a worker's choice of signal to the implications of screening for wage differences and educational spending.

edges.label: 改变偏离检验
edges.note: 比较在既有菜单固定时判断偏离与允许竞争对手作出反应时判断偏离。
edges.noteEn: Compare deviations against fixed existing offers with deviations evaluated after rivals can respond.

edges.label: 从存在到精炼
edges.note: 把教育信号的均衡多重性与偏离后应当相信哪种类型联系起来。
edges.noteEn: The multiplicity of education-signaling equilibria turns on which types can credibly make an off-path deviation.

edges.label: 允许撤回旧保单
edges.note: 固定旧保单会高估某些撇脂偏离的收益；既有保单撤回后进入者面对另一种风险组合。
edges.labelEn: Allowing incumbent policies to be withdrawn
edges.noteEn: Fixing incumbent policies can overstate gains from cream-skimming because withdrawals change the entrant's pool of risks.

edges.label: 改变竞争均衡概念
edges.note: 将均衡看作差异化伯特兰竞争的极限，用来区分非存在结果依赖的竞争设定。
edges.noteEn: An equilibrium limit of differentiated Bertrand competition helps identify which competitive assumptions drive nonexistence.

edges.label: 从存在性到损失大小
edges.note: 检出逆向选择并不确定其福利代价，价格引起的边际投保者变化补足这一信息。
edges.noteEn: Detecting adverse selection leaves its cost open. Changes in who enrolls at the margin reveal the missing information.

edges.label: 区分初始私有类型与日后重新分类
edges.note: 竞争筛选研究投保时已知的风险差异；长期寿险则问公开风险更新和投保人可退出如何改变保费时序。
edges.labelEn: Separating private risk from reclassification risk
edges.noteEn: Competitive screening sorts risks known at purchase. Long-term insurance instead asks how public risk updates and customer exit change the timing of premiums.

edges.label: 从教育成本到成交等待
edges.note: 使分离具有代价的变量由教育变为少成交或推迟成交的风险。
edges.labelEn: From education costs to waiting to trade
edges.noteEn: The cost supporting separation changes from education to the risk of delayed or foregone trade.

edges.label: 把需求反应加入类型
edges.note: 价格变化识别出的选择，既可能来自原有风险，也可能来自消费者预期自己投保后的行为。
edges.labelEn: Making behavioral responses part of type
edges.noteEn: Selection revealed by price variation can reflect baseline risk as well as anticipated behavioral responses to coverage.

resources.title: The Theory of Incentives: The Principal-Agent Model

branches.questionEn: When ability, risk or willingness to pay is privately known, what can the other side infer from education or contract choices?
branches.boundaryEn: In signaling models the informed party acts first. In screening models the uninformed party offers a menu. Competitive insurance and monopoly pricing also use different equilibrium conditions.

branches.name: 廉价沟通与可验证披露
branches.question: 知情人能够影响听者的行动时，究竟是什么约束他说什么、隐瞒什么？
branches.boundary: 先区分能任意发送的消息与只能如实出示的证据，再问听者是否知道证据存在。

papers.title: Good News and Bad News: Representation Theorems and Applications
papers.note: 在文中的可验证报告环境中，接收者对隐瞒信息的推断能迫使知情方披露原本想保留的信息。
papers.noteEn: In the verifiable-report model, the receiver's inference from silence can force the informed party to reveal information it would prefer to withhold.

papers.title: Strategic Information Transmission
papers.note: 发送者与接收者的偏好有系统性分歧时，均衡消息可把一维状态合并为区间；信息精细度受到激励相容约束。
papers.noteEn: When interests systematically diverge, equilibrium messages may pool intervals of a one-dimensional state. Incentive compatibility limits communication precision.

papers.title: Disclosure of Nonproprietary Information
papers.note: 投资者不确定经理是否取得消息时，沉默既可能来自无消息，也可能来自坏消息；可验证性可与选择性披露共存。
papers.noteEn: If investors do not know whether a manager received information, silence may mean either no news or bad news. Selective disclosure can coexist with verifiability.

papers.title: A Model of Expertise
papers.note: 依序咨询偏向不同的两位专家可支持比单一专家更有信息的均衡；意见分歧本身不足以保证完全揭示。
papers.noteEn: Consulting two differently biased experts in sequence may support more informative equilibria than consulting one. Disagreement alone does not ensure full revelation.

papers.title: The Informational Role of Warranties and Private Disclosure about Product Quality
papers.note: 卖家拥有可核实的质量信息时，买家对未说明的特征持怀疑态度，可以促使卖家披露。
papers.noteEn: When quality information is verifiable, buyers' skepticism about unspecified features can induce disclosure.

papers.title: Relying on the Information of Interested Parties
papers.note: 当决策者了解有关变量、发言者偏好并能策略性推断时，得到充分信息未必需要多方竞争。
papers.noteEn: A sophisticated decision maker who knows the relevant variables and interested parties' preferences may obtain full information without competition among informants.

papers.title: Meaning and Credibility in Cheap-Talk Games
papers.note: 若意外消息有双方理解的字面意义，一些均衡会被有动机说出该消息的类型打破；新语稳健均衡未必存在。
papers.noteEn: If an unexpected message has shared literal meaning, types with a credible reason to use it may upset an equilibrium. A neologism-proof equilibrium need not exist.

papers.title: Multiple Referrals and Multidimensional Cheap Talk
papers.note: 在多维状态下，不同专家的偏向方向可以提供交叉检验，在给定条件下支持完全揭示。
papers.noteEn: With multidimensional states, different directions of expert bias can enable cross-checks and support full revelation under stated conditions.

papers.title: Discretionary Disclosure
papers.note: 即使交易者知道经理想隐瞒坏消息，披露成本也可以使经理只选择公布超过阈值的消息。
papers.noteEn: Even when traders understand managers' incentive to hide bad news, a disclosure cost can induce disclosure only above a cutoff.

papers.title: Disclosing a Random Walk
papers.authors: Ilan Kremer · Amnon Schreiber · Andrzej Skrzypacz
papers.note: 公司价值随机游走，经理每期可能获知价值。经理有时会披露拉低当前价格的消息，以减少未来市场的不确定性。
papers.noteEn: Firm value follows a random walk, and the manager may learn it each period. Disclosing news that lowers today's price can reduce uncertainty in the future.

papers.title: Strategic Communication with Lying Costs
papers.note: 发送者偏向较高行动，但偏离真实状态的陈述有成本，因而夸大信息仍可透露部分真相。
papers.noteEn: An upward-biased sender pays to misreport, so inflated messages can still convey information.

papers.title: Professional Advice
papers.role: 专家对能力声誉的追求
papers.note: 专业人士想表现得消息灵通，建议与最终状态共同决定其声誉。在模型均衡中，有效传递的消息至多两种。
papers.noteEn: An expert wants to appear informed and is judged by advice against the realized state. At most two distinct messages are effectively conveyed in equilibrium.

papers.title: Media Bias and Reputation
papers.note: 受众不确定媒体质量时，与既有信念一致的报道可提高其质量评价，从而激励新闻机构歪曲报道。
papers.noteEn: When audiences are unsure about source quality, reports consistent with prior beliefs can improve perceived quality and induce reporting distortions.

papers.title: Credulity, Lies, and Costly Talk
papers.authors: Navin Kartik · Marco Ottaviani · Francesco Squintani
papers.note: 发送者偏好更高行动时，说谎有成本或部分听者轻信会改变均衡报告；状态空间向上无界时可出现完全分离。
papers.noteEn: With upward sender bias, costly misrepresentation or credulous listeners changes equilibrium reporting. An unbounded upper state space can support full separation.

edges.label: 信息技术对照
edges.note: 可验证证据限制哪些陈述能够作出，廉价沟通允许任意报告，信息须靠偏好与接收者反应维持。
edges.noteEn: Evidence limits which claims can be made. Cheap talk allows any report, so information transmission depends on preferences and receiver responses.

edges.label: 放松可观察条件
edges.note: 让外部人不再确定经理手里有无消息，改变沉默的推断，削弱完全揭示的逻辑。
edges.noteEn: Uncertainty about whether the manager has news changes what outsiders infer from silence and weakens the logic of full disclosure.

edges.label: 策略环境扩展
edges.note: 从一位发送者增至两位专家，第二位的发言使第一位报告的可信度和价值发生变化。
edges.noteEn: With two experts the second speaker changes the credibility and value of the first report.

edges.label: 把揭示用于商品质量
edges.note: 两文从可验证声明下对沉默的推断解释信息揭示，其中一篇进一步讨论担保与质量。
edges.noteEn: Both explain disclosure through inferences from silence under verifiability. Grossman connects it to warranties and product quality.

edges.label: 从一个证人到利益竞争
edges.note: 把揭示逻辑放入多个知情方可能竞争的环境，区分受众的推断能力和发言者竞争。
edges.labelEn: From one informant to competing interests
edges.noteEn: Allowing competing informants separates the informational role of audience sophistication from competition among speakers.

edges.label: 限制未使用消息的解释
edges.note: 在任意消息的模型上加入共同语言，检验原来的均衡能否抵抗有意义的偏离。
edges.noteEn: Shared language adds a test of whether an equilibrium survives meaningful deviations using previously unused messages.

edges.label: 改变信息维数
edges.note: 多名专家的价值除了来自发言顺序，也可能来自多维偏向的几何关系。
edges.noteEn: The value of multiple experts can come from the geometry of their biases as well as the order in which they speak.

edges.label: 区分沉默的理由
edges.note: 披露成本与投资者不确定经理是否知情，是选择性披露的两种不同来源。
edges.noteEn: Disclosure costs and uncertainty about whether the manager is informed are distinct sources of selective disclosure.

edges.label: 为沉默加入未来后果
edges.note: 保留旁人不知经理是否知情的设定，让今天的披露决定未来市场信念的起点。
edges.noteEn: Keep uncertainty about whether the manager is informed, but let today's disclosure determine the starting point of future market beliefs.

edges.label: 打破消息的完全等价
edges.note: 廉价沟通中的消息标签本无代价；让辞意偏离真实状态有成本便产生系统性夸大。
edges.noteEn: Making a message's literal distance from the truth costly gives content to labels and generates systematic inflation.

edges.label: 更换发送者的目标
edges.note: 基准模型中偏好分歧限制消息精度；这里即使没有外生的行动偏向，职业声誉也会压缩消息。
edges.labelEn: Changing the source of sender bias
edges.noteEn: In the benchmark, disagreement over actions limits precision. Here career reputation can coarsen advice without an exogenous action bias.

edges.label: 把听者的评价纳入奖励
edges.note: 专家偏向可外生给定，也可由媒体希望被受众视作可靠的声誉动机产生。
edges.labelEn: Rewarding the speaker through audience beliefs
edges.noteEn: Bias can be assumed for an expert or generated by a media outlet's desire to be perceived as reliable.

edges.label: 改变谎报的代价
edges.note: 对比任意廉价报告与有成本的夸大，后者改变偏离者愿意报告多远。
edges.noteEn: Unlike costless reports, costly exaggeration constrains how far a deviating type wishes to misrepresent its information.

branches.questionEn: When an informed speaker can influence a listener's actions, what constrains what the speaker says or withholds?
branches.boundaryEn: Distinguish unrestricted messages from verifiable evidence, then ask whether the listener knows that the evidence exists.

branches.name: 贝叶斯说服与信息设计
branches.question: 设计者可以承诺一种信号技术时，哪些行为分布可实施，哪一种最符合其目标？
branches.boundary: 区分设计者数目、接收者的原始私有信息，以及信息结构可否自由选择。

papers.title: Bayesian Persuasion
papers.note: 单一发送者承诺实验，通过选择均值等于先验的后验分布影响接收者，最优值可由凹化得到。
papers.noteEn: A sender commits to an experiment and chooses a distribution of posteriors whose mean is the prior. Concavification gives the optimal value.

papers.title: Bayes Correlated Equilibrium and the Comparison of Information Structures in Games
papers.note: 给定基本博弈及原始信息，利用一致性与服从约束刻画在附加信息下可能产生的贝叶斯均衡结果。
papers.noteEn: Given a basic game and initial information, consistency and obedience characterize the Bayesian equilibrium outcomes possible with additional information.

papers.title: Competition in Persuasion
papers.note: 多个发送者分别选择实验，刻画可能的均衡后验分布，并说明信息技术条件如何影响竞争能否增加揭示。
papers.noteEn: Several senders choose experiments separately. The paper characterizes equilibrium posterior distributions and how technology shapes whether competition increases disclosure.

papers.title: Constrained Information Design
papers.note: 把等式与不等式约束纳入升维的凹化问题，给出最优后验支持点数的界，并研究何时可以使用对偶方法。
papers.noteEn: Equality and inequality constraints enter a higher-dimensional concavification problem. The authors bound posterior support size and identify when dual methods apply.

papers.title: Optimal Information Disclosure
papers.note: 发送者偏好高利润的推荐，接收者重视相关性。把高利润低相关与低利润高相关对象适当合并，可提高推荐被接受的收益。
papers.noteEn: The sender values profit and the receiver relevance. Pooling less relevant but profitable prospects with more relevant ones can raise the sender's return.

papers.title: Subjectivity and Correlation in Randomized Strategies
papers.note: 玩家按私人信号行动，相关性使联合行动分布不必是独立混合策略的乘积。
papers.noteEn: Private signals can correlate actions, so their joint distribution need not factor into independent mixed strategies.

papers.title: The Simple Economics of Optimal Persuasion
papers.note: 把后验均值相关的说服问题构造成市场，用支持价格检验候选信号结构何时最优。
papers.noteEn: A market analogy for persuasion with posterior-mean payoffs yields supporting prices that certify candidate signal structures.

papers.title: Beeps
papers.note: 设计者控制随时间释放的信息，通过影响信念路径来引导接收者的一连串行动。
papers.noteEn: A designer filters information over time to influence belief paths and the sequence of receiver actions.

papers.title: Persuasion of a Privately Informed Receiver
papers.authors: Anton Kolotilin · Tymofiy Mylovanov · Andriy Zapechelnyuk · Ming Li
papers.note: 接收者有私有类型且只在两个行动间选择。在所研究的线性环境中，依类型报告定制的说服机制与统一实验实施能力等价。
papers.noteEn: For a privately informed receiver with two actions, type-contingent persuasion mechanisms and type-independent experiments are equivalent in implementation in the linear environment studied.

papers.title: Informed Information Design
papers.note: 设计者无事前承诺且私下知情，选择披露机制本身即可传信。论文刻画满足类型逐一收益要求的一组贝叶斯相关均衡。
papers.noteEn: A privately informed designer lacks ex ante commitment, so choosing a disclosure mechanism can itself signal information. Typewise payoff requirements select a subset of Bayes-correlated equilibria.

papers.title: Costly Persuasion
papers.note: 信号成本正比于不确定性的期望下降时，可对扣除信息成本后的目标使用凹包方法。
papers.noteEn: When signal cost is proportional to expected uncertainty reduction, concavification applies to the cost-adjusted objective.

papers.title: Information Structures in Optimal Auctions
papers.role: 卖方选择投标人的信息
papers.note: 拍卖人可选择投标人了解自身估值的程度。最优拍卖中的信息划分可为有限且单调，并可在对称投标人间不对称。
papers.noteEn: An auctioneer chooses how much bidders learn about their own values. Optimal-auction information partitions can be finite and monotone yet asymmetric across symmetric bidders.

papers.title: Preparing for the Worst but Hoping for the Best: Robust (Bayesian) Persuasion
papers.role: 对额外信息的稳健说服
papers.note: 发送者不确定接收者还能取得哪些消息或采用哪个均衡；先最大化最坏收益，再按其猜测的环境比较并列政策。
papers.noteEn: The sender doubts what other information receivers may obtain and which strategies they select. She first maximizes worst-case payoffs, then ranks ties under her conjecture.

papers.title: Persuasion with Coarse Communication
papers.note: 若只能发 k 种消息，发送者价值等于至多 k 个后验点的凹化值；最优后验的支撑可以取为仿射独立。
papers.noteEn: With k messages, sender value equals concavification over at most k posteriors. An optimum can have affinely independent support.

edges.label: 可实施对象扩展
edges.note: 单人最优反应改成多方分别愿意遵守推荐，基础信息结构也进入可实施结果集合。
edges.noteEn: A single receiver's best response becomes obedience by each of several players. Initial information also constrains implementable outcomes.

edges.label: 改变设计者数目
edges.note: 单一设计者的最优化变成多位信息提供者之间的均衡，各自会考虑增加或改变实验的收益。
edges.noteEn: A single optimization problem becomes an equilibrium among information providers, each weighing the gains from changing or adding an experiment.

edges.label: 改变可行集
edges.note: 后验均值约束之外再加入其他限制，原来的单一凹化空间由含约束维度的表示取代。
edges.noteEn: Additional requirements beyond the posterior mean call for a concavification that explicitly represents the extra constraint dimensions.

edges.label: 从具体推荐到一般后验
edges.note: 一文优化具体的推荐类别，另一文用后验均值约束描述一切可承诺实验。
edges.noteEn: One model optimizes recommendation categories. The other describes all committed experiments through a posterior-mean constraint.

edges.label: 从相关行动到信息约束
edges.note: 相关建议的服从条件发展为给定原始类型信息后对推荐行动的贝叶斯服从约束。
edges.labelEn: From correlated actions to informational constraints
edges.noteEn: Obedience to correlated recommendations becomes Bayesian obedience conditional on agents' initial type information.

edges.label: 凹化的价格解释
edges.note: 在收益依赖后验均值的环境中，价格证书给贝叶斯可行集合上的最优性提供另一种检验。
edges.noteEn: When payoffs depend on posterior means, a supporting-price certificate provides an alternative optimality test on the Bayes-plausible set.

edges.label: 由一次实验到信号过程
edges.note: 静态后验的选择变成何时发送何种消息的问题；早先披露也限制日后的信念路径。
edges.labelEn: From one experiment to a signal process
edges.noteEn: Choosing a static posterior becomes choosing when and what to disclose, with earlier disclosures constraining later beliefs.

edges.label: 加入接收者类型
edges.note: 比较所有人看到同一实验与信息取决于接收者自报类型时的可实施集合。
edges.noteEn: Compare implementability under a common experiment and disclosure contingent on the receiver's reported type.

edges.label: 加入设计者的中期激励
edges.note: 接收者服从推荐还不够，需检验每种设计者类型能否通过改选披露规则获益。
