edges.noteEn: Receiver obedience alone does not address whether each designer type could gain by choosing a different disclosure rule.

edges.label: 给信息精度定价
edges.note: 后验分布既决定说服收益也决定生成信号的成本，因而最优实验可能改变。
edges.noteEn: The distribution of posteriors determines both persuasion benefits and signal costs, altering the optimal experiment.

edges.label: 从拍卖收入到一般说服目标
edges.note: 拍卖中的实验影响竞价与收入；抽象的说服问题则通过后验分布刻画实验的可行性。
edges.labelEn: From auction revenue to a general persuasion objective
edges.noteEn: Experiments in an auction affect bidding and revenue. Abstract persuasion characterizes experiments through feasible distributions of posteriors.

edges.label: 改变设计者的评价准则
edges.note: 给定贝叶斯猜测的最优政策，改为还要抵御猜测错误或额外信息的政策。
edges.noteEn: A policy optimal under one Bayesian conjecture must now also withstand additional information and misspecification.

edges.label: 直接限制消息数
edges.note: 额外约束现在落在后验支撑大小上，不能仅靠保持后验均值来分拆信念。
edges.noteEn: The added restriction is on posterior support size. Preserving the mean alone no longer licenses arbitrary splitting.

branches.questionEn: When a designer can commit to a signal technology, which distributions of behavior can be induced, and which best serves the designer's objective?
branches.boundaryEn: Distinguish the number of designers, the receiver's initial private information and restrictions on the choice of information structure.

branches.name: 行动观察与社会学习
branches.question: 后到者只能看到前人的行动时，许多微弱私有信号最终能否汇总，汇总要多久？
branches.boundary: 观测对象是经过私人决策压缩的行动。观察范围、信号尾部和偏好异质性都会改变长程结果。

papers.title: A Simple Model of Herd Behavior
papers.note: 序贯决策者可能理性地仿效前人；当行动不再反映自己的信息时，后继者能从中学到的内容也会减少。
papers.noteEn: Sequential decision makers can rationally imitate predecessors. When their actions cease to reflect private information, later agents learn less from observing them.

papers.title: A Theory of Fads, Fashion, Custom, and Cultural Change as Informational Cascades
papers.authors: Sushil Bikhchandani · David Hirshleifer · Ivo Welch
papers.note: 当公开行动史足够偏向某一选择时，决策者无论收到何种私有信号都会采取同一行动，进一步的行动停止传递该信号。
papers.noteEn: A sufficiently one-sided public history makes the same action optimal for every private signal. Further actions then stop revealing those signals.

papers.title: Pathological Outcomes of Observational Learning
papers.note: 区分私人信念有界与无界，并研究异质偏好；后者可使公开信念停在不能辨明真实状态的位置。
papers.noteEn: The analysis distinguishes bounded from unbounded private beliefs and examines heterogeneous preferences, which can leave public beliefs short of identifying the state.

papers.title: Bayesian Learning in Social Networks
papers.authors: Daron Acemoglu · Munther A. Dahleh · Ilan Lobel · Asuman Ozdaglar
papers.note: 允许每人只看到网络邻居的行动，考察观察网络的扩张性质与私有信号如何共同决定渐近学习。
papers.noteEn: Agents may observe only network neighbors. The expansion of the observation network and private signal quality jointly determine asymptotic learning.

papers.title: The Speed of Sequential Asymptotic Learning
papers.authors: Wade Hann-Caruthers · Vadim V. Martynov · Omer Tamuz
papers.note: 即便最终能从行动学到状态，速度仍强烈依赖私有信号分布的尾部，观察行动与直接观察信号的收敛速度可以相差很大。
papers.noteEn: Even when the state is eventually learned from actions, convergence depends on the tails of private signals and may differ sharply from learning directly from signals.

papers.title: Learning from Neighbours
papers.note: 个人利用自己和邻居的经验学习未知收益，网络决定局部经验能传多远。
papers.noteEn: Agents learn unknown payoffs from their own and neighbors' experience. The network determines how far that experience travels.

papers.title: Market Crashes and Informational Avalanches
papers.note: 交易成本会使私人信息暂不进入订单，一次触发交易可令此前累积的信息迅速显现。
papers.noteEn: Trading costs keep some private information out of orders. A trigger trade can rapidly reveal accumulated information.

papers.title: Naïve Herding in Rich-Information Settings
papers.note: 若人人把前人行动都当成独立的私人信号，就会重复计算早期证据，即使私有信息丰富也可能跟错。
papers.noteEn: Treating each predecessor's action as reflecting only private information double-counts early evidence and can cause incorrect herding even with rich signals.

papers.title: A General Framework for Rational Learning in Social Networks
papers.note: 有私人信息的代理人反复观察邻居的选择，论文刻画整体共识、局部无差异和局部分歧。
papers.noteEn: Agents with private information repeatedly observe neighbors' choices. The paper characterizes global consensus, local indifference and local disagreement.

papers.title: Asymptotic Learning on Bayesian Social Networks
papers.authors: Elchanan Mossel · Allan Sly · Omer Tamuz
papers.note: 个人反复观察邻居对二元状态的最优猜测，研究网络扩大时学对状态的概率何时趋于一。
papers.noteEn: Agents repeatedly observe neighbors' best guesses of a binary state. The question is when the probability of correct learning tends to one as networks grow.

papers.title: Learning With Heterogeneous Misspecified Models: Characterization and Robustness
papers.authors: J. Aislinn Bohren · Daniel N. Hauser
papers.note: 人们可能按不同的错误模型解读别人行动。论文以错误设定的形式刻画长期信念，区分何时错读会持续影响学习。
papers.noteEn: Agents may interpret others' actions through different misspecified models. The form of misspecification characterizes long-run beliefs and whether misinterpretation persists.

papers.title: Informational Herding with Model Misspecification
papers.note: 误解前人的观察机会会使个体错误解读其行动，即使信息足够也可能形成长期低效行为。
papers.noteEn: Misunderstanding predecessors' opportunities to observe can distort inferred information and sustain inefficient behavior despite ample signals.

papers.title: Rules of Thumb for Social Learning
papers.note: 使用者依据邻居的技术体验按预定规则切换，比较同一技术适合所有人与适合不同人时的扩散。
papers.noteEn: Agents switch technologies under fixed rules based on neighbors' experiences. Diffusion changes when agents benefit from different technologies rather than sharing one best option.

papers.title: Word-of-Mouth Learning
papers.note: 年轻一代抽问前人的选择及满意程度。抽样有代表性、至少抽两人且反馈含信息时，长期可形成一致选择；正确选择还需足够有信息的收益反馈。
papers.noteEn: New agents sample choices and satisfaction. Representative samples of at least two with informative feedback can yield consensus. Efficient consensus requires sufficiently informative payoff feedback.

papers.title: Naïve Learning in Social Networks and the Wisdom of Crowds
papers.role: 意见加权与集体正确性
papers.note: 当人们反复对邻居意见取加权平均时，大社会能学对的充要条件是最大个体影响力趋于零。
papers.noteEn: Under repeated weighted averaging of neighbors' opinions, a large society learns the truth exactly when the most influential individual's weight vanishes.

edges.label: 同期并行模型
edges.note: 两篇分别刻画理性从众；后一模型给出私人信号对当前行动完全失去影响的信息瀑布。
edges.noteEn: Both papers study rational herding. The second identifies cascades in which the current action is entirely insensitive to the private signal.

edges.label: 放松基准假设
edges.note: 从离散信号的典型瀑布转向一般信念分布与异质偏好，区分长期模仿和长期学对状态。
edges.noteEn: Moving from discrete signals to general belief distributions and heterogeneous preferences separates long-run imitation from learning the correct state.

edges.label: 改变观察结构
edges.note: 将能看到全部前人行动的基准与仅能观察部分邻居的情形比较。
edges.noteEn: Compare observing all predecessors' actions with seeing only the actions of selected neighbors.

edges.label: 从极限到速率
edges.note: 在能够渐近学对的情形，进一步问公开信念接近真相的速度。
edges.noteEn: Conditional on asymptotic learning, how fast do public beliefs converge to the truth?

edges.label: 经验与行动的观察
edges.note: 比较反复观察邻居经验与依次观察部分前人行动，区分学习的时间和网络结构。
edges.noteEn: Compare repeated access to local experience with sequential observation of selected predecessors.

edges.label: 证券市场的瀑布
edges.note: 顺序交易中，暂不交易也是选择，价格会随订单揭示的信息调整。
edges.noteEn: In sequential trading, abstaining is a choice and prices adjust to information in orders.

edges.label: 改变推断规则
edges.note: 对社会观察的系统性误读改变了理性贝叶斯学习的边界。
edges.noteEn: Systematically misreading others' decisions changes the bounds on rational Bayesian learning.

edges.label: 允许同一人反复行动
edges.note: 持续决策使共识和分歧成为不同于一次性决策正确率的结果。
edges.labelEn: Letting the same agent act repeatedly
edges.noteEn: Repeated decisions make consensus and disagreement outcomes distinct from the accuracy of a one-time choice.

edges.label: 比较网络极限
edges.note: 区分序列中逐个加入新决策者与在每一给定网络上反复更新后再扩大网络。
edges.noteEn: Distinguish adding decision makers sequentially from repeated updating on each graph followed by a large-network limit.

edges.label: 改变共同推断模型
edges.note: 此前的边界来自信号与偏好，此处在给定信息来源下考察对其生成机制的错设。
edges.noteEn: Beyond signal and preference restrictions, the analysis varies beliefs about how observations are generated.

edges.label: 改变行动的似然
edges.note: 长期学习依赖正确解读行动背后的信号；错设这种映射会破坏累积学习。
edges.noteEn: Long-run learning requires interpreting the signals behind actions, a link disrupted by a misspecified observation model.

edges.label: 从最优推断到经验规则
edges.note: 跟随前人的行为也可能来自局部经验规则，其效率须从扩散过程检验。
edges.labelEn: From optimal inference to rules of thumb
edges.noteEn: Following peers can arise from local decision rules. Its efficiency must then be assessed via the resulting diffusion process.

edges.label: 从行动史到抽样反馈
edges.note: 私有信号经行动压缩后，询问前人对结果是否满意能提供额外信息，而样本偏差会改变传播。
edges.labelEn: From action histories to sampled feedback
edges.noteEn: Satisfaction adds information beyond observed choices, while nonrepresentative sampling changes how that information spreads.

edges.label: 区分意见平均与行动推断
edges.note: 同样的网络稀疏度未必产生相同的学习结果，意见的长期权重和观察行动的信息量是不同对象。
edges.noteEn: Long-run influence in opinion averaging and informativeness of observed Bayesian actions are distinct properties of an observation network.

branches.questionEn: If later agents observe only earlier actions, can many weak private signals eventually be aggregated, and how quickly?
branches.boundaryEn: Actions compress private information. Observation patterns, signal tails and preference heterogeneity affect the long-run outcome.

branches.name: 实验、搜索与学习的外部性
branches.question: 试验会牺牲即时回报，却会改善未来选择。谁承担试验成本，谁能使用新信息？
branches.boundary: 这里的信息来自行动产生的反馈。价格会改变试验成本，其他人观察反馈则会带来搭便车。

papers.title: A Two-Armed Bandit Theory of Market Pricing
papers.note: 卖方在未知需求下试探价格，当前价格既决定收入也决定未来能学到什么，最优行为可能不会辨明最佳价格。
papers.noteEn: A seller facing unknown demand experiments with prices. Price affects both revenue and learning, and optimal behavior need not identify the best price.

papers.title: Learning and Strategic Pricing
papers.note: 买方从反复购买中学习产品价值；卖方通过竞争性报价改变买方尝试不同产品的成本与收益。
papers.noteEn: Repeated purchases teach a buyer about product value. Competing sellers alter the costs and benefits of trying products through their prices.

papers.title: Strategic Experimentation
papers.note: 当多人共同观察试验结果时，每人都能从他人的探索获益；预期未来的共同实验也会改变今天的探索激励。
papers.noteEn: When experiments are publicly observed, agents benefit from others' exploration. Future joint experimentation also affects today's incentives.

papers.title: Strategic Experimentation with Exponential Bandits
papers.authors: Godfrey Keller · Sven Rady · Martin Cripps
papers.note: 风险臂的好消息以随机突破形式到来。在以共同信念为状态的平稳马尔可夫均衡中，搭便车使实验低于效率水平。
papers.noteEn: Good news from the risky arm arrives as a random breakthrough. Free-riding depresses experimentation below the efficient level in stationary Markov equilibria based on common beliefs.

papers.title: Bandit Processes and Dynamic Allocation Indices
papers.note: 对相互独立且未选时状态不变的折现老虎机，各臂可分别计算指数，选择最高指数的臂最优。
papers.noteEn: Independent discounted bandits frozen when unplayed have separate indices. Choosing the largest index is optimal.

papers.title: Optimal Experimentation in a Changing Environment
papers.note: 未知需求会随机切换，卖方必须持续追踪。折现和切换强度决定不同实验区间。
papers.noteEn: Unknown demand switches randomly and requires tracking. Discounting and switching intensities generate different experimentation regimes.

papers.title: Strategic Experimentation with Poisson Bandits
papers.role: 不完全揭示的到达事件
papers.note: 风险臂按取决于状态的泊松强度产生收益，一次到达未必就完全揭示状态。
papers.noteEn: The risky arm pays at a state-dependent Poisson rate. One arrival need not fully reveal the state.

papers.title: Collaborating
papers.note: 团队成员对成败未定的项目投入不可见努力。搭便车既降低努力，也引起拖延。
papers.noteEn: Members supply hidden effort to a project with uncertain success. Free-riding reduces effort and induces procrastination.

papers.title: Strategic Experimentation with Private Payoffs
papers.authors: Paul Heidhues · Sven Rady · Philipp Strack
papers.note: 第一次成功揭示风险臂占优。收益是否公开，会改变均衡实验能持续多久。
papers.noteEn: A first success reveals the risky arm to be superior. Public versus private payoffs affect how long equilibrium experimentation lasts.

papers.title: Recommender Systems as Mechanisms for Social Learning
papers.note: 平台选择向后来用户透露多少信息，使早期尝试者愿意为全体生产有价值的经验。
papers.noteEn: A platform controls what later users learn, managing early users' incentives to experiment for the benefit of others.

papers.title: Implementing the “Wisdom of the Crowd”
papers.authors: Ilan Kremer · Yishay Mansour · Motty Perry
papers.note: 到达者只选择一次行动。规划者利用先前试验产生的信息调整披露，让当前参与者有意愿探索并为后来者积累知识。
papers.noteEn: Each arrival acts only once. The planner conditions disclosure on past trials to induce current exploration that generates information for future participants.

papers.title: Optimal Contracts for Experimentation
papers.authors: Marina Halac · Navin Kartik · Qingmin Liu
papers.role: 实验者的私有能力与学习
papers.note: 研究者的能力是私有的，努力不可见，并会私下了解项目质量。三者共同约束资助人可实施的长期实验方案。
papers.roleEn: The experimenter's private ability and learning
papers.noteEn: Privately known ability, hidden effort and private learning about project quality jointly constrain the long-term experimentation program a sponsor can implement.

papers.title: Overcoming Free-Riding in Bandit Games
papers.authors: Johannes Hörner · Nicolas Klein · Sven Rady
papers.role: 历史依存均衡与有效探索
papers.note: 在含扩散成分的 Lévy 收益模型中，有效的完美贝叶斯均衡存在。只研究马尔可夫策略可能遗漏克服搭便车的均衡。
papers.noteEn: Lévy-bandit payoffs with a diffusion component admit efficient perfect Bayesian equilibria. Restricting attention to Markov strategies can miss equilibria that overcome free-riding.

edges.label: 改变价格形成
edges.note: 从卖方选择价格以学习需求，转向卖方定价以改变买方尝试产品的激励。
edges.noteEn: Move from a seller experimenting with prices to learn demand to sellers pricing in order to influence a buyer's product trials.

edges.label: 改变信息受益人
edges.note: 单人权衡探索与利用；多人环境下，一人的试验还创造可由他人利用的公开信息。
edges.noteEn: A lone decision maker balances exploration and exploitation. With several agents, experimentation also produces information others can use.

edges.label: 改变学习过程
edges.note: 把持续波动的信息流换成到达时间随机的离散突破，重新求解均衡。
edges.noteEn: Replace continuous fluctuations in information by discrete breakthroughs with random arrival times and solve for the resulting equilibria.

edges.label: 给探索价值定序
edges.note: 定价实验说明主动学习的价值，指数法给出可分解老虎机的选择规则。
edges.noteEn: Price experimentation illustrates the value of active learning. An index provides the rule when bandits decompose.

edges.label: 允许真实状态变化
edges.note: 需求变化会使过去数据过时，从而区分识别固定需求与追踪当前状态。
edges.labelEn: Allowing the true state to change
edges.noteEn: Switching makes old data obsolete, distinguishing identification of fixed demand from tracking its present state.

edges.label: 放宽首次突破的揭示力
edges.note: 允许两个状态下都产生收益后，收到支付时信念一般不会跳到确定状态。
edges.labelEn: Relaxing full revelation at a breakthrough
edges.noteEn: If payments can arrive in either state, a payment need not move beliefs to certainty.

edges.label: 让贡献不可见
edges.note: 比较共享实验信息产生的延迟与无法观察他人努力产生的延迟。
edges.noteEn: Compare delay from sharing experimental information with delay when teammates cannot observe each other's effort.

edges.label: 改变谁观察突破
edges.note: 把收益移到个人观察后，他人的行动成为传递实验信息的渠道。
edges.noteEn: When payoffs move into private histories, others' actions become a channel for experimental information.

edges.label: 将学习外部性纳入推荐
edges.note: 不完全披露既会影响当前采纳，也会改变未来用户可用的信息。
edges.noteEn: Partial disclosure changes current adoption and the information eventually available to future users.

edges.label: 把推荐与探索激励联立
edges.note: 两种推荐设计都必须让当前行动者愿意尝试，尽管部分信息收益属于尚未到场的人。
edges.noteEn: Both recommendation designs must induce today's agent to try an action even though part of its informational benefit accrues to future agents.

edges.label: 增加资助人与研究者的合约
edges.note: 团队实验研究成员如何分担投入，这里让委托人借助历史依存的支付组织实验。
edges.noteEn: Team experimentation asks how contributors share effort. Here a principal uses history-dependent rewards to organize experimentation.

edges.label: 放宽共同信念马尔可夫限制
edges.note: 允许行为取决于过去历史，区分信号技术本身的限制与马尔可夫策略的限制。
edges.noteEn: Allowing dependence on past histories distinguishes limits of the signal technology from those of Markov strategies.

branches.questionEn: Experimentation can sacrifice current returns to improve future choices. Who pays for it, and who gets to use the information?
branches.boundaryEn: Actions generate the feedback. Prices change experimentation costs, while others' ability to observe feedback creates opportunities to free-ride.

branches.name: 隐藏行动与团队激励
branches.question: 当努力不可直接订约时，哪些绩效信号、奖金和披露方式能诱导个人或团队投入？
branches.boundary: 单个代理人的风险分担、多任务之间的注意力转移，以及团队成员之间的均衡选择，是三个不同的激励约束。

papers.title: Moral Hazard and Observability
papers.note: 在模型条件下，新信号能否改善合同取决于它在既有产出信息之外是否还含有关于行动的信息。
papers.noteEn: Under the model's assumptions, a new signal can improve a contract when it adds information about the agent's action beyond what output already reveals.

papers.title: Moral Hazard in Teams
papers.note: 共同产出和预算平衡可以妨碍各成员的边际努力激励；可打破预算平衡的委托人提供了一种组织解释。
papers.noteEn: Joint production and budget balance can prevent efficient marginal effort incentives. A principal able to break budget balance helps explain the organization of teams.

papers.title: Multitask Principal–Agent Analyses: Incentive Contracts, Asset Ownership, and Job Design
papers.note: 对可衡量任务增加奖金可能把努力从难衡量任务吸走，因此弱绩效激励可以与最优任务配置一致。
papers.noteEn: Stronger rewards for measurable tasks can draw effort away from poorly measured tasks, making weak performance incentives consistent with optimal task allocation.

papers.title: Incentives and Discrimination
papers.note: 在目标是排除团队协调失败时，按不同顺序为成员提供足够努力激励，可使生产上对称的成员面对不同奖金。
papers.noteEn: When the principal must rule out coordination failure, sequentially securing sufficient effort incentives can require different bonuses for equally productive workers.

papers.title: Rank Uncertainty in Organizations
papers.authors: Marina Halac · Elliot Lipnowski · Daniel Rappoport
papers.note: 私人奖金使成员对激励次序存在不确定性；对称团队可用相同奖金实现唯一的工作均衡，节省公开差别奖金的成本。
papers.noteEn: Private bonuses leave the order of incentives uncertain. Identical bonuses can uniquely implement work in a symmetric team and save the cost of public discrimination.

papers.title: The Optimal Structure of Incentives and Authority Within an Organization
papers.note: 比较能力不可见但业绩可见，以及业绩本身观测不完全的组织，研究支付和权威配置。
papers.noteEn: The models distinguish unobservable ability with observable performance from imperfectly observed performance and study pay and authority.

papers.title: Risk Sharing and Incentives in the Principal and Agent Relationship
papers.note: 比较委托人只见结果与还能观察行动证据时的帕累托最优报酬。
papers.noteEn: The paper compares Pareto-optimal fee schedules with outcome data alone and with additional evidence of the agent's action.

papers.title: An Analysis of the Principal-Agent Problem
papers.authors: Sanford J. Grossman · Oliver D. Hart
papers.note: 效用对行动与报酬可分时，先求实施每个行动的最低成本，再比较行动，可避免把代理人的一阶条件当成充分条件。
papers.noteEn: With separability, find the least cost of inducing each action and then compare actions. This avoids treating the agent's first-order condition as sufficient.

papers.title: Aggregation and Linearity in the Provision of Intertemporal Incentives
papers.note: 在恒定绝对风险厌恶和可反复调整行动的环境中，按累计结果账户线性支付可以最优。
papers.noteEn: With constant absolute risk aversion and repeated action adjustment, linear pay on cumulative performance accounts can be optimal.

papers.title: Incentive Contracts and Performance Measurement
papers.role: 指标与真实目标的偏离
papers.note: 努力影响付薪指标与委托人真实收益的方式可能不同。对指标付重奖会加大这种扭曲。
papers.noteEn: Effort can affect measured performance differently from the principal's true return. Stronger measured incentives can worsen that distortion.

papers.title: Flexible Moral Hazard Problems
papers.authors: George Georgiadis · Doron Ravid · Balázs Szentes
papers.role: 代理人直接选择产出分布
papers.note: 代理人可以在给定紧支集上选择任一产出分布并承担成本。作者在分布空间建立一阶分析，刻画实施指定分布的合约。
papers.noteEn: The agent can choose any output distribution on a given compact support at a cost. A first-order approach on measures characterizes contracts implementing a target distribution.

papers.title: The Tenuous Trade-off between Risk and Incentives
papers.note: 不确定环境可促使委托人把任务选择交给掌握现场信息的代理人，增强对绩效激励的依赖。
papers.noteEn: Uncertainty can prompt delegation to a better-informed agent, increasing reliance on performance incentives.

papers.title: Limited Liability and Incentive Contracting with Ex-Ante Action Choices
papers.note: 借款人先选不可观察的努力。在双方风险中性、有法定责任限制且投资人收入须随利润不减时，标准债务合约最优。
papers.noteEn: A borrower chooses hidden effort ex ante. With risk neutrality, liability limits and a lender payoff nondecreasing in profit, standard debt is optimal.

papers.title: The First-Order Approach to Principal-Agent Problems
papers.note: 单调似然比与产出分布函数关于行动的凸性等条件，能使只检验局部一阶条件的做法在该模型中成立。
papers.roleEn: Sufficient conditions for the first-order approach
papers.noteEn: A monotone likelihood ratio and convexity of the output distribution function in action provide sufficient conditions for the first-order approach in this setting.

papers.title: Career Concerns with Exponential Learning
papers.role: 职业市场中的突破与努力
papers.note: 努力提高有才干者突破的概率，工资随市场对能力的看法变化。不同时间的努力互为替代，均衡努力和工资随资历呈单峰。
papers.noteEn: Effort raises a talented worker's chance of a breakthrough, and wages reflect market assessments. Effort at different dates substitutes, yielding single-peaked effort and wage paths.

edges.label: 从个人到团队
edges.note: 将一个不可观察的行动换成多人的不可观察行动，预算约束与共同产出成为关键。
edges.noteEn: Multiple hidden actions replace a single one. The budget constraint and joint output now play central roles.

edges.label: 从单项到多项任务
edges.note: 绩效指标除揭示投入外，还会引导努力在任务之间重新分配。
edges.noteEn: Besides revealing effort, performance measures redirect effort across tasks.

edges.label: 实施标准对照
edges.note: 团队激励的另一问题是如何排除低努力均衡，生产互补性使激励次序有价值。
edges.noteEn: Team incentives must sometimes rule out low-effort equilibria. Complementary efforts make the order of incentives valuable.

edges.label: 直接改变合同可见性
edges.note: 保留唯一实施目标，允许私下报价，由成员对奖金排序的不确定性改变最优成本与对称性。
edges.noteEn: Retain the goal of unique implementation but allow private offers. Uncertainty about the ranking of bonuses changes both minimum cost and optimal symmetry.

edges.label: 从观察到额外信号
edges.note: 给定绩效信息有限，进一步问哪些新增信号改善激励和保险。
edges.noteEn: Given limited performance observations, ask which extra signals improve incentives and insurance.

edges.label: 同期的风险分担研究
edges.note: 比较不同观察环境中的报酬安排与在给定已有信息后评价额外信号。
edges.noteEn: Compare pay across observation environments with the incremental value of a signal conditional on existing information.

edges.label: 检验完整激励约束
edges.note: 除信号信息量之外，还必须验证代理人不会偏离到任一其他可行行动。
edges.noteEn: Beyond signal informativeness, the agent must prefer the proposed action to every feasible deviation.

edges.label: 从跨期账户到任务组合
edges.note: 先解释线性激励为何最优，再问多项工作间的努力替代如何影响奖金强度。
edges.labelEn: From cumulative accounts to task portfolios
edges.noteEn: The first paper explains linearity. The multitask model examines how effort substitution between activities affects incentive strength.

edges.label: 检验绩效代理变量
edges.note: 多任务之间的转移和指标的偏误都要求比较行动对指标与真实目标的边际影响。
edges.noteEn: Both task substitution and proxy distortion call for comparing marginal effects on the measure and on the actual objective.

edges.label: 扩展行动空间
edges.note: 从用业绩信号推断有限或参数化的努力，转向让整个产出分布成为代理人的选择。
edges.noteEn: Move from performance signals about effort to an environment where the whole output distribution is the agent's choice.

edges.label: 加入任务选择
edges.note: 风险分担的负相关预测要与授权带来的正向激励效应同时考虑。
edges.noteEn: The standard risk-sharing force can be offset when uncertainty changes who selects the task.

edges.label: 限制支付表的形状
edges.note: 从额外信号能否改善激励，转向有限责任与支付单调性如何确定最优证券形状。
edges.noteEn: Move from the value of an additional performance signal to how liability and monotonicity shape optimal securities.

edges.label: 何时可用局部偏离
edges.note: 完整偏离约束通常不能只用一阶条件代替；此文给出这种简化可靠的技术条件。
edges.noteEn: Full incentive constraints cannot generally be replaced by first-order conditions. This paper gives conditions that justify the reduction.

edges.label: 用未来市场工资提供激励
edges.note: 报酬不只由当期的显式合同决定，今天努力留下的信息还会改变未来雇主的估值。
edges.labelEn: Providing incentives through future market wages
edges.noteEn: A current explicit contract is only one source of incentives. Evidence generated by effort also changes future employers' valuations.

resources.title: The Theory of Incentives: The Principal-Agent Model

branches.questionEn: When effort cannot be contracted on directly, which performance signals, bonuses and disclosure policies induce individual or team effort?
branches.boundaryEn: Individual risk sharing, effort substitution across tasks and equilibrium selection within a team create distinct incentive constraints.

branches.name: 不完全合同与产权
branches.question: 哪些难以事先写清的决策应由谁控制？资产所有权为什么会改变事前投资和企业边界？
branches.boundary: 产权模型强调资产控制和事后谈判。参考点模型另引入交易方的应得感及消极履约，属于不同微观基础。

papers.title: The Costs and Benefits of Ownership: A Theory of Vertical and Lateral Integration
papers.authors: Sanford J. Grossman · Oliver D. Hart
papers.note: 不能把所有资产用途预先写进合同时，所有权决定剩余控制权并改变事后谈判地位，进而改变双方事前投资。
papers.noteEn: When not all asset uses are contractible in advance, ownership changes residual control and bargaining positions, thereby changing both parties' ex ante investments.

papers.title: Property Rights and the Nature of the Firm
papers.note: 把所有权结构、联盟可用资产和参与者投资激励放在统一框架中，说明互补资产与关键投资者怎样影响企业边界。
papers.noteEn: Ownership, coalitional access to assets and investment incentives enter a common framework that relates asset complementarities and indispensable investors to firm boundaries.

papers.title: The Proper Scope of Government: Theory and an Application to Prisons
papers.authors: Oliver Hart · Andrei Shleifer · Robert W. Vishny
papers.note: 私有承包人对降低成本有更强激励；成本节约若损害不可订约的服务质量，私有化的收益会下降。
papers.noteEn: Private contractors have stronger cost-cutting incentives. Privatization is less attractive when savings compromise noncontractible service quality.

papers.title: Contracts as Reference Points
papers.note: 合同界定当事人自认有权得到的交易条件；灵活条款让双方能适应状态，也可能因应得感分歧导致消极履约。
papers.noteEn: Contracts shape which terms each party feels entitled to. Flexible terms permit adaptation but can induce shading when entitlements diverge.

papers.title: Vertical Integration, Appropriable Rents, and the Competitive Contracting Process
papers.authors: Benjamin Klein · Robert G. Crawford · Armen A. Alchian
papers.note: 资产一旦投入特定关系，交易方可能攫取专用资产的准租。纵向整合是降低这类缔约成本的一种办法。
papers.noteEn: Once an asset is tied to a relationship, a counterparty can appropriate its quasi-rents. Integration can reduce the resulting contracting costs.

papers.title: The Management of Innovation
papers.note: 研发投入难以写入完整合约时，创新成果归谁会改变研究者和资助方的投入，以及创新发生的概率与规模。
papers.noteEn: When R&D inputs are incompletely contractible, ownership of the innovation affects researcher and financier investments and the frequency and scale of innovation.

papers.title: Incomplete Contracts and Renegotiation
papers.note: 当专用投资之后可重新谈判交易，赋予发送消息的权利也未必能实现双方一阶最优的投资。
papers.noteEn: If trade can be renegotiated after relationship-specific investment, message-contingent rights need not deliver first-best investment by both parties.

papers.title: Unforeseen Contingencies and Incomplete Contracts
papers.role: 可预见后果与不可描述状态
papers.note: 即使状态难以事前描述，在特定承诺与偏好条件下，参与者能预测收益可能仍足以支持最优缔约。
papers.noteEn: Even if states are hard to describe ex ante, the ability to forecast payoffs can suffice for optimal contracting under specific commitment and preference assumptions.

papers.title: Complexity and Renegotiation: A Foundation for Incomplete Contracts
papers.note: 众多未来交易机会中只有一种有效且无法禁止重谈。机会数增加时，消息合约结果趋近于只能事后订约的情形。
papers.noteEn: Only one of many future trades is efficient and renegotiation cannot be ruled out. As opportunities multiply, message contracts approach the outcome with only ex post contracting.

papers.title: Information Gathering, Transaction Costs, and the Property Rights Approach
papers.note: 一方可在再谈判前获取私人信息，产权安排因此不仅影响事前投入，也影响事后谈判效率。
papers.noteEn: A party can acquire private information before renegotiation, so ownership affects both investment and ex post bargaining efficiency.

papers.title: Hold-up, Asset Ownership, and Reference Points
papers.note: 价值或成本异常时，即使已写定价格也会有人要求修改，触发消极履约。资产归属和价格指数化可降低这一风险。
papers.noteEn: Unusual values or costs can trigger demands to depart from a fixed price and induce shading. Ownership and price indexing can curb that risk.

papers.title: Power in a Theory of the Firm
papers.note: 企业可以通过控制谁能使用关键资源来激励专用投资。接入带来的权力更能依赖实际投资，因而有时优于转移所有权。
papers.noteEn: A firm can govern access to critical resources to encourage specific investment. Power from access can be more contingent on investment than power from ownership.

papers.title: Government Versus Private Ownership of Public Goods
papers.note: 双方都关心公共品时，文中不完全合约模型将所有权赋予相对更看重公共收益的一方，即使它并非关键投资者。
papers.noteEn: When both parties value a public good, the model assigns ownership to the party valuing its benefits more, even if that party is not the indispensable investor.

edges.label: 扩展所有权环境
edges.note: 从纵向和横向整合的问题，扩展到多人、多资产时谁能控制哪些资产和联盟活动。
edges.noteEn: Move from vertical and lateral integration to control of assets and coalitional activities with many people and assets.

edges.label: 公共服务应用
edges.note: 以不可订约的质量后果区分提高效率的降本与损害服务的降本，比较公营与私营。
edges.noteEn: The impact on noncontractible quality distinguishes productive cost saving from harmful cuts and informs the public–private comparison.

edges.label: 不完全性的不同机制
edges.note: 早期模型依靠控制权改变投资回报；参考点模型解释合同条款为何会改变事后合作行为。
edges.noteEn: In the early model control rights change investment returns. Reference points explain how contract terms change ex post cooperation.

edges.label: 从准租到资产控制
edges.note: 把关系专用投资带来的事后风险，落实为可分配的剩余控制权及其事前后果。
edges.noteEn: Translate ex post exposure of specific investment into allocable residual control rights and ex ante investment incentives.

edges.label: 改变投资对象
edges.note: 用对尚未发生的创新的权利配置，检验物质资产产权模型的投资逻辑。
edges.noteEn: Rights over a future innovation provide a test of the investment logic developed for physical assets.

edges.label: 把重谈纳入制度比较
edges.note: 除资产归属外，还须问一份事前协议在可预见的重谈下能实施哪些投资。
edges.noteEn: Beyond assigning ownership, one must ask which investments an ex ante agreement can implement in light of anticipated renegotiation.

edges.label: 检验不完全性的假设
edges.note: 对描述成本能否单独解释事前缺约提出检验，明确产权模型依赖哪些缔约限制。
edges.noteEn: Testing whether description costs alone explain missing contracts clarifies which restrictions a property-rights model requires.

edges.label: 用复杂度推导不完全性
edges.note: 把产权分析常用的不完全缔约前提变成一个随交易机会增加而出现的极限。
edges.noteEn: A contracting restriction used in ownership analysis emerges as a limit when possible trades proliferate.

edges.label: 使事后谈判有成本
edges.note: 将有动机的信息获取放入产权模型后，再谈判不再必然恢复有效配置。
edges.labelEn: Making ex post bargaining potentially inefficient
edges.noteEn: Once parties can acquire information strategically, renegotiation need not restore efficiency.

edges.label: 在参考点模型中加入所有权
edges.note: 这里的敲竹杠可以来自收益状态异常，并不要求先有无法订约的专用投资。
edges.labelEn: Introducing ownership into a reference-point model
edges.noteEn: Unusual payoff realizations can generate hold-up even without an initial noncontractible specific investment.

edges.label: 把接入与所有权分开
edges.note: 能够使用关键资产与法律上拥有它是两种权利，可对同一项投资产生不同激励。
edges.noteEn: Using a critical asset and owning it are different rights and can give different incentives for the same investment.

edges.label: 改变公共服务的受益者
edges.note: 对比节约成本损害不可订约质量的渠道与非所有者也享受公共产出的渠道。
edges.noteEn: Compare noncontractible quality losses from cost cutting with the effect of a nonowner benefiting from the public output.

branches.questionEn: Who should control decisions that cannot be specified in advance? Why does asset ownership change investment incentives and firm boundaries?
branches.boundaryEn: Property-rights models emphasize control and ex post bargaining. Reference-point models introduce a separate mechanism through perceived entitlements and shading.

branches.name: 关系合同与自我执行
branches.question: 当工作表现可被双方观察却难以由法院验证时，什么使今天承诺的奖励值得兑现？
branches.boundary: 激励强度受未来合作剩余约束；双方对合作剩余的了解、组织边界及可写入正式合同的信息都可能改变这个约束。

papers.title: The Existence of Self-Enforcing Implicit Contracts
papers.note: 持续交易的价值可以使隐性承诺具有约束力；文中给出简单环境下支持有效交易的自我执行合同。
papers.noteEn: The value of continued trade can make implicit promises binding. The paper gives self-enforcing contracts supporting efficient trade in a simple setting.

papers.title: Subjective Performance Measures in Optimal Incentive Contracts
papers.authors: George Baker · Robert Gibbons · Kevin J. Murphy
papers.note: 可验证指标能写入正式合同，主观评价依赖持续合作；在一定条件下，两类措施相互补充，单独使用都不足以维持有利可图的交易。
papers.noteEn: Verifiable measures support formal contracts, while subjective evaluations rely on continued cooperation. They sometimes complement each other so that neither alone sustains profitable trade.

papers.title: Relational Contracts and the Theory of the Firm
papers.authors: George Baker · Robert Gibbons · Kevin J. Murphy
papers.note: 整合改变一方违背非正式约定时可获得的回报，因此相同的生产关系在企业内外可持续的关系合同不同。
papers.noteEn: Integration changes the payoff to reneging on an informal agreement, making different relational contracts sustainable inside and outside the firm for the same production relationship.

papers.title: Relational Incentive Contracts
papers.note: 通过当期支付承诺与未来剩余之间的动态执行约束，刻画重复委托代理环境中的最优激励合同及其平稳表示。
papers.noteEn: A dynamic enforcement constraint connects promised current payments to future surplus and characterizes optimal incentives and their stationary representation in repeated agency.

papers.title: Relational Contracts and the Value of Relationships
papers.note: 委托人持久的私人外部选择影响她放弃关系的成本，也使观察到的履约行为传递有关关系价值的信息。
papers.noteEn: The principal's persistent private outside option changes the cost of abandoning the relationship. Observed performance of promises therefore conveys information about its value.

papers.title: Implicit Contracts, Incentive Compatibility, and Involuntary Unemployment
papers.authors: W. Bentley MacLeod · James M. Malcomson
papers.note: 业绩不可验证时，可自我执行的劳资交易限制就业关系的剩余分配；空缺和失业可以同时出现。
papers.noteEn: With unverifiable performance, self-enforcing employment contracts restrict surplus division. Vacancies and unemployment can coexist.

papers.title: Optimal Contracting with Subjective Evaluation
papers.note: 业绩由雇主主观评价时，最优报酬比使用可验证指标时更集中；最优激励可以依赖奖金。
papers.noteEn: Subjective evaluation compresses optimal pay relative to verifiable measures. Optimal incentives can rely on bonuses.

papers.title: Relational Incentives and Moral Hazard in Teams
papers.note: 可见努力的程度与未来合作的重要性共同决定利润份额应广泛分散，还是集中于一人。
papers.noteEn: Effort observability and the value of future interaction determine whether profit shares should be dispersed or concentrated in one person.

papers.title: Relational Contracts and the Value of Loyalty
papers.note: 委托人在多个供应商间反复选择时，事后攫取租金使建立新关系形成固定成本，最优安排偏向既有供应商。
papers.noteEn: When a principal repeatedly chooses suppliers, vulnerability to ex post holdup creates a fixed cost of new relationships and favors incumbents.

papers.title: Relational Contracts, Limited Liability, and Employment Dynamics
papers.note: 不可见努力加上有限责任时，最优关系合约比可承诺的长期合约更易终止，存续关系还可能在不同阶段间循环。
papers.noteEn: With hidden effort and limited liability, optimal relational contracts terminate more often than long-term commitment contracts and surviving relationships may cycle.

papers.title: Relational Contracts with Subjective Peer Evaluations
papers.authors: Joyee Deb · Jin Li · Arijit Mukherjee
papers.note: 薪酬依赖公开业绩和同事私下报告。若同一员工既要努力又要评价他人，如实报告与努力激励相互牵制。
papers.noteEn: Pay depends on public performance and privately reported peer evaluations. When each worker both exerts effort and evaluates peers, truth-telling and effort incentives interact.

papers.title: Motivation and Markets
papers.authors: W. Bentley MacLeod & James M. Malcomson
papers.role: 市场条件与主观绩效工资
papers.note: 比较效率工资与主观评定的绩效工资，解释职位空缺成本和合格劳动力供给怎样影响可持续激励。
papers.noteEn: Comparing efficiency wages with subjective performance pay shows how vacancy costs and worker scarcity affect sustainable incentives.

papers.title: Relationship Building: Conflict and Project Choice over Time
papers.note: 当评价主观且信息不对称时，合作可从低风险、低回报项目开始，积累关系资本后再选择更冒险的项目。
papers.noteEn: Under subjective evaluation and asymmetric information, partners may start with low-risk, low-return projects and move to riskier ones as relational capital accumulates.

papers.title: The Allocation of Future Business: Dynamic Relational Contracts with Multiple Agents
papers.note: 每个供应商只看到自己的关系且产出不可订约。企业会按与未来生产率无关的过去业绩分配订单，以使奖励可信。
papers.noteEn: Each supplier observes only its own relationship and output is noncontractible. A firm can condition orders on payoff-irrelevant past performance to make rewards credible.

papers.title: Managing Conflicts in Relational Contracts
papers.note: 管理者私下观察给员工报酬的机会成本；最优关系合约会经历努力和利润逐步下滑、随后突然恢复的冲突期。
papers.noteEn: A manager privately observes the opportunity cost of paying a worker. In the optimal contract, effort and profits can decline gradually during conflict and recover abruptly.

edges.label: 加入可验证绩效
edges.note: 持续关系从维持合作的工具，变成支撑主观奖金的一项资源，并与显性支付共同优化。
edges.noteEn: A continuing relationship supports subjective bonuses, which can be optimized jointly with explicit payments.

edges.label: 加入组织边界
edges.note: 对同一非正式承诺，资产控制权会改变出尔反尔的收益，进而影响它是否可持续。
edges.noteEn: Asset control changes the return to reneging on the same informal promise and hence whether it can be sustained.

edges.label: 从存在到最优
edges.note: 从说明自我执行合同可以存在，转向刻画执行约束下能获得多强的激励。
edges.noteEn: The analysis moves from existence of self-enforcing agreements to the strength of incentives attainable under enforcement constraints.

edges.label: 放松共同知识
edges.note: 让委托人私下知道外部机会，关系的延续同时承担筛选和激励作用。
edges.noteEn: A privately known outside opportunity gives continuation of the relationship both a screening role and an incentive role.

edges.label: 从双边关系到劳动市场
edges.note: 将单个关系中能否兑现承诺的问题嵌入企业与工人的市场均衡。
edges.labelEn: From bilateral relationships to labor markets
edges.noteEn: Embed bilateral enforcement constraints in equilibrium among employers and workers.

edges.label: 改变考核的可验证性
edges.note: 由比较正式与主观指标的组合，转向刻画主观评价对整个薪酬分布的影响。
edges.noteEn: Move from combining formal and subjective measures to tracing subjective evaluation through the pay distribution.

edges.label: 联立份额与履约约束
edges.note: 将双边关系激励扩展到团队，同时选择正式剩余索取权与可自我执行的奖励。
edges.noteEn: Extend bilateral relational incentives to teams and choose formal residual claims together with self-enforcing rewards.

edges.label: 内生选择交易对象
edges.note: 不只比较企业边界内外的履约激励，也让选择哪位伙伴参与交易成为合约的一部分。
edges.noteEn: Alongside enforcement inside and outside firms, the identity of the trading partner becomes part of the arrangement.

edges.label: 增加有限责任约束
edges.note: 双方自我执行之外再限制可施加的惩罚，改变可持续关系的时间路径。
edges.noteEn: Limiting punishments in addition to imposing self-enforcement changes the time path of surviving relationships.

edges.label: 让评价来自同事
edges.note: 把主观考核从雇主与一名员工的关系扩展为多人关系，并显式检验评价者的报告激励。
edges.noteEn: Subjective appraisal becomes a multiperson relationship with explicit reporting incentives for peer evaluators.

edges.label: 引入劳动市场外部机会
edges.note: 主观奖酬能否兑现取决于关系中断的代价，而这一代价随劳动市场改变。
edges.noteEn: The cost of ending the relationship disciplines discretionary pay and depends on labor-market conditions.

edges.label: 让关系决定做哪项交易
edges.note: 关系的继续价值既支撑支付承诺，还能约束当前适合承接哪类项目。
edges.labelEn: Letting the relationship determine the project
edges.noteEn: Continuation value can support promised payments and also limit which projects the parties can undertake today.

edges.label: 区分忠诚与绩效奖励
edges.note: 两者都选择未来伙伴；后者说明即使过去表现没有预测力，也可作为维持努力的奖励。
edges.noteEn: Both models allocate business across partners. Here past performance can reward effort even when it predicts nothing about future productivity.

edges.label: 让支付成本随期私下变化
edges.note: 稳定的自我执行关系加上私有支付成本后，履约争议本身可产生内生波动。
edges.noteEn: Introducing private payment costs into a self-enforcing relationship can make conflict generate endogenous fluctuations.

resources.title: Four formal(izable) theories of the firm?

branches.questionEn: When performance is observable to both parties but hard for a court to verify, why honor the reward promised today?
branches.boundaryEn: Future relationship surplus constrains incentives. Information about that surplus, firm boundaries and verifiable measures can all change the constraint.

branches.name: 授权、沟通与裁量权
branches.question: 谁应作最终决策？如果把决定交给比自己更知情的人，应预先排除哪些行动？
branches.boundary: 区分正式控制权、实际掌握的信息，以及可由承诺限制的行动集合。

papers.title: Formal and Real Authority in Organizations
papers.note: 正式拥有最终决定权的一方未必掌握采取行动所需的信息；给予下属更多实权会增强主动性并减少上级控制。
papers.noteEn: The party with the formal right to decide may lack the information to act. More real authority for subordinates increases initiative at the cost of managerial control.

papers.title: Authority and Communication in Organizations
papers.note: 当下属比上级掌握更多信息但有偏向时，把决策权交给下属可以避免咨询过程中策略性压缩信息的损失。
papers.noteEn: When a better-informed subordinate is biased, delegating the decision can avoid the strategic loss of information under consultation.

papers.title: Optimal Delegation
papers.note: 当合约能限制知情代理人的可选行动时，委托人可直接选择授权集合，论文刻画最优集合以及裁量范围的变化。
papers.noteEn: When contracts can restrict a privately informed agent's actions, the principal chooses the delegation set directly. The paper characterizes optimal sets and variation in discretion.

papers.title: The Theory of Optimal Delegation With an Application to Tariff Caps
papers.note: 在一般授权框架中给出区间配置最优的条件，并据此判断私人知情的政府何时应受关税上限制约。
papers.noteEn: The authors provide conditions for interval delegation to be optimal and use them to study tariff caps for a privately informed government.

papers.title: Delegating Multiple Decisions
papers.note: 多项决策联合授权时，可在各项行动的加权平均上设限；在恒定偏向等条件下，这类上限可精确最优。
papers.noteEn: When decisions are delegated together the principal can cap their weighted average. Such caps can be exactly optimal under conditions including constant bias.

papers.title: Communication in Settings with No Transfers
papers.note: 不能用金钱购买消息时，决策者能否事前承诺决策规则会改变信息传递；分歧足够大时最优规则可不连续。
papers.noteEn: Without transfers, commitment to a decision rule changes communication. Sufficient disagreement can make the optimal rule discontinuous.

papers.title: Transferable Control
papers.authors: Philippe Aghion · Mathias Dewatripont · Patrick Rey
papers.role: 可移交但不可承诺的控制权
papers.note: 委托人可以事后把控制权交给代理人，却不能预先承诺移交。行权所需的信息不可订约，为这种区别提供微观基础。
papers.noteEn: A principal can transfer control but cannot commit beforehand to doing so. Noncontractible information required to exercise authority helps explain this distinction.

papers.title: A Model of Delegated Project Choice
papers.note: 委托人能核验被选项目，却不知道代理人还有哪些项目可用，因此通过规定可接受项目集合引导选择。
papers.noteEn: The principal can verify the chosen project but does not know what alternatives existed. An acceptance set guides the agent's choice.

papers.title: Delegation and Nonmonetary Incentives
papers.note: 委托人可以让代理人为特定选择承担无转移价值的成本，在某些环境里这种成本是最优合约的一部分。
papers.noteEn: A principal can impose deadweight costs on particular choices. Such money burning can be part of the optimal contract.

papers.title: The Economics of Clear Advice and Extreme Options
papers.note: 信息不足时代理人倾向选择折中方案；排除或惩罚中间选项可以提高事前搜集信息的动力。
papers.noteEn: When information is poor the agent favors compromise. Removing or penalizing intermediate choices can raise incentives to acquire information.

papers.title: Stochastic Mechanisms in Settings without Monetary Transfers: The Regular Case
papers.note: 允许随机机制后，在二次收益与特定正则条件下，最优机制仍是确定性的。
papers.noteEn: Even with randomization available, deterministic delegation is optimal under quadratic payoffs and the paper's regularity condition.

papers.title: Veto-Based Delegation
papers.note: 在私人信息且无货币转移的模型中，适当选择默认决策，再保留否决权，就足以实施最优结果。
papers.noteEn: In a private-information model without transfers, veto-based delegation with an appropriate default decision can implement an optimal outcome.

papers.title: Benefiting from Bias: Delegating to Encourage Information Acquisition
papers.note: 代理人须先付费了解状态。最优集合可在事前最偏好的决策附近留出缺口；在一定获取成本下，委托人甚至偏好略有偏向的代理人。
papers.noteEn: The agent must pay to learn the state. A gap near the favorite ex ante action can foster learning, and under some information costs the principal prefers a mildly biased agent.

papers.title: Slackers and Zealots: Civil Service, Policy Discretion, and Bureaucratic Expertise
papers.note: 公务员是否重视政策本身会影响其积累专门知识的动机。文中联立研究任用制度、裁量权和专业人才的自我选择。
papers.noteEn: Whether officials care intrinsically about policy affects investment in specialized knowledge. The model links personnel rules, discretion and selection of policy-motivated officials.

edges.label: 权威的两种信息渠道
edges.note: 前文强调控制权改变信息获取意愿，后文研究信息已分散时咨询与授权怎样利用已有信息。
edges.noteEn: The first model makes control affect incentives to acquire information. The second asks how consultation and delegation use information that is already dispersed.

edges.label: 扩充可选制度
edges.note: 将保留或授出决定权进一步细化为可行行动子集的选择。
edges.noteEn: A binary decision to retain or delegate authority becomes a choice over subsets of feasible actions.

edges.label: 区间规则与应用
edges.note: 刻画更一般偏好与分布下区间最优的条件，并将其用于贸易协定。
edges.noteEn: More general preferences and distributions yield conditions for interval optimality and an application to trade agreements.

edges.label: 从单项到多项决定
edges.note: 单项上限推广为对一组决策的加权总量约束，各项选择能够相互抵偿。
edges.noteEn: A single cap becomes a weighted aggregate constraint under which choices can offset one another.

edges.label: 由沟通规则到授权集
edges.note: 用限制可选行动来表达决策者预先承诺如何响应私人信息。
edges.labelEn: From communication rules to delegation sets
edges.noteEn: Restricting the action set expresses a commitment about how private information translates into decisions.

edges.label: 让移交本身受限
edges.note: 形式权威与实际权威的区分，进一步导出无法事先承诺授权的契约环境。
edges.noteEn: The formal–real authority distinction motivates a setting where delegation cannot be promised in advance.

edges.label: 让可用项目不确定
edges.note: 一般授权集合之外，再区分规则允许的项目与代理人实际能找到的项目。
edges.noteEn: Distinguish projects permitted by the delegation rule from projects the agent actually finds.

edges.label: 扩大授权工具
edges.note: 除准许或禁止某个行动外，还可按选择附加成本以改变代理人的偏好排序。
edges.noteEn: Beyond permitting or prohibiting actions, attach costs that change the agent's ranking of alternatives.

edges.label: 区分知情与获取信息
edges.note: 若代理人的知识须先付费取得，限制裁量还会改变收集信息的意愿。
edges.noteEn: When information must first be acquired, restricting discretion changes the incentive to acquire it.

edges.label: 检验扩大机制空间是否有益
edges.note: 确定性授权的最优性需要经受随机替代方案的比较，正则条件说明何时能保留结论。
edges.labelEn: Testing the value of a larger mechanism space
edges.noteEn: Comparing deterministic authority with randomized alternatives identifies conditions preserving its optimality.

edges.label: 把授权集合落实为制度
edges.note: 集合形式的授权还可追问实施需要哪些正式权力，尤其是默认选项与否决权。
edges.noteEn: A delegation-set characterization leaves open which formal powers implement it, including the choice of default and a veto.

edges.label: 让偏向同时影响获取动机
edges.note: 限制中间选项原本用于鼓励调查；进一步问双方偏好差距能否降低激励调查的代价。
edges.noteEn: Excluding intermediate options can encourage investigation. A preference gap can also make that incentive less costly for the principal.

edges.label: 由单次主动性到职业选择
edges.note: 赋权可鼓励下属获取信息，还会改变什么类型的人愿意留在组织并积累专长。
edges.noteEn: Authority affects information acquisition and also which employees stay and invest in relationship-specific expertise.

resources.title: Four formal(izable) theories of the firm?

branches.questionEn: Who should decide? When authority goes to a better-informed agent, which actions should be ruled out in advance?
branches.boundaryEn: Distinguish formal control, the information needed to exercise it and the set of feasible actions that commitment can restrict.

branches.name: 长期合约、承诺效用与动态保险
branches.question: 今天报出的收入或观察到的业绩，怎样改变代理人以后能得到的消费与报酬？
branches.boundary: 研究可承诺的跨期合约。持续履约靠未来合作收益维持时，可参见关系合同分支。

papers.title: On Repeated Moral Hazard with Discounting
papers.note: 在双方贴现的无限期道德风险模型中，给代理人的条件期望贴现效用足以作为状态变量，最优合约因此有平稳的递归表示。
papers.noteEn: In infinite-horizon moral hazard with discounting by both parties, the agent's conditional expected discounted utility is a sufficient state variable for a stationary recursive representation.

papers.title: Income Fluctuation and Asymmetric Information: An Example of a Repeated Principal-Agent Problem
papers.note: 借款人私下观察收入。长期合约用未来消费保障换取如实报告；在无限期且可依法执行的模型中，借款人的效用几乎必然会降到任一给定下界以下。
papers.noteEn: The borrower privately observes income. Long-term contracts trade future consumption insurance for truthful reports. With an infinite horizon and enforceability, borrower utility almost surely falls below any given lower bound.

papers.title: On Efficient Distribution With Private Information
papers.authors: Andrew Atkeson · Robert E. Lucas, Jr.
papers.role: 从个人承诺到消费分布
papers.note: 给定私人偏好冲击，递归求解资源可行且激励相容的有效配置；文中例子里，越来越少的人得到越来越多的总资源。
papers.noteEn: With private taste shocks, recursion characterizes resource-feasible, incentive-compatible efficient allocations. In the examples a shrinking share of people receives a growing share of resources.
papers.roleEn: From individual promises to consumption distributions

papers.title: Optimal Security Design and Dynamic Capital Structure in a Continuous-Time Agency Model
papers.role: 把激励合约落实为证券
papers.note: 最优动态融资合约可由信用额度、长期债务和股权共同实施。代理人掌握支付决策，杠杆随历史盈利变化。
papers.noteEn: A credit line, long-term debt and equity can implement the optimal dynamic financing contract. The agent controls payouts and leverage varies with past profitability.

papers.title: A Continuous-Time Version of the Principal-Agent Problem
papers.note: 不可观察的努力决定产出扩散过程的漂移率。以延续效用为状态求解微分方程，产出的路径决定何时达到离职或调整岗位的边界。
papers.noteEn: Unobservable effort determines the drift of output. A differential equation uses continuation utility as its state, and the output path determines when exit or a change of position occurs.

papers.title: Optimal Multiperiod Contracts and the Gain from Enduring Relationships under Private Information
papers.note: 私人信息使跨期绑定有助于缓和激励问题；即使两期合同也可优于逐期交易。
papers.noteEn: Private information makes intertemporal links useful for incentives. Even a two-period contract can dominate successive one-period trades.

papers.title: Repeated Moral Hazard
papers.note: 最优支付依赖过去表现；如果允许代理人暗中储蓄，原合约中逐期分配的激励可能不能实施。
papers.noteEn: Optimal pay retains memory of performance. Allowing hidden saving can prevent implementation of the prescribed intertemporal allocation.

papers.title: Computing Multi-Period, Information-Constrained Optima
papers.note: 在不可观察努力的经济中计算多期配置，展示横截面上和同一人随时间的消费与劳动差异。
papers.noteEn: The authors compute multiperiod allocations with hidden effort, displaying variation in consumption and work both across people and over individual histories.

papers.title: Optimal Unemployment Insurance, with Human Capital Depreciation, and Duration Dependence
papers.role: 人力资本折旧与保障下限
papers.note: 若失业中人力资本迅速折旧，最优失业保险可内生形成最低救助水平，并可用再就业后的历史依存工资税调节激励。
papers.noteEn: Rapid depreciation during unemployment can yield an endogenous minimum benefit. History-dependent taxes after reemployment can also shape incentives.

papers.title: Inequality and Social Discounting
papers.role: 社会贴现与长期不平等
papers.note: 有私人偏好冲击的代际经济中，把后代福利直接列入社会目标，会改变长期消费分布和贫困化结论。
papers.noteEn: In an intergenerational economy with private taste shocks, including later generations directly in the social objective changes long-run inequality and immiseration.

papers.title: Dynamic Security Design: Convergence to Continuous Time and Asset Pricing Implications
papers.authors: Bruno Biais, Thomas Mariotti, Guillaume Plantin & Jean-Charles Rochet
papers.role: 由离散合同到连续时间
papers.note: 证明离散时间动态合同在细化期间时收敛，并研究这种证券设计对资产定价的含义。
papers.roleEn: From discrete contracts to continuous time
papers.noteEn: Shows convergence of discrete-time dynamic contracts as periods shrink and studies asset-pricing implications.

papers.title: A Recursive Formulation for Repeated Agency with History Dependence
papers.role: 持续私人信息的递归约束
papers.note: 各期私有变量相关时，递归表示除维持承诺和当期激励外，还要维持偏离者所面对的延续威胁。
papers.noteEn: When privately observed variables are linked over time, recursion requires threat keeping in addition to temporary incentives and promise keeping.

papers.title: International Lending with Moral Hazard and Risk of Repudiation
papers.note: 贷款人看不到借款国将资金投资还是消费，借款国还可以拒付。在双重约束下，最差产出时也可能要求资本净流出。
papers.noteEn: Lenders cannot see whether a country invests or consumes borrowed funds, and the country can repudiate. Under both constraints, the worst output can call for a net capital outflow.

papers.title: Optimal Long-Term Financial Contracting
papers.authors: Peter M. DeMarzo · Michael J. Fishman
papers.note: 管理者可挪用现金流时，最优长期安排可由长期债、信用额度与股权实施，并内生决定信用上限和派息。
papers.noteEn: With cash diversion, long-term debt, a credit line and equity can implement an optimal long-term arrangement and generate credit limits and payout policy.

edges.label: 隐藏行动与私人收入
edges.note: 两种动态激励问题分别约束努力和收入报告。后者让消费保险及其跨期代价成为分析对象。
edges.noteEn: The two dynamic incentive problems constrain effort and income reports respectively. The latter puts consumption insurance and its intertemporal cost at center stage.

edges.label: 个体保险与分配
edges.note: 把风险约束放入有许多私有冲击的消费者的交换经济，加入总资源约束后可追踪全体消费分布。
edges.noteEn: Private shocks enter a many-consumer exchange economy. An aggregate resource constraint makes it possible to track the entire consumption distribution.

edges.label: 把承诺效用带入连续时间
edges.note: 离散期的承诺状态在产出连续到达时成为随机过程，可用微分方程刻画最优合约。
edges.noteEn: With continuous output, a discrete-time promise becomes a stochastic process and a differential equation characterizes the optimal contract.

edges.label: 连续时间代理的两个问题
edges.note: 融资模型问证券如何实施激励，后一模型让风险厌恶的代理人连续消费，考察努力、工资以及职业边界。
edges.noteEn: One model asks which securities implement incentives. The other lets a risk-averse agent consume continuously and studies effort, pay and employment thresholds.

edges.label: 从跨期绑定到无限期保险
edges.note: 将长期关系的潜在收益具体化为私人收入冲击下的消费路径与报告激励。
edges.labelEn: From intertemporal links to indefinite insurance
edges.noteEn: The private-income model turns gains from an enduring relationship into consumption paths and reporting incentives.

edges.label: 压缩必要的历史信息
edges.note: 先说明历史影响最优支付，再用承诺效用表示那些影响延续合约的历史。
edges.noteEn: First establish that the past matters for pay, then summarize the relevant history by promised utility.

edges.label: 从状态表示到数值配置
edges.note: 把延续承诺下的激励和可行性写成可计算问题，得到整个人口的配置。
edges.labelEn: From state representation to computed allocations
edges.noteEn: Computational incentive and feasibility constraints under continuation promises yield population-wide allocations.

edges.label: 加入就业能力的状态
edges.note: 失业保险除了承诺效用还须跟踪未来就业能力，最优给付因此随失业经历变化。
edges.noteEn: Unemployment insurance must track future employability as well as promised utility, making optimal benefits depend on unemployment history.

edges.label: 改变跨代福利权重
edges.note: 保留私人冲击和跨期激励，改变对未来世代的权重以检验贫困化是否稳健。
edges.noteEn: Hold private shocks and dynamic incentives fixed and vary future generations' welfare weights to test immiseration.

edges.label: 检验时间近似
edges.note: 承诺效用递推可以随期间长度一起取极限，使连续时间合同与离散合约可比。
edges.noteEn: Taking a limit of promised-utility recursions connects continuous-time solutions to their discrete contract counterparts.

edges.label: 区分诚实者与偏离者的延续值
edges.note: 私有历史会影响未来偏离收益，只跟踪诚实报告者的承诺不能给出全部激励约束。
edges.labelEn: Separating truthful and deviating continuation values
edges.noteEn: Private histories affect future deviation payoffs. Tracking the truthful agent's promise alone does not capture all incentives.

edges.label: 在保险外加入债务执行
edges.note: 从可执行合约下的私人收入扩展到私人投资用途和主权退出，低产出时的最优资金方向随之变化。
edges.noteEn: Moving from enforceable private-income insurance to hidden investment and sovereign exit changes optimal flows following low output.

edges.label: 对照两种时间结构
edges.note: 在离散期现金流模型中检验连续时间融资模型所强调的信用额度、债务和股权组合。
edges.noteEn: A discrete-time cash-flow model gives a counterpart to the continuous-time implementation through a credit line, debt and equity.

resources.title: Contracts: The Theory of Dynamic Principal–Agent Relationships and the Continuous-Time Approach

branches.questionEn: How do reported income and observed performance today affect the consumption and pay an agent can receive in the future?
branches.boundaryEn: These models study commitment to intertemporal contracts. See relational contracts when future cooperative surplus sustains compliance.

branches.name: 信息处理、层级与企业内协调
branches.question: 问题由谁处理，遇到难题向哪一级求助？分部还要相互配合时，谁掌握本地信息会怎样影响组织设计？
branches.boundary: 核心对象是多人之间的信息流、知识分工和协调成本。单一代理人的裁量范围另见授权分支。

papers.title: The Organization of Decentralized Information Processing
papers.note: 经理处理信息的速度有限。以所需人数和决策延迟衡量组织效率，分别刻画单次任务和反复任务中的有效网络。
papers.noteEn: Managers process information at finite speed. Staffing needs and decision latency characterize efficient networks for one-off and repeated tasks.

papers.title: The Firm as a Communication Network
papers.note: 吸收他人送来的信息耗时，集中处理同类信息可以节省时间。专业化的好处与传递成本共同决定由谁承担任务、何时增设下属。
papers.noteEn: Absorbing others' information takes time, while repeated processing of similar information saves time. Specialization gains and communication costs determine task assignments and when to add subordinates.
papers.roleEn: Learning costs and division of information work

papers.title: Hierarchies and the Organization of Knowledge in Production
papers.note: 把问题送到知道答案的人手中需要成本。生产者学习常见问题，专门的解题者处理较少出现的问题，由此形成知识层级。
papers.noteEn: Routing problems to someone who knows the solution is costly. Production workers learn common problems and specialists solve rarer ones, generating a knowledge hierarchy.

papers.title: On the Design of Hierarchies: Coordination versus Specialization
papers.note: 多人的资产用途想法可能冲突。模型让有想法的最高级成员决定，刻画协调者何时应高于专家，以及何时应形成金字塔层级。
papers.noteEn: Ideas about asset use can conflict. The most senior person with an idea decides, which helps characterize when coordinators outrank specialists and pyramid hierarchies emerge.
papers.roleEn: Coordinators in the chain of command

papers.title: When Does Coordination Require Centralization?
papers.authors: Ricardo Alonso · Wouter Dessein · Niko Matouschek
papers.note: 分部决策既要适应本地条件也要彼此协调。协调需要增强时，横向信息传递改善、纵向汇报恶化，分权仍可能占优。
papers.noteEn: Divisions must adapt to local conditions and coordinate with one another. A greater need for coordination improves horizontal communication but worsens vertical reporting, so decentralization may still dominate.

papers.title: Optimal Contracting and the Organization of Knowledge
papers.authors: William Fuchs · Luis Garicano · Luis Rayo
papers.note: 求教者的问题难度和顾问的知识都难以判断，现货咨询市场存在逆向选择。模型中的事前合约把剩余索取权给顾问，并用激励合约补偿生产者，实现有效配置。
papers.noteEn: Both problem difficulty and consultant expertise are hard to verify, creating adverse selection in spot advice markets. Ex ante contracts give consultants residual claims and reward producers through incentive contracts, implementing efficiency.

papers.title: A Theory of Hierarchies Based on Limited Managerial Attention
papers.note: 即使经理目标一致，他们仍须选择关注什么；有限注意力和理解消息的能力约束组织协调。
papers.noteEn: Even with aligned objectives, managers must choose what to attend to. Limited attention and message comprehension constrain coordination.

papers.title: Language and the Theory of the Firm
papers.authors: Jacques Crémer · Luis Garicano · Andrea Prat
papers.note: 有效编码给常见事件更精确的词语。共用语言有利跨部门协作，但损失部门内部的表达效率。
papers.noteEn: Efficient codes describe frequent events precisely. A common language aids cross-unit cooperation but reduces within-unit communication efficiency.

papers.title: Organization and Inequality in a Knowledge Economy
papers.role: 知识层级中的工资分布
papers.note: 异质技能者选择学习内容并在层级中匹配。知识能服务更大团队，使高技能者有更强的获取知识激励。
papers.noteEn: Workers choose knowledge and sort into hierarchies. The ability to serve large teams increases incentives for high-skilled people to acquire knowledge.

papers.title: Adaptive Organizations
papers.note: 员工能按本地信息调整行动时，需要更多协调。改善通信可能促使企业变得更灵活，同时减少专业化。
papers.noteEn: Local adaptation requires coordination. Better communication can make a firm more adaptive while reducing specialization.

papers.title: Organizing for Synergies
papers.authors: Wouter Dessein · Luis Garicano · Robert Gertner
papers.note: 职能经理过度重视标准化，事业部经理过度重视本地适应；任务划分和权力配置共同影响协同收益。
papers.noteEn: Functional managers favor excessive standardization, while division managers favor local adaptation. Task and authority allocation jointly determine synergies.

papers.title: The Impact of Trade on Organization and Productivity
papers.note: 企业面对不同需求时选择管理层数、知识分配与控制幅度，改变市场规模便可能改变生产率。
papers.noteEn: Firms choose layers, knowledge assignments, and spans of control in response to demand, linking market size to productivity.

papers.title: The Architecture of Economic Systems: Hierarchies and Polyarchies
papers.authors: Raaj Kumar Sah · Joseph E. Stiglitz
papers.note: 多个筛选者都可能出错。项目须逐层获准还是任一部门可放行，会以不同方式交换错批和错拒的概率。
papers.noteEn: Fallible evaluators generate different false-acceptance and false-rejection rates when a project requires successive approvals or can pass through any of several units.

papers.title: Incentives and Loss of Control in an Optimal Hierarchy
papers.note: 层级中工人与经理的努力、薪酬、管理跨度和层数同时决定。组织扩张可以使高层更努力、基层努力下降。
papers.roleEn: Effort, span and number of tiers
papers.noteEn: Effort, pay, span of control and tier count are jointly determined. Expansion can increase top managers' effort while reducing workers' effort.

papers.title: A Theory of Firm Scope
papers.role: 整合、标准化与消极履约
papers.note: 分立企业在一方受损时可能无法采用共同标准。合并使协调外部性内部化，却可能低估员工的私人收益。
papers.noteEn: Independent firms may fail to adopt a common standard that hurts one of them. Integration internalizes the coordination externality but can underweight employee benefits.

edges.label: 处理容量与专业化
edges.note: 前者以人数和延迟评价信息网络，后者加入吸收信息的时间和专业化回报，以解释企业内任务分工。
edges.noteEn: The first model evaluates networks by staffing and delay. The second adds information absorption costs and specialization gains to explain task assignment within firms.

edges.label: 从信息种类到问题难度
edges.note: 信息传递的成本仍然重要，知识层级模型让成员预先选择学习哪些问题，例外任务再向上转交。
edges.noteEn: Communication remains costly. In knowledge hierarchies, agents choose in advance which problems to learn, and pass exceptional cases upward.

edges.label: 将知识分工写进合约
edges.note: 问题向专家集中后，进一步追问如何克服咨询前难以核实问题难度与专家能力的逆向选择。
edges.noteEn: Once difficult cases flow to experts, the next question is how to overcome adverse selection in the difficulty of questions and the expertise of advisers.

edges.label: 两种层级依据
edges.note: 知识层级按解题能力分工；命令链模型按提出相冲突想法时的决定权排序，以研究协调与专业化。
edges.noteEn: Knowledge hierarchies assign tasks by problem-solving capacity. Chains of command rank decision rights when ideas conflict, trading off coordination and specialization.

edges.label: 引入策略性汇报
edges.note: 命令链以职级解决冲突，多分部模型进一步区分横向与纵向沟通，比较本地适应和跨部协调。
edges.noteEn: Rank resolves conflicts in a chain of command. A multidivisional firm distinguishes vertical and horizontal communication to compare adaptation with coordination.

edges.label: 区分注意力与处理速度
edges.note: 注意力分配与处理信息所需时间是不同的组织约束，可以分别产生层级。
edges.noteEn: Allocating attention and processing information in time are distinct constraints that can each generate hierarchical organization.

edges.label: 让编码系统内生
edges.note: 信息传递成本不再仅取决于谁向谁发送消息，也取决于各单位是否使用相同的语言。
edges.noteEn: Communication costs depend on the codes used across units as well as who sends a message to whom.

edges.label: 从企业结构到个人收入
edges.note: 把单一知识层级嵌入市场均衡，同时决定学习、岗位分配和工资。
edges.noteEn: Embed a knowledge hierarchy in equilibrium to determine learning, job assignments and earnings jointly.

edges.label: 区分协调的工具
edges.note: 一文通过专业化与行动计划协调，另一文比较分权、集权及横向和纵向信息传递。
edges.noteEn: One model coordinates through specialization and action plans, the other through decision rights and vertical or horizontal messages.

edges.label: 内生组织中利益冲突
edges.note: 跨部门协调问题进一步变成职能与事业部如何分工，以及分工如何造就管理者偏向。
edges.noteEn: Coordination now depends on the division of tasks between functions and business units and the biases that division creates.

edges.label: 从企业内知识到贸易
edges.note: 贸易扩大需求带来的生产率变化可以经由企业重新组织发生。
edges.noteEn: Trade-driven demand changes can affect productivity by inducing firms to reorganize.

edges.label: 把层级理解为筛选规则
edges.note: 串联或并联评审决定项目能否通过；命令链模型则用职级解决竞争性构想间的冲突。
edges.noteEn: Serial or parallel review determines whether a proposal passes. A chain of command instead ranks competing ideas by authority.

edges.label: 把管理努力内生化
edges.note: 信息处理层级重视人数与延迟，激励层级则同时解释何以规模扩大伴随控制损失和工资分化。
edges.noteEn: Information-processing models emphasize staffing and delay. Incentive hierarchies also explain how expansion affects control and wage dispersion.

edges.label: 比较协调与企业范围
edges.note: 决策权影响协调，还可通过并入同一企业改变哪些收益被纳入决策及谁会消极履约。
edges.noteEn: Decision rights shape coordination, while integration changes whose benefits enter decisions and who may shade performance.

resources.title: Knowledge-Based Hierarchies: Using Organizations to Understand the Economy

branches.questionEn: Who handles a problem, and where should difficult cases go? When divisions must coordinate, how does local knowledge shape organizational design?
branches.boundaryEn: The focus is on information flows among people, specialization in knowledge and coordination costs. The delegation branch treats one agent's scope for discretion.

branches.name: 消费者数据、市场分割与个性化定价
branches.en: Consumer data, segmentation and personalized pricing
branches.question: 商家知道更多之后，谁付得更少？消费者能控制披露、数据能预测其他人时，利润与福利如何变化？
branches.boundary: 这里的价格依商家获得的消费者信息而变；同一菜单下买方自行挑选产品的激励约束另见多维筛选。

papers.title: Conditioning Prices on Purchase History
papers.note: 理性消费者会预判购买将如何影响未来价格。在估值固定且垄断者可承诺的基准中，按历史区别定价没有利润优势；改变承诺或增添老客服务会改变结论。
papers.noteEn: Forward-looking buyers account for the effect of a purchase on future prices. With fixed valuations and a monopolist able to commit, conditioning prices on history adds no profit. Commitment changes or extra services for incumbents can reverse this result.

papers.title: The Limits of Price Discrimination
papers.authors: Dirk Bergemann · Benjamin Brooks · Stephen Morris
papers.note: 遍历垄断者可能获得的买家信息，刻画能实现的消费者与生产者剩余组合：消费者剩余非负、利润至少为统一定价利润、总剩余至多为有效交易剩余。
papers.noteEn: Varying seller information characterizes feasible consumer and producer surplus. Consumer surplus is nonnegative, profit is at least uniform-price profit and total surplus cannot exceed efficient trade.

papers.title: Online Privacy and Information Disclosure by Consumers
papers.note: 消费者披露偏好既可换来更准确的商品推荐，也会影响价格。商家愿意承诺不将数据用于定价以鼓励披露，但这项承诺反而可能损害消费者。
papers.noteEn: Preference disclosure improves recommendations but also affects pricing. Sellers may commit to keeping prices independent of the data to encourage disclosure, which can nevertheless harm consumers.
papers.roleEn: Using data for recommendations and prices

papers.title: The Economics of Social Data
papers.authors: Dirk Bergemann · Alessandro Bonatti · Tan Gan
papers.note: 一位消费者的信号也预测其他人的行为，这种外部性可以降低中介收集数据的成本，并改变按个人身份出售数据的收益。
papers.noteEn: One consumer's signals can predict other consumers' behavior. This can lower an intermediary's data acquisition cost and change the return to selling information tied to identities.

papers.title: Voluntary Disclosure and Personalized Pricing
papers.authors: S. Nageeb Ali · Greg Lewis · Shoshana Vasserman
papers.note: 可验证的自愿披露可以强化卖方竞争，也能诱使垄断者降价。垄断市场上，必须能部分披露，消费者才可能因控制自身数据而获益。
papers.noteEn: Voluntary verifiable disclosure can intensify competition and induce even a monopolist to lower prices. Against a monopolist, consumers need partial disclosure to gain from control over their data.

papers.title: Price Discrimination and Social Welfare
papers.note: 给定市场分组时，三级价格歧视若要提高总剩余，必须满足产量扩张一类的必要条件。
papers.roleEn: An output test for discriminatory pricing
papers.noteEn: For given market segments, welfare gains from third-degree discrimination require an appropriate expansion in output under the stated demand and cost conditions.

papers.title: Customer Poaching and Brand Switching
papers.role: 按购买记录争夺对手顾客
papers.note: 双寡头能给对手老客户特殊优惠。偏好固定且仅能签短约时，均衡中的品牌转换可以损失社会福利。
papers.noteEn: Duopolists can target rivals' customers. With persistent tastes and short contracts, equilibrium switching can be socially inefficient.

papers.title: Consumer Privacy and the Market for Customer Information
papers.note: 在电子零售模型里，客户数据的价值来自个性化定价。允许第一家商家卖出名单会改变顾客的跨期购买激励。
papers.noteEn: In online retail, customer lists are valuable for personalized prices. Permitting a first seller to resell its list changes buyers' intertemporal incentives.

papers.title: On the Optimality of Privacy in Sequential Contracting
papers.note: 同一代理人与两位委托人相继缔约。在上游无下游交易利益、估值正相关及下游偏好可分时，上游提供完全隐私最优。
papers.noteEn: One agent contracts with two principals in sequence. Full privacy is optimal under no upstream stake in downstream trade, positive value correlation and downstream separability.

papers.title: Selling Cookies
papers.note: 数据商为关于个人特征的查询定价，广告主依据匹配价值决定是否购入信息以及如何投放。
papers.noteEn: A data provider prices queries about individuals. Advertisers decide what to buy and how to target spending based on match values.

papers.title: Too Much Data: Prices and Inefficiencies in Data Markets
papers.authors: Daron Acemoglu · Ali Makhdoumi · Azarakhsh Malekian · Asu Ozdaglar
papers.note: 他人已经泄露自己的信息时，个人不再愿花高代价保护隐私。关联性压低数据价格，可能导致过度分享，平台竞争也未必纠正。
papers.noteEn: When others leak a person's information, that person has less reason to protect it. Correlation depresses data prices and can induce excessive sharing that platform competition need not correct.

papers.title: Consumer Scores and Price Discrimination
papers.note: 多家企业用过去购买的统计评分定价，前瞻消费者会压低当前需求以影响未来评分。
papers.noteEn: Successive firms price from purchase-based scores, giving a forward-looking consumer reasons to shade demand and manipulate the score.

papers.title: The Limits of Multiproduct Price Discrimination
papers.note: 对多产品卖方，额外信息未必能同时实现有效配置并把全部增量剩余给消费者。论文刻画该基准何时可达。
papers.noteEn: With multiple products, information need not achieve efficiency while giving consumers the entire surplus gain. The paper characterizes when this benchmark is attainable.

papers.title: Competing Data Intermediaries
papers.note: 若多个中介都高价收集同一人的资料，从各家购买的下游价值会下降。因此中介竞争未必大幅提高消费者补偿。
papers.noteEn: If multiple intermediaries pay high compensation, consumers share the same data with several of them, lowering downstream value. Competition may only modestly benefit consumers.

papers.title: Screening and Segmenting: A Consumer Surplus Perspective
papers.authors: Dirk Bergemann · Tibor Heumann · Michael C. Wang
papers.note: 垄断者按细分市场同时选择价格与质量。在消费者最优的分割下，价值相同的消费者跨组得到相同质量，价格仍可不同。
papers.noteEn: A monopolist tailors both quality and price across segments. At a consumer-optimal segmentation equal-value buyers receive the same quality across segments even when prices differ.

edges.label: 购买历史与任意市场分割
edges.note: 前文考察由购买行为形成的特定信息，后文把分割方式本身当成变量，求所有可实现的福利组合。
edges.noteEn: The first model studies information arising from purchases. The second varies segmentation itself to trace every attainable welfare combination.
edges.labelEn: From purchase histories to arbitrary segmentation

edges.label: 内生披露与产品推荐
edges.note: 给定分割的福利边界之外，消费者为何愿意揭示偏好取决于数据同时带来的推荐收益和定价后果。
edges.noteEn: Beyond welfare bounds for a given segmentation, the incentive to reveal preferences depends on both better recommendations and the effect on prices.

edges.label: 数据影响扩大到其他消费者
edges.note: 从一人披露偏好的收益与成本，转向多个消费者信号之间的相关性，以及中介从中获得的信息价值。
edges.noteEn: The analysis shifts from one person's costs and benefits of disclosure to correlated signals across people and their value to a data intermediary.

edges.label: 限制可实施的市场分割
edges.note: 与任意信息结构的边界相比，可验证证据、消费者的自愿选择和卖方竞争共同决定实际形成的分割。
edges.noteEn: Within the bounds for arbitrary information, verifiable evidence, voluntary disclosure and seller competition jointly determine which segments emerge.

edges.label: 由给定分组到任意信息
edges.note: 先比较既有分组与统一定价，再遍历卖方可能得到的分割，得到福利的可行边界。
edges.labelEn: From fixed groups to arbitrary information
edges.noteEn: Compare fixed group pricing with a uniform price, then vary the seller's information to trace the entire feasible welfare frontier.

edges.label: 竞争与单一商家的历史定价
edges.note: 比较记录用于争夺对手顾客与用于向本店顾客定价时，消费者跨期选择的差异。
edges.labelEn: Competition and a single seller's history pricing
edges.noteEn: Compare forward-looking purchase choices when records enable competitive poaching and when a single seller prices its own customers.

edges.label: 区分名单交易与自用
edges.note: 客户记录既可被商家留作未来定价，也可售给下一家商家，引起不同的策略性保护行为。
edges.noteEn: Records can inform the original seller's future prices or be sold to a second seller, changing consumers' strategic privacy responses.

edges.label: 改变披露决定权
edges.note: 区分上游卖家承诺替顾客保密与消费者自己决定交出哪项证据。
edges.noteEn: Separate an upstream seller's privacy promise from a consumer's choice of what verifiable evidence to release.

edges.label: 从定向价值到数据外部性
edges.note: 广告定向先解释谁愿付费获取数据，跨人相关性再解释中介从消费者处购入数据的成本。
edges.labelEn: From targeting value to data externalities
edges.noteEn: Targeting explains willingness to pay for information. Cross-consumer correlation also changes what an intermediary must pay to acquire it.

edges.label: 同一外部性的福利分析
edges.note: 同一年的两项模型分别研究中介购入信息的成本，以及价格与个人隐私选择怎样导致低效率。
edges.labelEn: Welfare effects of the same externality
edges.noteEn: Parallel models study the intermediary's acquisition costs and how prices and individual privacy decisions can generate inefficiency.

edges.label: 把购买历史压缩成评分
edges.note: 评分的记忆和噪声决定早期购买对以后价格有多大影响。
edges.noteEn: The score's memory and noise determine how strongly earlier purchases influence later prices.

edges.label: 加入产品菜单
edges.note: 单产品市场分割的福利边界还需满足卖方在每个细分市场选产品和定价的激励。
edges.noteEn: The single-product segmentation frontier gains a new constraint from a seller optimizing product menus in each segment.

edges.label: 比较中介间与消费者间的外部性
edges.note: 同一个人向多家中介出售数据，与一人的信号预测他人，是两种不同的市场联动。
edges.noteEn: Reselling one person's data through competing intermediaries differs from one person's signal predicting others' preferences.

edges.label: 在每个分组内再筛选
edges.note: 分组决定卖方得到什么信息，组内质量菜单则决定如何用自选提取支付意愿。
edges.noteEn: Segments determine what the seller learns. A quality menu within each segment then screens willingness to pay.

branches.questionEn: Who pays less when a seller knows more? How do profit and welfare change when consumers control what they disclose or their data predict others' behavior?
branches.boundaryEn: Prices depend on what sellers learn about customers. For self-selection among products on a common menu, see multidimensional screening.

branches.name: 未知技术下的稳健合约
branches.question: 谁知道代理人能做什么？当行动清单、成本或产出分布只掌握一部分时，哪种支付规则仍能提供激励？
branches.boundary: 这里的不确定性来自生产环境。有的模型让委托人评价最坏技术，有的让代理人面对多个技术信念。规则本身刻意含糊的合约另见模糊机制分支。

papers.title: Robustness and Linear Contracts
papers.role: 未知行动下的线性分成
papers.note: 发表于 American Economic Review。双方风险中性且代理人受有限责任保护。委托人仅能确认部分行动，对可能额外存在的行动取最坏利润；在确定性合约中，线性分成能达到最优保障。
papers.noteEn: Published in the American Economic Review. Both parties are risk neutral and the agent has limited liability. With only some actions known, the principal evaluates the worst profit over possible additional actions. A linear share achieves the best deterministic guarantee.

papers.title: Robust Performance Evaluation of Independent Agents
papers.note: 发表于 Theoretical Economics。即使代理人相互独立，未知行动仍可使最优激励支付与他人绩效挂钩。在对称且产出为二元的环境里，同事表现越好，自己得到的支付越高。
papers.noteEn: Published in Theoretical Economics. Even independent agents may optimally be paid on others' performance when actions are unknown. With symmetry and binary outcomes, better results for colleagues raise own pay.

papers.title: Statistical Uncertainty and Coarse Contracts
papers.role: 代理人一侧的技术模糊
papers.note: 发表于 Journal of Economic Theory。标准委托人面对严格风险厌恶、以 Bewley 不完备偏好评价技术的代理人。技术不确定性很小时合约充分依状态支付，很大时最优合约一般只设两档支付。
papers.noteEn: Published in the Journal of Economic Theory. A conventional principal faces a strictly risk-averse agent with Bewley incomplete preferences over technologies. Small uncertainty allows fully contingent pay, while sufficiently extensive uncertainty generically yields just two payment levels.
papers.roleEn: Technological ambiguity on the agent's side

papers.title: Robust Contracts: A Revealed Preference Approach
papers.note: Kellogg 于 2025 年著录为 Review of Economics and Statistics 待刊。委托人观察若干旧合约下的产出分布，无须知道行动成本；最优支付表可写成旧支付表与把产出全给代理人的线性支付表的凸组合。
papers.noteEn: Kellogg listed the paper in 2025 as forthcoming in the Review of Economics and Statistics. Outcome distributions under old contracts suffice without action costs. An optimal payment schedule combines the old schedules with a linear one giving the agent all output.

papers.title: Robust Contracting and Voluntary Disclosure
papers.note: 2025 年 12 月工作论文。代理人可以证明自己拥有一项此前未知的行动。沉默也传递信息，在给出的充分条件下，未披露后的稳健最优合约为非线性。
papers.noteEn: December 2025 working paper. An agent can prove access to a previously unknown action. Silence is informative, and under stated sufficient conditions the robust optimum following nondisclosure is nonlinear.

papers.title: Randomization and the Robustness of Linear Contracts
papers.authors: Ashwin Kambhampati · Bo Peng · Zhihao Gavin Tang · Juuso Toikka · Rakesh Vohra
papers.note: 2026 年 7 月工作论文。委托人在代理人行动前抽取并公布合约，以随机化对冲未知技术。只需线性合约；最优方案依对数均匀分布抽取委托人的分成比例。
papers.noteEn: July 2026 working paper. The principal draws and announces the contract before the agent acts, hedging against unknown technology. Linear contracts suffice, with a log-uniform draw of the principal's share.

papers.title: Robust Incentives for Information Acquisition
papers.note: 专家可选择未被委托人预见的实验。在给定条件下，委托人限定可推荐的决策，并按推荐决策在真实状态下的价值付酬。
papers.noteEn: An expert can choose unforeseen experiments. Under stated conditions the principal restricts eligible decisions and pays in proportion to the recommended decision's realized value.

papers.title: Robust Contracting with Additive Noise
papers.note: 代理人先见到均值为零的产出冲击，再选努力。为线性激励提供稳健基础的条件包括委托人知道冲击下界而不知上界。
papers.noteEn: The agent observes a mean-zero output shock before choosing effort. A robust foundation for linear incentives requires, among other conditions, a known lower bound but no known upper bound on shocks.

papers.title: Robust Contracting for Sequential Search
papers.authors: Théo Durandard · Udayan Vaidya · Boli Xu
papers.note: 代理人可依次搜索项目，委托人仅知一个项目。在最坏技术下保障收益的合约可为债务式支付，固定比例分成可能抑制继续搜索。
papers.noteEn: The agent searches projects sequentially while the principal knows only one. A debt contract is robustly optimal, as a linear share can discourage further search.

papers.title: Robust Incentives for Risk
papers.role: 风险偏好与技术均未知
papers.note: 委托人同时担心技术和风险偏好。为防严重冒险，支付表在低于某阈值时给最低报酬，高于另一阈值时给最高报酬。
papers.noteEn: The principal is unsure about technology and risk preferences. Robustness to severe risk taking requires a floor below a lower output threshold and a cap above an upper threshold.

papers.title: Robust Dynamic Contracts with Multiple Agents
papers.note: 在连续时间的多代理人模型中，委托人担心项目终值分布的设定错误，可使工资依赖其他无直接关联项目的产出。
papers.noteEn: With multiple agents in continuous time, concern about terminal payoff distributions can make wages depend on outputs from otherwise unrelated projects.

papers.title: Simple versus Optimal Contracts
papers.authors: Paul Dütting, Tim Roughgarden & Inbal Talgam-Cohen
papers.note: 在隐藏行动模型中将最佳线性合同与全体合同中的最优收益比较，刻画简单性代价。
papers.noteEn: Compares the best linear contract with the unrestricted optimum in a hidden-action model to quantify the price of simplicity.

papers.title: Calibrated Incentive Contracts
papers.note: 结合有限责任、道德风险与逆向选择的动态环境中，从难以直接实施的简单基准校准支付；回报过程无须独立同分布或遍历，仍能给出业绩保障。
papers.noteEn: In dynamic agency with limited liability, moral hazard and selection, incentives are calibrated to simple benchmarks that cannot be implemented directly. Performance guarantees need neither i.i.d. nor ergodic returns.

papers.title: Robust Incentives for Teams
papers.role: 未知团队博弈下的利益一致
papers.note: 要求对团队成员所玩博弈的不确定性保持稳健会使合约趋于利益一致；预算平衡时，最优形式归为线性利润分成。
papers.roleEn: Aligned incentives under an unknown team game
papers.noteEn: Robustness to uncertainty about the game played by team members favors aligned incentives. Under budget balance, the optimal forms reduce to linear profit shares.

papers.title: Robust Contracting under Double Moral Hazard
papers.role: 双方都要投入隐藏努力
papers.note: 生产同时需要委托人和代理人的不可订约投入。双方风险中性且没有有限责任约束时，对未知行动取稳健保障可支持固定费加线性分成。
papers.noteEn: Both principal and agent supply noncontractible inputs. With risk neutrality and no limited liability, fixed fees plus linear shares are optimal under guarantees against unknown actions.

edges.label: 由单人到多人
edges.note: 多个独立代理人同时面对激励时，未知行动使他人的表现可以进入支付，单人线性分成的结论不能逐人照搬。
