edges.noteEn: With several independent agents, unknown actions can make others' performance relevant for pay, so the single-agent linear-sharing conclusion cannot be applied separately to each.

edges.label: 改变谁面对模糊性
edges.note: 一个模型以委托人的最坏利润评价额外行动，另一个模型把对技术的不完备信念放在代理人一侧，所得支付规则的粗细也随之改变。
edges.noteEn: One model evaluates extra actions by the principal's worst profit. Another gives the agent incomplete technological beliefs, changing how finely payments vary across outcomes.

edges.label: 改变已知数据
edges.note: 新模型以旧合约下实际观察到的选择代替已知行动和成本清单，由显示偏好约束筛除不可能的技术。
edges.noteEn: Observed choices under old contracts replace a list of known actions and costs. Revealed preference rules out inconsistent technologies.

edges.label: 允许证明额外行动
edges.note: 原先最坏情况中的未知行动现在可以被当事人主动证明，最优支付表因此要根据披露与沉默分别设计。
edges.noteEn: An agent can now verify an action that previously entered only the worst-case set. Optimal schedules depend on whether the agent discloses or remains silent.

edges.label: 扩大可选合约集合
edges.note: 确定性合约的最优线性形式仍有作用，但在选哪一个分成比例上随机化能进一步提高利润保障；代理人观察到抽取结果后才选择行动。
edges.noteEn: Deterministic linearity remains useful, yet randomizing the share can improve the guarantee further. The agent observes the draw before acting.

edges.label: 从产出行动到实验
edges.note: 把额外可行行动改为额外实验，奖励所对应的结果也变为可核验状态下的决策价值。
edges.noteEn: Extra feasible actions become extra experiments, and pay depends on the value of a decision under the subsequently verified state.

edges.label: 区分两种生产不确定性
edges.note: 额外可行动作与行动前已经实现的产出冲击都可能支持线性，但依赖的技术限制不同。
edges.noteEn: Unknown actions and output shocks realized before effort can each support linearity, under different restrictions.

edges.label: 让行动具有搜索顺序
edges.note: 从一次性生产选择转向依次探索机会，最坏情形设计还须照顾继续搜索的期权。
edges.noteEn: Moving from one production action to sequential opportunities adds the option to continue searching to the worst-case design problem.

edges.label: 放宽风险中性
edges.note: 不确定集合从可行行动扩大到代理人的风险偏好，最优保障因此可能需要限制报酬上端。
edges.noteEn: Extending uncertainty from actions to the agent's risk preferences can make an upper bound on pay essential.

edges.label: 比较跨人付薪的两种来源
edges.note: 一文引入未知行动，另一文引入终值分布误设。两者都可能使本不相干的产出进入工资。
edges.noteEn: Unknown actions in one model and misspecified terminal distributions in the other can each put otherwise unrelated outputs into pay.

edges.label: 从最坏情形到近似比
edges.note: 最坏情形下偏好线性合同，与在指定技术上衡量它损失多少，是两个可互补的评价标准。
edges.noteEn: Worst-case optimality and the approximation loss for a specified technology provide complementary evaluations of linear contracts.

edges.label: 区分动态基准与最坏技术
edges.note: 两个模型都避免完整指定生产环境，但一方跨期逼近基准，另一方比较额外行动对静态合约的最坏影响。
edges.labelEn: Distinguishing dynamic benchmarks from worst-case technology
edges.noteEn: Both avoid fully specifying production, but one tracks a benchmark over time while the other protects against extra actions in static contracting.

edges.label: 区分共同预算与独立产出
edges.note: 未知团队技术与预算平衡支持利润分成；个体产出独立但行动集不明时，最优性又可要求把工资跨人挂钩。
edges.labelEn: Distinguishing shared budgets from independent outputs
edges.noteEn: An uncertain team game under budget balance favors profit shares. With independent outputs and unknown actions, optimality can instead require cross-agent pay links.

edges.label: 加入委托人自己的激励
edges.note: 从一方隐藏行动转向双重道德风险，合约须对技术不确定下双方的收益给出保障。
edges.noteEn: Moving to double moral hazard requires guarantees for both parties when their feasible technologies are not fully known.

resources.title: Robustness in Mechanism Design and Contracting

branches.questionEn: Who knows what actions an agent can take? Which payments still provide incentives when actions, costs or outcome distributions are only partly known?
branches.boundaryEn: Uncertainty here concerns production. Some models make principals evaluate worst-case technologies, others give agents multiple technological beliefs. Deliberately ambiguous payment rules appear in the ambiguous mechanisms branch.

branches.name: 模糊机制、模糊合约与说服
branches.en: Designed ambiguity in mechanisms, contracts and persuasion
branches.question: 卖方、委托人或发送者能否通过承诺一组可能的规则获益？接收者何时行动、怎样看待模糊性，会改变答案吗？
branches.boundary: 这里的设计变量是参与者无法用单一已知概率描述的通信或支付规则。技术原本未知、或抽签概率与结果在行动前已公布，属于不同的安排。

papers.title: Mechanism Design With Ambiguous Communication Devices
papers.role: 用通信装置改变可实施性
papers.note: 发表于 Econometrica。设计者引入模糊的中介通信，在至少一个均衡中可实施一些相对于原先验不满足激励相容的社会选择函数，文中刻画了这种部分实施的范围。
papers.noteEn: Published in Econometrica. Deliberately ambiguous mediated communication can implement in at least one equilibrium some social choice functions that violate incentive compatibility under prior beliefs. The paper characterizes partial implementation.
papers.roleEn: Using communication devices to change implementation

papers.title: The Design of Ambiguous Mechanisms
papers.authors: Alfredo di Tillio · Nenad Kos · Matthias Messner
papers.role: 单物品销售的模糊规则
papers.note: 发表于 Review of Economic Studies。卖方向模糊厌恶的买方出售一件物品，承诺机制后仍可不公开其中某些特征；论文刻画何时这能增加利润，并构造优于最佳透明机制的简单方案。
papers.noteEn: Published in the Review of Economic Studies. A seller commits to a mechanism but can conceal some features from an ambiguity-averse buyer. The paper characterizes profit gains and constructs simple schemes outperforming the best transparent mechanism.
papers.roleEn: Ambiguous rules for selling one good

papers.title: Ambiguous Persuasion
papers.authors: Dorian Beauchêne · Jian Li · Ming Li
papers.role: 在信号生成中引入模糊性
papers.note: 发表于 Journal of Economic Theory。即便基础状态具有共同且精确的先验，双方按最坏信念评价时，发送者也能通过模糊通信装置诱导某些普通贝叶斯说服无法诱导的行动。
papers.noteEn: Published in the Journal of Economic Theory. Even with a precise common prior over states, an ambiguous device can induce actions unavailable under standard Bayesian persuasion when both players evaluate worst-case beliefs.

papers.title: Ambiguous Contracts
papers.authors: Paul Dütting · Michal Feldman · Daniel Peretz · Larry Samuelson
papers.role: 支付规则集合与混合行动
papers.note: 发表于 Econometrica。代理人按不同支付规则中的最坏收益选行动，各规则在目标行动下须给委托人相同期望收益。纯行动下模糊合约可能提高收益；代理人可混合行动时，该优势消失。
papers.noteEn: Published in Econometrica. The agent chooses an action by worst-case pay across rules. All rules must give the principal the same expected payoff under the target action. Gains possible with pure actions disappear if the agent can mix.

papers.title: Ambiguous Persuasion: An Ex-Ante Formulation
papers.role: 事前选择完整行动计划
papers.note: 发表于 Games and Economic Behavior。双方采用最大最小期望效用，接收者在看到具体消息前选定整套消息与行动的对应关系。在此时序下，发送者采用模糊装置没有严格收益。
papers.noteEn: Published in Games and Economic Behavior. Both players have maxmin expected utility, and the receiver chooses a full message-contingent action plan before receiving a message. The sender cannot strictly gain from ambiguity under this timing.
papers.roleEn: Selecting an entire action plan ex ante

papers.title: Persuasion with Ambiguous Communication
papers.authors: Xiaoyu Cheng · Peter Klibanoff · Sujoy Mukerji · Ludovic Renou
papers.note: 工作论文，2026 年 11 月 10 日修订。发送者若要获益，某个接收者愿意服从的实验必须能分成两个双方收益排序一致的实验。接收者只有两个可选行动时，发送者无法获益。
papers.noteEn: Working paper revised November 10, 2026. A gain requires an obedient experiment that splits into two experiments both players rank the same way. With only two receiver actions the sender cannot gain.

papers.title: A Dynamic Mechanism and Surplus Extraction under Ambiguity
papers.note: 在带污染先验的独立私人价值环境中，离散荷兰拍卖的一种变体能提取几乎全部剩余。
papers.noteEn: With contaminated priors in an independent-private-values setting, a modified discrete Dutch auction can extract almost all surplus.

papers.title: Optimal Auctions with Ambiguity
papers.authors: Subir Bose · Emre Ozdenoren · Andreas Duus Pape
papers.role: 先验模糊下的竞标保险
papers.note: 竞买人比卖方更不确定估值分布时，在文中条件下给各类型充分保险可弱提高卖方收入。
papers.noteEn: When bidders face greater ambiguity about the value distribution than the seller, fully insuring each type can weakly increase revenue under the paper's conditions.

papers.title: Endogenous Ambiguity in Cheap Talk
papers.authors: Christian Kellner · Mark T. Le Quement
papers.note: 发送者可按未知概率随机发言。接收者的最坏情形反应可减小有效利益冲突，从而支持更多信息传递。
papers.noteEn: A sender may randomize messages with unknown probabilities. The receiver's worst-case response can narrow the effective conflict and sustain more communication.

papers.title: Succinct Ambiguous Contracts
papers.authors: Paul Dütting · Michal Feldman · Yarden Rashti
papers.note: 公开预印本限制支付表最多有 k 张。最优设计可分解成对行动分组后选择传统合约，规模限制会造成离散的利润损失。
papers.roleEn: Bounding the size of ambiguous contracts
papers.noteEn: The preprint caps the number of payment schedules at k. The optimum reduces to designing classical contracts over partitions of actions, and a size restriction can cause a discrete payoff loss.

papers.title: Persuasion under Ambiguity
papers.authors: Jonas Hedlund · T. Florian Kauffeldt · Malte Lammert
papers.note: 发送者有单一先验，接收者按多个先验中的最佳与最坏期望的加权平均作选择；行动对状态的敏感度影响最优信号。
papers.noteEn: The sender has one prior and the receiver weights best- and worst-case expectations over an interval of priors. The sensitivity of action payoffs to states shapes the optimal signal.

papers.title: Endogenous Ambiguity under Commodification of Probabilistic Information
papers.note: 买方可购买概率信息以缩小模糊；把待售的信息批次随机化有助于处理交易中的敲竹杠问题。
papers.noteEn: A buyer can purchase probabilistic information to reduce ambiguity. Randomizing information batches helps address contractual holdup.

papers.title: Auction Design with Ambiguity: Optimality of the First-Price Auction
papers.authors: Sung-Ha Hwang · Youngwoo Koh · Sosung Baik
papers.role: 输赢条件下的最优支付
papers.note: 买方将与卖方信念的散度不超过界限的一组先验作最坏评价。给定分配，最优输赢支付只需依赖本人的类型与是否胜出。
papers.noteEn: Bidders evaluate a divergence neighborhood of the seller's belief by its worst case. For a given allocation, optimal transfers need depend only on own type and winning or losing.

papers.title: Modes of Ambiguous Communication
papers.authors: Christian Kellner · Mark T. Le Quement
papers.role: 区分说者与听者的随机行为
papers.note: 两状态、两行动的廉价沟通模型允许先验模糊。发言者与接收者都可能混合，即使偏好一致，两个消息有时也不足以实施发送者最优决策。
papers.noteEn: With two states, two actions and ambiguous priors, both parties may mix. Even aligned preferences need not make two messages sufficient to implement the sender's favorite rule.

papers.title: Dynamic Consistency and Ambiguous Communication
papers.role: 模糊策略下的动态一致性
papers.note: 2025 年公开预印本研究带模糊策略的博弈，考察接收者动态一致时，模糊通信仍能如何产生收益。
papers.noteEn: This publicly posted 2025 working paper studies games with ambiguous strategies and asks how gains from ambiguous communication can persist with dynamically consistent behavior.

edges.label: 从实施到售卖利润
edges.note: 前者问哪些社会选择可以部分实施，后者在单买家问题中直接求卖方收益，并考察可操作的规则。
edges.noteEn: The first model asks what can be partially implemented. The second maximizes revenue from one buyer and considers practical sales rules.

edges.label: 从中介通信到最优说服
edges.note: 两者都让设计者选择信息传递方式。说服模型固定状态的共同先验，把可变部分集中在从状态到消息的传递规则。
edges.noteEn: In both models the designer chooses how information is transmitted. Persuasion holds fixed the common prior on states and varies how states generate messages.

edges.label: 从交易规则到支付规则
edges.note: 把单物品售卖转换成隐藏行动合约。支付表在目标行动下对委托人的收益必须一致，代理人能否混合行动决定能否从模糊性获益。
edges.noteEn: Replace a single-good sale with a hidden-action contract. Rules must agree on the principal's expected payoff at the chosen action, and the agent's ability to mix determines the value of ambiguity.

edges.label: 改变行动选择的时点
edges.note: 比较收到消息后逐一选行动与事先选择整套应对计划。最大最小评价不保证这两个时点产生相同的说服价值。
edges.noteEn: Choosing after each message and selecting all contingent responses beforehand may have different persuasion values under maxmin preferences.

edges.label: 检验无收益的偏好条件
edges.note: 保持接收者动态一致，进一步刻画不同模糊态度下何时存在说服收益，并用可服从实验的分解与行动数给出限制。
edges.noteEn: Maintaining dynamic consistency, the analysis studies when different ambiguity attitudes permit gains. Splits of obedient experiments and the number of actions constrain the answer.
edges.labelEn: Testing preference conditions for no gain

edges.label: 区分动态规则与隐匿规则
edges.note: 前文利用既有模糊信念与拍卖时序，后文考察卖方主动保留其承诺机制的细节。
edges.labelEn: Distinguishing dynamic rules from concealed rules
edges.noteEn: The auction exploits prior ambiguity through timing. The later sales model lets the seller conceal elements of the committed mechanism.

edges.label: 辨明模糊的来源
edges.note: 拍卖模型面对既有多先验；模糊中介机制则允许设计者主动使参与者无法确定通信规则。
edges.noteEn: The auction takes multiple priors as given. Ambiguous mediation lets the designer create uncertainty about the communication rule.

edges.label: 改变承诺技术
edges.note: 廉价沟通中须逐类型维持发言激励，说服中则可事前承诺模糊实验。
edges.noteEn: Cheap talk requires truthful incentives type by type, whereas persuasion can use ex ante commitment to an ambiguous experiment.

edges.label: 给规则集合设上限
edges.note: 把能承诺任意数量支付表的一般模型收紧，研究精简合约的收益代价与计算难度。
edges.noteEn: Limit how many schedules can be promised and examine both the value loss and the computational cost of a concise contract.

edges.label: 区分先验与实验的模糊
edges.note: 一方选择模糊通信技术与接收者原本就不确定状态分布，对应两个不同的说服问题。
edges.noteEn: Choosing an ambiguous experiment and facing a receiver already unsure of the state distribution define different persuasion problems.

edges.label: 从说服到信息买卖
edges.note: 信号设计之外，信息批次如何售卖也会内生改变买方面对的信念集合。
edges.noteEn: Beyond persuasion, the way information is sold changes the set of beliefs facing its buyer.

edges.label: 具体化买方的先验集合
edges.note: 早期模型强调充分保险的收益；用散度邻域和明确的支付限制可检验何时一价拍卖最优。
edges.noteEn: Earlier work emphasizes full insurance. Divergence neighborhoods and explicit transfer restrictions yield conditions for first-price optimality.

edges.label: 区分既有与内生的模糊
edges.note: 前一模型从状态先验的模糊出发，后一模型允许发送者自己用未知概率选择消息。
edges.noteEn: One model starts from ambiguity over the state. The other allows the sender to deliberately randomize messages with unknown probabilities.

edges.label: 比较动态一致性的建模方法
edges.note: 两项研究都保留动态一致性。一项从模糊策略的博弈表述出发，另一项借可服从实验的分解刻画说服收益。
edges.noteEn: Both maintain dynamic consistency. One starts from games with ambiguous strategies, the other characterizes persuasion gains through splits of obedient experiments.

branches.questionEn: Can a seller, principal or sender benefit by committing to a set of possible rules? Does the answer depend on when the receiver acts and how they regard ambiguity?
branches.boundaryEn: Communication or payment rules are chosen so participants cannot describe them by a single known probability. Unknown production technologies and publicly resolved lotteries describe different environments.

branches.name: 社会选择与防操纵
branches.question: 个人排行怎样汇总成集体行动？投票者若能策略性地改变报告，哪些规则仍能采用？
branches.boundary: 排序聚合与单赢家选择是不同的社会决策对象。能否绕过独裁结论取决于备选项数量、偏好域、规则的值域，以及是否允许随机化。

papers.title: A Difficulty in the Concept of Social Welfare
papers.note: 提出偏好聚合的公理冲突。此处输出是社会排序，策略报告尚未进入问题。
papers.noteEn: Identifies conflicting axioms for preference aggregation. The output is a social ranking, and individuals' strategic reports do not yet enter the problem.

papers.title: Manipulation of Voting Schemes: A General Result
papers.note: 在不受限的严格排序域，只要确定性规则能产生至少三个备选结果，非独裁规则便可被某个选民操纵。
papers.noteEn: On an unrestricted domain of strict rankings, a deterministic rule whose range contains at least three alternatives is manipulable by some voter unless it is dictatorial.

papers.title: Strategy-proofness and Arrow’s Conditions: Existence and Correspondence Theorems for Voting Procedures and Social Welfare Functions
papers.note: 独立刻画确定性防操纵投票规则，并建立投票规则与社会福利排序条件之间的联系。
papers.noteEn: Independently characterizes deterministic strategy-proof voting and relates conditions on voting rules to conditions on social welfare rankings.

papers.title: On Strategy-Proofness and Single Peakedness
papers.note: 当选项排列在一条线上、选民偏好单峰时，在该文的匿名性和效率条件下，可用固定选票加中位数表达防操纵规则。
papers.noteEn: When alternatives lie on a line and preferences are single-peaked, strategy-proof rules satisfying the paper's anonymity and efficiency conditions admit a median representation with fixed ballots.

papers.title: Voting by Committees
papers.authors: Salvador Barberà · Hugo Sonnenschein · Lin Zhou
papers.note: 在对备选对象组合具有可分偏好的环境，选民主权和防操纵要求逐项使用单调的获胜联盟族。
papers.noteEn: With separable preferences over sets of objects, voter sovereignty and strategy-proofness require a monotone family of winning coalitions for each object.

papers.title: On the Rationale of Group Decision-making
papers.note: 单峰偏好下，奇数个投票者的中位理想点能击败其他选项。
papers.noteEn: With single-peaked preferences and an odd electorate, the median ideal point wins pairwise majority comparisons.

papers.title: A Set of Independent Necessary and Sufficient Conditions for Simple Majority Decision
papers.note: 借助匿名性、中立性与正响应等条件刻画两个选项之间的简单多数决。
papers.noteEn: Characterizes simple majority decision between two alternatives using anonymity, neutrality and positive responsiveness.

papers.title: Manipulation of Schemes that Mix Voting with Chance
papers.note: 在不受限偏好域上刻画防操纵的随机规则；单边规则与二元规则的混合构成基本结构。
papers.noteEn: Characterizes strategy-proof random schemes on an unrestricted domain using mixtures of unilateral and duple schemes.

papers.title: The Equivalence of Strong Positive Association and Strategy-Proofness
papers.note: 在论文的无限制排序域上，把策略无关与强正相关条件联系起来。
papers.noteEn: Relates strategy-proofness to strong positive association on the paper's unrestricted domain of rankings.

papers.title: Impossibility of Strategy-Proof Mechanisms in Economies with Pure Public Goods
papers.note: 在多维公共品空间，即使存在偏好结构限制，非独裁与防操纵也面临新的冲突。
papers.noteEn: In a multidimensional public-good space, nondictatorship and strategy-proofness can conflict even with structure on preferences.

papers.title: Relaxed Notions of Condorcet-Consistency and Efficiency for Strategyproof Social Decision Schemes
papers.authors: Felix Brandt; Patrick Lederer; René Romen
papers.note: 以康多塞赢家的最低获选概率、帕累托劣选项的最高获选概率，量化随机规则能满足多少多数性和效率。
papers.noteEn: Quantifies majority and efficiency guarantees using a lower bound on a Condorcet winner's selection probability and an upper bound on a Pareto-dominated option's probability.

papers.title: The Structure of Strategy-Proof Social Choice — Part I: General Characterization and Possibility Results on Median Spaces
papers.role: 中位空间的可实施选择
papers.note: 在丰富的广义单峰偏好域上，用按议题投票和交集性质刻画防操纵规则。
papers.noteEn: On rich domains of generalized single-peaked preferences, issue-wise voting and an intersection property characterize strategy-proof rules.

papers.title: Incentives in social decision schemes with pairwise comparison preferences
papers.authors: Felix Brandt; Patrick Lederer; Warut Suksompong
papers.note: 把对确定选项的排序扩展为对彩票的成对比较偏好，考察随机投票规则在这一比较标准下的策略激励。
papers.noteEn: Extends rankings over alternatives to pairwise comparisons of lotteries and studies strategic incentives under that lottery comparison.

papers.title: Optimal Voting Mechanisms on Generalized Single-Peaked Domains
papers.role: 广义单峰域的最优规则
papers.roleEn: Optimal rules on generalized single-peaked domains
papers.note: 在中位空间上，从匿名、满射且防操纵的规则中选取福利最高者；最优规则对不同二元表决可要求不同多数门槛。
papers.noteEn: On median spaces, the welfare-maximizing anonymous, onto and strategy-proof rules combine binary votes with potentially different majority thresholds.

papers.title: Group strategy-proof rules in multidimensional binary domains
papers.note: 选项为二元向量，效用按与理想向量的汉明距离排序。在一致、匿名和议题中立下，四人及以上、至少三个议题时不存在强群体防操纵规则。
papers.noteEn: With binary vectors ranked by Hamming distance, unanimity, anonymity and component neutrality rule out strong group strategy-proofness for at least four voters and three components.

papers.title: A unified characterization of the randomized strategy-proof rules
papers.role: 随机规则的限制域刻画
papers.note: 利用介于两点之间的关系，对多种受限偏好域中一致且防操纵的随机规则给出统一刻画，涵盖单峰与单交叉等环境。
papers.noteEn: Uses a betweenness relation to characterize unanimous, strategy-proof randomized rules across restricted domains, including single-peaked and single-crossing settings.

edges.label: 概念联系
edges.note: 从社会排序公理转向选赢家的策略激励；Satterthwaite 显式研究两个对象的对应。
edges.noteEn: The question shifts from axioms on rankings to strategic incentives in choosing a winner. Satterthwaite explicitly relates the two objects.

edges.label: 独立刻画
edges.note: 这两篇形成 Gibbard–Satterthwaite 结论的两种来源；年份先后不代表后一篇依赖前一篇证明。
edges.noteEn: These papers give two sources of the Gibbard–Satterthwaite theorem. Publication order does not imply dependence of the second proof on the first.

edges.label: 限制偏好域
edges.note: 单峰性排除了导致一般域不可能性的一部分偏好轮廓，使非独裁的正面刻画成为可能。
edges.noteEn: Single-peakedness excludes some profiles underlying the unrestricted impossibility, permitting a positive characterization of nondictatorial rules.

edges.label: 比较结构
edges.note: 单峰位置选择与可分的多对象选择分别说明，偏好域的结构决定可实行的集体选择规则。
edges.noteEn: Location choice on a single-peaked domain and multiple-object choice with separable preferences illustrate how domain structure determines feasible collective rules.

edges.label: 单峰多数决
edges.note: Black 研究多数决的稳定性；Moulin 在同类偏好域上刻画防操纵的规则。
edges.noteEn: Black studies majority stability, while Moulin characterizes strategy-proof rules on a related domain.

edges.label: 二元公理刻画
edges.note: 将备选项缩减为两个后，集体选择可得到正面的公理刻画。
edges.noteEn: Restricting the agenda to two alternatives permits a positive axiomatic characterization of collective decision.

edges.label: 随机投票
edges.note: 允许结果是彩票后，必须比较对彩票的偏好，确定性独裁结论相应改变。
edges.noteEn: Lottery outcomes introduce preferences over risk and change the deterministic dictatorship conclusion.

edges.label: 正相关与激励
edges.note: 用选民提高某选项时选择结果如何变化，重写原本逐个偏离的激励检验。
edges.noteEn: The response of a rule to raising an alternative provides another way to test incentives against individual deviations.

edges.label: 多维公共品
edges.note: 一维中位数规则的正面结论依赖几何结构；多维公共项目检验这一边界。
edges.noteEn: Multidimensional public projects test the geometric limits of positive median-rule results on a line.

edges.label: 概率化多数标准
edges.note: 保留防操纵要求，将确定性选举的赢家标准改成可度量的彩票保证。
edges.noteEn: Retains protection against manipulation while turning a deterministic winner criterion into a quantitative lottery guarantee.

edges.label: 限制偏好域以恢复可能性
edges.note: 偏好域的几何结构限定了哪些逐项表决能拼成一个一致的社会选择。
edges.noteEn: Domain geometry determines which issue-by-issue decisions fit together as a coherent social choice.

edges.label: 成对比较彩票
edges.note: Gibbard 的随机规则结果取决于如何评价对彩票的偏离；换用成对比较可以独立检验这项假设。
edges.noteEn: Pairwise comparisons provide a different way to evaluate a deviation between lotteries in Gibbard's random-rule setting.

edges.label: 广义单峰域的最优规则
edges.labelEn: Optimal rules on generalized single-peaked domains
edges.note: 限制偏好几何结构后，可在满足防操纵的多个规则之间进一步按福利排序。
edges.noteEn: Restricting preference geometry leaves multiple strategy-proof rules that can be ranked by welfare.

edges.label: 多议题的联盟偏离
edges.note: 从单个选民的虚报转向多个选民跨议题的联合虚报，规则的可行边界随人数和议题数而变。
edges.noteEn: Replacing individual reports with coordinated misreports across issues makes the boundary depend on the numbers of voters and issues.

edges.label: 随机规则的限制域刻画
edges.note: 将随机选择的不受限偏好域换成具有共同几何结构的一族偏好域。
edges.noteEn: Replaces the unrestricted domain of random social choice with a family of domains sharing a geometric structure.

branches.questionEn: How can individual rankings determine collective action? Which voting rules survive strategic misreporting?
branches.boundaryEn: Aggregating rankings and selecting one winner are different tasks. Dictatorship results depend on the number of alternatives, the preference domain, the range of the rule and the availability of randomization.

branches.name: 均衡实施与显示原理
branches.question: 怎样设计博弈，使均衡结果集合恰好等于给定社会选择对应？
branches.boundary: 显示原理将给定均衡的结果重写为直接机制中的诚实均衡。完全实施还约束其他均衡的结果。这里着重完全信息下的 Nash 与子博弈精炼实施。

papers.title: The Implementation of Social Choice Rules: Some General Results on Incentive Compatibility
papers.authors: Partha Dasgupta · Peter Hammond · Eric Maskin
papers.note: 考察给定社会规则的激励相容性，梳理通过报告与通过一般博弈实施的关系。
papers.noteEn: Studies the incentive compatibility of a given social rule and relates implementation through reports to implementation through general games.

papers.title: Nash Equilibrium and Welfare Optimality
papers.note: 1977 年起流传，1999 年正式发表。Maskin 单调性是必要条件；三人及以上时，加上无否决权可得到充分条件。
papers.noteEn: Circulated from 1977 and published in 1999. Maskin monotonicity is necessary. With at least three agents, adding no veto power yields sufficient conditions.

papers.title: Subgame Perfect Implementation
papers.note: 用扩展式博弈和子博弈精炼排除不可信威胁，改变可完全实施的社会规则集合。
papers.noteEn: Uses extensive-form games and subgame perfection to eliminate noncredible threats, changing the set of fully implementable social rules.

papers.title: Nash Implementation: A Full Characterization
papers.note: 为纯策略 Nash 实施给出完整刻画，分别处理至少三人与两人的情形。
papers.noteEn: Characterizes implementation in pure-strategy Nash equilibrium, treating the cases of two and at least three agents separately.

papers.title: Bayesian Implementation
papers.note: 参与者持有私人信息时，刻画贝叶斯均衡中社会选择规则的实施条件。
papers.noteEn: Characterizes implementation of social choice rules in Bayesian equilibrium when agents have private information.

papers.title: Virtual Implementation in Nash Equilibrium
papers.note: 用彩票逼近目标结果，研究哪些规则可在 Nash 均衡中以任意精度实现。
papers.noteEn: Uses lotteries near the target outcome to study which rules can be implemented to arbitrary accuracy in Nash equilibrium.

papers.title: Virtual Implementation in Iteratively Undominated Strategies: Complete Information
papers.note: 在完全信息下，通过迭代剔除劣策略与小概率抽签实现近似目标。
papers.noteEn: Under complete information, uses iterated deletion of dominated strategies and small-probability lotteries to approach the target.

papers.title: On the Necessary and Sufficient Conditions for Nash Implementation
papers.note: 给出检查社会选择对应是否可以在 Nash 均衡中实施的构造方法。
papers.noteEn: Gives a constructive way to check whether a social choice correspondence is Nash implementable.

papers.title: A Necessary and Sufficient Condition for Two-Person Nash Implementation
papers.note: 为两名参与者的 Nash 实施单独给出必要充分条件。
papers.noteEn: Provides a necessary and sufficient condition for Nash implementation with two participants.

papers.title: Implementation with Evidence
papers.note: 参与者可以提交硬证据或在不同状态成本不同的证据时，以证据单调性刻画实施约束。
papers.noteEn: With hard evidence or evidence that costs different amounts across states, evidence monotonicity captures restrictions on implementation.

papers.title: Robust Implementation in Direct Mechanisms
papers.note: 在文中的单交叉相互依赖价值环境中，严格事后激励相容配合收缩性质可保证稳健实施。
papers.noteEn: In the paper's interdependent-value, single-crossing setting, strict ex post incentive compatibility and a contraction property guarantee robust implementation.

papers.title: Continuous virtual implementation: Complete information
papers.note: 当偏好轮廓只接近共同知识时，要求机制的所有均衡结果仍能任意逼近社会规则指定的结果。
papers.noteEn: When preference profiles are only close to common knowledge, continuous virtual implementation requires all equilibrium outcomes to remain arbitrarily close to the prescribed ones.

papers.title: Robust Implementation with Costly Information
papers.note: 参与者要付费了解状态，设计者又不了解高阶信念；在罕见偏好扰动和文中稳健性标准下，构造机制实施目标函数。
papers.noteEn: Agents pay to learn the state and the designer lacks higher-order beliefs. Under rare preference perturbations and the paper's robustness criterion, a mechanism implements the target function.

papers.title: Implementation in undominated strategies with applications to auction design, public good provision and matching
papers.authors: Saptarshi Mukherjee; Nozomu Muto; Arunava Sen
papers.role: 有限机制与未被支配策略
papers.note: 在有限机制中研究未被支配策略实施，允许同一状态对应多个结果，并将条件用于拍卖、公共品和匹配。
papers.noteEn: Studies implementation in undominated strategies by finite mechanisms, allowing multiple outcomes at one state, with applications to auctions, public goods and matching.

papers.title: Subgame perfect implementation: A full characterization
papers.role: 子博弈精炼的完整刻画
papers.note: 对以子博弈精炼均衡实施社会选择规则给出必要且充分条件，补全早期只覆盖部分边界的判据。
papers.noteEn: Gives necessary and sufficient conditions for subgame-perfect implementation, completing earlier partial criteria.

edges.label: 比较实施标准
edges.note: 给定机制中存在合适均衡，与设计机制使每个均衡都给出目标结果，是两个检验。
edges.noteEn: The existence of a desired equilibrium in a given mechanism and the requirement that every equilibrium deliver a target outcome are distinct tests.

edges.label: 改变均衡概念
edges.note: 从 Nash 均衡转向动态博弈中的子博弈精炼均衡。出发点是 1977 年已流传的 Maskin 结果。
edges.noteEn: Moves from Nash equilibrium to subgame perfection in dynamic games, building on Maskin's result circulated in 1977.

edges.label: 补全刻画
edges.note: 从必要条件和一组便于检查的充分条件，走向对可实施规则的必要充分刻画。
edges.noteEn: Moves from necessary conditions and convenient sufficient conditions to a necessary and sufficient characterization of implementable rules.

edges.label: 不完全信息实施
edges.note: 相对于给定状态下的 Nash 激励，类型须根据其条件信念评价偏离。
edges.noteEn: Unlike statewise Nash incentives, a type evaluates deviations under its conditional beliefs.

edges.label: 近似实施
edges.note: 将均衡结果与目标完全一致的要求放宽为任意接近。
edges.noteEn: Replaces exact equality of equilibrium and target outcomes with arbitrary closeness.

edges.label: 迭代剔除与近似
edges.note: 既改变对结果精确性的要求，也改变用于预测行为的解概念。
edges.noteEn: Changes both the accuracy requirement and the solution concept used to predict behavior.

edges.label: 可检验条件
edges.note: 与一般必要充分刻画并读，可区分规则存在哪种实施机制与如何检验条件。
edges.noteEn: Alongside the general characterization, this asks how to check whether an implementing mechanism exists.

edges.label: 两人实施
edges.note: 双人情形不能依赖第三人的消息协调，对可实施性的限制须单独处理。
edges.noteEn: A two-agent mechanism cannot use a third agent's message, requiring a separate treatment of implementability.

edges.label: 可提交的证据
edges.note: 允许状态影响参与者能够发送的消息，使一些不满足 Maskin 单调性的规则可以实施。
edges.noteEn: When the state changes which messages agents can send, some rules that fail Maskin monotonicity become implementable.

edges.label: 排除依赖特定信念的实施
edges.note: 要求迭代剔除严格劣势消息后仍选中目标，会在真报激励以外限制类型间的联动。
edges.noteEn: Requiring iterated dominance to select the target adds cross-type restrictions beyond incentives for truthful reporting.

edges.label: 近似共同知识
edges.note: 除了放宽目标结果的精确度，此处还扰动参与者关于偏好的共同知识。
edges.noteEn: In addition to relaxing exact implementation, the analysis perturbs common knowledge of preferences.

edges.label: 有成本的状态学习
edges.note: 同时把实施所需的信息看作须激励取得的投入，并检验对偏好扰动的敏感性。
edges.noteEn: Makes acquisition of implementation-relevant information an incentive problem and tests the effect of preference perturbations.

edges.label: 有限机制与未被支配策略
edges.note: 迭代剔除下的虚拟实施与有限机制中的未被支配策略实施，对预测行为和可出现结果有不同要求。
edges.noteEn: Virtual implementation by iterated deletion and implementation in undominated strategies with finite mechanisms impose different behavioral and outcome restrictions.

edges.label: 子博弈精炼的完整刻画
edges.note: Moore 与 Repullo 以子博弈精炼支持动态实施；新刻画给出这一均衡概念下完整的必要充分条件。
edges.noteEn: Moore and Repullo use subgame perfection for dynamic implementation. The subsequent characterization supplies necessary and sufficient conditions for this solution concept.

branches.questionEn: How can one design a game whose set of equilibrium outcomes coincides with a given social choice correspondence?
branches.boundaryEn: The revelation principle reproduces a given equilibrium outcome as a truthful equilibrium of a direct mechanism. Full implementation also restricts the outcomes of other equilibria. This branch emphasizes complete-information Nash and subgame-perfect implementation.

branches.name: 拍卖、信息与收入
branches.question: 卖方应把物品给谁、收多少钱？信息结构与竞争强度如何改变制度比较？
branches.boundary: 将独立私人价值、关联信号与相互依赖价值分别处理。任何收入排序都要说明价值结构、风险偏好和参与条件。

papers.title: Counterspeculation, Auctions, and Competitive Sealed Tenders
papers.note: 在私人价值的单物品第二价格拍卖中，付价由对手决定，揭示自己的估值是弱占优策略。
papers.noteEn: In a single-object second-price auction with private values, rivals determine the winner's payment. Bidding one's value is weakly dominant.

papers.title: Optimal Auction Design
papers.note: 独立私人信息下，将期望收入改写为虚拟盈余；正则时依虚拟价值配置，非正则时需熨平。
papers.noteEn: With independent private information, expected revenue can be expressed as virtual surplus. Allocation uses virtual values under regularity and ironing otherwise.

papers.title: A Theory of Auctions and Competitive Bidding
papers.authors: Paul R. Milgrom · Robert J. Weber
papers.note: 引入关联信号及相互依赖的价值，研究不同拍卖格式如何通过公开信息改变出价和收入。
papers.noteEn: Introduces affiliated signals and interdependent values to study how disclosure under different auction formats affects bidding and revenue.

papers.title: Auctions Versus Negotiations
papers.note: 在标准独立同分布、正则的价值基准下，额外引入一个竞标者可使无保留价的标准拍卖胜过原人数下的最优机制。
papers.noteEn: In the standard symmetric independent regular-value benchmark, a standard auction without a reserve and with one additional bidder can outperform the optimal mechanism with the original bidders.

papers.title: Optimal Auctions
papers.authors: John G. Riley; William F. Samuelson
papers.note: 比较一类标准拍卖的预期收入，刻画私人价值情形下卖方的最优保留价。
papers.noteEn: Compares expected receipts across standard auctions and characterizes the seller's optimal reserve in a private-value setting.

papers.title: Full Extraction of the Surplus in Bayesian and Dominant Strategy Auctions
papers.note: 当条件信念满足适当秩条件时，依赖其他报告的彩票支付可支持期望剩余的完全提取。
papers.noteEn: Under suitable rank conditions on conditional beliefs, payments contingent on others' reports can extract the expected surplus.

papers.title: The Winner's Curse and Public Information in Common Value Auctions
papers.note: 共同价值拍卖实验记录竞标者人数和公共信息如何影响过度出价及卖方收入。
papers.noteEn: Common-value experiments measure how bidder numbers and public information affect overbidding and seller revenue.

papers.title: An Efficient Ascending-Bid Auction for Multiple Objects
papers.note: 通过价格上升时逐步锁定单位，让具有递减边际价值的竞标者在多单位环境中实现有效配置。
papers.noteEn: A clinching procedure awards units as prices rise and supports efficiency with diminishing marginal values.

papers.title: Walrasian Equilibrium with Gross Substitutes
papers.note: 总替代性支持多物品市场的瓦尔拉斯均衡；充分复制的经济中，最低均衡价格与 VCG 支付相联系。
papers.noteEn: Gross substitutes support Walrasian equilibrium; in sufficiently replicated economies, the lowest equilibrium prices are linked to VCG payments.

papers.title: The Sample Complexity of Revenue Maximization
papers.note: 研究为每个竞标者观察多少个历史估值样本，才能在独立估值环境中学到接近最优收入的拍卖。
papers.noteEn: Asks how many past value samples per bidder suffice to learn a near-revenue-optimal auction under independent values.

papers.title: Clock Auctions and Radio Spectrum Reallocation
papers.note: 递减时钟在多物品采购中逐轮压低报价，对单一目标投标者具有直观可见的激励性质。
papers.noteEn: Descending clocks lower offers round by round in multi-item procurement and yield transparent incentive properties for single-minded bidders.

papers.title: A Universally Efficient Dynamic Auction for All Unimodular Demand Types
papers.note: 对满足幺模条件的需求类型构造异质不可分物品的动态拍卖，包括某些互补需求。真诚出价是事后精炼 Nash 均衡并实现效率。
papers.noteEn: Constructs a dynamic auction for heterogeneous indivisibilities with unimodular demand types, including some complements. Sincere bidding is an ex post perfect Nash equilibrium and yields efficiency.

papers.title: Combinatorial Auctions with Interdependent Valuations: SOS to the Rescue
papers.authors: Alon Eden; Michal Feldman; Amos Fiat; Kira Goldner; Anna R. Karlin
papers.note: 组合标的价值可以依赖所有人的私人信号。对信号具有次模性的估值允许在不要求传统单交叉的情况下构造福利近似机制。
papers.noteEn: Values for bundles can depend on everyone's signals. Submodularity over signals supports welfare approximation without the usual single-crossing requirement.

papers.title: A Case for Pay-as-Bid Auctions
papers.note: 研究多单位按报价支付与统一价格拍卖。论文的环境中，供给透明和完全披露能最大化按报价支付的收入，对统一价格不总如此。
papers.noteEn: In the paper's multi-unit model, supply transparency and full disclosure maximize pay-as-bid revenue, whereas uniform-price revenue need not be maximized by the same disclosure policy.

papers.title: The English Auction with Differentiated Commodities
papers.note: 在不可分异质商品和总替代性需求下，研究英式升价如何发现均衡价格并配置物品。
papers.noteEn: Studies how ascending prices discover equilibrium prices and allocate differentiated indivisible goods with gross substitutes.

edges.label: 改变目标
edges.note: 第二价格揭示私人价值的激励是基准；收入最优性允许保留价以及对不同竞标者的区别对待。
edges.noteEn: Second-price truth-telling is the private-value benchmark. A revenue-optimal mechanism can impose reserves and discriminate across bidders.

edges.label: 改变信息结构
edges.note: 其他人的信号会携带关于自己价值的信息，拍卖过程中披露的信息因此影响制度比较。
edges.noteEn: Rivals' signals can be informative about one's own value, making information disclosed during the auction relevant to format comparisons.

edges.label: 更换比较基准
edges.note: 拿已知人数下的最优设计与多一个竞争者的简易拍卖直接比较。
edges.noteEn: Directly compares optimal design for a fixed number of bidders with a simple auction that attracts one additional competitor.

edges.label: 保留价与收入
edges.note: 将一般最优机制与熟悉的拍卖格式及保留价选择对应起来。
edges.noteEn: Relates general optimal design to familiar auction formats and a choice of reserve.

edges.label: 相关类型与租金
edges.note: 类型相关使他人的报告可以用来区分本人的类型，独立私人信息基准下的租金随之改变。
edges.noteEn: Correlation makes others' reports useful for separating one's type, changing the rents in the independent-information benchmark.

edges.label: 实验检验
edges.note: 同样关心信息披露，但实验将均衡比较与实际出价及赢家诅咒对照。
edges.noteEn: The disclosure comparison is taken to the laboratory, where observed bidding can display the winner's curse.

edges.label: 多单位升价
edges.note: 把单物品的外部性支付逻辑转成对多单位需求的动态出价程序。
edges.noteEn: Translates the single-object externality-payment logic into a dynamic procedure for multi-unit demand.

edges.label: 价格与机制支付
edges.note: 用多物品竞争价格比较拍卖中的外部性支付。
edges.noteEn: Compares auction externality payments with competitive prices for several indivisible goods.

edges.label: 从样本学习拍卖
edges.note: 将收入最优机制中的已知分布改为可观察的有限历史样本。
edges.noteEn: Replaces the known distributions used in optimal auction design with finite historical samples.

edges.label: 使参与者看得见激励
edges.note: Vickrey 支付虽能实现真报，但逐步退出规则可以改变参与者判断最优行动所需的信息。
edges.noteEn: Even when Vickrey payments induce truthfulness, gradual exit can change what bidders must understand to act optimally.

edges.label: 幺模需求类型
edges.note: 从总替代性保障均衡价格，推进到在更广需求类型上以策略性动态程序实现配置。
edges.noteEn: Moves from equilibrium prices under gross substitutes to strategic dynamic allocation on a broader class of demand types.

edges.label: 信号的次模性
edges.note: 把相互依赖的价值从单个标的扩展到物品包，目标也转为可以保证的福利近似。
edges.noteEn: Extends interdependent values from one object to bundles and studies guaranteed welfare approximation.

edges.label: 多单位按报价支付
edges.note: 信息公开的收益效应也取决于各中标单位按自身报价还是同一清算价格付款。
edges.noteEn: The revenue effect of disclosure depends on whether units are paid for at their bids or at a common clearing price.

edges.label: 异质物品升价过程
edges.note: 把均衡价格存在性的静态结果转化为价格如何随超额需求调整的动态问题。
edges.noteEn: Turns a static price-existence result into a dynamic problem of adjusting prices in response to excess demand.

resources.title: Auction Theory: A Guide to the Literature

branches.questionEn: Who should receive the object, and what should the seller charge? How do information and competition affect comparisons across auction formats?
branches.boundaryEn: Independent private values, affiliated signals and interdependent values require separate treatment. A revenue ranking must specify the value structure, risk preferences and participation conditions.

branches.name: 多维筛选与多商品定价
branches.question: 客户的私人信息包含多个维度时，如何给不同类型配置商品并定价？
branches.boundary: 区分机制是否可实施、利润最优菜单的形状、简单菜单能保证的收入比例。不同结论对估值可加性、商品独立性和分布均有不同要求。

papers.title: A Necessary and Sufficient Condition for Rationalizability in a Quasi-Linear Context
papers.note: 刻画一个配置规则能否配上转移支付而成为激励相容机制；循环单调性把各类型之间的偏离连在一起。
papers.noteEn: Characterizes allocations that admit incentive-compatible transfers. Cyclical monotonicity links deviations across types.

papers.title: Multiproduct Nonlinear Pricing
papers.note: 多品垄断者面对多维私人信息，在文中连续类型环境与相应条件下，最优菜单会排除一部分低类型客户。
papers.noteEn: With multidimensional private information, the multiproduct monopolist's optimal menu excludes some low types in the paper's continuous-type setting under its stated conditions.

papers.title: Ironing, Sweeping, and Multidimensional Screening
papers.note: 给出多维筛选的存在性和刻画；通过类型混同解释许多不同类型为何选择同一配置。
papers.noteEn: Establishes existence and characterizes multidimensional screening. Bunching explains why different types can choose the same allocation.

papers.title: A Simple and Approximately Optimal Mechanism for an Additive Buyer
papers.authors: Moshe Babaioff · Nicole Immorlica · Brendan Lucier · S. Matthew Weinberg
papers.note: 单个可加买方、各物品估值独立时，分别定价与整包定价取优，能保证最优收入的一个常数比例。
papers.noteEn: For one additive buyer with independent item values, the better of separate sales and pure bundling guarantees a constant fraction of optimal revenue.

papers.title: Maximal Revenue with Multiple Goods: Nonmonotonicity and Other Observations
papers.note: 多个物品时，更高的估值分布不必提高最优收入；示例揭示随机菜单与单商品基准的差异。
papers.noteEn: With several goods, a higher value distribution need not increase optimal revenue. Examples highlight differences between randomized menus and the single-good benchmark.

papers.title: Multidimensional Incentive Compatibility and Mechanism Design
papers.note: 刻画多商品与多维类型的激励约束，应用于非线性定价和捆绑定价。
papers.noteEn: Characterizes incentive constraints for multiple goods and type dimensions and applies them to nonlinear pricing and bundling.

papers.title: Strong Duality for a Multiple-Good Monopolist
papers.authors: Constantinos Daskalakis; Alan Deckelbaum; Christos Tzamos
papers.note: 把可加买方的多商品收入最大化与最优传输对偶相联系，用对偶解验证菜单最优性。
papers.noteEn: Relates multiproduct revenue maximization for an additive buyer to an optimal transport dual that certifies optimal menus.

papers.title: Approximate Revenue Maximization with Multiple Items
papers.note: 为单个买方、多个独立物品估值建立简单销售方式相对于最优收入的保证。
papers.noteEn: Bounds revenue from simple selling methods relative to the optimum for one buyer with independent item values.

papers.title: Optimal Mechanism for Selling Two Goods
papers.note: 求解有私人需求特征的两商品销售模型，解释何时卖家愿意提供物品彩票。
papers.noteEn: Solves two-good models with private demand characteristics and explains when the seller offers lotteries over goods.

papers.title: Nested Bundling
papers.note: 在一维消费者异质性和准凹等条件下，用单独销售量与集合包含关系识别最优嵌套菜单。
papers.noteEn: With one-dimensional heterogeneity and quasi-concavity conditions, stand-alone sales quantities and set inclusion identify optimal nested menus.

papers.title: The Menu-Size Complexity of Revenue Approximation
papers.authors: Moshe Babaioff; Yannai A. Gonczarowski; Noam Nisan
papers.note: 研究给单个可加买方销售独立估值物品时，近似最优收入所需的菜单项数量。
papers.noteEn: Studies the number of menu entries needed to approximate optimal revenue from one additive buyer with independent item values.

papers.title: When Is Pure Bundling Optimal?
papers.note: 用对大捆绑的总估值与对小捆绑的相对估值之间的排序，给出全捆销售最优的条件。
papers.noteEn: Orders total values for the grand bundle against relative values for smaller bundles to obtain conditions for pure bundling.

papers.title: Multidimensional Screening With Precise Seller Information
papers.authors: Mira Frick; Ryota Iijima; Yuhta Ishii
papers.note: 当卖家对多维估值的信息趋于精确，整包销售的收入以与最优机制相同的速率接近第一最佳；分别出售的速率可不同。
papers.noteEn: As the seller's information about values becomes precise, pure bundling approaches first-best revenue at the optimal mechanism's rate. Separate sales can converge at a different rate.

papers.title: Costly Multidimensional Screening
papers.note: 类型同时影响生产性和造成浪费的筛选工具。当两者偏好满足论文定义的正相关条件，仅在生产性维度上筛选已最优。
papers.noteEn: Types value both productive and socially costly instruments. Under the paper's positive-dependence condition, screening only the productive component is optimal.

papers.title: A Characterization for Optimal Bundling of Products with Nonadditive Values
papers.role: 非可加估值的整包销售
papers.note: 在单调偏好和单峰利润下，整包单独销售的最优销量高于每一较小包的最优销量，恰好刻画整包销售最优。
papers.noteEn: With monotone preferences and single-peaked profits, pure bundling is optimal exactly when the grand bundle's stand-alone optimal quantity exceeds that of every smaller bundle.

papers.title: Multi-Dimensional Screening: Buyer-Optimal Learning and Informational Robustness
papers.note: 卖家知道多维估值的先验，却不知道买家会收到什么信号。对买方学习取最坏情形时，具有可交换先验的商品可最优地整包出售。
papers.noteEn: The seller knows the prior on values but not the signal the buyer will receive. Under exchangeable priors, pure bundling is robustly optimal against buyer learning.

edges.label: 运用激励约束
edges.note: 从给定分配能否实施，转到在可实施分配集合内求最优和刻画混同。
edges.noteEn: Moves from implementability of a given allocation to optimization and the characterization of bunching within the implementable set.

edges.label: 不同的最优畸变
edges.note: 两文分别揭示排除与混同。多维类型可能令一部分客户不交易，也可能让多个类型购买同一配置。
edges.noteEn: The two papers isolate exclusion and bunching. Some multidimensional types may abstain, while others choose the same allocation.

edges.label: 改变目标
edges.note: 从连续模型中的精确最优菜单转为独立、可加环境中简单定价的收入保证。
edges.noteEn: Moves from an exact optimal menu in continuous models to revenue guarantees for simple pricing with independent, additive values.

edges.label: 检验直觉
edges.note: 在离散多商品例子中检验从单商品最优收入推出的直觉。
edges.noteEn: Uses discrete multigood examples to test intuitions drawn from optimal single-good revenue.

edges.label: 多维激励的应用
edges.note: 从抽象的配置可实施性推进到需求未知时的垄断定价问题。
edges.noteEn: Takes implementability of allocations to monopoly pricing with unknown demand characteristics.

edges.label: 对偶证书
edges.note: 为刻画多维最优配置提供另一种证明工具，可直接检验候选菜单。
edges.noteEn: Provides a different proof tool for multidimensional optimal allocation by testing a candidate menu against a dual certificate.

edges.label: 简单定价的界
edges.note: 共同使用分别销售和捆绑销售作基准，比较保证随商品数和分布而变的方式。
edges.noteEn: Both analyze separate and bundled sales, comparing how guarantees depend on the number of goods and the value distribution.

edges.label: 两商品菜单
edges.note: 将多维筛选中的配置扭曲具体化为对两种物品的概率与数量选择。
edges.noteEn: Gives the distortion in multidimensional screening a concrete interpretation through quantities and lotteries over two goods.

edges.label: 嵌套捆绑
edges.note: 保留多产品但限制消费者异质性的维度，可以进一步刻画菜单中出现哪些包。
edges.noteEn: Retaining multiple products while restricting the dimension of heterogeneity gives sharper predictions about which bundles are offered.

edges.label: 菜单长度
edges.note: 从分别出售或整包出售的固定机制，转到按收入误差控制整个菜单的规模。
edges.noteEn: Moves from fixed separate-sale or bundling mechanisms to controlling menu size for a chosen revenue error.

edges.label: 何时一个菜单项足够
edges.note: 商品价值有多维异质性，但特定的价值排序能使所有部分捆绑在最优菜单中消失。
edges.labelEn: When a single menu item suffices
edges.noteEn: Despite multidimensional heterogeneity, restrictions on relative values can remove every partial bundle from the optimal menu.

edges.label: 卖方信息的精度
edges.note: 在多产品定价中引入越来越精确的卖方信息，用收入收敛速度比较简单菜单与最优筛选。
edges.noteEn: Adds increasingly precise seller information to multiproduct pricing and compares simple menus with optimal screening by revenue convergence rates.

edges.label: 有成本的筛选工具
edges.note: 从一般多维激励可行性转向判断何时值得为筛选额外制造社会成本。
edges.noteEn: Moves from multidimensional implementability to deciding when it is worth creating a real cost to screen types.

edges.label: 非可加估值的整包销售
edges.note: 独立比较各包的销量既可检验只卖整包，也可用于后续识别嵌套菜单。
edges.noteEn: Stand-alone quantities provide a test for pure bundling and later help identify nested menus.

edges.label: 买方学习的稳健定价
edges.note: 在既定类型分布下求最优菜单之外，把买家的信号结构也纳入收入比较。
edges.noteEn: Adds the buyer's signal structure to the revenue comparison for a given prior on types.

branches.questionEn: How should a seller allocate and price goods when customers have several dimensions of private information?
branches.boundaryEn: Implementability, the shape of an optimal menu and the revenue guarantee of a simple menu are separate questions. Results depend on additivity, independence across goods and distributional assumptions.

branches.name: 双边匹配与合同
branches.question: 能否找到没有阻挡对的稳定分配？哪些参与者愿意真实报告偏好？
branches.boundary: 双边稳定性以双方能否形成有利偏离衡量。机制的策略性质依赖哪一方提出申请、谁能操作，以及雇主如何比较一组合同。

papers.title: College Admissions and the Stability of Marriage
papers.note: 构造延迟接受算法，证明经典婚姻与招生模型存在稳定匹配，并展示提出申请的一方获得稳定集合中最有利的结果。
papers.noteEn: Constructs deferred acceptance, establishes existence in classic marriage and admissions models, and shows that proposers receive their best outcomes among stable matchings.

papers.title: The Economics of Matching: Stability and Incentives
papers.note: 在经典双边婚姻模型中，稳定程序不能同时保证两方所有参与者都有真实报告的占优策略。
papers.noteEn: In the classic two-sided marriage model, a stable procedure cannot make truth-telling a dominant strategy for every participant on both sides.

papers.title: Job Matching, Coalition Formation, and Gross Substitutes
papers.authors: Alexander S. Kelso, Jr. · Vincent P. Crawford
papers.note: 把工资与企业招聘多个工人纳入分配，以总替代性条件支撑逐步调整的匹配过程和稳定结果。
papers.noteEn: Introduces wages and firms hiring several workers. A gross-substitutes condition supports an iterative matching process and stable outcomes.

papers.title: Matching with Contracts
papers.authors: John William Hatfield · Paul R. Milgrom
papers.note: 将工作岗位、工资等条款编码为合同；通过选择函数的替代性与需求规律等条件区分稳定性与申请方的激励性质。
papers.noteEn: Encodes jobs, wages and other terms as contracts. Conditions on choice functions, including substitutes and the law of aggregate demand, distinguish stability guarantees from proposer incentives.

papers.title: Machiavelli and the Gale-Shapley Algorithm
papers.authors: Lester E. Dubins; David A. Freedman
papers.note: 在婚姻匹配中，提出申请的一组人不能通过合谋虚报使每名成员都严格获益。
papers.noteEn: In marriage matching no coalition of proposers can misreport so as to make each member strictly better off.

papers.title: On the Allocation of Residents to Rural Hospitals: A General Property of Two-Sided Matching Markets
papers.note: 在标准的医院－医生模型中，各医院录取人数在稳定结果间相同，未满额医院的录取名单也相同。
papers.noteEn: In the standard hospital–resident model each hospital fills the same number of places across stable matches, and an undersubscribed hospital receives the same residents.

papers.title: The Redesign of the Matching Market for American Physicians: Some Engineering Aspects of Economic Design
papers.note: 重新设计美国住院医师匹配程序，用计算实验检验夫妻等互补性偏离简单模型时的表现。
papers.noteEn: Redesigns the US physician match and uses computational experiments to study complementarities such as couples outside the simple model.

papers.title: Substitutes and Stability for Matching with Contracts
papers.note: 定义双边替代性与单边替代性，区分稳定匹配存在与申请方激励所需的条件。
papers.noteEn: Introduces bilateral and unilateral substitutes to separate conditions for stable existence and proposer incentives.

papers.title: A Fixed-Point Approach to Stable Matchings and Some Applications
papers.note: 用基于格的不动点方法表示稳定匹配，并将其用于更一般的稳定分配问题。
papers.noteEn: Uses a lattice fixed-point approach to stable matchings and applies it to more general stable allocation problems.

papers.title: Stability and Competitive Equilibrium in Trading Networks
papers.authors: John William Hatfield; Scott Duke Kominers; Alexandru Nichifor; Michael Ostrovsky; Alexander Westkamp
papers.note: 允许同一参与者既买又卖，通过完全替代性研究双边合同网络中的稳定性与竞争均衡。
papers.noteEn: Allows a participant to buy and sell, using full substitutability to study stability and competitive equilibrium in networks of bilateral contracts.

papers.title: Incentives and Stability in Large Two-Sided Matching Markets
papers.note: 在给定正则条件下，研究学生最优稳定机制中可通过操纵获益的参与者比例随市场扩张如何变化。
papers.noteEn: Under regularity conditions, the fraction able to gain by manipulating the student-optimal stable mechanism declines with market size.

papers.title: NONSTANDARD CHOICE IN MATCHING MARKETS
papers.note: 用参与者的选择行为刻画稳定且激励相容的匹配机制何时存在，允许选择偏离通常的偏好最大化。
papers.noteEn: Characterizes when stable, incentive-compatible matching mechanisms exist from participants' choice behavior, allowing departures from standard preference maximization.

papers.title: Matching with Externalities
papers.note: 允许一项配对的价值依赖其他配对。论文扩展替代性条件，在其成立时证明稳定匹配存在，并推广延迟接受。
papers.noteEn: Allows a match to depend on other matches. An extended substitutability condition yields stable existence and a version of deferred acceptance.

papers.title: Stable Matching with Mistaken Agents
papers.authors: Georgy Artemov; Yeon-Koo Che; YingHua He
papers.note: 研究申请者可能犯错时的大型延迟接受市场，并给出均衡结果何时仍接近真实申报下稳定分配的条件。
papers.noteEn: Studies large deferred acceptance markets with mistakes and gives conditions under which equilibrium outcomes still approximate the stable allocation under truthful reports.

papers.title: Stability in Large Matching Markets with Complementarities
papers.authors: Itai Ashlagi; Mark Braverman; Avinatan Hassidim
papers.note: 在有夫妻共同申请的随机市场中，若夫妻数量增长慢于市场规模，算法以高概率找到稳定匹配；夫妻数线性增长时可能持续不存在稳定匹配。
papers.noteEn: In random markets with couples, an algorithm finds a stable match with high probability when couples grow sublinearly; nonexistence can persist when they grow linearly.

edges.label: 加入私人报告
edges.note: 算法可以从任一给定排序生成稳定结果，但参与者有动机改变其报告。
edges.noteEn: An algorithm can produce a stable outcome for any reported rankings, yet participants may wish to misreport.

edges.label: 纳入工资
edges.note: 从给定两方排名转到可以协商工资、企业对工人集合有需求的劳动市场。
edges.noteEn: Moves from fixed rankings on each side to negotiable wages and firms that demand sets of workers.

edges.label: 统一合同表示
edges.note: 合同同时标识交易双方和条款，企业对合同集合的选择函数可以表达带工资的劳动匹配。
edges.noteEn: A contract identifies both parties and the terms of trade. Firms' choice functions over contract sets can represent labor matching with wages.

edges.label: 申请方联合操纵
edges.note: 对给定排名的算法性质，延伸至多个申请者共同改变排名的后果。
edges.noteEn: Extends the algorithmic analysis at fixed rankings to simultaneous deviations by multiple proposers.

edges.label: 稳定结果中的空缺
edges.note: 稳定匹配可能不唯一，但部分医院的招生结果在整个稳定集合中不变。
edges.noteEn: Although stable matchings need not be unique, some recruitment outcomes are invariant across the stable set.

edges.label: 夫妻与实际市场
edges.note: 将经典稳定程序的操纵边界与有限申请名单及双人联合需求下的实际机会相比较。
edges.noteEn: Compares textbook manipulation limits with actual opportunities under short lists and joint demand by couples.

edges.label: 较弱替代条件
edges.note: 检验合同匹配中的完全替代性在哪些结论中能够进一步减弱。
edges.noteEn: Tests where the full substitutes condition in matching with contracts can be weakened.

edges.label: 不动点构造
edges.note: 不动点是比较双边选择与合同稳定性的共同数学工具。
edges.noteEn: Fixed points provide a common mathematical tool for comparing two-sided choice and contract stability.

edges.label: 交易网络中的合同
edges.note: 将合同选择从固定的两侧市场扩展至同一中间商同时签署上游和下游合同。
edges.noteEn: Extends contract choice from fixed market sides to intermediaries who sign both upstream and downstream contracts.

edges.label: 量化最坏情形的普遍程度
edges.note: 存在可操纵实例并不说明典型参与者能否得益；市场序列给出渐近答案。
edges.noteEn: Finite counterexamples do not show how often participants can gain, which a sequence of large markets helps determine.

edges.label: 非标准选择行为
edges.note: 以选择函数表示合同时，可以问哪些行为限制足以支持市场设计，而不预设每次选择都最大化一个排序。
edges.noteEn: A choice-function representation makes it possible to test which behavioral restrictions suffice without assuming maximization of a ranking.

edges.label: 匹配外部性
edges.note: 原有合同模型中对一组可选合同的选择，现在还取决于市场上其他人的安排。
edges.noteEn: Choice from a set of contracts now also depends on the arrangements made by others in the market.

edges.label: 错误申报与大市场
edges.note: 经典策略无关讨论真实报告是否最优；这里另问即便有人没有这样做，结果会偏离多少。
edges.noteEn: Classical strategy-proofness asks whether honesty is optimal. This asks how far outcomes can move when some applicants nevertheless make mistakes.

edges.label: 夫妻互补与市场规模
edges.note: 夫妻对两个岗位的联合需求打破替代性；市场厚度有时可以缓解稳定性问题。
edges.noteEn: Couples' joint demand for positions violates substitutes. Market thickness can nevertheless restore existence with high probability.

resources.title: Two-Sided Matching: A Study in Game-Theoretic Modeling and Analysis
resources.authors: Alvin E. Roth · Marilda A. Oliveira Sotomayor

branches.questionEn: Does an allocation free of blocking pairs exist? Which participants have incentives to report their preferences truthfully?
branches.boundaryEn: Two-sided stability examines mutually beneficial deviations. Strategic properties depend on who proposes, who can manipulate and how employers evaluate sets of contracts.

branches.name: 学校选择与交换市场
branches.question: 在禁止价格清算的环境，怎样用优先权、席位和交换环来分配稀缺资源？
branches.boundary: 学校优先权与学生偏好不是同一种权利。住房或肾脏交换还涉及初始禀赋、兼容性与允许的环长度。

papers.title: On Cores and Indivisibility
papers.note: 房屋不可分、每人初始拥有一套房屋；核心存在，文中介绍的顶端交易环算法可构造核心配置。
papers.noteEn: Each agent initially owns one indivisible house. The core exists, and the top trading cycles algorithm described in the paper constructs a core allocation.

papers.title: A Tale of Two Mechanisms: Student Placement
papers.note: 研究学生拥有偏好、席位由考试等规定优先次序的配置问题，并据此比较入学制度。
papers.noteEn: Studies students with preferences over seats allocated under priorities such as exam scores, and uses this model to compare admissions systems.

papers.title: School Choice: A Mechanism Design Approach
papers.note: 在席位容量和学校优先权下，比较延迟接受与顶端交易环，并解释优先权、公平及帕累托效率的关系。
papers.noteEn: Compares deferred acceptance and top trading cycles with school capacities and priorities, explaining the relationship between priority, fairness and Pareto efficiency.

papers.title: Kidney Exchange
papers.authors: Alvin E. Roth · Tayfun Sönmez · M. Utku Ünver
papers.note: 将不可分资源交换用于不相容的患者与捐献人，研究交易环及包含候补名单选项的安排。
papers.noteEn: Adapts indivisible-resource exchange to incompatible patient–donor pairs, studying cycles and arrangements that include a waiting-list option.

papers.title: Pairwise Kidney Exchange
papers.authors: Alvin E. Roth · Tayfun Sönmez · M. Utku Ünver
papers.note: 当制度仅允许两个患者－捐献者对彼此交换时，在相容图上重新研究有效分配和激励。
papers.noteEn: When only two patient–donor pairs may exchange with each other, revisits efficient allocations and incentives on the compatibility graph.

papers.title: Leveling the Playing Field: Sincere and Sophisticated Players in the Boston Mechanism
papers.note: 允许部分家庭按真偏好申请，另一些家庭策略填报，考察 Boston 机制如何在不同参与者间分配优势。
papers.noteEn: Allows some families to apply sincerely and others strategically, and studies how the Boston mechanism allocates advantages across participants.

papers.title: School Choice with Consent
papers.note: 允许被特定优先权阻挡的改进在有关学生同意时进行，从而提高延迟接受的效率。
papers.noteEn: Allows priority waivers with students' consent to obtain efficiency improvements over deferred acceptance.

papers.title: What's the Matter with Tie-Breaking? Improving Efficiency in School Choice
papers.note: 任意打破学校优先权中的并列会损失效率；文中构造稳定改进程序。
papers.noteEn: Arbitrary tie-breaking in school priorities can sacrifice efficiency; the paper constructs stable improvement procedures.

papers.title: Strategy-Proofness versus Efficiency in Matching with Indifferences: Redesigning the NYC High School Match
papers.authors: Atila Abdulkadiroğlu; Parag A. Pathak; Alvin E. Roth
papers.note: 利用纽约高中的实际设计，研究学校并列优先权下策略无关与效率的冲突。
papers.noteEn: Uses the New York high school redesign to study the tension between strategy-proofness and efficiency with priority ties.

papers.title: Efficient Kidney Exchange: Coincidence of Wants in Markets with Compatibility-Based Preferences
papers.authors: Alvin E. Roth; Tayfun Sönmez; M. Utku Ünver
papers.note: 研究基于兼容性的肾脏交换，比较允许两对与更多对互换时可实现的移植。
papers.noteEn: Studies compatibility-based kidney exchange and compares transplants attainable with two-way and larger cycles.

papers.title: Dynamic Kidney Exchange
papers.note: 在患者－捐献者对随时间进入时，比较现在交换与等待未来相容配对之间的取舍。
papers.noteEn: With arriving patient–donor pairs, studies the trade-off between exchanging now and waiting for future compatible pairs.

papers.title: School Admissions Reform in Chicago and England: Comparing Mechanisms by Their Vulnerability to Manipulation
papers.note: 以可以获利操纵的偏好轮廓比较招生制度，应用于芝加哥与英格兰的改革。
papers.noteEn: Ranks admissions rules by the preference profiles admitting profitable manipulation and applies the comparison to reforms in Chicago and England.

papers.title: The Welfare Effects of Coordinated Assignment: Evidence from the New York City High School Match
papers.authors: Atila Abdulkadiroğlu, Nikhil Agarwal & Parag A. Pathak
papers.note: 利用纽约高中招生改革前后的数据，比较分散发放录取与协调分配对学生福利的影响。
papers.noteEn: New York high-school admissions data compare student welfare under uncoordinated offers and coordinated assignment.

papers.title: Improving Transparency and Verifiability in School Admissions: Theory and Experiment
papers.note: 学校派位算法即便已公布，学生通常也看不到其他人的输入。论文用截止线和逐校询问等反馈提高可核验性，并开展实验。
papers.noteEn: Even a published assignment rule can be hard to verify when others' inputs are hidden. The paper studies cutoff feedback and school-by-school elicitation and tests them experimentally.

papers.title: Regret‐free truth‐telling in school choice with consent
papers.note: 在不完全信息下，效率调整后的延迟接受允许操纵，但如实申报可满足文中无后悔的报告准则。
papers.noteEn: Under incomplete information, efficiency-adjusted deferred acceptance can be manipulated, yet truth-telling satisfies the paper's regret-free reporting criterion.

papers.title: Constrained school choice
papers.note: 每个学生最多只能申报固定数目的学校。论文分析截短志愿表如何改变申报博弈及不同派位程序的结果。
papers.noteEn: Students may declare only a fixed number of schools acceptable. The paper analyzes how that restriction changes the reporting game and outcomes across assignment rules.

papers.title: Pairwise Kidney Exchange over the Blood Group Barrier
papers.note: 允许原本血型不兼容的捐献者在额外治疗后成为可选对象，区分兼容与条件兼容，重新分析双向交换的配置。
papers.noteEn: Adds donors who become compatible only after additional treatment, distinguishing compatible and conditionally compatible donors in pairwise exchange.

edges.label: 制度迁移
edges.note: 将学生与席位的优先权模型用于公共学校选择，比较不同分配规则。
edges.noteEn: Uses a priority-based model of students and seats to compare allocation rules in public school choice.

edges.label: 迁移算法
edges.note: 用交换环配置学校席位时，要先说明初始席位的优先权从何而来。
edges.noteEn: Applying trading cycles to school seats requires specifying who initially holds priority for each seat.

edges.label: 迁移市场
edges.note: 用住房交换的思想组织患者与不相容捐献者之间的交换关系。
edges.noteEn: Uses the housing-exchange idea to organize trades among patients and their incompatible donors.

edges.label: 收紧可行集
edges.note: 把可行交换限制在两个患者－捐献者对，原先可行的长环随之消失。
edges.noteEn: Limiting exchanges to two patient–donor pairs removes longer cycles from the feasible set.

edges.label: 放宽行为同质性
edges.note: 在实际招生程序中比较真诚申请者与懂得策略填报的家庭。
edges.noteEn: Compares sincere applicants with families who know how to report strategically in an actual admissions procedure.

edges.label: 自愿让渡优先权
edges.note: 追问消除哪些优先权冲突能改善学生福利，以及征得谁的同意。
edges.noteEn: Identifies which priority conflicts block welfare gains and whose consent can release them.

edges.label: 并列优先权
edges.note: 将严格优先序改为允许并列，出现既尊重原有优先权又改进分配的空间。
edges.noteEn: Allowing priority ties leaves room for improvements that still respect the original priorities.

edges.label: 纽约高中派位
edges.note: 把抽签打破并列的方式带入大型招生程序，以数据评估机制之间的差别。
edges.noteEn: Brings lottery tie-breaking into a large admissions system and assesses the differences using market data.

edges.label: 不同长度的交换环
edges.note: 将只允许双向交换的可行集扩大，量化新循环可以缓解哪些不相容问题。
edges.noteEn: Expands the feasible set beyond pairwise exchange and examines which incompatibilities longer cycles can overcome.

edges.label: 等待与未来匹配
edges.note: 给定相容图上的静态交换，变成面向未来到达者的动态分配。
edges.noteEn: Static exchange on a given compatibility graph becomes dynamic allocation with future arrivals.

edges.label: 操纵机会的包含关系
edges.note: 从家庭策略经验不同造成的后果，转到比较规则本身为操纵提供多少机会。
edges.noteEn: Moves from differences in families' strategic sophistication to comparing how many opportunities the rules themselves permit.

edges.label: 衡量消除录取拥堵的收益
edges.note: 稳定匹配之外，还可估计集中发放录取减少空缺与错配给学生带来多大收益。
edges.labelEn: Measuring gains from reducing offer congestion
edges.noteEn: Beyond stability, the reform makes it possible to estimate welfare gains from relieving congestion and misallocation.

edges.label: 派位结果的可核验性
edges.note: 在比较规则的效率和激励之外，考察学生如何确认公布的规则在自己身上被正确执行。
edges.noteEn: Adds the student's ability to verify execution to comparisons based on efficiency and reporting incentives.

edges.label: 后悔与优先权让渡
edges.note: 当程序允许学生放弃优先权时，可用偏离事后是否会后悔来评价通常的占优策略条件之外的激励。
edges.noteEn: When priorities can be waived, regret after a possible deviation provides an incentive test beyond ordinary dominant strategies.

edges.label: 志愿表长度上限
edges.note: 当学生无法提交完整偏好时，选择哪些学校进入名单本身成为策略。
edges.noteEn: With full rankings unavailable, deciding which schools to list becomes a strategic choice.

edges.label: 血型屏障与条件兼容
edges.note: 双向交换的边数可以因医疗技术增多，但新增边对患者的代价不同，原先的二元兼容模型需要扩展。
edges.noteEn: Medical technology adds edges to the exchange graph at patient-specific costs, extending binary compatibility.

branches.questionEn: When prices cannot clear the market, how can priorities, seats and trading cycles allocate scarce resources?
branches.boundaryEn: School priorities and student preferences encode different rights. Housing and kidney exchange also depend on initial endowments, compatibility and permitted cycle lengths.

branches.name: 公共决策、预算与有效交易
branches.en: Public decisions, budget balance, and trade
branches.question: 何时能够在收支可行的同时，让有私人信息的人真实报告并实现有效配置？
branches.boundary: 预算逐状态平衡、期望收支及个体参与是不同要求。占优策略的支付结构与贝叶斯激励的支付结构也不同。

papers.title: Multipart Pricing of Public Goods
papers.note: 在公共决策中，用个人报告对其他人造成的外部性构造支付。
papers.noteEn: Constructs public-decision payments using the externality an individual's report imposes on others.

papers.title: Incentives in Teams
papers.note: 在可转移效用下，以他人报告福利等项构造奖励，使个人的激励与有效决策一致。
papers.noteEn: With transferable utility, rewards based on others' reported welfare align individual incentives with efficient decisions.

papers.title: Characterization of Satisfactory Mechanisms for the Revelation of Preferences for Public Goods
papers.note: 在文中丰富的准线性偏好域上刻画有效且占优策略诚实的机制，由转移支付的结构揭示收支兼顾的限制。
papers.noteEn: Characterizes efficient, dominant-strategy truthful mechanisms on the paper's rich quasilinear domain. The transfer structure exposes limits to budget balance.

papers.title: Incentives and Incomplete Information
papers.note: 转向贝叶斯均衡，在信念满足相应条件时，通过预期外部性的转移支付实现有效配置并处理预算平衡。
papers.noteEn: Uses expected-externality transfers in Bayesian equilibrium to implement efficient allocations and address budget balance under appropriate belief conditions.

papers.title: Efficient Mechanisms for Bilateral Trading
papers.authors: Roger B. Myerson · Mark A. Satterthwaite
papers.note: 买卖双方的独立私人估值具有重叠支持时，事后有效交易与贝叶斯激励、个体理性及无外部补贴一般不能兼得。
papers.noteEn: When independent private buyer and seller values have overlapping supports, ex post efficiency generally conflicts with Bayesian incentives, individual rationality and the absence of outside subsidies.

papers.title: Optimal Decision-Making with Minimal Waste: Strategyproof Redistribution of VCG Payments
papers.note: 在部分估值域中返还 VCG 付款，保留占优策略激励并减少留在系统外的资金。
papers.noteEn: Redistributes VCG payments on suitable valuation domains, preserving dominant-strategy incentives while reducing money withheld from the agents.

papers.title: On the Nonexistence of a Dominant Strategy Mechanism for Making Optimal Public Decisions
papers.note: 在一类公共决策环境中，证明策略无关的决策程序无法总是得到帕累托最优结果。
papers.noteEn: Establishes a conflict between strategy-proof choice and Pareto optimality in a class of public-decision environments.

papers.title: Optimal Allocation of Public Goods: A Solution to the “Free Rider” Problem
papers.note: 通过消息与税收规则，把公共品供给的搭便车问题表述为均衡中的有效配置。
papers.noteEn: Uses messages and tax rules to address free riding through efficient equilibrium provision of public goods.

papers.title: A Dominant Strategy Double Auction
papers.note: 构造多买多卖的占优策略双向拍卖，必要时牺牲一笔边际交易以避免外部补贴。
papers.noteEn: Constructs a dominant-strategy double auction that may forgo a marginal trade to avoid an outside subsidy.

papers.title: Robust Trading Mechanisms
papers.authors: Kathleen M. Hagerty; William P. Rogerson
papers.note: 在文中的双边自主交易环境，使双方都拥有占优策略的机制基本限于预先报价、双方同意才成交。
papers.noteEn: In the paper's bilateral trading environment, dominant strategies for both sides essentially restrict trade to posted prices accepted by both.

papers.title: Approximating Gains from Trade in Two-Sided Markets via Simple Mechanisms
papers.authors: Johannes Brustle; Yang Cai; Fa Wu; Mingfei Zhao
papers.note: 在双边市场中，以简单机制近似实现激励、参与和预算约束下的交易收益基准。
papers.noteEn: Uses simple mechanisms to approximate a gains-from-trade benchmark subject to incentive, participation and budget constraints in two-sided markets.

papers.title: (Almost) Efficient Mechanisms for Bilateral Trading
papers.note: 在无法保证完全有效的双边交易中，构造简单机制，并区分总福利与净交易增益的近似保证。
papers.noteEn: Constructs simple mechanisms for bilateral trade and distinguishes approximation of total welfare from that of gains from trade.

papers.title: Ready to trade? On budget-balanced efficient trade with uncertain arrival
papers.note: 买卖双方的估值和成本随时间变化，也在随机时点准备交易。论文研究重复交易中怎样协调有效配置与预算平衡。
papers.noteEn: Values and costs evolve and each trader becomes available at a random time. The paper studies efficient budget-balanced mechanisms for repeated trade.

papers.title: Balanced VCG mechanisms for sequencing problems
papers.authors: Youngsub Chun; Manipushpak Mitra; Suresh Mutuswami
papers.role: 排序问题中的预算平衡
papers.note: 把平衡的 VCG 支付应用于处理顺序的选择，刻画如何在给定排队技术下协调有效排序和收支。
papers.noteEn: Extends balanced VCG payments to sequencing problems, studying how the scheduling technology permits efficient ordering and balanced transfers.

papers.title: Optimal information structures in bilateral trade
papers.note: 同时选择双方获得的信息和交易机制，最大化期望交易收益；在二元底层类型模型中定量比较其与第一最佳的差距。
papers.noteEn: Jointly selects information and a trading mechanism to maximize expected gains from trade, quantifying the remaining gap from first best for binary underlying types.

papers.title: Efficient Mechanisms for Public Goods with Use Exclusions
papers.roleEn: Excludable use of a public good
papers.note: 公共品可对部分人限制使用时，研究最优供给与收费，并刻画大市场中以固定供给和固定价格近似最优机制的条件。
papers.noteEn: Studies optimal provision and charges when use of a public good can be withheld, and conditions for approximation by fixed provision and fixed fees in large markets.

edges.label: 支付规则关系
edges.note: Clarke 枢轴支付可写成 Groves 支付族的一种选择。
edges.noteEn: The Clarke pivot payment is a particular choice within the Groves family.

edges.label: 扩展至必要性
edges.note: 从一类实现有效与诚实的支付出发，追问在丰富域上还能有何别的支付规则。
edges.noteEn: Starts from a class of efficient truthful transfers and asks which other payment rules are possible on a rich domain.

edges.label: 改变激励标准
edges.note: 用信念和贝叶斯激励条件放松逐状态的占优激励，从而重新考察预算平衡。
edges.noteEn: Beliefs and Bayesian incentives relax the state-by-state requirements of dominant strategies, reopening the question of budget balance.

edges.label: 加入自愿交易
edges.note: 贝叶斯激励并不自动保证有效预算可行；双边贸易中的参与约束给出新的限制。
edges.noteEn: Bayesian incentives alone do not ensure efficient, financially feasible trade. Participation constraints introduce a further limit in bilateral trade.

edges.label: 返还收入
edges.note: 将枢轴支付的收入与取决于其他人报告的返还项组合，研究可实现的预算改善。
edges.noteEn: Adds rebates depending on others' reports to pivot payments and studies the resulting improvement in budget use.

edges.label: 公共决策的不可能性
edges.note: 与支付刻画结合阅读，可以比较公共决策中的帕累托要求和私人偏离约束。
edges.noteEn: Alongside the transfer characterization, compares Pareto requirements with individual deviation constraints in public decisions.

edges.label: Nash 公共品机制
edges.note: 同样借助转移支付，改用 Nash 均衡来协调公共品供给及融资。
edges.noteEn: Uses transfers but changes the incentive criterion to Nash equilibrium to coordinate provision and financing.

edges.label: 减少一笔交易
edges.note: 从单一买卖对的效率不可能性，转向竞争市场中可以控制多少效率损失。
edges.noteEn: Moves from bilateral impossibility to controlling the efficiency loss with multiple buyers and sellers.

edges.label: 张贴价格
edges.note: 在同一个双边交易问题上加强激励标准，可以刻画机制的具体价格形式。
edges.noteEn: Strengthening incentives in bilateral trade yields a specific characterization of admissible pricing rules.

edges.label: 可达交易收益的近似
edges.note: 知道第一最佳不可普遍实现之后，改问简单机制与可行基准之间有多大差距。
edges.noteEn: After first-best impossibility, measures the gap between a simple mechanism and a feasible benchmark.

edges.label: 改变近似的分母
edges.note: 机制接近最优总福利，并不意味着能取得相同比例的新增交易收益。
edges.noteEn: Approximating total welfare does not imply capturing the same fraction of the incremental gains from trade.

edges.label: 随机到达的买卖双方
edges.note: 除了估值私有，交易何时能开始也会影响重复双边交易可实现的剩余。
edges.noteEn: In addition to private valuations, uncertainty about when trade can start changes the surplus attainable over repeated transactions.

edges.label: 排序问题中的预算平衡
edges.note: 在具体可行集上利用排序结构，检验一般 Groves 转移能否通过返还实现预算平衡。
edges.noteEn: Uses the structure of a sequencing environment to test whether a Groves transfer can be balanced by rebates.

edges.label: 设计交易前的信息
edges.note: 固定信息后产生的交易损失，在允许预先设计信号时可以缩小。
edges.noteEn: The loss from private information under a fixed signal structure can shrink when signals are designed before trade.

edges.label: 公共品的使用排除
edges.labelEn: Excludable use of a public good
edges.note: 排除使用增加了可用于筛选个体的配置维度，从而改变公共品机制的融资问题。
edges.noteEn: Exclusion adds an allocation instrument for screening individuals and changes the public-good financing problem.

resources.title: Mechanism Design Theory
resources.authors: Prize Committee of the Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences

branches.questionEn: When can a mechanism elicit private information truthfully and allocate efficiently while financing its transfers?
branches.boundaryEn: State-by-state budget balance, expected balance and voluntary participation are distinct requirements. Dominant-strategy and Bayesian incentives also imply different transfer structures.

branches.name: 对信念与分布的稳健设计
branches.question: 设计者不愿指定完整的信念结构、联合分布或需求分布时，哪些机制仍然可行、能保证怎样的收益？
branches.boundary: 稳健实施、最坏情形收益、极小极大遗憾是不同目标。每个结果的内容都取决于什么已知、什么容许变化。

papers.title: Robust Mechanism Design
papers.note: 固定支付相关的类型，允许更丰富的信念与类型空间，考察在所有这类空间内实施目标与事后激励之间的关系。
papers.noteEn: Fixes payoff-relevant types while allowing richer beliefs and type spaces, and relates implementation across all such spaces to ex post incentives.

papers.title: Foundations of Dominant-Strategy Mechanisms
papers.note: 在卖方掌握估值分布而对竞标者信念缺乏了解的设定，给出占优策略拍卖获得稳健收益基础的条件。
papers.noteEn: When the seller knows the value distribution but has little information about bidder beliefs, gives conditions supporting dominant-strategy auctions on robust revenue grounds.

papers.title: Pricing without Priors
papers.note: 卖家掌握的估值信息有限，选择随机定价策略，使相对知晓估值的基准所产生的最大遗憾最小。
papers.noteEn: A seller with limited information about values randomizes prices to minimize maximum regret relative to a benchmark that knows the realized value.

papers.title: Robustness and Separation in Multidimensional Screening
papers.note: 各维度的边际分布已知，联合依赖结构未知；在其可分环境下，分别筛选各维度可以最大化最坏情形收益。
papers.noteEn: Marginal distributions are known but their dependence is unknown. Under the paper's separability conditions, screening dimensions separately maximizes worst-case revenue.

papers.title: Robust Implementation in General Mechanisms
papers.note: 在一般机制中，研究目标是否对丰富类型空间中的所有相关均衡都成立，并给出稳健实施条件。
papers.noteEn: Studies whether target outcomes survive all relevant equilibria across rich type spaces and derives conditions for robust implementation in general mechanisms.

papers.title: First-Price Auctions with General Information Structures: Implications for Bidding and Revenue
papers.authors: Dirk Bergemann; Benjamin Brooks; Stephen Morris
papers.role: 一般信号下的一价拍卖
papers.note: 在给定估值环境和多种信息结构下，刻画一价拍卖的投标与收入边界。
papers.noteEn: Bounds first-price bids and revenues across information structures for a given value environment.

papers.title: Robustness and Linear Contracts
papers.note: 委托人只掌握部分行动技术时，以最坏情形收益评价激励合同，并推导线性支付的稳健性质。
papers.noteEn: Evaluates contracts by worst-case profit when the principal knows only part of the action technology, deriving a robustness rationale for linear pay.

papers.title: Optimal Auction Design with Common Values: An Informationally Robust Approach
papers.note: 已知共同价值的先验，但不指定竞标者信号结构时，研究如何最大化最坏情形均衡收入。
papers.noteEn: Given a prior on the common value, studies how to maximize worst-case equilibrium revenue without fixing bidders' information structures.

papers.title: Robust Monopoly Pricing
papers.note: 需求分布在给定模型附近波动，比较最大最小利润与最小最大遗憾所导出的报价。
papers.noteEn: With demand distributions in a neighborhood of a reference model, compares maximin profit and minimax-regret prices.

papers.title: Correlation-Robust Auction Design
papers.role: 竞标者之间的未知相关性
papers.note: 只知道各竞标者的边际估值分布时，分析不同联合相关结构下拍卖可保证的收入。
papers.noteEn: When only bidders' marginal value distributions are known, studies auction revenue guarantees across joint dependence structures.

papers.title: Robustly Optimal Auctions with Unknown Resale Opportunities
papers.note: 设计者不确定拍后如何转售，最坏转售环境会改变通过低效率分配压低信息租金的价值。
papers.noteEn: An unknown resale market changes the value of inefficient initial assignments for reducing information rents.

papers.title: On the Robustness of Second-Price Auctions in Prior-Independent Mechanism Design
papers.authors: Jerry Anunrojwong; Santiago R. Balseiro; Omar Besbes
papers.role: 随机保留价与最坏遗憾
papers.note: 只给定估值上界时，研究卖方相对完全信息基准的最大遗憾；一系列分布类别下，带随机保留价的二价拍卖达到最小最大遗憾。
papers.noteEn: With only a bound on values, studies regret relative to a full-information benchmark. A second-price auction with a random reserve minimizes worst-case regret across several distribution classes.

papers.title: Worst‐case equilibria in first‐price auctions
papers.note: 竞标人只掌握对手估值分布的均值。论文定义基于最坏情形推理的均衡，并在模型内得到实质唯一且有效的一价拍卖均衡。
papers.noteEn: Bidders know only the mean of rivals' value distributions. Under the paper's worst-case reasoning, first-price equilibrium is essentially unique and efficient.

papers.title: Robust Revenue Maximization Under Minimal Statistical Information
papers.authors: Yiannis Giannakopoulos; Diogo Poças; Alexandros Tsigonias-Dimitriadis
papers.note: 面对单个可加买方，卖家只知道每项估值的均值和标准差上界，且各项可相关。比较简单机制与知道完整分布的最优收入。
papers.noteEn: For an additive buyer, only each item's mean and a standard-deviation bound are known, and values may be correlated. Benchmarks mechanisms against revenue with a known distribution.

papers.title: Minimax Regret Robust Screening with Moment Information
papers.authors: Shixin Wang; Shaoxuan Liu; Jiawei Zhang
papers.note: 卖家只知估值的矩和支持集，用线性规划求使收益相对完全信息事后基准的最坏比例尽可能高的筛选机制。
papers.noteEn: With moments and support information, formulates screening as a linear program maximizing worst-case relative performance against a hindsight benchmark.

edges.label: 从可实施性转向收益
edges.note: 允许信念变化后，一个问题问社会规则能否实施，另一个问题问拍卖能保证多少收入。
edges.noteEn: With varying beliefs, one problem asks whether a social rule can be implemented and the other asks what revenue an auction can guarantee.

edges.label: 比较稳健目标
edges.note: 收益保证与相对个别状态的最佳定价之遗憾比较，使用不同的基准。
edges.noteEn: A revenue guarantee and regret relative to the best price in each state use different benchmarks.

edges.label: 改变未知对象
edges.note: 两文分别在竞标者信念与多维类型之间的未知相关性上做最坏情形比较。
edges.noteEn: The papers take worst cases over bidder beliefs and over dependence across dimensions of private types, respectively.

edges.label: 稳健的完全实施
edges.note: 从诚实均衡是否存在，进一步要求其他均衡也无法选出错误结果。
edges.noteEn: Strengthens the existence of a desired truthful equilibrium by also controlling outcomes in other equilibria.

edges.label: 一般信号下的一价拍卖
edges.note: 固定拍卖格式后，估值和信念之间的未知关系仍可引起很大的收入差别。
edges.noteEn: Holding the auction format fixed isolates revenue variation caused by unspecified information.

edges.label: 未知行动集
edges.note: 将未知的跨维相关性改为未知行动机会，比较不同信息缺口为何支持简单机制。
edges.noteEn: Replaces unknown dependence across dimensions with unknown actions to compare why different information gaps support simple mechanisms.

edges.label: 共同价值的收入保证
edges.note: 从具有私人价值的稳健拍卖转到共同价值，此时对手的信息还能改变本人对物品的判断。
edges.noteEn: Moves from robust private-value auctions to common values, where rivals' information can change an agent's assessment of the object.

edges.label: 分布邻域
edges.note: 将几乎未知的估值改为围绕一个参考分布的多个先验，分开考察两种稳健目标。
edges.noteEn: Replaces near-ignorance about value with priors near a reference distribution and separates two robustness criteria.

edges.label: 竞标者之间的未知相关性
edges.note: 将跨商品维度的未知相关性换成竞标者之间的未知相关性，双方分享同一种边际信息约束。
edges.noteEn: Moves unknown dependence from dimensions of one buyer's values to values across bidders while keeping the marginal-information constraint.

edges.label: 加入交易后的再次配置
edges.note: 转售可能让高价值投标者重新得到标的，故原先用于提取收入的歧视性配置需要重新评估。
edges.noteEn: Resale may return the good to a high-value bidder, changing which discriminatory assignments raise revenue.

edges.label: 随机保留价与最坏遗憾
edges.note: 把对信念的不确定性换成对估值分布的限制，改用遗憾来衡量简单拍卖的稳健性。
edges.noteEn: Replaces uncertainty about beliefs with restrictions on value distributions and evaluates the auction by regret.

edges.label: 竞标者的均值信息
edges.note: 给定一价拍卖，从允许多种信息结构的结果界转到具体规定竞标者怎样面对未知分布。
edges.noteEn: For a fixed first-price format, moves from bounds across information structures to an explicit model of how bidders face distributional uncertainty.

edges.label: 逐物品矩信息
edges.note: 将已知每个边际分布进一步削弱为只知边际矩，改变稳健收入的基准。
edges.noteEn: Weakens knowledge of each marginal distribution to marginal moments and changes the robust revenue benchmark.

edges.label: 矩约束下的相对保证
edges.note: 同样在不确定分布下设计机制，但约束由边际分布变成矩，目标也换为相对于事后基准的绩效。
