edges.noteEn: Changes ambiguity-set restrictions from marginals to moments and evaluates performance relative to hindsight.

resources.title: Robustness in Mechanism Design and Contracting

branches.questionEn: Which mechanisms remain feasible, and what returns can they guarantee, without a fully specified belief structure, joint distribution or demand distribution?
branches.boundaryEn: Robust implementation, worst-case revenue and minimax regret are different objectives. Each result depends on what is known and what may vary.

branches.name: 计算约束下的机制设计
branches.question: 当求最优配置本身计算困难，能否在可接受时间内同时做到诚实和近似有效？
branches.boundary: 近似比必须说明比较的福利基准、估值域以及通信或计算模型。随机机制还要区分对每次随机化都诚实与仅期望上诚实。

papers.title: Algorithmic Mechanism Design
papers.note: 把私人输入下的策略行为引入算法设计，以任务分配等问题同时考察计算效率、激励和近似效果。
papers.noteEn: Introduces strategic private inputs into algorithm design, using problems such as task allocation to study computational efficiency, incentives and approximation together.

papers.title: Truthful Mechanisms for One-Parameter Agents
papers.note: 在单参数成本环境，用工作量关于申报成本的单调性刻画可配上诚实支付的分配算法。
papers.noteEn: In single-parameter cost environments, monotonicity of the assigned workload in reported cost characterizes allocation algorithms that admit truthful payments.

papers.title: Truth Revelation in Approximately Efficient Combinatorial Auctions
papers.authors: Daniel Lehmann · Liadan Ita O’Callaghan · Yoav Shoham
papers.note: 单一目标包的竞标者环境中，构造有效率保证的近似分配及相应支付，使诚实仍是占优策略。
papers.noteEn: For single-minded bidders, constructs approximate allocations with welfare guarantees and payments that preserve dominant-strategy truthfulness.

papers.title: Truthful Randomized Mechanisms for Combinatorial Auctions
papers.authors: Shahar Dobzinski · Noam Nisan · Michael Schapira
papers.note: 在组合拍卖中将随机化与策略性质结合，在不同估值域与查询条件下给出福利近似保证。
papers.noteEn: Combines randomization with strategic constraints in combinatorial auctions, obtaining welfare guarantees across valuation domains and query models.

papers.title: Truthful and Near-Optimal Mechanism Design via Linear Programming
papers.note: 利用线性规划松弛与近似算法构造随机机制，获得期望意义的诚实和近似福利。
papers.noteEn: Uses linear programming relaxations and approximation algorithms to build randomized mechanisms with truthfulness in expectation and welfare guarantees.

papers.title: On Optimal Single-Item Auctions
papers.note: 在竞标者估值相关时研究收入最优的确定性诚实单物品拍卖，给出算法及复杂度边界。
papers.noteEn: Studies optimal deterministic truthful single-item auctions for correlated bidder values and derives algorithms and complexity bounds.

papers.title: Matroid Prophet Inequalities
papers.note: 在拟阵独立约束下，在线阈值选择可获得预知全部独立权重的基准收益的一半。
papers.noteEn: Under a matroid constraint, online thresholds capture half the expected reward of an offline prophet who knows all independent weights.

papers.title: An Impossibility Result for Truthful Combinatorial Auctions with Submodular Valuations
papers.note: 对子模估值的组合拍卖，给出同时追求诚实、高福利近似和少量查询时的下界。
papers.noteEn: Proves lower bounds on jointly achieving truthfulness, good welfare approximation and low query complexity for submodular valuations.

papers.title: From Convex Optimization to Randomized Mechanisms: Toward Optimal Combinatorial Auctions
papers.authors: Shaddin Dughmi; Tim Roughgarden; Qiqi Yan
papers.note: 为拟阵秩和估值的组合拍卖构造期望诚实的随机机制，以凸优化选择舍入后的分配。
papers.noteEn: Builds a truthful-in-expectation randomized mechanism for matroid rank sum valuations using convex optimization over rounded allocations.

papers.title: Improved Truthful Mechanisms for Combinatorial Auctions with Submodular Bidders
papers.note: 在子模竞标者环境下，用线性数量的需求查询构造对每个随机种子均诚实、且具有期望福利近似保证的机制。
papers.noteEn: For submodular bidders, obtains an expected welfare guarantee with a universally truthful mechanism using a linear number of demand queries.

papers.title: Simple versus Optimal Mechanisms
papers.note: 在单参数配置环境中比较带保留价的简单机制与最优收入，分析哪些设定保留近似保证。
papers.noteEn: In single-parameter environments, compares simple reserve-based mechanisms with optimal revenue and identifies approximation guarantees.

papers.title: Algorithmic Mechanism Design With Investment
papers.authors: Mohammad Akbarpour; Scott Duke Kominers; Kevin Michael Li; Shengwu Li; Paul Milgrom
papers.note: 近似算法即便在给定估值时几乎有效，也可能给出很差的投资激励。论文刻画其投资与配置保证何时一致，并应用于背包问题。
papers.noteEn: An algorithm that nearly maximizes welfare at given values can create poor investment incentives. The paper characterizes when its investment and allocation guarantees agree and applies the result to knapsack allocation.

papers.title: Separating the Communication Complexity of Truthful and Nontruthful Algorithms for Combinatorial Auctions
papers.authors: Sepehr Assadi; Hrishikesh Khandeparkar; Raghuvansh R. Saxena; S. Matthew Weinberg
papers.note: 对两位 XOS 估值买家的组合拍卖，证明多项式通信下诚实机制与不受激励约束的算法可达到的福利近似存在严格差距。
papers.noteEn: For two buyers with XOS valuations, proves a strict gap between welfare approximations achievable with polynomial communication by truthful mechanisms and unrestricted algorithms.

papers.title: Truthful mechanism design for multidimensional scheduling via cycle monotonicity
papers.role: 多维调度与循环单调性
papers.note: 每个任务在每台机器上的处理时间只能是高或低时，用循环单调性研究多维调度算法能否配上诚实支付。
papers.noteEn: Uses cycle monotonicity to design truthful scheduling algorithms when each job's processing time on each machine is either high or low.

papers.title: Combinatorial Auctions Do Need Modest Interaction
papers.note: 在次可加组合估值下，给定通信量限制，约束广播消息的轮数会限制福利近似的质量。
papers.noteEn: For subadditive combinatorial values, limiting broadcast rounds constrains welfare approximation even at a given communication budget.

edges.label: 特化参数域
edges.note: 把一般算法激励问题限制到单参数代理人，分配规则的单调性成为可验证条件。
edges.noteEn: Restricts the general algorithmic incentive problem to single-parameter agents, making monotonicity a testable allocation condition.

edges.label: 应用于组合拍卖
edges.note: 用近似算法解决分配困难时，仍须单独构造让竞标者诚实的支付。
edges.noteEn: Approximating a difficult allocation problem still requires a separate payment construction that makes truthful bidding optimal.
edges.labelEn: Applying the method to combinatorial auctions

edges.label: 改变估值域和机制
edges.note: 从单一目标包的确定性基准转向随机化与更一般的组合估值，比较可得的福利保证。
edges.noteEn: Moves from a deterministic single-minded benchmark to randomization and richer combinatorial valuations, comparing achievable welfare guarantees.

edges.label: 线性松弛与随机实施
edges.note: 将随机分配的选取与支付构造联立，用线性松弛控制近似损失。
edges.noteEn: Links randomized allocation to payments and controls the approximation loss through a linear relaxation.

edges.label: 相关估值的计算难度
edges.note: 从近似福利转向计算收入最优拍卖，单一物品也可因相关性产生计算难题。
edges.noteEn: Changes the objective from approximate welfare to optimal revenue, where correlation can make even one object computationally difficult.

edges.label: 在线阈值与先知界
edges.note: 在线阈值机制把单参数的临界值逻辑用于顺序到达的分配。
edges.noteEn: Online thresholds connect single-parameter critical values to sequential allocation.

edges.label: 诚实近似的下界
edges.note: 将构造近似机制的正面结果与同一领域中的查询复杂度下界相对照。
edges.noteEn: Pairs constructive approximation guarantees with query lower bounds in the same auction domain.

edges.label: 凸舍入
edges.note: 对估值结构施加明确限制后，随机化与优化工具能提高福利近似保证。
edges.noteEn: Restricting the valuation class enables randomization and optimization to sharpen the welfare guarantee.

edges.label: 需求查询与随机近似
edges.note: 在明确的需求查询模型中，将随机机制的福利保证与逐次随机化的诚实性同时加强。
edges.noteEn: Uses a specified demand-query model to combine an improved welfare guarantee with truthfulness for each realization of the randomization.

edges.label: 把简洁性作为近似约束
edges.note: 即使最优拍卖难以实施，也可以在同一环境中为较简单规则的收入损失求界。
edges.labelEn: Treating simplicity as an approximation constraint
edges.noteEn: Even when the optimum is difficult to implement, its revenue advantage over a simpler rule can be bounded.

edges.label: 事前投资激励
edges.note: 竞标者不只申报给定估值，还可事前投资改变估值，因而福利保证须计入投资成本和回报。
edges.noteEn: Bidders can invest to change values before reporting them, so welfare guarantees must account for investment costs and returns.

edges.label: 诚实所需的通信量
edges.note: 把查询难度的下界与通信模型中的激励成本区分开来，后者可由有无诚实约束直接比较。
edges.noteEn: Separates query lower bounds from the cost of incentives in a communication model where truthful and unrestricted algorithms can be compared directly.

edges.label: 多维调度与循环单调性
edges.note: 从单一目标包竞价转到每个代理人的多项私人成本，检验偏离需要考虑跨多种类型的循环。
edges.noteEn: Moves from single-minded package bids to vectors of private machine costs, making cycles of type deviations relevant.

edges.label: 互动轮数
edges.note: 除优化算法的近似损失，还须考虑参与者能否根据先前消息再发送一轮信息。
edges.noteEn: Alongside approximation losses in optimization, the ability to send messages conditional on earlier rounds matters.

resources.title: Algorithmic Game Theory
resources.authors: Noam Nisan · Tim Roughgarden · Éva Tardos · Vijay V. Vazirani（编）

branches.questionEn: When exact allocation is computationally difficult, can a tractable mechanism remain truthful and approximately efficient?
branches.boundaryEn: An approximation ratio must specify its welfare benchmark, valuation domain and communication or computational model. Randomization also distinguishes truthfulness for every realization from truthfulness in expectation.

branches.name: 棘轮效应、重新谈判与有限承诺
branches.question: 当今天暴露的信息会被明天的合同利用，代理人还愿意揭示多少？设计者还能承诺什么？
branches.boundary: 短约逐期重选、已签的长约允许双方同意重新谈判、可承诺长期机制，是三种合同环境。明天能否单方改约、谁观察到今天的报告，会改变今天的披露动机。

papers.title: Planning under Incomplete Information and the Ratchet Effect
papers.authors: Xavier Freixas · Roger Guesnerie · Jean Tirole
papers.note: 计划者从当前表现推断生产能力，并据此调整今后的要求。预见标准上调的生产者就有动机隐藏自己的能力。
papers.noteEn: A planner infers productivity from current performance and adjusts future targets. Producers who anticipate higher targets have incentives to conceal capacity.

papers.title: The Dynamics of Incentive Contracts
papers.note: 在委托人缺乏长期承诺时，代理人当期的成本表现会影响后续合同。文中刻画这一激励如何使不同能力者在第一期混同。
papers.noteEn: Without long-term commitment, current cost performance influences future contracts. The paper characterizes how this incentive leads different abilities to pool in the first period.

papers.title: Contract Renegotiation and Coasian Dynamics
papers.note: 比较不同承诺和重新谈判安排，在文中一类耐久品环境中建立可重谈长约与 Coase 式无承诺动态之间的联系。
papers.noteEn: Compares commitment and renegotiation regimes. For a class of durable-good environments, it relates renegotiable long-term contracts to Coasian dynamics without commitment.
papers.roleEn: Long-term contracts and ex post revision

papers.title: Adverse Selection and Renegotiation in Procurement
papers.role: 采购合同中的重新谈判
papers.note: 两期采购中，长期合同可执行、但双方可以同意重新谈判。论文刻画初始筛选、后续修约和信息租金如何共同决定结果。
papers.noteEn: In two-period procurement, the long-term contract is enforceable but can be renegotiated by mutual agreement. Initial screening, subsequent revisions and information rents jointly determine outcomes.

papers.title: Mechanism Design With Limited Commitment
papers.note: 设计者仅能承诺本期机制。规范机制同时规定支付相关的配置以及当期互动之后应披露的信息，以复制一般机制选择博弈的均衡结果。
papers.noteEn: A designer can commit only to the current mechanism. Canonical mechanisms specify both payoff-relevant allocations and what to disclose after each interaction, reproducing equilibria of general mechanism-selection games.

papers.title: Durability and Monopoly
papers.note: 耐用品买家可延迟购买；垄断者日后降价的诱因会削弱今天维持高价的能力。
papers.noteEn: Durable-good buyers can wait, and the monopolist's future incentive to cut price can undermine today's high price.

papers.title: Foundations of Dynamic Monopoly and the Coase Conjecture
papers.authors: Faruk Gul; Hugo Sonnenschein; Robert Wilson
papers.note: 在耐用品动态垄断模型中分析均衡价格如何随两次报价间隔缩短而变化，并给出 Coase 猜想成立的条件。
papers.noteEn: Studies equilibrium prices as offers become more frequent and gives conditions for the Coase conjecture in dynamic durable-good monopoly.

papers.title: Renegotiation and Information Revelation over Time: The Case of Optimal Labor Contracts
papers.note: 初始合同暴露的信息可创造双方愿意重新谈判的机会，因而劳动合同会主动控制揭示的程度。
papers.noteEn: Information released by an initial labor contract can create mutually profitable renegotiations, giving parties a reason to control revelation.

papers.title: Contracting with Imperfect Commitment and the Revelation Principle: The Single Agent Case
papers.note: 针对单代理人和不完全承诺研究直接机制，揭示选择性传递信息为何影响可达结果。
papers.noteEn: Studies direct mechanisms with one agent and imperfect commitment, showing why selective information transmission matters for attainable outcomes.

papers.title: Sequentially Optimal Mechanisms
papers.note: 风险中性的买卖双方交易一个物品、卖方不能承诺下一期的机制时，有限期模型中逐期张贴价格最优。
papers.noteEn: For a risk-neutral buyer and seller trading one good without commitment to later mechanisms, period-by-period posted pricing is optimal in the finite-horizon model.

papers.title: Optimal Mechanism for the Sale of a Durable Good
papers.note: 对一个知晓自身估值的买方出售耐用品，证明有限承诺下文中无限期模型可用张贴价格取得最优结果。
papers.noteEn: For a durable good sold to a privately informed buyer, shows that posted prices suffice in the paper's infinite-horizon limited-commitment model.

papers.title: Purchase History and Product Personalization
papers.note: 下游可利用购买历史差别定价，促使上游减少个性化商品，从而限制第一期选择传递的信息。
papers.noteEn: Downstream price discrimination based on purchase histories induces the upstream seller to reduce product personalization, limiting what early choices reveal.

papers.title: Smart Contracts and the Coase Conjecture
papers.authors: Thomas Brzustowski; Alkis Georgiadis-Harris; Balázs Szentes
papers.note: 买家拥有二元私人估值，卖家逐期决定保留或替换上一期的动态合同。在此环境中，即使报价间隔缩短，卖方收益仍可高于低估值基准。
papers.noteEn: With a binary private value, the seller can retain or replace the previous dynamic contract each period. The seller's payoff stays above the low-value benchmark as frictions vanish.

papers.title: Repeated contracting without commitment
papers.note: 垄断卖家无法承诺未来合同。论文刻画均衡与初始信念的关系，并展示随机交付合同可以优于简单报价。
papers.noteEn: Without commitment to future contracts, equilibrium depends on initial beliefs, and random delivery contracts can improve the seller's payoff over posted prices.

papers.title: Mechanism design with limited commitment: Markov environments
papers.note: 在马尔可夫环境中，设计者可以把当期类型报告映射为对当期类型的后验，再由后验确定分配；这些机制足以达到所有均衡收益。
papers.noteEn: In Markov environments, the designer may map current type reports into posteriors about current types, then map posteriors into allocations. Such mechanisms attain all equilibrium payoffs.

papers.title: Auctions with Limited Commitment
papers.authors: Qingmin Liu; Konrad Mierendorff; Xianwen Shi; Weijie Zhong
papers.note: 卖方只能承诺本期拍卖及其保留价。拍卖间隔趋于零时，论文刻画均衡利润，并证明至少三名买方时立刻有效拍卖最优。
papers.noteEn: The seller commits only to the current auction and reserve. The paper characterizes limiting equilibrium profits and proves that an immediate efficient auction is optimal with at least three buyers.

edges.label: 从计划指标到激励合同
edges.note: 两个模型都使当期表现成为未来条款的依据；后者在激励合同模型中进一步研究均衡混同。
edges.noteEn: In both models current performance informs future terms. The later paper studies equilibrium pooling in an incentive-contract model.
edges.labelEn: From plan targets to incentive contracts

edges.label: 比较重谈环境
edges.note: 两篇都让当事人重新审视既有承诺，分别在长期交易与采购规制中追踪重谈对信息揭示的反馈。
edges.noteEn: Both papers allow existing commitments to be revisited, tracing the feedback from renegotiation to information revelation in long-term trade and regulated procurement.

edges.label: 拓展机制空间
edges.note: 逐期更换合同时，报告不仅决定当前配置，也决定下一期设计者可利用的信息。后文将这点编码为一般的规范机制。
edges.noteEn: When contracting repeats, reports determine today's allocation and the information available to tomorrow's designer. The later paper encodes this in a general canonical mechanism.

edges.label: 比较承诺边界
edges.note: 可执行长约上的双方重谈与只承诺短期机制给予双方不同的后续选择权。
edges.noteEn: Mutual renegotiation of an enforceable long-term contract and commitment only to a short-term mechanism grant different continuation rights.

edges.label: 耐用品垄断
edges.note: 可重谈合同研究可与经典耐用品问题相比较，关键是卖家能否约束未来价格。
edges.noteEn: Renegotiable contracts can be compared with the classical durable-good problem through the seller's ability to bind future prices.

edges.label: 耐用品均衡的极限
edges.note: 可重谈长约所比较的无承诺基准，在此由逐期报价均衡明确给出。
edges.noteEn: Provides an explicit sequence-of-offers benchmark for the comparison with renegotiable long-term contracts.

edges.label: 劳动合同的信息披露
edges.note: 采购与劳动合同面对相同的后续改约约束，但一方的劳动／生产类型及可调整条款不同。
edges.noteEn: Labor and procurement contracts share a renegotiation constraint but differ in private types and adjustable terms.

edges.label: 有限承诺的显示原理
edges.note: 两类显示结论都必须说明委托人事后获得的信息，以及并不完全诚实披露的可能性。
edges.noteEn: Both revelation results require careful accounting for the principal's later information and the possibility of incomplete disclosure.

edges.label: 逐期报价的最优性
edges.note: 在具体单物品模型中，抽象的逐期机制选择可化约为各期选择报价。
edges.noteEn: In a specific single-object model the general problem of choosing a mechanism each period reduces to setting a price.

edges.label: 无限期耐用品销售
edges.note: 将有限承诺的显示原理用于具体销售问题，限制历史信息的作用并刻画最优机制。
edges.noteEn: Applies the limited-commitment revelation principle to a sales problem, tracking past information to characterize the optimal mechanism.

edges.label: 从承诺约束到产品线
edges.note: 不能联合承诺未来价格时，减少当前产品种类成为避免棘轮效应的工具。
edges.labelEn: From commitment limits to product lines
edges.noteEn: Without joint commitment to downstream prices, reducing current variety can curb ratcheting.

edges.label: 智能合约与耐用品
edges.note: 能部署随后仍可替换的动态合同，改变了断续报价与 Coase 收益界之间的关系。
edges.noteEn: Allowing a dynamic contract to remain deployable changes the link between successive offers and the Coasian payoff bound.

edges.label: 随机交付与短约
edges.note: 随机交付可有价值的模型与张贴价格已足够的耐用品模型并读，可分辨哪些交易条件支撑价格最优。
edges.noteEn: Comparing the gain from random delivery with posted-price optimality in a durable-good model identifies the role of the trading environment.

edges.label: 马尔可夫型有限承诺
edges.note: 在一般有限承诺框架中加入状态转移结构，以便递归追踪后续设计可用的信息。
edges.noteEn: Adds a transition structure to general limited commitment so that information available for future design can be tracked recursively.

edges.label: 无法承诺未来保留价
edges.note: 将一个买方的重新交易机会扩展到多个买方，以竞争强度解释保留价承诺的价值。
edges.noteEn: Adds buyer competition to the future trading opportunities faced by a seller and studies how it affects the value of commitment to reserves.

branches.questionEn: How much will an agent reveal today if tomorrow's contract uses that information? What can the designer commit to?
branches.boundaryEn: Period-by-period contracting, binding long-term contracts subject to mutual renegotiation, and full long-term commitment are different environments. Who may change tomorrow's terms and who observes today's report affect current disclosure.

branches.name: 随机分配与概率序列机制
branches.question: 不可分的公共席位无法按价格出售时，怎样分配获得各席位的概率？为什么抽签的顺序会影响效率与激励？
branches.boundary: 基数偏好与序数偏好决定可以使用什么效率标准。逐次抽签产生的每个确定性结果都有效，仍不保证所得彩票序数有效；公平、策略无关和精确可实施性又是不同要求。

papers.title: The Efficient Allocation of Individuals to Positions
papers.note: 以等额虚拟预算和位置概率的价格组织选择，使参与者表达对不同彩票的基数偏好。
papers.noteEn: Uses equal artificial budgets and prices for assignment probabilities, allowing participants to express cardinal preferences over lotteries.

papers.title: Random Serial Dictatorship and the Core from Random Endowments in House Allocation Problems
papers.note: 在经典住房分配模型中，先均匀随机产生优先次序再依序选择，与先随机分配禀赋再求核产生相同的彩票分配。
papers.noteEn: In the classic house-allocation model, drawing a uniform priority order and choosing serially produces the same lottery as randomly assigning endowments and selecting the core.

papers.title: A New Solution to the Random Assignment Problem
papers.note: 让所有人以相同速度消耗当前最偏好的可用物品，消耗份额就是分配概率。得到的随机分配序数有效且无嫉妒，但一般不满足通常的占优策略诚实。
papers.noteEn: Agents consume their favorite available objects simultaneously at equal speeds. Shares consumed give assignment probabilities. The outcome is ordinally efficient and envy-free, although ordinary dominant-strategy truthfulness generally fails.

papers.title: A Solution to the Random Assignment Problem on the Full Preference Domain
papers.note: 经典概率序列以严格排序为出发点。扩展的概率序列在可能对多个物品无差异的偏好域上定义分配。
papers.noteEn: Classic probabilistic serial starts from strict rankings. Extended probabilistic serial defines assignments when agents can be indifferent among objects.

papers.title: Designing Random Allocation Mechanisms: Theory and Applications
papers.authors: Eric Budish · Yeon-Koo Che · Fuhito Kojima · Paul Milgrom
papers.note: 研究多单位分配及各类配额约束，给出随机化实施条件，使确定性抽签结果逐一满足相应的可行约束。
papers.noteEn: Studies multi-unit assignments under quota constraints and gives conditions for implementing fractional shares by a lottery whose every deterministic realization respects feasibility.

papers.title: On a Conjecture by Gale about One-Sided Matching Problems
papers.note: 三个或更多人分配同样多的物品时，文中的单边分配模型不可能同时满足对称、帕累托最优和策略无关。
papers.noteEn: In the paper's one-sided assignment environment, assigning at least three objects to as many agents precludes symmetry, Pareto optimality and strategy-proofness together.

papers.title: Incentives in the Probabilistic Serial Mechanism
papers.note: 固定物品种类和个人的期望效用函数后，每种物品的副本足够多可使该人的真实报告成为弱占优策略。
papers.noteEn: For fixed object types and an individual's expected utility function, enough copies of each object type make truth-telling weakly dominant for that individual.

papers.title: Asymptotic Equivalence of Probabilistic Serial and Random Priority Mechanisms
papers.note: 在论文的大市场序列中，随机优先顺序与概率序列产生的个体获配概率趋近。
papers.noteEn: Along the paper's sequence of large markets, individual assignment probabilities under random priority and probabilistic serial converge to one another.

papers.title: A Characterization of the Extended Serial Correspondence
papers.note: 以随机占优效率、无嫉妒和有限不变性刻画允许并列偏好的扩展序列对应。
papers.noteEn: Characterizes the extended serial correspondence with stochastic-dominance efficiency, no envy and limited invariance.

papers.title: Asymptotic Ordinal Inefficiency of Random Serial Dictatorship
papers.note: 随物品种类增多，在文中考察的偏好轮廓集合中，随机顺序独裁恰好序数有效的比例趋于零。
papers.noteEn: As the number of object types grows, the share of preference profiles with ordinally efficient random serial dictatorship vanishes in the studied profile space.

papers.title: The Random Priority Mechanism Is Uniquely Simple, Efficient, and Fair
papers.note: 在不可分物品分配中，以论文所定义的简明性、效率和公平性公理，刻画随机优先机制的唯一性。
papers.noteEn: Characterizes random priority in indivisible-object allocation using the paper's axioms of simplicity, efficiency and fairness.

papers.title: Why Do Popular Mechanisms Lack Efficiency in Random Environments?
papers.note: 用交易循环刻画随机优先与概率序列两种机制，比较交易开始前的不同分配条件。
papers.roleEn: A trading interpretation of random assignment
papers.noteEn: Trading-cycle representations connect random priority and probabilistic serial and isolate differences in their starting conditions.

papers.title: On (Constrained) Efficiency of Strategy‐Proof Random Assignment
papers.note: 相同类型同等待遇、事后效率和策略无关不能唯一刻画随机顺序独裁；存在同时满足三者却有不同福利结果的规则。
papers.noteEn: Equal treatment of equals, ex post efficiency and strategy-proofness do not characterize random serial dictatorship: other rules satisfy all three with different welfare outcomes.

papers.title: Egalitarian random assignment
papers.note: 提出侧重最不利参与者的公平标准；至少四人时，随机占优效率无法同时兼顾该标准与无嫉妒。
papers.noteEn: Introduces a fairness requirement focused on the least advantaged person. With at least four agents, stochastic-dominance efficiency cannot accommodate both this requirement and envy-freeness.

papers.title: Partial strategyproofness: Relaxing strategyproofness for the random assignment problem
papers.note: 以对不同排序兼容的效用强度施加限制，衡量随机分配规则在多大估值范围内能保证真实报告。
papers.noteEn: Restricts cardinal utility differences consistent with an ordering to measure the range over which a random assignment rule protects truthful reporting.

papers.title: The Random Assignment Problem with Submodular Constraints on Goods
papers.authors: Satoru Fujishige; Yoshio Sano; Ping Zhan
papers.note: 将概率序列扩展到拟阵或多态拟阵约束。单位需求的拟阵情形下保留序数效率、无嫉妒和弱随机占优策略无关。
papers.noteEn: Extends probabilistic serial to matroid and polymatroid constraints. With unit demand and matroid feasibility it preserves ordinal efficiency, envy-freeness and weak stochastic-dominance strategy-proofness.

edges.label: 改变信息要求
edges.note: 伪市场利用彩票的基数比较；概率序列机制只要求对确定性物品的排序，并以随机占优比较彩票。
edges.noteEn: The pseudomarket uses cardinal comparisons of lotteries. Probabilistic serial requires only rankings of objects and compares lotteries by stochastic dominance.

edges.label: 更换随机化规则
edges.note: 从先抽优先序、再依次选物品，改为同时消耗。随机优先具有策略优势，概率序列改善序数效率。
edges.noteEn: Replaces drawing priorities and choosing in sequence with simultaneous consumption. Random priority has incentive advantages, while probabilistic serial improves ordinal efficiency.

edges.label: 放宽严格偏好
edges.note: 允许排序中出现无差异时，需要重新定义同时消耗的过程。
edges.noteEn: Ties require a revised definition of the simultaneous eating process.

edges.label: 增加派位约束
edges.note: 位置份额不仅要在期望上满足配额，还要能分解为逐个符合配额的确定性分配。
edges.noteEn: Fractional seats must meet quotas in expectation and admit a decomposition into deterministic assignments that individually satisfy the quotas.

edges.label: 效率、公平与激励
edges.note: 在伪市场激励问题的背景下，刻画对称有效派位能否普遍真实实施的界限。
edges.noteEn: In the context of pseudomarket incentives, identifies limits to strategy-proof implementation of symmetric efficient assignments.

edges.label: 大市场真实报告
edges.note: 将有限市场中概率序列的一般可操纵性，与复制物品后针对给定代理人的结论区分。
edges.noteEn: Contrasts manipulability in finite probabilistic serial markets with the individual incentive result under replication.

edges.label: 两种抽签的渐近等价
edges.note: 从随机优先的有限市场刻画转向其与同时消耗的彩票在极限上的比较。
edges.noteEn: Moves from a finite-market characterization of random priority to a limiting comparison with simultaneous eating.

edges.label: 扩展序列的公理
edges.note: 原文定义含并列的消耗程序；公理刻画反过来从福利与不变性要求确定其结果。
edges.noteEn: The earlier paper defines the eating procedure with ties; the characterization recovers its outcomes from welfare and invariance requirements.

edges.label: 序数低效的频率
edges.note: 条件于每次抽签的有效性依然成立，但不同抽签结果的概率组合通常有改进空间。
edges.noteEn: Efficiency of each realized assignment can coexist with room for improvement in the mixture over lottery outcomes.

edges.label: 随机优先的公理基础
edges.note: 随机优先与随机禀赋抽签的等价性识别同一彩票，新的刻画追问哪些行为与公平要求能够唯一确定它。
edges.noteEn: The equivalence with random endowments identifies the same lottery, while the characterization asks which behavioral and fairness requirements uniquely determine it.

edges.label: 追溯序数效率差异
edges.note: 把两个规则放到共同交易表示里，可找出起始条件如何影响最终分配。
edges.noteEn: A common trading representation helps trace allocation differences to the starting conditions.

edges.label: 随机优先的约束效率
edges.note: 在序数效率与激励之间的取舍之外，进一步问保留事后效率和策略无关时是否还存在其他彩票。
edges.noteEn: Beyond the ordinal-efficiency incentive trade-off, asks whether other lotteries preserve both ex post efficiency and strategy-proofness.

edges.label: 照顾最不利者
edges.note: 概率序列的无嫉妒针对两两比较；关注最不利者的公平性可以给出不同的评价。
edges.noteEn: Envy-freeness in probabilistic serial compares individuals pairwise, while protecting the least advantaged can rank assignments differently.

edges.label: 部分策略无关
edges.note: 比只判断概率序列能否被操纵更细，区分何种效用强度使某种虚报有利。
edges.noteEn: Refines the binary manipulability test for probabilistic serial by distinguishing utility intensities at which a misreport pays.

edges.label: 物品集合的次模约束
edges.note: 更换可行物品集合后，同时消耗的步骤也要尊重跨物品容量约束。
edges.noteEn: Changing feasible sets requires the simultaneous eating procedure to respect capacity restrictions across objects.

resources.title: Fair Division in the Internet Age

branches.questionEn: How should probabilities of receiving indivisible public seats be allocated when seats cannot be sold? Why does the timing of randomization affect efficiency and incentives?
branches.boundaryEn: Cardinal and ordinal preferences support different efficiency criteria. Efficient deterministic realizations need not produce an ordinally efficient lottery. Fairness, strategy-proofness and exact implementability impose further distinct requirements.

branches.name: 动态机制与序贯私人信息
branches.question: 当私人信息逐期到达、今天的决策还会改变明天的选择时，什么样的支付足以实现效率或最大化收入？
branches.boundary: 动态承诺的对象是历史依赖的配置和支付。有效配置、动态预算平衡和最优收入分别是不同的问题；各自需要不同的独立性和激励条件。

papers.title: Regulation and Information in a Continuing Relationship
papers.note: 企业的私人成本随时间变化，能够长期承诺的规制者需要考虑本期报告对将来成本的信息含量。
papers.noteEn: A firm's private costs evolve over time. A regulator with long-term commitment must account for what today's report reveals about future costs.

papers.title: The Dynamic Pivot Mechanism
papers.note: 在动态独立私人价值环境，把每名参与者对后续总剩余的边际贡献用于转移支付，为逐期诚实和有效配置提供激励。
papers.noteEn: Under dynamic independent private values, transfers reflect each agent's marginal contribution to continuation surplus, supporting periodic truthfulness and efficient allocations.

papers.title: An Efficient Dynamic Mechanism
papers.note: 在可数期的一般准线性环境中构造有效、贝叶斯激励相容的动态机制；类型按其独立性条件演化时，还能保持预算平衡。
papers.noteEn: Constructs efficient, Bayesian incentive-compatible dynamic mechanisms in a general quasilinear setting with countably many periods. Budget balance is also attainable when types evolve under the paper's independence conditions.

papers.title: Dynamic Mechanism Design: A Myersonian Approach
papers.authors: Alessandro Pavan · Ilya Segal · Juuso Toikka
papers.note: 用动态包络条件追踪本期信息对未来类型和效用的影响，从而刻画激励约束和利润最优机制的动态扭曲。
papers.noteEn: Uses a dynamic envelope condition to trace how current information affects future types and utilities, characterizing incentives and the dynamic distortions of profit-maximizing mechanisms.

papers.title: Sequential Screening
papers.note: 消费者先知道其估值分布、随后知道自己的实际估值；卖家用退款合同在两个时点筛选。
papers.noteEn: Consumers first learn their value distribution and later their realized valuation. Refund contracts allow the seller to screen across the two dates.

papers.title: Long-Term Contracting with Markovian Consumers
papers.note: 消费者偏好按马尔可夫过程演化。最优长期合同取决于历史，在文中条件下供给最终趋向有效水平。
papers.noteEn: Preferences follow a Markov process. The optimal long-term contract is history dependent, and supply converges to efficiency under the paper's conditions.

papers.title: Optimal Information Disclosure in Auctions and the Handicap Auction
papers.role: 内生披露的两阶段拍卖
papers.note: 竞标者先选择将来的加价，卖家随后释放额外信号，再运行第二价格式拍卖。
papers.noteEn: Bidders first choose a future premium, the seller releases additional signals, and a second-price-style auction follows.

papers.title: Optimal Sales Contracts with Withdrawal Rights
papers.note: 买方在进一步了解估值后可退出时，额外的参与约束可以使静态合同成为最优。
papers.noteEn: When the buyer can withdraw after learning more about value, additional participation constraints can make a static contract optimal.

papers.title: Optimal Dynamic Mechanism Design and the Virtual-Pivot Mechanism
papers.authors: Sham M. Kakade; Ilan Lobel; Hamid Nazerzadeh
papers.note: 在满足可分性条件的动态环境，虚拟枢轴机制用虚拟价值调整后的目标实现最优收入。
papers.noteEn: In dynamic environments satisfying a separability condition, the virtual-pivot mechanism implements a revenue objective based on virtual values.

papers.title: Managerial Turnover in a Changing World
papers.note: 经理私有的匹配质量随时间变化时，企业联合选择激励合同与何时更换经理。
papers.noteEn: When a manager's privately known match quality changes over time, the firm jointly chooses incentives and when to replace the manager.

papers.title: Revenue Management with Forward-Looking Buyers
papers.note: 买方持续到达并可推迟购买，最优分配门槛仅取决于余货与剩余时间；连续时间极限可用匿名价格实施。
papers.noteEn: Buyers arrive over time and can delay purchases. Optimal cutoffs depend only on inventory and time left, with anonymous prices implementing the continuous-time limit.

papers.title: Efficient sequential screening with informational externalities
papers.role: 分期到达与信息外部性
papers.note: 买方估值取决于两个私人信号。适当条件下，分期收到信号可以实现有效交易，即便同时收到时信息外部性会阻碍实施。
papers.noteEn: The buyer's value depends on two private signals. Under appropriate conditions staggered arrival supports efficient trade even when informational externalities obstruct it with simultaneous signals.

papers.title: Sequential Screening with Type-Enhancing Investment
papers.note: 在序贯采购筛选中加入不可观察的早期投资。投资成本为凸时配置扭曲减轻，特定线性成本下甚至能使有效采购最优。
papers.noteEn: Adds hidden early investment to sequential procurement screening. Convex investment costs mitigate allocation distortions, and with sufficiently effective investment under linear costs efficient procurement can be optimal.

papers.title: Dynamic screening with liquidity constraints
papers.note: 各期类型相互独立，但代理人当期不能承担合同亏损。流动性违约可被核验时，后续合同可依该事件调整，从而改变真实报告约束。
papers.noteEn: Types are independent over time, but an agent cannot absorb a current contractual loss. Verifiable liquidity breaches allow contingent continuation terms and alter truth-telling constraints.

papers.title: Prior‐free dynamic allocation under limited liability
papers.note: 公共生产资源使用者只有在生产成功后才能支付。论文构造不依赖先验的动态机制，以枢轴 VCG 的表现为近似目标。
papers.noteEn: Users of a productive public resource can pay only after success. The paper constructs prior-free dynamic mechanisms to approximate pivot VCG performance.

edges.label: 一般化动态筛选
edges.note: 早期规制模型中的跨期信息持续性，在更一般模型中通过当前信号对未来类型的影响进入虚拟盈余分析。
edges.noteEn: Intertemporal persistence in early regulatory models enters more general virtual surplus analysis through the effect of current signals on future types.

edges.label: 改变融资要求
edges.note: 两文都以逐期到来的信息实现效率。额外要求在参与者之间平衡转移预算，改变了所用的支付构造和激励概念。
edges.noteEn: Both papers pursue efficiency as new information arrives. Requiring transfers to balance across agents changes the payment construction and the incentive concept.

edges.label: 比较目标
edges.note: 动态有效机制以社会收益为目标；委托人寻求收入时，必须把随历史变化的类型租金也计入目标。
edges.noteEn: Dynamic efficiency targets social surplus. A revenue-seeking principal must also account for history-dependent information rents.

edges.label: 提前售票与筛选
edges.note: 两阶段售票提供动态信息租金的具体例子，早期类型描述未来估值的不确定性。
edges.noteEn: Two-stage ticketing provides a concrete dynamic-rent example in which the early type describes uncertainty about future value.

edges.label: 马尔可夫类型
edges.note: 将规制中的持续私人成本改为消费者需求，研究扭曲如何随报告历史演化。
edges.noteEn: Replaces persistent private regulatory costs with consumer demand to track the evolution of distortions over reporting histories.

edges.label: 内生披露的两阶段拍卖
edges.note: 动态租金不仅受初始类型影响，也受卖方决定后续何时披露信息影响。
edges.noteEn: Dynamic rents depend both on initial private types and on the seller's choice of subsequent disclosure.

edges.label: 学习后退出
edges.note: 在动态筛选上加入后续个体理性，改变委托人从序贯披露获益的空间。
edges.noteEn: Adds later participation constraints to dynamic screening, changing the gains from eliciting information sequentially.

edges.label: 虚拟枢轴支付
edges.note: 从真实边际社会贡献转向虚拟边际贡献，使动态效率的支付逻辑服务于收入目标。
edges.noteEn: Replaces actual with virtual marginal contributions, adapting dynamic efficiency payments to a revenue objective.

edges.label: 更换经理与动态租金
edges.note: 把动态类型租金具体化为解聘边界：保留当前经理会改变此后需要支付的信息租金。
edges.noteEn: Makes dynamic rents concrete in a dismissal decision, since retaining the manager changes the rents payable later.

edges.label: 使等待成为策略
edges.note: 动态机制既要从私人估值中筛选买方，也要控制其推迟购买的动机。
edges.noteEn: Dynamic screening must manage incentives to delay as well as incentives to report private values.

edges.label: 分期到达与信息外部性
edges.note: 与通过卖方披露设计信息到达次序相联系，把比较目标从收入变为有效交易的可实施性。
edges.noteEn: Relates to the timing of seller disclosure while changing the target from revenue to implementation of efficient trade.

edges.label: 影响未来类型的投资
edges.note: 早期决定不只预测将来类型，还会通过投资改变类型的分布。
edges.noteEn: Early choices do more than predict subsequent types: investment can shift their distribution.

edges.label: 逐期流动性约束
edges.note: 历史的价值来自可验证的资金短缺，即便各期私人类型没有持续性。
edges.noteEn: Verifiable cash shortfalls make history valuable even without persistence in private types.

edges.label: 有限责任的动态配置
edges.note: 将可以完整收取边际外部性支付的基准，改为只能从事后产出融资的场景。
edges.noteEn: Changes a benchmark in which full externality payments can be collected to one where transfers must be financed from realized output.

branches.questionEn: When information arrives gradually and current decisions affect future choices, which transfers implement efficiency or maximize revenue?
branches.boundaryEn: Dynamic commitment covers history-dependent allocations and payments. Efficiency, dynamic budget balance and optimal revenue pose different problems and require different independence and incentive conditions.

branches.name: 显然策略无关与机制简明性
branches.question: 一条诚实行动真的是参与者在当前决策点就能看出的最优选择吗？
branches.boundary: OSP 是扩展式机制及其策略的性质。实现同一输入输出映射的不同程序，可能要求不同深度的推理。稳定匹配、房屋交换和一般社会选择规则须分别检验。

papers.title: Obviously Strategy-Proof Mechanisms
papers.note: 在策略第一次分岔的信息集，诚实的最差结果若仍不差于偏离的最好结果，诚实便在该处显然占优。
papers.noteEn: At an information set where strategies first diverge, truthfulness is obviously dominant if its worst outcome is at least as good as the deviation's best outcome.

papers.title: Stable Matching Mechanisms Are Not Obviously Strategy-Proof
papers.note: 一般双边匹配环境中，稳定机制难以为一方同时提供显然的策略保障；这比传统的申请方策略无关要求更强。
papers.noteEn: In general two-sided markets, stable mechanisms face limits on making incentives obvious to one side. This is stronger than conventional proposer strategy-proofness.

papers.title: Obviously Strategy-Proof Implementation of Top Trading Cycles
papers.note: 在以优先权分配不可分物品的模型中，给出使顶端交易环规则可以按 OSP 方式实施的必要充分的无环条件。
papers.noteEn: In an indivisible-object model with priorities, gives a necessary and sufficient acyclicity condition for an OSP implementation of top trading cycles.

papers.title: A Theory of Simplicity in Games and Mechanism Design
papers.note: 以玩家能预先规划多少未来行动来参数化对简明性的要求，并研究不同规划视野下可实施的规则。
papers.noteEn: Parameterizes simplicity by the number of future actions a player can plan and studies implementability at different horizons.

papers.title: Gibbard-Satterthwaite Success Stories and Obvious Strategyproofness
papers.note: 2016 年工作论文考察限制偏好域或划定对象权利后，普通策略无关的正面结果中哪些还能显然实施。
papers.noteEn: This 2016 working paper examines which positive strategy-proofness results on restricted domains or with object rights admit obvious implementation.

papers.title: On Obvious Strategy-Proofness and Single-Peakedness
papers.authors: R. Pablo Arribillaga; Jordi Massó; Alejandro Neme
papers.note: 刻画广义中位选民规则中可以通过显然策略无关程序实施的规则。
papers.roleEn: Obvious implementation on a single-peaked domain
papers.noteEn: Characterizes the generalized median voter schemes that admit obviously strategy-proof procedures.

papers.title: Obvious Manipulations
papers.note: 比较偏离前后的最好结果及最坏结果，区分哪些获利性操纵容易被参与者察觉。
papers.noteEn: Compares best cases with best cases and worst cases with worst cases to distinguish manipulations that are apparent to participants.

papers.title: Obviously Strategy-Proof Implementation of Assignment Rules: A New Characterization
papers.note: 以一般派位规则的显然可实施性刻画，推出固定优先权顶端交易环和分层交换等规则的条件。
papers.noteEn: Characterizes obvious implementability of assignment rules and derives conditions for fixed-priority top trading cycles and hierarchical exchange.

papers.title: Bounded Rationality and Robust Mechanism Design: An Axiomatic Approach
papers.note: 放宽主观期望效用的假设，提出显然偏好并以此刻画显然占优策略。
papers.noteEn: Weakens subjective expected utility through obvious preference and uses it to characterize obviously dominant strategies.

papers.title: Credible Auctions: A Trilemma
papers.note: 研究卖方能否在不被买方察觉的情况下偏离拍卖规则，并刻画拍卖形式在可信性、策略激励与程序属性上的取舍。
papers.noteEn: Studies whether the seller can depart from auction rules without detection by buyers and characterizes trade-offs among credibility, bidding incentives and procedure.

papers.title: A Revelation Principle for Obviously Strategy-Proof Implementation
papers.role: 显然策略无关的标准形式
papers.note: 把一类随机显然策略无关实施转换成参与者轮流公开报告部分私人信息的随机圆桌机制。
papers.roleEn: A canonical form for obvious implementation
papers.noteEn: Converts probabilistic obvious implementations into randomized round-table mechanisms with public sequential announcements about private information.

papers.title: Group obvious strategy-proofness: Definition and characterization
papers.authors: R. Pablo Arribillaga; Jordi Massó; Alejandro Neme
papers.note: 将显然策略无关扩展到联盟，要求在扩展式机制中，成员联合偏离时也能从分岔处直接判断按规定行动的优势。
papers.noteEn: Extends obvious strategy-proofness to coalitions, comparing compliance and coordinated deviations at the relevant divergence in an extensive-form implementation.

papers.title: New Constructions of Obviously Strategyproof Mechanisms
papers.authors: Diodato Ferraioli; Adrian Meier; Paolo Penna; Carmine Ventre
papers.note: 对相关机器调度给出显然策略无关机制的紧近似界，并刻画哪些集合系统可通过这种机制求得精确最优。
papers.noteEn: Obtains tight approximation bounds for obvious mechanisms in related-machine scheduling and characterizes set systems that admit an optimal obvious mechanism.

papers.title: All sequential allotment rules are obviously strategy‐proof
papers.authors: R. Pablo Arribillaga; Jordi Massó; Alejandro Neme
papers.roleEn: Sequential allotment of a divisible resource
papers.note: 在单峰偏好的分割问题中，所有序贯配给规则均有显然策略无关的实施。
papers.noteEn: Every sequential allotment rule in the single-peaked division environment admits an obviously strategy-proof implementation.

papers.title: Strategically Simple Mechanisms
papers.note: 定义一类机制，其中选择最优策略仅需对他人偏好的一阶信念及对其理性的一阶确信；高阶信念不影响最优选择。
papers.noteEn: Defines mechanisms in which optimal choices require only first-order beliefs about others' preferences and first-order certainty of their rationality, making higher-order beliefs irrelevant.

edges.label: 用更强激励检验稳定性
edges.note: 在经典模型中，针对申请方的占优策略保证不能直接升级为对一般稳定规则的 OSP 保证。
edges.noteEn: A conventional dominant-strategy guarantee for proposers does not directly extend to OSP for general stable rules.

edges.label: 刻画特定规则
edges.note: 对给定顶端交易环规则，问题转为是否存在合适的扩展式实施及哪些优先权允许这种实施。
edges.noteEn: For a given top trading cycles rule, asks whether an appropriate extensive form exists and which priority structures admit one.

edges.label: 改变可规划的行动集
edges.note: 简单占优的标准随着规划视野变化，允许比较不同认知要求的机制。
edges.noteEn: The criterion of simple dominance changes with the planning horizon, allowing mechanisms with different cognitive requirements to be compared.

edges.label: 检验经典正面结果
edges.note: 把首次分岔点的检验应用到若干绕开 Gibbard–Satterthwaite 不可能性的环境。
edges.noteEn: Applies the first-divergence test to several environments that escape the Gibbard–Satterthwaite impossibility.

edges.label: 单峰域的显然实施
edges.labelEn: Obvious implementation on a single-peaked domain
edges.note: 单峰域已支持策略无关；逐节点比较进一步限制可采用的程序及规则。
edges.noteEn: Single-peakedness permits strategy-proof rules, and nodewise incentives further restrict the available rules and procedures.

edges.label: 显然可操纵性
edges.note: 显然操纵与显然占优使用不同的极值比较，因此给同一规则提出不同问题。
edges.noteEn: Obvious manipulation and obvious dominance use different comparisons of extremes and ask different questions of a rule.

edges.label: 一般派位规则
edges.note: 把针对一种优先权交易环算法的问题纳入更广的派位规则分类。
edges.noteEn: Places implementation of a particular priority-based trading cycles rule inside a broader classification of assignment rules.

edges.label: 有限理性的偏好基础
edges.note: 为节点上跨状态的极端结果比较提供偏好层面的公理解释。
edges.noteEn: Provides preference axioms for comparing extreme outcomes across states at a decision node.

edges.label: 卖方的可信履约
edges.note: 除了竞标者看得出的激励，还要求拍卖人没有能逃过监督的有利偏离。
edges.noteEn: Alongside bidders' ability to recognize incentives, adds a constraint on profitable deviations the auctioneer could conceal.

edges.label: 保留可见激励的简化
edges.note: 直接一次性报告未必保留显然性，标准化轮流报告则给出可搜索的机制类别。
edges.noteEn: One-shot direct reports may lose obviousness, while a canonical sequential reporting format restricts the search for mechanisms.

edges.label: 联盟的显然策略无关
edges.note: 单人节点上的最差与最好结果比较须改写，以容纳多人的联合策略。
edges.noteEn: The worst-versus-best comparison at an individual's node must be adapted to coordinated strategies.

edges.label: 显然机制的算法构造
edges.note: 把逐节点的偏离限制变成筛选算法的条件，使显然性与配置近似质量可以同时比较。
edges.noteEn: Turns nodewise deviation restrictions into conditions on algorithms so that obviousness and allocation quality can be assessed together.

edges.label: 可分资源的序贯配给
edges.labelEn: Sequential allotment of a divisible resource
edges.note: 某些通常只被刻画为有效且策略无关的配给规则，还能由不要求复杂反事实比较的程序实施。
edges.noteEn: Some efficient and conventionally strategy-proof allotment rules also admit procedures without demanding counterfactual comparisons.

edges.label: 只需一阶信念
edges.note: 逐节点能否看出占优与最优反应需要几层信念，给出两种不同的认知要求。
edges.noteEn: Recognizing dominance at a node and determining how many orders of belief a best response needs are distinct cognitive requirements.

resources.title: Behavioral Economics in Education Market Design: A Forward-Looking Review

branches.questionEn: Can a participant recognize at the current decision point that truthful action is optimal?
branches.boundaryEn: OSP is a property of an extensive-form mechanism and its strategies. Different procedures with the same input-output mapping may demand different depths of reasoning. Stable matching, housing exchange and general social choice require separate tests.

branches.name: 不可验证信息与同伴预测
branches.question: 评价和私人观察无法事后对照真相时，如何既鼓励人认真观察，又鼓励如实报告？
branches.boundary: 观察是否相关、设计者知道多少先验、每人完成一个还是多个任务都会改变可得的保证。诚实构成一个均衡，并不自动排除协调在同一假报告上的均衡。

papers.title: A Bayesian Truth Serum for Subjective Data
papers.note: 要求参与者同时报告自己的回答及群体回答分布的预测，并比较回答出现的频率与预期频率，构造诚实激励。
papers.noteEn: Asks for an answer and a predicted distribution of others' answers, comparing observed frequencies with predicted frequencies to create incentives for truth.

papers.title: Eliciting Informative Feedback: The Peer-Prediction Method
papers.authors: Nolan Miller · Paul Resnick · Richard Zeckhauser
papers.note: 私人信号对同伴报告的预测不同。用恰当评分规则评价信号所隐含的后验，使如实报告成为均衡。
papers.noteEn: Private signals imply different predictions about peers. A proper scoring rule rewards the posterior implied by a signal, supporting truthful reporting in equilibrium.

papers.title: Crowdsourced Judgement Elicitation with Endogenous Proficiency
papers.note: 在多个二元判断任务中，参与者既可选择是否认真取得信息，也可选择如何报告；跨任务比较帮助区分有信息的相关性与机械一致。
papers.noteEn: Across multiple binary tasks, participants choose whether to acquire information and how to report it. Cross-task comparisons help distinguish informative correlation from mechanical agreement.

papers.title: Informed Truthfulness in Multi-Task Peer Prediction
papers.authors: Victor Shnayder · Arpit Agarwal · Rafael Frongillo · David C. Parkes
papers.role: 比较有信息与无信息报告
papers.note: 在多任务环境中研究相关一致机制，用收益比较区分如实利用私人信息的策略与完全忽略信息的报告。
papers.noteEn: Studies correlated agreement across tasks, comparing payoffs to truthful use of private information and to reports that ignore information entirely.

papers.title: Peer Prediction without a Common Prior
papers.note: 参与者对状态和信号似然持有私人主观信念时，设计同伴预测程序征集诚实反馈。
papers.noteEn: Constructs a peer prediction procedure for agents with private subjective beliefs about states and signal likelihoods.

papers.title: Mechanisms for Making Crowds Truthful
papers.note: 以其他报告作为参照设计报酬，分析反馈成本和参与者协调虚报对真实评价的影响。
papers.noteEn: Designs payments based on reference reports, studying feedback costs and the effects of coordinated misreporting.

papers.title: An Information Theoretic Framework for Designing Information Elicitation Mechanisms That Reward Truth-telling
papers.note: 以互信息刻画报告携带的同伴信息，并将多任务诚实激励从二元信号扩展到更一般的回答。
papers.noteEn: Uses mutual information to measure what reports reveal about peers and extends multitask truthful elicitation beyond binary responses.

papers.title: A Robust Bayesian Truth Serum for Small Populations
papers.note: 为较小参与群体及二元信号设计稳健的贝叶斯测谎机制，使信号与预测报告都得到评分。
papers.noteEn: Constructs a robust Bayesian truth serum for small populations with binary signals, scoring both signals and predictions.

papers.title: Incentivizing Evaluation with Peer Prediction and Limited Access to Ground Truth
papers.authors: Xi Alice Gao; James R. Wright; Kevin Leyton-Brown
papers.note: 允许少量独立核验时，比较抽查与结合同伴评分的机制，考虑评审人协调在低成本信号上的风险。
papers.noteEn: Compares spot-checking with schemes combining verification and peer scores when reviewers can coordinate on low-cost signals.

papers.title: Surrogate Scoring Rules
papers.authors: Yang Liu; Juntao Wang; Yiling Chen
papers.note: 真实状态不可观察时，根据有噪声代理信号及其误差率校正评分，恢复适当评分规则的激励性质。
papers.noteEn: When the outcome is unobservable, corrects scores using a noisy proxy and its error rates to recover incentives from proper scoring rules.

papers.title: A Solution to the Single-Question Crowd Wisdom Problem
papers.authors: Dražen Prelec, H. Sebastian Seung & John McCoy
papers.note: 同时征集答案和对他人回答比例的预测，用实际流行度相对预测的超额程度聚合意见。
papers.noteEn: Collects answers and predictions of others' responses, aggregating using how much an answer's popularity exceeds its predicted popularity.

papers.title: Dominantly Truthful Peer Prediction Mechanisms with a Finite Number of Tasks
papers.roleEn: Dominant truthfulness with finitely many tasks
papers.note: 用体积互信息构造同伴支付，在有限任务数下实现文中占优诚实条件；行列式互信息机制所需任务数随答案类别数变化。
papers.noteEn: Uses volume mutual information to construct peer payments with dominant truthfulness for finitely many tasks. The determinant-based special case requires a number of tasks that depends on the answer alphabet.

papers.title: Measurement Integrity in Peer Prediction: A Peer Assessment Case Study
papers.note: 用同伴评分数据检验机制的报酬是否对应评价者的真实贡献；案例中，多种已有同伴预测方法的报酬难以可靠反映质量。
papers.noteEn: Uses peer-assessment data to test whether payments track the quality of an evaluator's contribution. Several existing mechanisms perform poorly on that criterion in the case study.

papers.title: Eliciting Informative Text Evaluations with Large Language Models
papers.authors: Yuxuan Lu; Shengwei Xu; Yichi Zhang; Yuqing Kong; Grant Schoenebeck
papers.note: 语言模型根据一个评审的文本预测另一个评审的文本。预测足够准确时，努力和诚实报告可构成近似贝叶斯 Nash 均衡。
papers.noteEn: A language model predicts a peer's text from an evaluator's report. Sufficient predictive accuracy can support high effort and truthful reports in approximate Bayesian Nash equilibrium.

papers.title: A Geometric Perspective on Minimal Peer Prediction
papers.note: 只要求报告私人信号的最简机制可以用加权 Voronoi 图刻画；几何表示也用于比较努力激励和稳健性。
papers.noteEn: Characterizes minimal mechanisms that elicit only private signals using power diagrams, a weighted Voronoi construction, and applies the representation to effort incentives and robustness.

edges.label: 比较机制所需报告
edges.note: 前者同时征集信号与总体预测，后者根据一个信号报告得到对同伴回答的隐含预测。
edges.noteEn: One mechanism elicits both a signal and a population prediction. The other infers a prediction of a peer's answer from a signal report.

edges.label: 加入观察成本
edges.note: 简单的报告博弈可以从给定信号出发，众包任务进一步要求信息生产本身得到回报。
edges.noteEn: A reporting game can start with endowed signals. Crowdsourcing also requires rewarding the production of information.

edges.label: 扩展多任务设计
edges.note: 跨任务相关性可用于超越普通的一致性奖励；后文进一步考察一般信号的有信息诚实。
edges.noteEn: Cross-task correlation can improve on raw agreement rewards. The later paper examines informed truthfulness with more general signals.

edges.label: 移除共同先验
edges.note: 放松原同伴评分方法对共同先验的要求，改变必须征集的信念信息。
edges.noteEn: Relaxing the common-prior requirement changes the belief information that must be elicited.

edges.label: 合谋与反馈支付
edges.note: 从某人单独如实报告为最佳回应，转到多个评价者可以协调策略的环境。
edges.noteEn: Moves from unilateral truthful best responses to an environment in which several reviewers can coordinate strategies.

edges.label: 互信息支付
edges.note: 把跨任务相关性的二元方法纳入信息度量框架，说明处理一般信号时需要哪些条件。
edges.noteEn: Places binary cross-task correlation in an information-measure framework and identifies conditions for general signals.

edges.label: 小样本预测
edges.note: 小群体中频率近似不可靠，因而重新构造评分法，保留信号与预测两类报告。
edges.noteEn: A small group weakens frequency approximations, motivating different scores for the same two kinds of reports.

edges.label: 少量真实核验
edges.note: 在努力和报告同时可选的模型中加入少量可验证真相，改变真实努力的激励来源。
edges.noteEn: Adds limited verification to an effort-and-reporting model, changing how informative effort can be rewarded.

edges.label: 有噪声的核验基准
edges.note: 同伴预测依据信号间的相关性评分；替代评分进一步校正参照信号与真值之间的误差。
edges.noteEn: Peer prediction exploits correlation across reports, while surrogate scoring explicitly corrects error between a proxy and the outcome.

edges.label: 将同伴预测用于聚合
edges.note: 同样的二层报告除用于奖励真报，还可在多数人可能犯错时辨认被低估的答案。
edges.noteEn: The same second-order reports can identify an underestimated answer when a simple majority may be wrong.

edges.label: 有限任务的占优诚实
edges.labelEn: Dominant truthfulness with finitely many tasks
edges.note: 把信息量用于支付的思想从大量任务的极限保证推进到明确的有限任务要求。
edges.noteEn: Moves information-based payments from large-task guarantees to explicit finite-task requirements.

edges.label: 报酬能否衡量质量
edges.note: 存在如实报告的均衡，与在实际评审数据中按贡献高低准确支付，是可以分开检验的问题。
edges.noteEn: A truthful equilibrium and accurate payment for contribution quality in actual assessments are separate empirical and theoretical questions.

edges.label: 开放文本的同伴预测
edges.note: 从少数类别的同伴报告扩展到自由文本，将预测误差显式纳入激励保证。
edges.noteEn: Extends peer predictions from a small report alphabet to free text and puts prediction error into the incentive guarantee.

edges.label: 最简同伴机制的几何
edges.note: 把信号报告诱导的同伴后验划分为最优报告区域，几何边界表达激励约束。
edges.noteEn: Partitions posteriors about peers into optimal-report regions whose geometric boundaries encode incentive constraints.

resources.title: Game Theory for Data Science: Eliciting Truthful Information

branches.questionEn: When private observations cannot be verified afterward, how can a mechanism reward both careful observation and truthful reporting?
branches.boundaryEn: Guarantees depend on signal correlation, the designer's knowledge of the prior and the number of tasks per participant. A truthful equilibrium can coexist with an equilibrium in which agents coordinate on a common false report.

branches.name: 可转移效用匹配与排序
branches.question: 匹配双方可以转移效用时，哪些人配对，谁分走合作剩余？观察到的配对又能识别什么？
branches.boundary: 可转移效用使净剩余最大化成为描述匹配配置的工具。稳定只约束收益分配，未必唯一决定工资或配偶间转移。由匹配频数反推偏好还需额外分布结构。

papers.title: The Assignment Game I: The Core
papers.note: 双边配对产生可分剩余。最大权重指派问题给出配置，其线性规划对偶描述如何在双方间分配剩余并防止阻挡。
papers.noteEn: Pairs generate divisible surplus. A maximum-weight assignment gives the allocation, and the linear programming dual describes how to divide surplus across sides without blocking.

papers.title: A Theory of Marriage: Part I
papers.note: 以家庭生产收益解释婚姻排序：当高类型与高类型配对产生更大的边际产出时，互补性可以支撑正向排序。
papers.noteEn: Explains marital sorting by household production. Complementarity can support positive sorting when matching high types together raises the marginal product.

papers.title: Who Marries Whom and Why
papers.note: 在具有个体未观察异质性的可转移效用婚姻模型中，从各类型的匹配与单身频数推算系统性的婚姻收益。
papers.noteEn: In a transferable-utility marriage model with unobserved individual heterogeneity, infers systematic gains from marriage from matching and singlehood frequencies by type.
papers.roleEn: From matching frequencies to marital gains

papers.title: Cupid’s Invisible Hand: Social Surplus and Identification in Matching Models
papers.note: 在可分的未观察异质性下，统一刻画均衡如何权衡可观察互补与私人偏好，并研究由匹配分布识别剩余。
papers.noteEn: With separable unobserved heterogeneity, characterizes equilibrium trade-offs between observable complementarity and private tastes, and studies identification of surplus from the distribution of matches.

papers.title: Multi-Item Auctions
papers.authors: Gabrielle Demange; David Gale; Marilda Sotomayor
papers.note: 单位需求下提出两种动态拍卖，分别求得或逼近买方最优的均衡价格。
papers.noteEn: For unit-demand buyers, gives dynamic auctions that reach or approximate buyer-optimal equilibrium prices.

papers.title: Comparative Advantage and the Distributions of Earnings and Abilities
papers.note: 利用不同能力的工人在不同难度任务上的比较优势，推导能力分布、岗位配置与收入之间的联系。
papers.noteEn: Uses comparative advantage across worker abilities and task difficulties to connect ability distributions, assignments and earnings.

papers.title: Assortative Matching and Search
papers.note: 对象随机相遇且等待有成本时，研究哪些生产互补性条件仍能保证正向排序。
papers.noteEn: When partners meet randomly and waiting is costly, studies complementarity conditions that continue to deliver positive sorting.

papers.title: Estimating Matching Games with Transfers
papers.note: 利用匹配稳定性所隐含的排序不等式估计有转移支付的匹配模型，并应用于汽车零件采购。
papers.noteEn: Uses ranking inequalities implied by matching stability to estimate transferable-utility matching models and applies the method to auto parts sourcing.

papers.title: Personality Traits and the Marriage Market
papers.note: 把教育、人格等多个属性纳入婚姻匹配，估计哪些特征组合对配对剩余更重要。
papers.noteEn: Brings multiple traits such as education and personality into marriage matching and estimates which combinations matter for pair surplus.

papers.title: Costly Concessions: An Empirical Framework for Matching with Imperfectly Transferable Utility
papers.authors: Alfred Galichon; Scott Duke Kominers; Simon Weber
papers.note: 将未观察偏好异质性与不完全可转移效用结合，使伴侣间让渡一单位效用的成本可以偏离一比一。
papers.noteEn: Combines unobserved taste heterogeneity with imperfect transferability, allowing the cost of transferring utility across partners to depart from one-for-one.

papers.title: Partner Choice, Investment in Children, and the Marital College Premium
papers.authors: Pierre-André Chiappori, Bernard Salanié & Yoram Weiss
papers.note: 在婚配模型内加入儿童人力资本这一家庭公共品，研究教育排序和婚姻市场上的大学溢价。
papers.noteEn: Adding children's human capital as a household public good links educational sorting to the marital college premium.

papers.title: Assessing Racial and Educational Segmentation in Large Marriage Markets
papers.note: 在可转移效用的动态婚姻市场中，同时估计接触成本和配对收益，区分同类配对来自相遇分割还是偏好互补。
papers.noteEn: Estimates meeting costs and match gains in a dynamic transferable-utility marriage market, separating homogamy due to segmented opportunities from preference complementarity.

papers.title: Matching with transfers under distributional constraints
papers.authors: Devansh Jalota; Michael Ostrovsky; Marco Pavone
papers.note: 在允许转移支付的多对一匹配市场中加入跨岗位或机构的约束。论文给出保证均衡存在的结构条件，并用线性规划对偶计算均衡。
papers.noteEn: Adds distributional constraints to many-to-one matching with transfers. Gives structural conditions for existence and a linear-programming dual method to compute equilibria.

papers.title: Matching to share risk
papers.note: 两人配对以分担外生收入风险。在论文的模型中稳定匹配存在，通常唯一，并按风险厌恶程度负向排序：一方越厌恶风险，其伴侣越能承受风险。
papers.noteEn: Partners match to share exogenous income risk. In the model a stable match exists, is generically unique and sorts negatively on risk aversion: a more risk-averse person is paired with a more risk-tolerant partner.

papers.title: Hedonic price equilibria, stable matching, and optimal transport: equivalence, topology, and uniqueness
papers.authors: Pierre-André Chiappori; Robert J. McCann; Lars P. Nesheim
papers.note: 建立准线性特征价格均衡、可转移效用稳定匹配和最优传输之间的对应，研究均衡匹配的结构及唯一性。
papers.noteEn: Relates quasilinear hedonic-price equilibrium, transferable-utility stable matching and optimal transport, studying match structure and uniqueness.

edges.label: 比较剩余结构
edges.note: 前者从给定配对剩余构造稳定收益分配；后者问家庭生产技术如何使配对剩余具有排序结构。
edges.noteEn: One paper constructs stable payoffs for given pair surpluses. The other asks when household production gives those surpluses a sorting structure.

edges.label: 加入未观察异质性
edges.note: 系统性特征决定的婚姻收益与个人偏好共同解释同类人为何仍选择不同配偶。
edges.noteEn: Systematic gains from observable characteristics and individual tastes jointly explain why individuals of the same type choose different spouses.

edges.label: 放宽分布假设
edges.note: 把特定随机效用模型下的匹配函数推广至更一般的可分异质性，并给出与社会剩余优化的对应。
edges.noteEn: Generalizes a particular random-utility matching function to richer forms of separable heterogeneity and relates it to social surplus optimization.

edges.label: 竞价求均衡价格
edges.note: 将指派博弈中的对偶价格转成可以通过逐次出价求出的市场结果。
edges.noteEn: Turns assignment-game dual prices into market outcomes computed by successive bids.

edges.label: 工人与岗位
edges.note: 将家庭生产中的互补排序与劳动市场中人岗配置和收入联系起来。
edges.noteEn: Relates complementarity-based sorting in household production to the assignment of workers to jobs and the resulting earnings.

edges.label: 搜寻摩擦与排序
edges.note: 无摩擦配对中的超模性结论需面对拒绝当前对象后再次相遇的机会成本。
edges.noteEn: The frictionless supermodularity argument must account for the opportunity cost of rejecting a current partner.

edges.label: 匹配最大计分估计
edges.note: 除由婚姻频数反演收益外，还可利用观察到的配对相对于可行重配的剩余排序。
edges.noteEn: Alongside inversion from marriage frequencies, one can use surplus rankings of observed matches against feasible rearrangements.

edges.label: 多维属性的互补
edges.note: 以结构化的多维可观测属性替代简单类型，利用配对资料刻画婚姻收益的互补方向。
edges.noteEn: Replaces coarse types with structured multidimensional traits and uses observed matches to estimate the directions of complementarity.

edges.label: 不完全可转移效用
edges.note: 保留从配对资料估计结构参数的目标，放松固定总剩余可以无成本分割的假设。
edges.noteEn: Retains structural estimation from matches while relaxing costless division of a fixed total surplus.

edges.label: 给匹配剩余以家庭结构
edges.note: 对子女的共同投资改变不同教育组合的价值，使估计的婚配模式有可解释的经济机制。
edges.noteEn: Joint investment changes the value of different education pairs and gives observed sorting an economic mechanism.

edges.label: 接触机会与配对剩余
edges.note: 加入交往时长、分离与再婚数据后，类型间配对频数可与机会不均等分开解释。
edges.noteEn: Relationship durations, separation and remarriage help distinguish match frequencies from unequal meeting opportunities.

edges.label: 分布性配额与转移
edges.note: 跨配对的约束会改变指派问题的可行集，也改变支持分配的价格条件。
edges.noteEn: Cross-match restrictions change both the assignment feasible set and the prices that support an allocation.

edges.label: 为分担风险而配对
edges.note: 把家庭生产中的互补性换成风险分担所产生的互补性，重新推导排序。
edges.noteEn: Replaces production complementarity with complementarity generated by risk sharing to derive sorting patterns.

edges.label: 稳定匹配与最优传输
edges.note: 将离散指派的原问题与对偶价格扩展到连续特征空间中的运输与定价。
edges.noteEn: Extends the primal assignment and its dual prices to transport and pricing on continuous characteristic spaces.

branches.questionEn: When partners can transfer utility, who matches and how is surplus divided? What can observed matches identify?
branches.boundaryEn: Transferable utility makes total surplus maximization a tool for describing matches. Stability constrains its division but need not uniquely determine wages or transfers within couples. Inferring preferences from frequencies requires additional distributional structure.

branches.name: 竞争均衡、福利与核心
branches.en: Competitive equilibrium, welfare and the core
branches.question: 由价格协调的配置何时存在，何时有效，又能否抵抗联盟自行重组？
branches.boundary: 区分均衡存在、帕累托效率和核心等价。复制极限与把交易者直接设为连续统采用不同的大市场概念。

papers.title: Existence of an Equilibrium for a Competitive Economy
papers.note: 在偏好、技术与禀赋满足文中条件时，存在一组价格，使个体最优选择彼此相容并使市场出清。
papers.noteEn: Under the paper's assumptions on preferences, technology, and endowments, prices exist at which individually optimal choices are compatible and markets clear.

papers.title: Valuation Equilibrium and Pareto Optimum
papers.note: 在凸性等条件下，用估价体系支持帕累托最优配置。这和在给定个体禀赋后找出市场出清价格是两个问题。
papers.noteEn: Under convexity and related conditions, a valuation system supports a Pareto optimum. Finding market-clearing prices for a given distribution of individual endowments is a separate problem.

papers.title: A Limit Theorem on the Core of an Economy
papers.note: 复制各类消费者后，能在每种规模下抵抗联盟阻挡的同等对待配置须由竞争价格支持。
papers.noteEn: An equal-treatment allocation that withstands coalitional blocking at every replication scale must be supported by competitive prices.

papers.title: Markets with a Continuum of Traders
papers.note: 用连续统表示单个交易者可以忽略的经济；在相应正则条件下，核心与竞争配置集合相等。
papers.noteEn: A continuum represents an economy in which each individual trader is negligible. Under suitable regularity conditions, the core equals the set of competitive allocations.

papers.title: On Equilibrium in Graham's Model of World Trade and Other Competitive Systems
papers.role: 贸易与生产的均衡存在
papers.note: 从格雷厄姆的贸易模型出发，以不动点方法证明竞争价格与可行生产活动可以相容。
papers.noteEn: Starting from Graham's trade model, a fixed-point argument establishes compatibility of competitive prices and feasible production activities.

papers.title: Some Examples of Global Instability of the Competitive Equilibrium
papers.note: 构造交换经济，使价格按超额需求调整时仍无法从某些初始价格收敛到均衡。
papers.noteEn: In these exchange economies, adjusting prices in response to excess demand need not converge to equilibrium from every initial price.

papers.title: Economies with a Finite Set of Equilibria
papers.note: 在光滑交换经济中，正则性使均衡局部孤立；一般位置下，均衡集合是有限的。
papers.noteEn: In smooth exchange economies, regularity locally isolates equilibria. Generically, the equilibrium set is finite.

papers.title: Market Excess Demand Functions
papers.note: 研究哪些超额需求曲线能由效用最大化家庭加总得到，说明个体理论对总量曲线形状的约束很弱。
papers.noteEn: The paper investigates which excess demand functions can be generated by aggregating utility-maximizing households, revealing weak restrictions on aggregate shape.

papers.title: An Elementary Core Equivalence Theorem
papers.note: 用有限交换经济的界来说明，当单个交易者相对市场足够小时，核心配置近似由竞争价格支持。
papers.noteEn: Bounds for finite exchange economies show in what sense competitive prices approximately support core allocations when each trader is small relative to the market.

papers.title: Excess Demand Functions
papers.note: 在适当价格域上刻画可由个人最优化生成的总超额需求，说明个体理性对总量形状的限制很弱。
papers.noteEn: Characterizes excess demand representable by optimizing consumers on an appropriate price domain, showing the limited aggregate shape restrictions of individual rationality.

papers.title: Existence of Competitive Equilibria in Markets with a Continuum of Traders
papers.note: 在无原子的交易者空间中，加总会凸化需求。即使个人偏好不凸，在其余假设成立时也能证明竞争均衡存在。
papers.noteEn: With an atomless trader space, aggregation convexifies demand. Competitive equilibrium can exist even without convex individual preferences when the other assumptions hold.

papers.title: Quasi-Equilibria in Markets with Non-Convex Preferences
papers.note: 用夏普利–福克曼型加总结果控制个人偏好不凸造成的市场出清误差，说明经济规模相对于商品数的作用。
papers.noteEn: A Shapley–Folkman aggregation argument bounds the market-clearing error due to nonconvex individual preferences, showing why size relative to the number of goods matters.

papers.title: Testable Restrictions on the Equilibrium Manifold
papers.authors: Donald J. Brown · Rosa L. Matzkin
papers.role: 市场均衡的可检验限制
papers.note: 用多组价格、总资源和个体收入观测检验它们能否由同一组消费者偏好产生，得到跨观测的均衡限制。
papers.noteEn: Multiple observations of prices, aggregate resources, and individual incomes can be tested for consistency with one profile of consumer preferences, yielding cross-observation restrictions.

papers.title: Competitive Equilibria in Semi-Algebraic Economies
papers.note: 对偏好可用半代数关系表示的交换经济，把均衡条件化成多项式等式和不等式，计算随参数变化的均衡对应。
papers.noteEn: For exchange economies with semialgebraic preferences, polynomial equations and inequalities describe the equilibrium correspondence, allowing it to be computed as parameters vary.

papers.title: Opportunity-Based Other-Regarding Preferences in General Equilibrium: Existence
papers.authors: Maria Bernadette Donato · Chiara Sperati · Antonio Villanacci
papers.role: 关心他人可选机会的均衡
papers.roleEn: Equilibrium with concern for others’ opportunities
papers.note: 家庭关注他人的财富所代表的机会，并可承诺可执行的转移。论文在有限交换经济中为这种带有相互依赖效用的模型证明均衡存在。
papers.noteEn: Households care about the opportunities represented by others' wealth and can commit to transfers. The paper proves equilibrium existence in a finite exchange economy with these interdependent preferences.

edges.label: 从均衡存在到福利刻画
edges.note: 给定禀赋和技术的竞争均衡存在之后，另一个问题是哪些有效配置能由支持价格分散实现。
edges.noteEn: Once existence is established for given endowments and technologies, a separate question is which efficient allocations can be decentralized with supporting prices.

edges.label: 加入联盟阻挡
edges.note: 把价格支持的配置与所有联盟都不能改进的配置作比较，借复制经济缩小两者间的距离。
edges.noteEn: Compare price-supported allocations with allocations that no coalition can improve on. Replication narrows the gap between the two sets.

edges.label: 从极限走向精确等价
edges.note: 有限类型的复制极限换成无原子交易者空间，得到核心与竞争配置的集合等价。
edges.noteEn: Replacing the replication limit of a finite-type economy with an atomless space of traders yields equality between the core and competitive allocations.

edges.label: 同期的另一条存在性证明
edges.note: 两篇论文均证明价格可以协调分散决策；麦肯齐从贸易与生产活动出发构造均衡。
edges.noteEn: Both papers establish that prices can coordinate decentralized decisions. McKenzie's construction starts with trade and production activities.

edges.label: 存在不保证调整收敛
edges.note: 共同出清的价格存在，仍不足以证明交易者按超额需求调整价格时能找到它。
edges.noteEn: Market-clearing prices may exist even when a process that adjusts prices to excess demand fails to reach them.

edges.label: 从有无到均衡个数
edges.labelEn: From existence to the number of equilibria
edges.note: 先建立存在，再以正则性限制均衡价格的集合；有限个均衡仍允许多个解。
edges.noteEn: After existence, regularity restricts the set of equilibrium prices. Finiteness still permits multiplicity.

edges.label: 考察均衡方程的形状
edges.labelEn: Examine the shape of equilibrium equations
edges.note: 证明存在可以利用市场超额需求的基本性质，但个体最优化本身对总量斜率的限制很少。
edges.noteEn: Existence uses basic properties of market excess demand, yet individual optimization alone imposes little discipline on aggregate slopes.

edges.label: 放松精确复制
edges.note: 不要求每个消费者类型同比例复制，改为从单个交易者的相对规模推导近似价格支持。
edges.noteEn: Instead of replicating each type proportionately, use the relative size of individual traders to bound deviations from price support.

edges.label: 由存在转向形状
edges.note: 证明竞争均衡存在并不能推出需求斜率、唯一性或稳定性；还需考察可生成的总需求。
edges.noteEn: Existence alone does not yield slopes, uniqueness, or stability. These depend on what excess demands the economy can generate.

edges.label: 同一连续统中的另一个问题
edges.labelEn: A second question about atomless economies
edges.note: 核心等价说明两类配置何时相同；还需单独证明这个共同集合确实非空。
edges.noteEn: Core equivalence identifies two sets of allocations. A separate existence proof establishes that their common set is nonempty.

edges.label: 放松个人凸性
edges.note: 放弃基准存在定理的凸性后，将问题改为有限市场能以多大误差接近竞争配置。
edges.noteEn: Dropping the benchmark convexity assumption changes the question to how closely a finite market can approximate a competitive allocation.

edges.label: 改变可以观察的数据
edges.note: 单个市场的超额需求形状受限很少；若能变动禀赋并追踪收入和均衡价格，多次观测间仍有可检验关系。
edges.noteEn: Weak restrictions on one market excess-demand function can coexist with testable relations across observations when endowments, incomes and equilibrium prices vary.

edges.label: 从一般有限到找出全部解
edges.labelEn: From generic finiteness to finding all solutions
edges.note: 知道一般位置只有有限个均衡，还需要一种方法在给定经济中列出解并识别多重均衡的参数区域。
edges.noteEn: Generic finiteness does not identify all solutions in a specified economy or the parameter regions with multiplicity. The algebraic formulation addresses both.

edges.label: 让他人的机会集进入效用
edges.note: 当家庭关心他人财富且可承诺转移时，个人选择会改变他人的效用和预算；原先彼此独立的消费问题须重新协调。
edges.noteEn: When households value others' wealth and can commit transfers, one household's decisions change others' utility and budgets. Existence must accommodate that feedback.

resources.title: An Extension of the Basic Theorems of Classical Welfare Economics

branches.questionEn: When do prices support an allocation, when is it efficient, and can any coalition improve on it by acting on its own?
branches.boundaryEn: Existence, Pareto efficiency, and core equivalence are distinct questions. Replicating a finite economy and starting with a continuum of traders formalize large markets in different ways.

branches.name: 不完备资产市场
branches.question: 交易工具有限时，价格能否协调跨期计划？这样的均衡能否在同样有限的工具下得到改进？
branches.boundary: 风险分担受证券张成空间约束。信号如何反映到价格，是相邻的信息聚合问题。

papers.title: Existence of Equilibrium of Plans, Prices, and Price Expectations in a Sequence of Markets
papers.note: 逐期选择商品与证券头寸。当前计划与对未来价格的预期须彼此相容，证券交易的约束在存在性证明中起作用。
papers.noteEn: Agents choose goods and security positions over time. Current plans and future price expectations must be compatible, and constraints on securities trading matter for the existence proof.

papers.title: On the Optimality of Equilibrium When the Market Structure Is Incomplete
papers.note: 考察可交易资产不张成全部状态时的均衡，展示市场不完备如何打破存在性或福利结论的简单推广。
papers.noteEn: When traded assets do not span all states, familiar existence and welfare results need not extend from complete markets.

papers.title: Equilibrium in Incomplete Markets: I: A Basic Model of Generic Existence
papers.note: 两期经济的证券以未来商品束交割，其价值取决于现货价格；研究在光滑性等条件下何时可得到一般位置下的存在性。
papers.noteEn: In a two-period economy, real securities deliver future commodity bundles whose values depend on spot prices. The paper examines generic existence under smoothness and related conditions.

papers.title: Generic Inefficiency of Stock Market Equilibrium When Markets Are Incomplete
papers.authors: John Geanakoplos · Michael Magill · Martine Quinzii · Jacques Drèze
papers.note: 当资产市场不完备、各状态至少有两种消费品等条件成立时，对一般的禀赋配置，调整企业投资并在事前作总额转移可以让每一位消费者受益。
papers.noteEn: When markets are incomplete and each state has at least two consumption goods, among other conditions, changing firms' investment and making ex ante lump-sum transfers can benefit every consumer for generic endowments.

papers.title: The Role of Securities in the Optimal Allocation of Risk-bearing
papers.note: 通过先买卖状态证券、后按实现状态交易现货，可以在适当条件下分散实现完全或有商品市场的风险分担。
papers.noteEn: Under suitable conditions, trading state securities before spot goods decentralizes the risk sharing attainable with complete contingent commodity markets.

papers.title: Implementing Arrow-Debreu Equilibria by Continuous Trading of Few Long-Lived Securities
papers.note: 在连续时间模型中，交易者可以持续调整少数长期证券的头寸；满足风险张成等条件时，这足以实施阿罗–德布鲁均衡。
papers.noteEn: With continuous rebalancing and sufficient spanning of the underlying risks, a small number of long-lived securities can implement an Arrow–Debreu equilibrium.

papers.title: Real Indeterminacy with Financial Assets
papers.role: 名义资产与实物不确定性
papers.note: 不完备的资产以货币单位交付时，不同状态的物价水平会改变实际偿付，使多个不同的实物均衡配置成为可能。
papers.noteEn: With incomplete assets promising nominal payoffs, state-specific price levels change real deliveries and can give rise to multiple real equilibrium allocations.

papers.title: Characterisation of Generically Complete Real Asset Structures
papers.note: 给出实物证券结构的正则条件，使序贯证券和现货市场一般地复制完全或有市场的均衡配置，并证明相应的必要性。
papers.noteEn: A regularity condition on real asset structures is necessary and sufficient for sequential spot and asset markets to reproduce contingent-market allocations generically.

papers.title: Existence of Sunspot Equilibrium and Absence of Non-Sunspot Equilibria in a Financial Economy
papers.note: 以反例说明，没有外生不确定性时可能不存在均衡，而加入与基本面无关的随机状态后可以出现均衡。
papers.noteEn: Examples show that equilibrium can fail without extrinsic uncertainty yet exist once payoffs and prices can condition on a sunspot.

papers.title: Incomplete Markets over an Infinite Horizon: Long-Lived Securities and Speculative Bubbles
papers.note: 在无限期序列经济中研究不完备证券结构下的均衡存在，以及长期证券价格中的投机泡沫。
papers.noteEn: Studies existence in infinite-horizon sequence economies with incomplete securities and the scope for speculative bubbles in long-lived asset prices.

papers.title: Optimal Innovation of Futures Contracts
papers.note: 不再给定证券的偿付向量，而让交易所决定推出什么期货。在文中模型里，垄断交易所选择的合约设计可以是帕累托最优的。
papers.noteEn: Instead of taking payoff vectors as given, an exchange chooses which futures contracts to introduce. In the paper's model, a monopolist's optimal contract design is Pareto optimal.

papers.title: Efficiency and the Role of Default When Security Markets Are Incomplete
papers.note: 若每项承诺都须在所有状态全额履行，市场不完备可能妨碍风险分担。允许有代价的违约能支持本来无法订立的合约并改善福利。
papers.noteEn: Requiring every promise to be met in every state can obstruct risk sharing when markets are incomplete. Costly default can support otherwise unavailable contracts and improve welfare.

papers.title: Welfare Effects of Financial Innovation in Incomplete Markets Economies with Several Consumption Goods
papers.roleEn: Welfare effects of a new security
papers.note: 多种消费品且未保险状态足够多时，新增资产引起的现货价格变化可以使均衡效用沿任意局部方向移动，包括使人人变差。
papers.noteEn: With multiple consumption goods and enough uninsured states, equilibrium utility changes induced by a new asset can point in any local direction, including losses for everyone.

papers.title: Inefficient Credit Booms
papers.note: 企业对未来收入的承诺能力有限。事前借款加大事后抛售、压低资产价格并恶化融资条件，分散选择因而可能导致过度借款。
papers.noteEn: Limited pledgeability constrains firms. Ex ante debt can amplify later asset sales, lower prices and tighten financing conditions, so decentralized contracts may generate excessive borrowing.

papers.title: Equilibrium in Incomplete Markets with Differential Information: A Basic Model of Generic Existence
papers.role: 信息不同的家庭交易不完备资产
papers.note: 两期经济中家庭掌握的状态信息不同，证券以货币或商品偿付。论文给出光滑性等条件，证明这种信息差异与资产不完备同时存在时的一般均衡存在结果。
papers.noteEn: Households have different state information in a two-period economy with cash- or commodity-paying securities. The paper gives conditions for generic existence when both differential information and incomplete spanning are present.

edges.label: 检验福利边界
edges.note: 将序贯计划的相容性与风险分担的效率分开；有限的可交易状态索取权使完全市场的结论失效。
edges.noteEn: Consistency of sequential plans and efficient risk sharing are different properties. A limited set of traded state claims breaks the complete-markets conclusion.

edges.label: 从反例到一般存在
edges.note: 承认某些经济可能无均衡，转而问实物证券市场在哪些经济中一般地存在均衡。
edges.noteEn: Some economies have no equilibrium. The next question is whether equilibrium exists generically with real securities.

edges.label: 从不完备市场反例到一般投资无效率
edges.note: 进入有生产的经济，考察一个只改变企业投资并在事前作总额转移的干预者，说明均衡投资在文中条件下一般可被改进。
edges.noteEn: In a production economy, an intervention limited to firms' investment and ex ante lump-sum transfers can generically improve equilibrium under the paper's conditions.
edges.labelEn: From counterexamples to generic investment inefficiency

edges.label: 分开均衡存在和投资效率
edges.note: 证明资产市场中的均衡一般存在后，仍须问企业投资有没有受约束的帕累托改进空间。两篇文章分别分析这两个问题。
edges.noteEn: Even when equilibrium exists generically, firms' investments may admit a constrained Pareto improvement. The papers address these two questions separately.

edges.label: 回到序贯交易的张成基准
edges.note: 将一般的序贯资产交易与每个状态都有索取权的特例对照，可以看出缺少的是哪些财富转移。
edges.noteEn: Contrast general sequential asset trade with claims covering every state to identify missing wealth transfers.

edges.label: 让头寸连续调整
edges.note: 资产种类少不一定意味着可达的消费计划少，还要考虑信息到达后能否重新交易。
edges.noteEn: A small menu of assets need not restrict attainable consumption plans if agents can trade again as information arrives.

edges.label: 将实物交割换成名义偿付
edges.labelEn: Replace real deliveries with nominal payoffs
edges.note: 实物证券的价值随价格变化；名义承诺的实际购买力也随价格变化，从而带来另一种均衡不确定性。
edges.noteEn: Spot prices value real deliveries, while state price levels determine the purchasing power of nominal promises. The latter creates a distinct source of indeterminacy.

edges.label: 从一般存在到一般完备
edges.labelEn: From generic existence to generic completeness
edges.note: 比存在性更强的问题是，即使市场分期开放，哪些实物收益结构仍能实现完全市场配置。
edges.noteEn: Beyond existence, which real payoff structures allow sequential markets to attain complete-market allocations?

edges.label: 在不存在的例子中加入太阳黑子
edges.labelEn: Add a sunspot to a nonexistence example
edges.note: 不只问哪些经济会无解，还比较同一基本面在允许价格依赖外生信号后有没有均衡。
edges.noteEn: The comparison holds fundamentals fixed and asks whether conditioning prices on an extrinsic signal restores equilibrium.

edges.label: 撤去终端日期
edges.note: 没有最后一个清算日期时，需要新的条件来控制资产价值与可行计划。
edges.noteEn: Without a last settlement date, new conditions are needed to control asset values and feasible trading plans.

edges.label: 将给定的证券结构内生化
edges.note: 从判断哪些证券组合能张成需求，转向比较有自身目标的中介会实际创造哪种偿付。
edges.noteEn: Move from asking which sets of securities span desired payoffs to asking which payoff an intermediary with its own objective will create.

edges.label: 让可执行承诺随偿付规则改变
edges.note: 资产种类缺失时，合约到期能否少付，会改变既有证券能实现的风险转移。
edges.noteEn: When some assets are missing, the possibility of partial repayment at maturity changes the risk transfers feasible with the existing instruments.

edges.label: 设计带来特定福利方向的资产
edges.labelEn: Design an asset for a welfare direction
edges.note: 从不完备市场的福利反例进一步追问，一项新证券的偿付能否经由现货价格改变各人的均衡效用。
edges.noteEn: Beyond a welfare counterexample, ask whether selecting one new payoff vector can steer individual equilibrium utilities through induced spot-price changes.

edges.label: 把价格外部性落实到信用决策
edges.labelEn: Locate the price externality in borrowing
edges.note: 同样要比较私人投资与受约束规划者的选择，这里可具体追踪债务如何经由危机时的资产价格影响他人的约束。
edges.noteEn: The constrained planner comparison now traces a specific mechanism from debt through crisis asset prices to other agents' financing constraints.

edges.label: 在一般存在问题中放松信息对称
edges.labelEn: Relax symmetric information in generic existence
edges.note: 原有困难来自证券价值依赖现货价格；当个人的信息也有差异时，还要协调不同信息下的跨期交易计划。
edges.noteEn: Beyond spot prices determining security values, agents' different information sets must now be reconciled in their intertemporal plans.

resources.title: An Introduction to General Equilibrium with Incomplete Asset Markets
Existence, Regularity, and Constrained Suboptimality of Competitive Allocations When the Asset Market Is Incomplete

branches.questionEn: Can prices coordinate intertemporal plans when trading instruments are limited? Could an intervention using similarly limited instruments improve the equilibrium?
