branches.boundaryEn: The securities' payoff span constrains risk sharing. How signals are incorporated into prices is a related question about information aggregation.

branches.name: 搜寻、报价与匹配摩擦
branches.en: Search, wage posting and matching frictions
branches.question: 等待下一次报价的选择如何改变市场工资、就业和企业规模？
branches.boundary: 包括工人或买方寻找交易对象的摩擦；将已知选项按顺序检查的最优停止可参看个体搜索理论。

papers.title: Economics of Information and Job Search
papers.note: 面对外生报价分布与继续搜寻的机会成本，求职者用保留工资决定何时接受报价。
papers.noteEn: Given an exogenous offer distribution and the opportunity cost of further search, a job seeker uses a reservation wage to decide when to accept.

papers.title: A Model of Price Adjustment
papers.note: 顾客必须付出正成本才能取得额外报价；在基准环境中，卖方的最优报价可以集中在垄断价格。
papers.noteEn: Obtaining another quote is costly. In the benchmark environment, sellers' optimal offers can concentrate at the monopoly price.

papers.title: Wage Determination and Efficiency in Search Equilibrium
papers.note: 搜寻技术和议价决定工资。新工人加入带来的预期收益与社会边际产值可以不同。
papers.noteEn: The matching technology and bargaining determine wages. The expected return to a worker entering the market can differ from the worker's marginal social product.

papers.title: Job Creation and Job Destruction in the Theory of Unemployment
papers.authors: Dale T. Mortensen · Christopher A. Pissarides
papers.note: 冲击改变匹配生产率与继续经营的剩余；企业同时决定是否创造空缺、是否关闭已有岗位。
papers.noteEn: Shocks change match productivity and the surplus from continuing. Firms decide both whether to create vacancies and whether to close existing jobs.

papers.title: Wage Differentials, Employer Size, and Unemployment
papers.note: 允许在职者继续搜索。高工资企业留人更久并吸引更多工人，同质工人和同质企业也可出现非退化工资分布。
papers.noteEn: Employed workers keep searching. High-wage firms attract more workers and keep them longer, so identical workers and firms can generate a nondegenerate wage distribution.

papers.title: Equilibrium Price Dispersion
papers.note: 有些消费者只观察一个报价，另一些比较多个报价。卖方在争取比较者和向低信息顾客收取高价之间权衡。
papers.noteEn: Some consumers see one quote and others compare several. Sellers trade off attracting comparison shoppers against charging captive buyers a higher price.

papers.title: Aggregate Demand Management in Search Equilibrium
papers.note: 随机相遇的易货市场中，别人也参与交易会改善自己的成交机会，模型因此可有多个稳态和低效率。
papers.noteEn: In a barter economy with random matching, other agents' participation improves one's trading prospects. The model can have multiple steady states and inefficiency.

papers.title: On the Efficiency of Matching and Related Models of Search and Unemployment
papers.note: 在规模报酬不变的匹配基准中，某一方获得的剩余份额应与匹配量对该方投入的弹性相符，私人参与才会内化边际匹配效果。
papers.noteEn: In the constant-returns matching benchmark, a side's surplus share must equal the matching elasticity with respect to its input for private participation to internalize the marginal matching effect.

papers.title: Competitive Search Equilibrium
papers.note: 企业公开工资，求职者选择工资与排队长度不同的子市场。模型中工资和成交概率的权衡可实现有效分配。
papers.noteEn: Firms advertise wages and workers choose among submarkets with different wages and queues. The trade-off between wages and matching probabilities can implement efficiency in the model.

papers.title: Efficient Unemployment Insurance
papers.note: 风险厌恶的工人可能回避高工资、低录用概率的岗位。失业保险改变其选择，也影响企业创造什么岗位和投资多少。
papers.noteEn: Risk-averse workers may shun high-wage openings with low hiring probabilities. Insurance changes their choices and firms' job creation and investment decisions.

papers.title: Marriage and Class
papers.note: 随机相遇的异质个体都能拒绝对方，在不可转移效用下，均衡接受门槛可以内生地产生婚配阶层。
papers.noteEn: With nontransferable utility and bilateral acceptance, heterogeneous searchers can sort into endogenous classes in steady state.

papers.title: Pricing and Matching with Frictions
papers.authors: Kenneth Burdett · Shouyong Shi · Randall Wright
papers.note: 卖方承诺价格，买方选择去哪家并可能与他人撞在同一家；价格和成交概率共同决定买方选择，且有限市场也有明确均衡。
papers.noteEn: Sellers commit to prices and buyers choose which seller to visit, risking a collision with other buyers. Prices and trading probabilities jointly determine visits, including in finite markets.

papers.title: Equilibrium Wage Dispersion with Worker and Employer Heterogeneity
papers.note: 工人和企业均异质，在职者收到新邀约时，原雇主可以还价。工资因生产率组合和过去收到的报价而不同。
papers.noteEn: Workers and firms are heterogeneous and incumbent employers can counter outside offers. Pay depends both on the productivity match and on the offers a worker has encountered.

papers.title: The Cyclical Behavior of Equilibrium Unemployment and Vacancies
papers.role: 失业与空缺的波动幅度
papers.note: 将搜寻匹配模型的失业与空缺反应量化。按基准设定校准时，合理规模的生产率冲击产生的市场紧张度波动远小于美国数据。
papers.noteEn: The paper quantifies unemployment and vacancy responses in a search-and-matching model. Under the benchmark calibration, plausible productivity shocks generate much less market-tightness volatility than in US data.

papers.title: Efficient Search on the Job and the Business Cycle
papers.note: 模型让在职工人根据岗位特定生产率决定是否定向寻找新职位，并用分块递归结构研究总量冲击下的跨岗流动。
papers.noteEn: Employed workers direct search toward new jobs as match productivity changes. A block-recursive structure makes job-to-job flows under aggregate shocks tractable.

papers.title: Sequentially Mixed Search and Equilibrium Price Dispersion
papers.roleEn: Directed search followed by noisy matching
papers.note: 买家先选择报价分布，再随机收到若干报价。即使买卖双方各自同质，文中的唯一受约束有效均衡仍有连续、非退化的价格分布。
papers.noteEn: Buyers direct search toward a price distribution and then draw multiple offers through noisy matching. Even with homogeneous agents on each side, the unique constrained-efficient equilibrium has a continuous, nondegenerate price distribution.

edges.label: 报价改由卖方选择
edges.note: 个人拿给定报价分布作停止决策。卖方也最优化后，搜索成本反过来决定报价是否分散。
edges.noteEn: The individual stopping problem takes the offer distribution as given. Once sellers optimize, search costs also affect whether offers are dispersed.

edges.label: 在职搜寻
edges.note: 坚持比较后续报价，同时允许已就业工人收到新报价，企业通过发薪影响雇佣和流失。
edges.noteEn: Workers continue comparing offers after finding a job. Firms use wages to influence recruitment and turnover.

edges.label: 岗位存续内生
edges.note: 匹配议价影响工资分配，岗位特定冲击进一步决定哪些匹配会终止。
edges.noteEn: Bargaining determines how match surplus is divided. Match-specific shocks additionally determine which jobs end.

edges.label: 议价与张贴的分岔
edges.note: 前者在相遇后分配剩余，后者由企业预先发布工资，以队伍的招聘与留任来决定收益。
edges.noteEn: One approach divides surplus after a meeting. The other has firms post wages in advance, with profits depending on recruitment and retention.

edges.label: 允许同批取得多个报价
edges.labelEn: Allow several quotes in one search
edges.note: 买方获得报价的方式改变后，卖方可以在同质商品市场上维持非退化的均衡价格分布。
edges.noteEn: Changing how consumers obtain quotations can support a nondegenerate price distribution even for a homogeneous good.

edges.label: 从双边议价到参与外部性
edges.note: 两种模型都让成交依赖相遇；易货模型把他人参与对匹配机会的影响放在中心。
edges.noteEn: Both models require meetings for trade. The barter model isolates how other agents' participation changes the chance of a match.

edges.label: 明确效率的份额条件
edges.note: 双边议价决定剩余如何分配，匹配函数则衡量额外参与者为市场带来的机会；比较二者得到效率条件。
edges.noteEn: Bargaining sets the surplus split and the matching function measures what another participant adds. Comparing them gives an efficiency condition.

edges.label: 让报价引导搜索方向
edges.note: 工资不只影响收到报价后的接受意愿，还改变求职者到哪个子市场排队。
edges.noteEn: A posted wage affects both offer acceptance and the submarket in which workers choose to queue.

edges.label: 在定向搜寻中引入风险厌恶
edges.labelEn: Add risk aversion to directed search
edges.note: 不同子市场的等待风险由工人承担时，提供保险会改变求职方向，进而改变企业投资。
edges.noteEn: When workers bear different waiting risks across submarkets, insurance changes where they search and hence firms' investment.

edges.label: 从单边停止到双边接受
edges.note: 接受眼前对象既取决于自己的等待价值，也取决于对方是否愿意成交。
edges.labelEn: From one-sided stopping to mutual acceptance
edges.noteEn: Acceptance depends on one's value of waiting and on whether the other side will accept.

edges.label: 在有限市场推导排队概率
edges.labelEn: Derive queues in a finite market
edges.note: 定向搜寻中的成交概率在这里来自买方同时选择具体卖家的策略，而不仅是给定的匹配函数。
edges.noteEn: Matching probabilities arise from buyers simultaneously choosing individual sellers rather than being imposed by a matching function.

edges.label: 让在位雇主回应外部报价
edges.labelEn: Let the incumbent counter an offer
edges.note: 张贴工资的企业靠工资吸引和留住工人；可以还价时，同一生产率配对也会因报价历史不同而付不同工资。
edges.noteEn: Posting trades off recruitment and retention. With counteroffers, otherwise identical productivity matches can pay differently because offer histories differ.

edges.label: 用空缺与失业之比检验放大效应
edges.labelEn: Test amplification with the vacancy–unemployment ratio
edges.note: 模型能产生岗位创建和消亡后，还须检验工资与匹配剩余的反应能否使波动达到数据中的量级。
edges.noteEn: A model can generate job creation and destruction yet fail quantitatively if wages and match surplus do not amplify shocks enough.

edges.label: 把定向搜索延伸到已就业者
edges.labelEn: Extend directed search to employed workers
edges.note: 有了在职搜索，企业争夺的对象不仅是失业者；总量状态会改变在现有岗位等待和转职的相对价值。
edges.noteEn: Firms now compete for employed as well as unemployed workers, and aggregate conditions change the relative value of waiting in a match and moving.

edges.label: 把报价比较嵌入定向搜索
edges.labelEn: Embed quotation comparisons in directed search
edges.note: 获得多个报价能产生价格分散；进一步允许买家在取得报价前选择搜索哪种市场，就可同时研究分散与市场效率。
edges.noteEn: Multiple quotes can sustain dispersion. Allowing buyers to choose a market before drawing offers makes it possible to study dispersion and market efficiency jointly.

resources.title: Search-Theoretic Models of the Labor Market: A Survey
resources.authors: Richard Rogerson · Robert Shimer · Randall Wright

branches.questionEn: How does the option to wait for another offer affect market wages, employment, and firm size?
branches.boundaryEn: The focus is on frictions in finding trading partners. For optimal stopping when known alternatives can be inspected in sequence, see individual search theory.

branches.name: 产品差异化与价格竞争
branches.question: 厂商会选择彼此靠近以争夺需求，还是通过拉开差异来缓和价格竞争？
branches.boundary: 水平差异使消费者对同一对产品排序不同；纵向差异允许消费者同意哪种品质更好，却愿为品质支付不同价格。

papers.title: Stability in Competition
papers.note: 用消费者到两家厂商的距离刻画产品差异，讨论竞争者有无向相同位置靠近的动机。
papers.noteEn: Consumer distance from two firms captures product differences and helps explain why competitors might move toward the same location.

papers.title: On Hotelling’s “Stability in Competition”
papers.authors: Claude d’Aspremont · Jean Jaskold Gabszewicz · Jacques-François Thisse
papers.note: 线性交通成本下企业过近会使价格子博弈失去纯策略均衡；二次交通成本的版本可产生最大差异化。
papers.noteEn: With linear transport costs, nearby firms may have no pure-strategy price equilibrium. Quadratic transport costs can generate maximal differentiation.

papers.title: Monopolistic Competition with Outside Goods
papers.note: 在环形产品空间中引入外部商品与进入，区分局部价格竞争和争夺外部商品消费者的激励。
papers.noteEn: Introducing an outside good and entry on a product circle separates local price competition from competition for buyers of the outside good.

papers.title: Relaxing Price Competition Through Product Differentiation
papers.note: 消费者对品质排序一致、支付意愿不同；厂商先选择品质，借助品质距离缓和此后的价格竞争。
papers.noteEn: Consumers agree on quality but differ in willingness to pay. Firms choose quality before prices and can soften price competition by separating their qualities.

papers.title: Product Selection, Fixed Costs, and Monopolistic Competition
papers.note: 新产品的利润和消费者从新品种获得的剩余不同；存在固定成本时，自由进入未必选出有效的品种组合。
papers.noteEn: Profits from introducing a product need not capture the surplus it creates for consumers. With fixed costs, free entry need not select the efficient product mix.

papers.title: Monopolistic Competition and Optimum Product Diversity
papers.authors: Avinash K. Dixit · Joseph E. Stiglitz
papers.note: 每个品种分担固定成本，消费者又偏好多样性。模型比较垄断竞争均衡和规划者选择的品种数与单厂产量。
papers.noteEn: Each variety incurs a fixed cost, while consumers value diversity. The model compares decentralized variety and output per firm with the planner's choices.

papers.title: Monopoly and Product Quality
papers.note: 垄断者面对支付意愿不同的消费者，以价格和品质组合筛选类型。设计低品质产品时必须考虑高类型是否愿意模仿。
papers.noteEn: A monopolist screens consumers with different willingness to pay by offering price–quality pairs. Low quality must be designed with high types' incentives to imitate in mind.

papers.title: Price Competition, Quality and Income Disparities
papers.note: 消费者偏好相同但收入不同，在互斥的质量选项中购买；两家厂商的价格竞争因此受到收入分布影响。
papers.noteEn: Consumers have the same tastes but different incomes and make mutually exclusive quality choices. The income distribution therefore shapes price competition between the firms.

papers.title: Pricing, Product Diversity, and Search Costs: A Bertrand–Chamberlin–Diamond Model
papers.note: 买家付成本寻找更适合的品种。多样性会提高继续搜索的价值，因此差异化增加时均衡价格未必立刻上升。
papers.noteEn: Buyers pay to look for a better match. Variety can make further search worthwhile, so more differentiation need not initially raise equilibrium prices.

papers.title: Automobile Prices in Market Equilibrium
papers.authors: Steven Berry, James Levinsohn & Ariel Pakes
papers.role: 差异化需求的结构估计
papers.note: 把随机系数消费者需求和多产品厂商定价条件结合，用汽车市场数据估计替代、加价和边际成本。
papers.noteEn: Combines random-coefficient consumer demand and multiproduct pricing conditions to estimate substitution, markups, and marginal costs in automobiles.

papers.title: Natural Oligopolies
papers.role: 质量竞争的集中度下界
papers.note: 在文中纵向产品差异模型的条件下，扩大市场未必支撑越来越多有规模的厂商。质量竞争能使产业在大市场中仍然集中。
papers.noteEn: Under the paper's conditions for vertically differentiated goods, a growing market need not support ever more substantial firms. Quality competition can sustain concentration even in large markets.

papers.title: Equilibrium with Product Differentiation
papers.authors: Jeffrey M. Perloff · Steven C. Salop
papers.note: 消费者对不同品牌有不同的匹配价值。增加品牌数量对价格加成的作用取决于口味分布，竞争极限不必等同于无差异商品的结果。
papers.noteEn: Consumers have brand-specific match values. The effect of adding brands on markups depends on the distribution of tastes, so the limit need not mimic homogeneous-good competition.

papers.title: Price and Variety in the Spokes Model
papers.note: 产品分布在不同辐条上，消费者只考虑部分品牌。新增品种同时带来竞争对手和新的市场覆盖，使价格对品种数的反应可能非单调。
papers.noteEn: Products occupy different spokes and each consumer considers only some brands. Adding a variety changes both rivalry and coverage, so prices need not respond monotonically to variety.

papers.title: Multiproduct-Firm Oligopoly: An Aggregative Games Approach
papers.role: 多产品企业的加总定价
papers.note: 在文中需求体系下，企业掌握多个产品时的最优价格向量可由一个标量概括。CES 与 logit 情形还允许把市场竞争环境进一步加总。
papers.noteEn: For the paper's demand systems, a scalar summarizes a multiproduct firm's optimal price vector. CES and logit demand permit further aggregation of the competitive environment.

papers.title: Continuous Spatial Monopolistic Competition: Matching Goods with Consumers
papers.authors: Maxim Goryunov · Sergey Kokovin · Takatoshi Tabuchi
papers.role: 连续品种空间中的垄断竞争
papers.roleEn: Monopolistic competition in a continuous variety space
papers.note: 消费者在产品特征空间中有理想位置。模型把这种空间匹配放进可加的垄断竞争需求，研究覆盖范围、竞争与品种分布。
papers.noteEn: Consumers have ideal points in a space of product characteristics. Adding this matching dimension to additive monopolistic competition permits analysis of market coverage, competition and the distribution of varieties.

edges.label: 均衡存在性修正
edges.note: 先检查选址后的价格子博弈。若不存在纯策略价格均衡，从其利润推导选址激励就缺少依据。
edges.noteEn: The price subgame after location choices must be examined first. Without a pure-strategy price equilibrium, its presumed profits cannot justify location incentives.

edges.label: 进入与市场覆盖
edges.note: 从线段上的两家厂商转向环形竞争，进入和外部商品改变覆盖范围与均衡品种。
edges.noteEn: Moving from two firms on a line to circular competition adds an outside good and entry, which affect coverage and equilibrium variety.

edges.label: 横向与纵向差异
edges.note: 两条路线都比较差异化如何缓解价格竞争，但区分厂商的是偏好位置或消费者一致排序的品质。
edges.noteEn: Both approaches examine how differentiation softens price competition. Firms differ either in their positions relative to tastes or in qualities on which consumers agree.

edges.label: 比较私人进入与社会品种价值
edges.labelEn: Compare entry profits with the value of variety
edges.note: 环形市场问相邻企业如何争夺顾客；品种选择的福利问题还要比较新增产品的利润与社会增益。
edges.noteEn: Circular rivalry explains local competition. The welfare question compares the entrant's profits with the social gain from another product.

edges.label: 用对称需求分离规模和品种
edges.labelEn: Separate scale from variety under symmetric demand
edges.note: 在对称的差异化商品体系内，可以分别考察单厂生产规模和进入品种数偏离福利基准的原因。
edges.noteEn: A symmetric differentiated-goods system separates departures from efficient plant scale from departures in the number of varieties.

edges.label: 将多厂商质量选择改为单厂商菜单
edges.labelEn: Replace competing qualities with a monopoly menu
edges.note: 同样以质量区分产品，多厂竞争取决于对手定价，单厂菜单则受消费者自我选择约束。
edges.noteEn: Both models distinguish products by quality. Rival prices discipline competing firms, while consumer self-selection constrains a monopolist's menu.

edges.label: 区分给定质量与先选质量
edges.note: 研究给定产品的价格博弈，为比较企业在定价前是否愿意扩大品质差距提供基准。
edges.noteEn: Competition with given products provides a benchmark for determining whether firms choose to widen quality differences before setting prices.

edges.label: 把偏好位置与信息成本结合
edges.labelEn: Combine taste differences with search frictions
edges.note: 消费者不仅与产品有匹配远近，还要先付出成本才能知道下一种产品是否更适合。
edges.noteEn: Besides differing in fit across products, consumers must incur a cost to discover whether another product suits them better.

edges.label: 由理论价格到可估计加价
edges.note: 产品特征上的异质偏好决定替代程度，经由均衡一阶条件映射到价格成本差。
edges.labelEn: From equilibrium prices to estimated markups
edges.noteEn: Heterogeneity over product characteristics governs substitution, which pricing first-order conditions map into margins.

edges.label: 改变市场规模和企业数
edges.labelEn: Vary market size and the number of firms
edges.note: 由给定厂商数下通过质量缓和价格竞争，进一步问市场扩大、容许进入时质量竞争如何限制存活者数量。
edges.noteEn: From quality choices that soften price rivalry among given firms, ask how the same rivalry limits survival when the market expands and entry is possible.

edges.label: 从邻近位置转向品牌匹配价值
edges.labelEn: Replace neighbors with brand-specific match values
edges.note: 圆周模型预先规定谁是最接近的对手；随机口味使对手的强弱由消费者各自的品牌排序决定。
edges.noteEn: A circle fixes each seller's neighbors in advance. With random tastes, the relevant rivals are determined by each consumer's ranking of brands.

edges.label: 改变空间结构和可比较的品牌
edges.labelEn: Change the geography of feasible comparisons
edges.note: 将圆周上固定的相邻竞争改为不同辐条间的成对替代，可以区分抢走原有顾客和吸引未被覆盖者。
edges.noteEn: Pairwise substitution across spokes replaces fixed neighbors on a circle, distinguishing business stealing from the attraction of previously unserved consumers.

edges.label: 寻找高维定价问题的充分统计量
edges.labelEn: Find sufficient statistics for high-dimensional pricing
edges.note: 给定市场份额与多产品所有权，完整定价系统通常维度很高；对需求施加结构可导出更低维的均衡表示。
edges.noteEn: With market shares and multiproduct ownership, the pricing system can be high-dimensional. Additional demand structure yields a lower-dimensional equilibrium characterization.

edges.label: 让多样性偏好具有空间位置
edges.labelEn: Give the demand for variety a spatial structure
edges.note: 对品种的共同喜好不能区分哪个产品更适合某名消费者；引入理想品种后，进入的效果也取决于新品种位于哪里。
edges.noteEn: A common taste for variety does not say which good best suits each buyer. With ideal varieties, the effect of entry also depends on where the entrant locates.

resources.title: Discrete Choice Theory of Product Differentiation
resources.authors: Simon P. Anderson · André de Palma · Jacques-François Thisse

branches.questionEn: Do firms move closer to capture demand, or differentiate to soften price competition?
branches.boundaryEn: With horizontal differentiation, consumers rank a pair of goods differently. With vertical differentiation, consumers agree on the quality ranking but differ in willingness to pay for quality.

branches.name: 网络效应与多边平台
branches.question: 平台应该向哪一边收钱？用户能否同时加入多个平台，如何改变答案？
branches.boundary: 网络外部性可发生在单一用户群中；多边平台进一步选择不同用户群之间的费率结构。

papers.title: Network Externalities, Competition, and Compatibility
papers.note: 消费者从预期网络规模中获益，兼容性会改变厂商争夺用户的激励和不同网络的相对吸引力。
papers.noteEn: Consumers value expected network size. Compatibility changes firms' incentives to compete for users and the relative attractiveness of networks.

papers.title: Chicken & Egg: Competition among Intermediation Service Providers
papers.note: 平台必须协调不同类别用户的加入；注册费、交易费与用户能否同时使用多个中介影响进入策略。
papers.noteEn: A platform must attract distinct groups at the same time. Registration fees, transaction fees, and users' ability to join several intermediaries affect entry strategies.

papers.title: Platform Competition in Two-Sided Markets
papers.note: 一边的参与提高另一边的交易价值。即使总收费给定，在两边之间重新分摊收费也会改变交易量。
papers.noteEn: Participation on one side raises the value of transactions on the other. Reallocating a given total charge across sides can therefore change transaction volume.

papers.title: Competition in Two-Sided Markets
papers.note: 比较垄断、两边均单归属及一边多归属。平台对接触单归属用户的控制改变两边面临的竞争。
papers.noteEn: The paper compares monopoly, two-sided single-homing, and multihoming on one side. Control over access to single-homing users changes competition on both sides.

papers.title: A Price Theory of Multi-Sided Platforms
papers.note: 在多边垄断平台上比较经营者与社会目标下的边际定价激励，考虑边际用户和平均用户创造的外部性差别。
papers.noteEn: For a multisided monopolist, the private and social incentives to change prices depend on the difference between the externalities created by marginal and average users.

papers.title: A Price Theory of Multi-Sided Platforms: Comment
papers.note: 指出局部定价激励的差额不足以直接给出两个最优价格的水平差，明确原文公式的解释边界。
papers.noteEn: A difference in local pricing incentives does not directly give the difference in the levels of two optimal prices. The comment clarifies how the original formula can be interpreted.

papers.title: A Price Theory of Multi-Sided Platforms: Reply
papers.note: 回应对价格扭曲公式的评论，和原文及评论配对阅读。
papers.noteEn: The authors respond to the comment on the price-distortion formula. Read the reply together with the original paper and the comment.

papers.title: Standardization, Compatibility, and Innovation
papers.note: 当新旧标准的价值取决于他人采用什么标准时，企业对切换时机的犹豫会妨碍有利的技术转换。
papers.noteEn: When a standard's value depends on other adopters, uncertainty over whether others will switch can impede a beneficial transition to a new technology.

papers.title: Pricing and Commitment by Two-Sided Platforms
papers.note: 卖方先于买方到达。若卖方对平台持悲观预期，垄断平台可能愿意在宣布卖方费用时保留未来确定买方价格的权利。
papers.noteEn: Sellers arrive before buyers. With unfavorable seller expectations, a monopoly platform may prefer to retain flexibility over its buyer price when announcing seller fees.

papers.title: Asymmetric Networks in Two-Sided Markets
papers.note: 限制用户协调失败的程度后，两个网络仍可并存。一个在第一边更大且更便宜，另一个在第二边更大且更便宜。
papers.noteEn: Even with restrictions on coordination failures, two networks can coexist. One is larger and cheaper on the first side, the other on the second.

papers.title: Platform Competition and Seller Investment Incentives
papers.note: 买卖双方可在收费平台上交易，卖方先投资以提高其产品价值。平台竞争和开放平台在卖方能获得的投资回报上可以不同。
papers.noteEn: Sellers invest in product value before trading on fee-charging platforms. Competition between proprietary platforms and an open platform can leave sellers with different returns to investment.

papers.title: Marketplace or Reseller?
papers.note: 中介可让供应商直接销售，也可买入再转售。哪种方式更好取决于谁掌握营销决策所需的信息，以及产品间存在什么外部性。
papers.noteEn: An intermediary can facilitate direct sales or purchase and resell products. The preferred mode depends on who holds information relevant to marketing decisions and on externalities across products.

papers.title: Why Do Intermediaries Divert Search?
papers.note: 平台可刻意改变消费者找到商家的路径，使消费者与商家加入平台时都有不同激励。
papers.noteEn: A platform can deliberately redirect consumer search, changing the incentives on both sides to participate.

papers.title: Two-Sided Markets, Competitive Bottlenecks and Exclusive Contracts
papers.note: 两边的产品差异程度可不同，因此一边可能选择同时加入多个平台。排他合约会改变争夺多归属一侧及接触另一侧用户的方式。
papers.noteEn: Differentiation can differ across sides, allowing one side to join several platforms. Exclusive contracts change competition for multihoming users and access to users on the other side.

papers.title: Search Advertising
papers.note: 搜索引擎能用广告帮助消费者找到更匹配的卖家，但垄断平台可能把向广告主收取的费用定得过高，抵消定向的收益。
papers.noteEn: Targeted search advertising can help consumers find suitable sellers. A monopoly search engine may charge advertisers enough to offset the gains from targeting.

papers.title: Price Coherence and Excessive Intermediation
papers.note: 卖家对直购和经中介购买者收取同价时，使用中介者不能充分感受到渠道成本。中介服务与用户奖励都可能超过有效率的水平。
papers.noteEn: When buyers pay the same retail price through an intermediary and directly, intermediary users may not bear the channel's full cost. Intermediation and buyer benefits can exceed efficient levels.

papers.title: Search Platforms: Showrooming and Price Parity Clauses
papers.note: 消费者可先在平台搜索，再绕开平台向卖家购买。不同范围的价格平价条款改变平台的收费空间、卖家价格与消费者的搜索激励。
papers.noteEn: Consumers can search on a platform and then buy directly from the seller. Price-parity clauses of different scope change platform fees, retail prices, and consumers' incentives to search.

papers.title: Private Contracts in Two-Sided Platforms
papers.note: 平台与卖方订立保密合约时，买卖双方都面临平台事后改变激励的问题。在文中环境下，平台能更多控制卖方价格反而可提高透明度和福利。
papers.noteEn: Confidential seller contracts create interrelated hold-up problems for buyers and sellers. In the model, greater platform control over seller prices can improve transparency and welfare.

edges.label: 把加入分成两边
edges.note: 消费者关心网络规模进一步表现为两类用户互相等待；补贴一边可帮助平台争取另一边。
edges.noteEn: Concern about network size becomes a coordination problem between two groups. Subsidizing one side can help attract the other.

edges.label: 从兼容性转向费率分摊
edges.note: 当交易需两边同时参与，总收费之外，两边各付多少会影响交易规模。
edges.noteEn: When transactions require participation on both sides, their size depends on who pays as well as on the total charge.

edges.label: 改变归属方式
edges.note: 一边能同时使用多个平台时，接触只加入一家平台的另一边用户会成为竞争瓶颈。
edges.noteEn: If one side joins several platforms, access to users on the single-homing side can become a competitive bottleneck.

edges.label: 从竞争到垄断福利
edges.note: 在多边垄断定价下进一步比较市场需求边际与外部性，将行业竞争与福利问题分开。
edges.noteEn: The multisided monopoly model compares demand margins with externalities and distinguishes welfare questions from competition among platforms.

edges.label: 公式解释的修正
edges.note: 边际偏离激励与两种最优价格之间的总偏差需要分开。
edges.noteEn: Distinguish incentives for a marginal change in price from the overall difference between the two optimal prices.

edges.label: 评论与回应
edges.note: 将订正意见与作者回应并列，保留对原结论适用范围的说明。
edges.noteEn: Read the correction alongside the reply to determine the scope of the original conclusion.

edges.label: 从静态兼容到转换时机
edges.note: 给定兼容性时用户关心网络规模；更换标准还要求企业协调谁先承担离开旧网络的成本。
edges.noteEn: Users care about network size at a given compatibility level. Switching also requires coordination over who bears the cost of leaving the old network first.

edges.label: 加入收费承诺的时序
edges.labelEn: Introduce the timing of fee commitments
edges.note: 不仅比较两边各付多少，也比较平台何时承诺第二边的价格，以及第一边据此是否加入。
edges.noteEn: Alongside the division of fees, the timing of commitments to second-side prices changes first-side participation.

edges.label: 比较两边规模不对称的市场结构
edges.labelEn: Allow network sizes to differ across sides
edges.note: 吸引两边用户无需由同一网络在两边都占优；相反的收费倾斜可以支持不同的用户构成。
edges.noteEn: Attracting both sides need not make one network largest on each. Opposite fee tilts can sustain different participation patterns.

edges.label: 让卖方价值在事前内生
edges.note: 在双边参与和平台竞争之外，收费规则还影响卖方在买家到来前愿意投入多少。
edges.noteEn: Beyond participation and platform rivalry, fees affect sellers' willingness to invest before buyers arrive.

edges.label: 把平台的组织形式也作为选择
edges.note: 研究双边收费通常先给定交易平台；如果中介还能选择控制营销决策，平台与转售便成为可以比较的组织形式。
edges.noteEn: Two-sided pricing typically takes intermediation as given. When control of marketing decisions can be assigned, a marketplace and a reseller become alternative organizations.

edges.label: 把匹配顺序纳入平台工具
edges.note: 除双边价格外，分配消费者注意力的规则也能影响平台收益。
edges.labelEn: Adding search order to platform instruments
edges.noteEn: Alongside two-sided prices, the rules routing consumer attention affect platform profits.

edges.label: 让归属方式受合约影响
edges.note: 在单归属形成竞争瓶颈的基础上，进一步考察平台能否利用排他条款改变原有的归属方式。
edges.noteEn: Once single-homing creates a bottleneck, an exclusive clause gives platforms a means to alter the homing pattern itself.

edges.label: 区分匹配质量与收费扭曲
edges.labelEn: Separate match quality from fee distortions
edges.note: 中介不仅能改变用户搜索路径，卖方是否付费进入广告位也会改变消费者最终看到的匹配集合。
edges.noteEn: Beyond changing the route a consumer searches, sellers' decisions to buy sponsored placement change which matches the consumer sees.

edges.label: 把直接购买作为外部选项
edges.labelEn: Introduce direct purchase as an outside option
edges.note: 收费扭曲除了来自两边的外部性，也可能来自卖家不能把渠道特有的成本反映到该渠道的零售价。
edges.noteEn: Alongside cross-side externalities, pricing distortions can arise because sellers cannot pass channel-specific costs through to that channel's buyers.

edges.label: 把发现产品与完成交易分开
edges.labelEn: Separate finding a product from transacting
edges.note: 选择中介形式时，搜寻服务与销售可能发生在不同渠道；平价条款把这两个渠道的定价联系起来。
edges.noteEn: A search service and the eventual sale can take place in different channels. Parity clauses link the prices in those channels.

edges.label: 将公开承诺换成保密签约
edges.labelEn: Replace public commitments with private contracts
edges.note: 两边对未来收费的预期影响参与；卖方合约不公开时，平台能否可信承诺价格又与谁控制零售价相关。
edges.noteEn: Participation depends on expectations of future fees. When contracts are secret, credible commitment also depends on who controls retail prices.

resources.title: Two-Sided Markets, Pricing, and Network Effects
resources.authors: Bruno Jullien · Alessandro Pavan · Marc Rysman

branches.questionEn: Which side should a platform charge? How does the answer change when users can join several platforms?
branches.boundaryEn: Network externalities may arise within one user group. Multisided platforms also choose how to divide fees among distinct user groups.

branches.name: 公共品、搭便车与自愿供给
branches.question: 公共品对所有人都有价值，个人出资什么时候足以提供它？
branches.boundary: 这里考察公共品的福利条件、自愿供给以及简单筹资规则。税制诱导劳动供给与私有信息下的最优税另成问题。

papers.title: The Pure Theory of Public Expenditure
papers.note: 同一公共品单位同时服务多名消费者。内点效率条件将各人的边际支付意愿相加，与供给的边际成本比较。
papers.noteEn: One unit of a public good benefits several consumers at once. Interior efficiency equates the sum of their marginal willingness to pay with the marginal cost of provision.

papers.title: On the Private Provision of Public Goods
papers.authors: Theodore Bergstrom · Lawrence Blume · Hal Varian
papers.note: 个人只选择自己的贡献并把他人给定。在纯公共品偏好下，贡献者之间的小额收入再分配可保持公共品总量不变。
papers.noteEn: Each person chooses a contribution taking others' contributions as given. With pure public-good preferences, small income transfers among contributors can leave total provision unchanged.

papers.title: Provision of Public Goods: Fully Implementing the Core through Private Contributions
papers.note: 在离散公共项目的简单环境下，门槛和未达标退款改变关键贡献者的激励；在未被支配的完善均衡中完全实施核心。
papers.noteEn: For a discrete public project in a simple environment, a provision threshold and refunds below it alter pivotal contributors' incentives. The mechanism fully implements the core in undominated perfect equilibria.

papers.title: Impure Altruism and Donations to Public Goods: A Theory of Warm-Glow Giving
papers.note: 捐赠者也在意给出的是自己的钱；这种动机改变政府供给对私人捐赠的挤出效果。
papers.noteEn: Donors care about making a contribution themselves. This changes how much public provision crowds out private giving.

papers.title: The Private Provision of a Public Good Is Independent of the Distribution of Income
papers.role: 贡献者间的再分配中性
papers.note: 在贡献仍为正等条件下，贡献者之间转移收入会改变各自捐款，却不改变公共品总量。
papers.noteEn: When contributors remain interior, income transfers between them change individual gifts but leave aggregate public-good provision unchanged.

papers.title: Privately Provided Public Goods in a Large Economy: The Limits of Altruism
papers.role: 大经济中的贡献者比例
papers.note: 在纯公共品式利他模型中，经济规模扩大时，自愿贡献者占人口的比例可趋于零。
papers.noteEn: Under the paper's pure public-good model of altruism, the share of the population contributing vanishes as the economy grows.

papers.title: Joint Projects without Commitment
papers.note: 合作者轮流作出不可收回的投入，不能事先订立执行合同。均衡出资路径由等待对方的诱因决定，项目实施可能低效。
papers.noteEn: Partners alternate making sunk contributions without enforceable commitments. Incentives to wait for the other partner shape the equilibrium path and can make implementation inefficient.

papers.title: Dynamic Voluntary Contribution to a Public Project
papers.authors: Leslie M. Marx · Steven A. Matthews
papers.note: 各期只观察总出资。期限足够长、偏好相近且主体耐心或出资间隔足够短时，存在可以基本完成项目的动态均衡。
papers.noteEn: Only aggregate contributions are observed. With a long horizon, similar preferences, and sufficient patience or short periods, dynamic equilibria can come close to completing the project.

papers.title: Financing Public Goods by Means of Lotteries
papers.note: 购票兼具中奖机会与资助公共品的作用。在准线性偏好等条件下，彩票均衡比直接自愿捐款提供更多公共品。
papers.noteEn: A ticket buys a chance to win and finances a public good. With quasilinear preferences and the paper's other conditions, a lottery provides more than direct voluntary giving.

papers.title: Altruistic Punishment in Humans
papers.note: 公共品实验允许参与者自费惩罚低贡献者，比较有无此机会时的合作。
papers.noteEn: Public-goods experiments allow costly punishment of low contributors and compare cooperation with and without that option.

papers.title: Easy Riders, Joint Production, and Public Goods
papers.role: 私人和公共产出的联产品
papers.note: 同一项活动既产生个人可独享的收益也提供公共品。个人贡献取决于这两种产出的结合方式，自愿供给对收入或价格的反应随之改变。
papers.noteEn: One activity yields a private benefit as well as a public good. Voluntary provision and its response to prices or income depend on how the two outputs are jointly produced.

papers.title: Toward a Theory of Charitable Fund-Raising
papers.note: 慈善项目有启动成本时，可以同时存在无人捐款与项目获得支持的均衡。先期的大额资金能排除低参与的均衡，使公开筹款成为可能。
papers.noteEn: Start-up costs can support both a no-giving equilibrium and one in which a charity is funded. A sufficiently large initial gift can remove the low-participation equilibrium.

papers.title: The Informational Value of Sequential Fundraising
papers.role: 先行捐赠传递质量信息
papers.note: 先行捐赠者可付费了解项目质量。向后来者公布已捐数额能传递其信息，因而顺序筹资的结果不同于同时筹资。
papers.noteEn: An initial donor can incur a cost to learn the charity's quality. Announcing the first contribution conveys information to later donors, changing provision relative to simultaneous solicitation.

papers.title: A Network Approach to Public Goods
papers.note: 个人努力给不同邻人带来的边际收益可以不同。边际收益矩阵的谱性质刻画合作改进的可能，林达尔配置又与该网络的中心性有关。
papers.noteEn: Effort creates heterogeneous marginal benefits for others. Spectral properties of the marginal-benefits matrix characterize the scope for cooperative gains, and Lindahl outcomes relate to centrality in that network.

papers.title: Public Goods in Networks: Comparative Statics Results
papers.note: 在异质参与者的网络公共品博弈中，用与原博弈相联系的反向网络线性系统，判断个人特征与互动关系的变化怎样影响个体和总出资。
papers.noteEn: For a network public-good game with heterogeneous agents, an associated linear system with reversed interactions helps determine how shocks to characteristics and links affect individual and total provision.

edges.label: 从效率基准到分散供给
edges.note: 规划者计入所有人的边际受益；贡献者只把自己的边际受益与支出比较。
edges.noteEn: A planner counts everyone's marginal benefit. Individual contributors compare only their own marginal benefits with their outlay.

edges.label: 改变捐赠动机
edges.note: 当自己的捐赠本身进入效用时，他人的捐赠无法一比一替代自己的贡献。
edges.noteEn: When one's own gift enters utility directly, other people's gifts are imperfect substitutes for it.

edges.label: 改变筹资规则
edges.note: 保持自愿贡献，引入离散项目、门槛与退款，在特定均衡精炼下重新评价实施。
edges.noteEn: With contributions still voluntary, a discrete project, a threshold, and refunds change what can be implemented under a particular equilibrium refinement.

edges.label: 追溯收入中性结果
edges.note: 先看贡献者之间收入转移何时被捐款调整抵消，再理解一般模型对贡献者集合变化的处理。
edges.noteEn: Start with offsetting gifts among existing contributors, then see how the more general model handles changes in the set of contributors.

edges.label: 考察经济规模的极限
edges.note: 从给定人口下的贡献均衡，推进到比较人口扩大时谁仍愿意为全体受益者出资。
edges.noteEn: Rather than holding population fixed, ask who will still contribute as the pool of beneficiaries grows.

edges.label: 从门槛退款到不可收回的分期投入
edges.labelEn: Replace threshold refunds with sunk installments
edges.note: 同样需要筹足项目经费，已投入资源是否能退回以及谁下一步出资改变了策略。
edges.noteEn: A project still needs funding, but refundability and whose turn it is to contribute change incentives.

edges.label: 改变出资机会与可观察信息
edges.note: 轮流出资改为每人各期均可投入，个人行动不可单独观察；可持续的筹资和延迟结果随之改变。
edges.noteEn: Everyone may now contribute each period without revealing individual actions. This alters sustainable funding and delay outcomes.

edges.label: 引入捐款以外的私人回报
edges.labelEn: Add a private return to contributing
edges.note: 多买一张票既改变公共品经费也改变中奖概率，后一个私人激励会抵消一部分搭便车动机。
edges.noteEn: An extra ticket changes both project funding and the buyer's probability of winning. The private prize incentive offsets part of the free-riding motive.

edges.label: 改变偏离的后果
edges.note: 贡献者除决定自身出资，还能惩罚他人，改变自愿供给博弈的激励。
edges.noteEn: Adding peer sanctions to contribution choices changes incentives for voluntary provision.

edges.label: 区分私人物品与捐赠动机
edges.labelEn: Distinguish a private output from a motive for giving
edges.note: 个人出资的额外回报可以源于捐赠行为本身，也可以源于生产技术同时生成的可独享产品。
edges.noteEn: The private return to contributing can come from the act of giving itself or from an excludable benefit jointly produced by the activity.

edges.label: 将门槛联系到筹款发起者
edges.note: 研究者不再只给定筹资门槛，而考察慈善机构为何先取得种子资金，再向更广的捐赠群体发起筹款。
edges.noteEn: Beyond taking a provision threshold as given, the model explains why a charity secures seed money before soliciting a wider set of donors.

edges.label: 给先行出资增加信息作用
edges.labelEn: Give early contributions an informational role
edges.note: 分期筹款中，前人的出资除了改变还缺多少钱，也可能告诉后来者这个项目是否值得资助。
edges.noteEn: An early gift changes the remaining funding requirement and can also tell later donors whether the project is worth supporting.

edges.label: 由边际受益之和转向受益矩阵
edges.labelEn: From summed benefits to a matrix of beneficiaries
edges.note: 当每个人提供的公共投入造福不同的人时，一个总量不足以刻画外部性，需保留谁使谁受益及其强度。
edges.noteEn: When each person's public input benefits different people, one aggregate cannot describe the externalities. The identities of contributors and beneficiaries matter.

edges.label: 从谁受益转向冲击怎样传导
edges.labelEn: From who benefits to how shocks propagate
edges.note: 网络福利分析保留受益的方向；比较静态进一步区分一人贡献变化和其他人调整后总贡献的变化。
edges.noteEn: A benefits network keeps the direction of spillovers. Comparative statics further separates a direct change in one person's effort from the total response after others adjust.

branches.questionEn: When is individual funding sufficient to provide a good that benefits everyone?
branches.boundaryEn: This branch covers welfare conditions, voluntary provision, and simple funding rules. Tax-induced labor supply and optimal taxation under private information raise separate questions.

branches.name: 多数决、议程权与立法议价
branches.en: Majority rule, agenda control and legislative bargaining
branches.question: 相同的选民和偏好，为什么换一个提案程序就会选出另一项政策？
branches.boundary: 区分投票关系本身是否稳定、谁能设定议程、提案被否决后谁掌握下一次机会。

papers.title: On the Rationale of Group Decision-making
papers.note: 当备选方案可以排在同一条线上且偏好单峰时，中位数理想点可成为多数决下的稳定选择。
papers.noteEn: When alternatives lie on a line and preferences are single-peaked, the median ideal point can be stable under majority rule.

papers.title: Intransitivities in Multidimensional Voting Models and Some Implications for Agenda Control
papers.note: 在文中多维环境与条件下，成对多数决可沿一连串胜出提案走到很广的结果集合，议程顺序因而重要。
papers.noteEn: In the paper's multidimensional environment, successive proposals that win pairwise majority votes can reach a wide range of outcomes. Agenda order therefore matters.

papers.title: Political Resource Allocation, Controlled Agendas, and the Status Quo
papers.note: 提案者选择与既定现状二选一的提案；选民能够否决，却未必能把提案移回自己最喜欢的位置。
papers.noteEn: The proposer chooses an alternative to a fixed status quo. Voters may reject the proposal without having the opportunity to amend it to their favorite policy.

papers.title: Bargaining in Legislatures
papers.authors: David P. Baron · John A. Ferejohn
papers.note: 提案人按程序获得机会组成获胜联盟，否决后转入未来议价；提案权、通过规则与耐心共同影响分配。
papers.noteEn: Legislators are recognized to propose winning coalitions. Rejection leads to future bargaining, so recognition, voting rules, and patience jointly determine division.

papers.title: A Notion of Equilibrium and Its Possibility under Majority Rule
papers.note: 在多维政策空间中，围绕候选点的偏好方向需满足严格的平衡条件，才能使该点不被任何竞争方案以多数击败。
papers.noteEn: In multidimensional policy space, directions of preference around a candidate point must satisfy stringent balancing conditions for it to withstand all majority challenges.

papers.title: Sophisticated Voting Outcomes and Agenda Control
papers.note: 选民预见后续表决时，用必要且充分的条件刻画哪些备选项能在某种修正案议程下胜出。
papers.noteEn: When voters anticipate later ballots, necessary and sufficient conditions characterize which alternatives can win under some amendment agenda.

papers.title: Uniqueness of Stationary Equilibrium Payoffs in the Baron–Ferejohn Model
papers.role: 平稳议价收益的唯一性
papers.note: 证明该立法议价模型中平稳均衡收益唯一。若议员折现因子相同，其收益随被认定为提案人的概率弱增。
papers.noteEn: Stationary equilibrium payoffs are unique in the legislative bargaining model. With common discounting, a legislator's payoff is nondecreasing in their recognition probability.

papers.title: Cohesion in Legislatures and the Vote of Confidence Procedure
papers.role: 信任投票与联盟凝聚力
papers.note: 当法案表决与政府存续挂钩时，联盟成员也要考虑失败后丧失未来权力的代价，从而可能更一致地投票。
papers.noteEn: When a bill is tied to government survival, coalition members face the cost of losing future power after defeat, which can induce greater voting cohesion.

papers.title: The Swing Voter's Curse
papers.note: 若选民对于共同影响效用的状态了解不同，信息较少的中立选民即使投票无成本，也可能严格偏好弃权。
papers.noteEn: When voters differ in their information about a payoff-relevant common state, less informed indifferent voters can strictly prefer abstaining even with zero voting costs.

papers.title: Convicting the Innocent: The Inferiority of Unanimous Jury Verdicts under Strategic Voting
papers.note: 在私人信号和共同误判成本下，关键一票的推断会使全票定罪未必比其他门槛更少错判无辜。
papers.noteEn: With private signals, pivotal-event inference means unanimity need not reduce wrongful convictions relative to other thresholds.

papers.title: Information Aggregation, Rationality, and the Condorcet Jury Theorem
papers.note: 孔多塞陪审团定理按各人的信号汇总投票；理性选民则以自己的票能改变结果为条件推断状态，通常不能直接假定按信号投票就是均衡。
papers.noteEn: The Condorcet jury argument aggregates informative ballots, while a rational voter conditions on being pivotal. Voting one's signal cannot generally be assumed to be an equilibrium.

papers.title: Voting Behavior and Information Aggregation in Elections with Private Information
papers.note: 选民既有私人信息也有不同偏好。论文刻画大规模选举中的均衡投票，说明胜选门槛会影响选票如何反映信息和候选人的得票份额。
papers.noteEn: Voters have private information and heterogeneous preferences. Equilibrium voting in large elections connects the winning threshold to information aggregation and candidates' vote shares.

papers.title: A Dynamic Theory of Collective Goods Programs
papers.roleEn: Today's program becomes tomorrow's status quo
papers.note: 立法者反复提出并表决公共项目，上一次通过的方案成为当期提案未通过时的默认政策。因此今天的投票也在改变未来议价的位置。
papers.noteEn: Legislators repeatedly propose and vote on public programs. The last enacted program is the default if a new proposal fails, so a vote today changes tomorrow's bargaining position.

papers.title: Legislative Bargaining with Reconsideration
papers.note: 一名持续掌握议程的提案者可以再次修订已通过的政策。选民顾虑今日盟友未来被逐一排除，因此再审议可以限制提案权的价值。
papers.noteEn: A persistent agenda setter can reopen enacted policies. Voters anticipate future exclusion of coalition partners, so reconsideration can limit the value of proposal power.

papers.title: Sequential Agenda Setting with Strategic and Informative Voting
papers.role: 第一次公投透露选民偏好
papers.roleEn: Preferences revealed by a first referendum
papers.note: 议程设定者不了解选民偏好，首个提案只有被否决才可修改重投。选民因此会考虑第一次表决透露了什么，以及这会引来哪种修订提案。
papers.noteEn: An agenda setter does not know voters' preferences and can revise a proposal only if it first fails. Voters therefore consider what their initial ballots reveal and which amendment that information will induce.

edges.label: 政策维度改变
edges.note: 一维单峰偏好的多数稳定性难以直接移植到多维空间，胜出路径的选择权可以影响终点。
edges.noteEn: Majority stability with single-peaked preferences on a line need not survive in several dimensions. Choosing a sequence of winners can influence the destination.

edges.label: 控制可选集合
edges.note: 即使在一维，中位选民也只在提案和现状间投票，拥有提案权者借现状影响结果。
edges.noteEn: Even in one dimension, the median voter chooses only between the proposal and the status quo. The agenda setter can exploit the status quo.

edges.label: 动态化提案程序
edges.note: 接受与否取决于未来被认可为提案人和加入获胜联盟的机会，拒绝的价值随制度改变。
edges.noteEn: Acceptance depends on future opportunities to propose or join a winning coalition. Institutions change the value of rejection.

edges.label: 从胜出路径到均衡路径
edges.note: 多数关系描述哪些提案能打败哪些选择；程序与战略行为进一步决定实际提出哪项议案。
edges.noteEn: The majority relation determines which proposals beat which alternatives. Procedure and strategic behavior additionally determine what is actually proposed.
edges.labelEn: From winning paths to equilibrium paths

edges.label: 从中位点到多维平衡
edges.labelEn: From a median to multidimensional balance
edges.note: 单一政策轴上的中位逻辑在多维空间中变成对各个方向的偏好排列施加条件。
edges.noteEn: The median logic on a single policy axis becomes a condition on how preference directions are arranged in several dimensions.

edges.label: 将战略预见加入多数路径
edges.note: 沿多数关系能形成的路径和前瞻选民愿意走的路径有别；后者约束议程设定者能实现的结果。
edges.noteEn: A path of pairwise victories need not be followed by forward-looking voters. Their incentives constrain the agenda setter's attainable outcomes.

edges.label: 从构造均衡到确定收益
edges.labelEn: From equilibrium construction to payoff uniqueness
edges.note: 组成联盟的具体策略可能有别，平稳性约束下仍可问每位议员所得收益是否已确定。
edges.noteEn: Even if coalition choices differ, stationarity raises a separate question about whether each legislator's payoff is pinned down.

edges.label: 让否决影响政府存续
edges.note: 否决不只是延后分配，还可能改变未来控制提案权的政府联盟，因而改变今天接受法案的条件。
edges.noteEn: Rejection may replace the governing coalition that controls future proposals, in addition to delaying the division. This changes present acceptance incentives.

edges.label: 用共同状态替代已知偏好排序
edges.labelEn: Introduce uncertainty about the common state
edges.note: 选民除了比较政策位置，还从自己可能成为关键票这一事件推断其他选民的信息。
edges.noteEn: Besides comparing policies, voters draw inferences about others' information conditional on their own ballot being pivotal.

edges.label: 引入关键票推断
edges.note: 改变表决门槛也改变一张票会起作用时所包含的信息，因此必须重新求解投票行为。
edges.noteEn: A voting threshold changes the information conveyed by being pivotal, so voting behavior must be solved anew.

edges.label: 追问按信号投票能否实施
edges.labelEn: Check whether voting one's signal is implementable
edges.note: 解释一致决规则的反直觉后果之前，先辨别将信息统计上加总所需的行为是否符合选民激励。
edges.noteEn: Before comparing unanimity rules, ask whether the behavior needed for statistical aggregation is consistent with voters' incentives.

edges.label: 从个别选民的关键票到大选结果
edges.labelEn: From individual pivotality to election outcomes
edges.note: 策略性投票不仅决定某人是否弃权；将所有类型的选择汇总后，还可分析超多数门槛怎样改变信息汇总。
edges.noteEn: Strategic voting affects more than individual abstention. Aggregating all voters' decisions shows how a supermajority threshold changes information aggregation.

edges.label: 让现状由历史表决产生
edges.labelEn: Make the status quo a product of past votes
edges.note: 一次性的提案者以外生现状为参照；持续存在的项目则把现状本身变成可被当期多数改变的状态变量。
edges.noteEn: A one-shot agenda setter faces a given fallback. When programs persist, the current majority can change the state variable governing future votes.

edges.label: 允许通过后再议
edges.note: 提案一经通过也不能保证当前分配永久有效，这使支持者更在乎提案者以后能对其联盟做什么。
edges.noteEn: Passage no longer guarantees a lasting division. Supporters must consider what the proposer can subsequently do to their coalition.

edges.label: 让否决同时传递信息
edges.note: 固定现状仍然限制提案者，但第一次失败可帮助它了解选民并修改方案，从而改变最初投票的战略价值。
edges.noteEn: A fixed fallback still constrains the proposer, but a first defeat teaches the proposer about voters and permits revision, altering the strategic value of the initial vote.

resources.title: Positive Political Theory I: Collective Preference

branches.questionEn: Why can a different proposal procedure produce a different policy with the same voters and preferences?
branches.boundaryEn: Distinguish stability of the majority relation, control of the agenda, and the assignment of proposal rights after a rejection.

branches.name: 信息聚合与市场微观结构
branches.question: 交易价格能揭示多少私人信息？何时出现价差、价格冲击和知情者利润？
branches.boundary: 先区分竞争性理性预期均衡与显式交易过程，再区分私人信息、成本、噪声交易及其他交易动机。

papers.title: On the Impossibility of Informationally Efficient Markets
papers.authors: Sanford J. Grossman · Joseph E. Stiglitz
papers.note: 如果价格完全揭示私人信号，付费搜集信息便失去回报。均衡的信息含量须与知情者的获取激励相容。
papers.noteEn: If prices perfectly revealed private signals, acquiring them would no longer pay. Equilibrium price informativeness must be consistent with incentives to become informed.

papers.title: On the Aggregation of Information in Competitive Markets
papers.note: 考察众多交易者各持部分信息时，竞争价格怎样汇总分散信号，以及噪声如何限制信息揭示。
papers.noteEn: When many traders each hold a piece of information, competitive prices can aggregate their signals. Noise limits what prices reveal.

papers.title: Information, Trade and Common Knowledge
papers.note: 在共同先验、初始配置已有效率等条件下，当自愿接受投机性交易成为共同知识，单凭私人信息难以支持交易。
papers.noteEn: Under a common prior and an initially efficient allocation, among other conditions, private information alone cannot sustain voluntary speculative trade when willingness to trade becomes common knowledge.

papers.title: Continuous Auctions and Insider Trading
papers.note: 知情者在噪声交易掩护下分期下单，做市商从总订单流学习，信息租金与价格冲击共同决定揭示速度。
papers.noteEn: An informed trader breaks up orders under cover of noise traders. Market makers learn from aggregate order flow, so information rents and price impact jointly shape the speed of revelation.

papers.title: Bid, Ask and Transaction Prices in a Specialist Market with Heterogeneously Informed Traders
papers.authors: Lawrence R. Glosten · Paul R. Milgrom
papers.note: 成交方向透露对手可能掌握的信息，竞争性且风险中性的做市商也会报出不同的买价与卖价。
papers.noteEn: Trade direction reveals information about the counterparty. Even competitive, risk-neutral market makers can quote different bid and ask prices.
papers.roleEn: Adverse selection and the bid–ask spread

papers.title: A Noisy Rational Expectations Equilibrium for Multi-Asset Securities Markets
papers.note: 构造多资产的线性噪声理性预期均衡。交易者从整个价格向量推断资产收益，相关性使一项资产的价格传递另一项资产的信息。
papers.noteEn: In a linear noisy rational-expectations equilibrium with multiple assets, traders infer payoffs from the price vector. Correlation lets one asset's price convey information about another.

papers.title: Price, Trade Size, and Information in Securities Markets
papers.note: 知情者可选择交易规模，在相同价格下偏好较大交易。做市商遂从方向与规模同时学习，对大单给出的条件可以更差。
papers.noteEn: Informed traders can choose order size and prefer larger trades at a given price. Market makers learn from direction and quantity, and may offer worse terms on large orders.

papers.title: A Theory of Intraday Patterns: Volume and Price Variability
papers.note: 有时间选择权的流动性交易者和知情者策略性安排下单时点，能在均衡中产生日内成交量与价格波动的集中。
papers.noteEn: Discretionary liquidity traders and informed traders strategically choose when to trade, generating concentrated intraday volume and price variability in equilibrium.

papers.title: Long-Lived Private Information and Imperfect Competition
papers.note: 多个知情者共享长期有效的信息时，会抢在对手之前变现，信息可以比单一知情者操纵订单流时更快进入价格。
papers.noteEn: Several insiders with the same long-lived information compete to act first, potentially impounding information into prices much faster than a single strategic insider would.

papers.title: The High-Frequency Trading Arms Race: Frequent Batch Auctions as a Market Design Response
papers.authors: Eric Budish · Peter Cramton · John Shim
papers.note: 连续订单簿允许交易者凭极小的速度优势击中过时的报价。频繁批量拍卖把同一批订单放在离散时点集中竞价，改变抢先的收益。
papers.noteEn: A continuous order book lets faster traders pick off stale quotes. Frequent batch auctions collect orders at discrete times, changing the return to tiny speed advantages.

papers.title: Over-the-Counter Markets
papers.authors: Darrell Duffie, Nicolae Gârleanu & Lasse Heje Pedersen
papers.note: 场外交易者搜寻对手并双边议价；接触交易商和替代对手的速度影响投资者价格与价差。
papers.noteEn: OTC traders search and bargain. Access to dealers and alternative counterparties influences investor prices and spreads.

papers.title: Insider Trading in Continuous Time
papers.note: 在连续时间中刻画知情交易者的订单策略与做市商的条件期望价格，并将 Kyle 的线性正态基准延伸至更一般的终值分布。
papers.noteEn: The paper characterizes an insider's order strategy and market makers' conditional-expectation prices in continuous time, extending Kyle's Gaussian linear benchmark to more general terminal-value distributions.

papers.title: Price Dynamics in Limit Order Markets
papers.role: 订单簿与订单类型选择
papers.note: 交易者到达后在立即成交的市价单与可能排队的限价单之间选择。现有队列影响成交机会，因而订单簿历史影响接下来的订单和价格。
papers.noteEn: Arriving traders choose between immediate market orders and limit orders that may wait. Existing queues affect execution probabilities, making order flow and prices depend on the book's history.

papers.title: Competing on Speed
papers.note: 交易场所选择技术速度并争取投资者。场所间竞争能提高参与和交易量，但市场分割与速度投入未必符合社会最优。
papers.noteEn: Trading venues choose technological speed to attract investors. Venue competition can increase participation and trading volume, while fragmentation and speed investment need not be efficient.

papers.title: Short-Term Investment and the Informational Efficiency of the Market
papers.role: 投资期限与信息反映速度
papers.note: 交易者拥有分散信号且投资期限有限。模型跟踪竞争价格随时间反映私人信息的速度，区分短期交易动机与长期信息效率。
papers.noteEn: With dispersed signals and finite investment horizons, the model traces how quickly competitive prices incorporate information, separating short-term trading incentives from long-run informativeness.

papers.title: Market-Making with Search and Information Frictions
papers.authors: Benjamin Lester · Ali Shourideh · Venky Venkateswaran · Ariel Zetlin-Jones
papers.note: 投资者寻找做市商需要时间，做市商也面临逆向选择。加快交易接触可能改变交易者的组成，以买卖价差衡量的流动性甚至可能恶化。
papers.noteEn: Investors reach dealers only with a delay, and market makers face adverse selection. Faster access can alter the composition of trades and even worsen liquidity as measured by the bid–ask spread.

edges.label: 信息生产与信息聚合
edges.note: 前者问价格若已揭示信息，谁来付钱获取它；后者考察信号给定时价格能汇总多少信息。
edges.noteEn: One question is who pays to gather information if prices reveal it. Another is what prices aggregate when signals are given.

edges.label: 从均衡价格到订单流
edges.note: 让做市商根据订单流逐期定价，并使知情者内生选择交易速度。
edges.noteEn: Market makers set prices sequentially from order flow, while the informed trader chooses how quickly to trade.
edges.labelEn: From equilibrium prices to order flow

edges.label: 数量冲击与买卖价差
edges.note: 两种模型都让做市商从订单学习；连续交易的知情者优化交易量，序贯买卖则从交易方向产生逆向选择成本。
edges.noteEn: Both models feature inference from orders. In one, an informed trader chooses quantities over time. In the other, buy and sell decisions generate adverse-selection costs.
edges.labelEn: Quantity impact and the bid–ask spread

edges.label: 引入噪声交易
edges.note: 无交易基准强调单凭私人信息自愿对赌的困难；噪声订单为知情者隐藏交易提供了空间。
edges.noteEn: The no-trade result highlights the difficulty of voluntary bets on private information alone. Noise orders allow an informed trader to conceal trades.

edges.label: 把单一价格推广为价格向量
edges.labelEn: Replace one price with a price vector
edges.note: 分散信息的汇总不再逐个资产进行；不同证券的价格和信号可能要联合解释。
edges.noteEn: Information is no longer aggregated security by security. Prices and signals across assets may need to be interpreted jointly.

edges.label: 让订单规模也传递信号
edges.note: 原先从买卖方向推断类型，现须同时解释对方为什么选择这个交易量。
edges.noteEn: Inference from buy versus sell orders now also conditions on why the trader chose that quantity.

edges.label: 让流动性交易时点内生
edges.labelEn: Endogenize the timing of liquidity trades
edges.note: 知情者原来在给定噪声下拆单；流动性交易者也选时，便会共同决定流动性在哪些时段聚集。
edges.noteEn: Informed orders are initially split against a given noise process. When liquidity traders also time trades, the timing of market depth becomes endogenous.

edges.label: 从单一知情者到竞相抢先
edges.labelEn: From one insider to competing insiders
edges.note: 拆分订单可以减少价格冲击，但也给其他知情者抢先交易的机会，改变了最优揭示速度。
edges.noteEn: Splitting an order limits price impact but lets other insiders trade first, changing the optimal speed of revelation.

edges.label: 区分私人消息与公开消息到达延迟
edges.labelEn: Distinguish private signals from latency on public news
edges.note: 报价者面临的损失也可能来自公共消息到达后撤单不及，交易规则因此影响速度投资与提供流动性的成本。
edges.noteEn: Quote providers can lose when public news arrives before they can cancel. Trading rules then affect investment in speed and the cost of supplying liquidity.

edges.label: 区分信息与搜寻摩擦
edges.note: 观察到买卖价差时，搜寻与议价提供一种有别于逆向选择补偿的机制。
edges.noteEn: For observed spreads, search and bargaining offer an explanation distinct from compensation for adverse selection.

edges.label: 放松终值正态假设
edges.note: 保留订单流学习和知情者的战略拆单，研究在线性正态结构之外仍能怎样构造均衡。
edges.noteEn: Keeping order-flow learning and strategic order splitting, ask how equilibrium can be constructed beyond the Gaussian linear specification.

edges.label: 把报价交给排队的交易者
edges.labelEn: Replace dealer quotes with queued orders
edges.note: 从做市商权衡逆向选择，切换到交易者自己权衡价格改进和未能成交的风险。
edges.noteEn: Instead of asking how a dealer prices adverse selection, the order book asks how individual traders trade price improvement against nonexecution.

edges.label: 将技术投资者改为交易场所
edges.labelEn: Make venues the investors in speed
edges.note: 对速度竞争的另一种刻画，显式建模交易场所如何选择速度以及投资者如何在场所间分流。
edges.noteEn: A different account of speed competition makes venues choose their technology and investors choose where to trade.

edges.label: 追踪均衡揭示的时间路径
edges.labelEn: Trace the time path of revelation
edges.note: 一次均衡中能汇总多少信号，与分期交易时价格以多快速度吸收信号，是两个不同的问题。
edges.noteEn: A static price's capacity to aggregate signals is distinct from the rate at which a sequence of trading prices learns them.

edges.label: 叠加交易对手的信息不对称
edges.note: 降低搜索摩擦会缩短等待，却不保证减小价差；后者还取决于做市商从成交中推断出的信息。
edges.noteEn: Reducing search frictions shortens waiting but need not narrow spreads, which also depend on what dealers infer from the trades they receive.

branches.questionEn: How much private information can prices reveal? When do bid–ask spreads, price impact, and trading profits for informed agents arise?
branches.boundaryEn: Distinguish competitive rational-expectations equilibria from explicit trading protocols, then specify private information, information costs, noise trading, and other reasons for trade.

branches.name: 国际贸易、企业选择与贸易收益
branches.en: Comparative advantage, firm selection and the gains from trade
branches.question: 相似的国家为何互相贸易？开放以后哪些企业会出口或退出，怎样从贸易数据推算福利变化？
branches.boundary: 两条线分别从国家间的相对成本差异和企业内部规模经济出发。在特定条件下，两条线会给出同一个总量福利公式，但对企业进退的预测仍可不同。

papers.title: Comparative Advantage and the Theory of Tariffs: A Multi-Country, Multi-Commodity Model
papers.note: 将李嘉图模型推广到多个国家和商品，研究相对劳动需求怎样限制有效的国际分工，并讨论关税对这一分工的影响。
papers.noteEn: A Ricardian model with many countries and goods shows how relative labor requirements constrain efficient specialization and examines how tariffs affect that pattern.

papers.title: Comparative Advantage, Trade, and Payments in a Ricardian Model with a Continuum of Goods
papers.authors: Rudiger Dornbusch · Stanley Fischer · Paul A. Samuelson
papers.note: 按相对生产率排列连续商品，在两国模型中联立确定相对工资与生产分界；还可考察运输成本对贸易范围的影响。
papers.noteEn: Ranking a continuum of goods by relative productivity determines relative wages and the specialization cutoff jointly in a two-country model. Transport costs can also affect the range of traded goods.

papers.title: Increasing Returns, Monopolistic Competition, and International Trade
papers.note: 企业有内部规模经济，消费者偏好多样化产品。即使两国的技术、要素和偏好相同，扩大市场也能带来贸易与福利收益。
papers.noteEn: Firms have internal scale economies and consumers value variety. A larger market can generate trade and welfare gains even when countries share the same technology, endowments, and preferences.

papers.title: Technology, Geography, and Trade
papers.note: 各国在每种商品上的效率不同，购买者比较含贸易成本的到岸价格。由此把技术差异与地理阻力联系到双边采购份额。
papers.noteEn: Efficiency varies across countries and goods. Buyers compare delivered prices including trade costs, linking differences in technology and geography to bilateral expenditure shares.

papers.title: The Impact of Trade on Intra-Industry Reallocations and Aggregate Industry Productivity
papers.note: 企业进入后才知道生产率，并面临固定出口成本。开放使高生产率企业扩张或出口，部分低生产率企业退出，从而改变产业生产率。
papers.noteEn: Firms learn productivity after entering and face fixed costs of exporting. Opening to trade lets high-productivity firms expand or export while some low-productivity firms exit, changing industry productivity.

papers.title: New Trade Models, Same Old Gains?
papers.authors: Costas Arkolakis · Arnaud Costinot · Andrés Rodríguez-Clare
papers.role: 贸易收益的充分统计量
papers.note: 对满足文中限制的一类模型，国内支出份额的变化与贸易弹性足以计算贸易成本变化引起的实际收入变化。
papers.noteEn: For models satisfying the paper's restrictions, the change in the domestic expenditure share and the trade elasticity suffice to calculate the real-income change induced by a change in trade costs.
papers.roleEn: Sufficient statistics for gains from trade

papers.title: Protection and Real Wages
papers.authors: Wolfgang F. Stolper · Paul A. Samuelson
papers.role: 相对商品价格与要素收入
papers.roleEn: Relative goods prices and factor rewards
papers.note: 在标准的两商品、两要素且均生产两种商品的经济中，一种商品相对价格上升会提高其密集使用要素的实际报酬，并降低另一要素的实际报酬。
papers.noteEn: In the standard diversified two-good, two-factor economy, a rise in one good's relative price raises the real return to the factor it uses intensively and lowers the other factor's real return.

papers.title: Scale Economies, Product Differentiation, and the Pattern of Trade
papers.note: 在规模经济、产品差异化与运输成本并存时，相对大的本地需求可以吸引该行业超比例的生产，并改变净出口方向。
papers.noteEn: With scale economies, differentiated goods, and transport costs, relatively large local demand can attract a more than proportionate share of an industry's production and shape net exports.

papers.title: Export Versus FDI with Heterogeneous Firms
papers.authors: Elhanan Helpman · Marc J. Melitz · Stephen R. Yeaple
papers.note: 在国外建厂有较高固定成本，但可节省出口的可变成本。在相应成本排序下，生产率最高的企业选择海外生产，其他国际化企业出口。
papers.noteEn: Foreign production incurs higher fixed costs but avoids variable export costs. Under the stated cost ranking, the most productive firms produce abroad, while other international firms export.

papers.title: Market Size, Trade, and Productivity
papers.authors: Marc J. Melitz · Gianmarco I. P. Ottaviano
papers.note: 在线性需求与异质企业下，较大且更一体化的市场竞争更强、生产率选择更严。企业加成也随市场环境改变。
papers.noteEn: With linear demand and heterogeneous firms, larger and more integrated markets feature tougher competition and stronger productivity selection. Markups vary across market environments.

papers.title: Distorted Gravity: The Intensive and Extensive Margins of International Trade
papers.note: 贸易壁垒变化既改变现有出口商的销量，也改变进入外国市场的企业集合。替代弹性对这两个反应的作用方向可以相反。
papers.noteEn: Changes in trade barriers affect both existing exporters' shipments and the set of firms entering a foreign market. Substitution elasticity can affect these margins in opposite directions.

papers.title: The Elusive Pro-Competitive Effects of Trade
papers.authors: Costas Arkolakis · Arnaud Costinot · Dave Donaldson · Andrés Rodríguez-Clare
papers.role: 可变加成下的福利衡量
papers.note: 在异质企业与可变加成下推导贸易福利变化，区分进口竞争的加成效应与价格、收入的其他调整，检验竞争是否带来额外总收益。
papers.noteEn: In models with heterogeneous firms and variable markups, the welfare analysis separates markup effects of import competition from other price and income adjustments and tests for extra aggregate gains.

papers.title: What Goods Do Countries Trade? A Quantitative Exploration of Ricardo's Ideas
papers.authors: Arnaud Costinot, Dave Donaldson & Ivana Komunjer
papers.note: 在李嘉图模型中将行业生产率差异映射为双边行业贸易模式，量化相对技术差异的重要性。
papers.noteEn: A Ricardian model maps industry productivity differences into bilateral trade patterns and quantifies the role of relative technology.

papers.title: Globalization and the Inequality of Nations
papers.note: 企业既向其他厂商供货又购买中间品，形成需求和成本的区位关联。运输成本下降可先引发制造业集聚与国家间收入分化，再使区位格局改变。
papers.noteEn: Firms both supply other firms and buy intermediates, creating demand and cost linkages across locations. Falling transport costs can first concentrate manufacturing and widen income differences, then alter that geography again.

papers.title: An Elementary Theory of Comparative Advantage
papers.note: 用互补性和对数超模性条件，把技术与要素差异转化为国家、行业之间可排序的专业化预测。
papers.noteEn: Complementarity and log-supermodularity conditions turn technological and factor differences into ordered predictions about specialization across countries and industries.

papers.title: Estimates of the Trade and Welfare Effects of NAFTA
papers.role: 行业关联下的贸易反事实
papers.note: 将多国李嘉图模型扩展至多个行业、可贸易中间品和投入产出关联，按行业估计贸易弹性并量化 NAFTA 关税变化的福利影响。
papers.noteEn: The quantitative Ricardian model incorporates multiple sectors, tradable intermediates and input–output linkages. Sectoral trade elasticities are estimated to quantify welfare effects of NAFTA tariff changes.

papers.title: New Trade Models, New Welfare Implications
papers.authors: Marc J. Melitz · Stephen J. Redding
papers.role: 生产率选择的福利价值
papers.note: 比较给定可比基准事实的异质企业与同质企业经济，分析贸易自由化改变生产率选择时，两类模型的福利反事实为何可以不同。
papers.noteEn: The paper compares heterogeneous- and homogeneous-firm economies calibrated to comparable initial facts and identifies how productivity selection can change their welfare counterfactuals.

papers.title: The Margins of Trade
papers.note: 贸易扩大可表现为更多产品、更大数量或更高质量。模型让质量和数量共同进入消费与生产，用产品层面价格数量数据分解这些福利来源。
papers.noteEn: Trade can expand through more goods, higher quantities, or higher quality. The model lets quantity and quality enter consumption and production, using product-level prices and quantities to decompose welfare gains.

edges.label: 从多国离散商品到两国连续商品
edges.note: 共同采用相对成本解释分工。后者把商品排成连续谱，在两国环境中同时求相对工资与边际生产行业。
edges.noteEn: Both models explain specialization by relative costs. The latter orders goods along a continuum to solve for relative wages and the marginal industry in two countries.
edges.labelEn: From many countries and discrete goods to two countries and a continuum

edges.label: 从双边分工到多国采购
edges.note: 引入国家与商品层面的随机效率及双边贸易成本，用各国赢得最低到岸价的概率计算贸易份额。
edges.noteEn: Country-by-good productivity draws and bilateral trade costs let trade shares be calculated from the probability of offering the lowest delivered price.
edges.labelEn: From bilateral specialization to multicountry sourcing

edges.label: 贸易动因分叉
edges.note: 前者研究各国成本差异与专业化，后者表明即使各国相同，规模经济与品种需求也能支持贸易。
edges.noteEn: One approach studies cost differences and specialization. The other shows that scale economies and demand for variety can sustain trade even between identical countries.

edges.label: 加入企业生产率差异
edges.note: 垄断竞争环境中加入生产率抽样和出口固定成本，开放后便出现同一行业内企业行为的分化。
edges.noteEn: Productivity draws and fixed export costs in a monopolistically competitive environment make firms in the same industry respond differently to opening.

edges.label: 用贸易份额计算福利
edges.note: 李嘉图型多国模型是研究中的实例之一；在相应限制下，可以用支出份额和贸易弹性归纳福利反事实。
edges.noteEn: The multicountry Ricardian model is one case in the analysis. Under suitable restrictions, expenditure shares and the trade elasticity summarize the welfare counterfactual.
edges.labelEn: Use expenditure shares to calculate welfare

edges.label: 比较异质企业模型的总量预测
edges.note: 当异质企业模型也满足论文的限制时，把不同企业的进入、退出、出口汇总后，实际收入变化服从同一公式。
edges.noteEn: When a heterogeneous-firm model also meets the restrictions, aggregating entry, exit, and exporting produces the same formula for the change in real income.
edges.labelEn: Compare aggregate predictions for heterogeneous firms

edges.label: 从技术分工转向贸易的分配后果
edges.note: 李嘉图分工侧重国家间相对劳动成本；多种国内要素的模型能追问商品价格改变时国内谁得益、谁受损。
edges.noteEn: Ricardian specialization emphasizes relative labor costs across countries. With several domestic factors, one can ask who gains and loses when goods prices change.

edges.label: 从相互贸易到生产区位
edges.labelEn: From two-way trade to production location
edges.note: 在规模与品种的贸易模型中加入运输成本和市场大小差异，区分为何贸易和哪些产品在哪里生产。
edges.noteEn: Transport costs and differences in market size distinguish the location of production from the basic motive for trade in varieties.

edges.label: 在出口选择之外加入海外建厂
edges.labelEn: Add foreign production to the export decision
edges.note: 国内经营与出口的门槛之外再出现一个生产率门槛，区分以贸易还是以当地生产服务海外买家。
edges.noteEn: A further productivity cutoff distinguishes serving foreign buyers by exports from doing so through local production.

edges.label: 将固定加成换成内生加成
edges.note: 贸易引起的重新配置仍在，需求曲线现在允许竞争同时改变在位企业的加成。
edges.noteEn: Trade still reallocates production, while the demand system now lets competition change incumbents' markups as well.

edges.label: 用企业选择推导贸易流弹性
edges.labelEn: Derive trade-flow elasticities from firm selection
edges.note: 加入企业进入外国市场的广延边际后，仅凭一家代表性企业的销售反应不足以判断总贸易流的变化。
edges.noteEn: With an extensive margin of export entry, the sales response of a representative exporter does not determine the change in aggregate trade.

edges.label: 检验固定加成之外的福利公式
edges.labelEn: Test welfare formulas beyond constant markups
edges.note: 放松固定加成后，需要计算不同市场的加成调整如何共同影响福利；单凭部分企业降价不能确定总效应。
edges.noteEn: Allowing markups to vary requires aggregating markup changes across markets. Price cuts by some firms do not determine the overall welfare effect.

edges.label: 将技术优势带到产品数据
edges.note: 从解释总贸易流进一步推导哪些国家会在特定行业相对多出口。
edges.labelEn: Taking technology differences to industry data
edges.noteEn: Moving from aggregate trade flows to industry predictions tests which countries export relatively more in each sector.

edges.label: 让市场规模受到生产区位反馈
edges.labelEn: Let production location feed back into market size
edges.note: 厂商迁入不只为了接近给定的最终需求，也会给其他供应商创造需求并改善本地投入的可获得性。
edges.noteEn: Firms move not only toward final demand. Their presence creates demand for other suppliers and improves local access to inputs.

edges.label: 用互补结构推出分工方向
edges.note: 离散的比较成本可以判断一种给定配置；对技术结构增加可排序条件，便能在多国多行业环境下得到系统性的排序。
edges.noteEn: Relative costs can assess a given assignment. Additional structure yields systematic sorting predictions with many countries and industries.

edges.label: 加入跨行业传导
edges.note: 单个行业的关税冲击可经由中间投入成本传播到下游，因而行业支出权重和投入份额同时影响福利。
edges.noteEn: A sectoral tariff shock travels through downstream input costs, so both final spending weights and input shares matter for welfare.

edges.label: 区分相同公式与相同反事实
edges.labelEn: Distinguish a common formula from a common counterfactual
edges.note: 给定国内份额变化的公式可以相同，但相同贸易成本冲击未必在两种经济中生成同样的份额、弹性路径和福利。
edges.noteEn: Models can share a formula conditional on the domestic share, yet generate different share and elasticity responses to the same trade-cost shock, with different welfare changes.

edges.label: 在销量与进入之外单列质量
edges.labelEn: Identify quality separately from shipments and entry
edges.note: 贸易额上升可能来自卖出更多单位，也可能来自质量升级。显式引入质量可以在福利分解中将二者区别开。
edges.noteEn: Higher trade value can reflect more units sold or quality upgrading. An explicit quality margin distinguishes them in a welfare decomposition.

resources.title: Trade Theory with Numbers: Quantifying the Consequences of Globalization
On the Principles of Political Economy and Taxation, Chapter VII: On Foreign Trade
resources.type: 专著章节（初版于 1817 年，链接为 1821 年第三版）
resources.typeEn: Book chapter (first published in 1817; the link is to the 1821 third edition)

branches.questionEn: Why do similar countries trade? Which firms export or exit after opening, and how can trade data be used to infer welfare changes?
branches.boundaryEn: The two approaches start from relative-cost differences across countries and from economies of scale within firms. Under specific conditions they give the same aggregate welfare formula, even while predicting different patterns of firm entry and exit.

branches.name: 创新激励、专利竞赛与累积研发
branches.en: Innovation incentives, patent races and cumulative research
branches.question: 在位企业和进入者谁更愿意研发？把成功时间改为随机，或让后续发明依赖前人的成果，会怎样改变研发投入？
branches.boundary: 区分采用一项已知发明的净收益、争夺发明优先权的投入，以及上下游发明人分配利润的问题。结果取决于研发费用何时支付、发现时点是否随机与许可安排。

papers.title: Optimal Timing of Innovations
papers.note: 争夺率先发明的回报可能导致过早投入，但发明人无法取得全部社会收益也可能推迟创新。两种力量并存，使私人选择的创新时点偏离社会最优。
papers.noteEn: Competition to innovate first can induce premature investment, while an innovator's inability to capture all social benefits can delay innovation. Both forces can move private timing away from the social optimum.

papers.title: Market Structure and Innovation
papers.note: 多个研发者以事前投入影响随机发现时间，最早成功者赢得回报。模型把企业数量、个体投入及行业发现速度区别开来。
papers.noteEn: Upfront investment affects the random time to discovery, and the first success earns the prize. The model separates the number of firms, investment per firm, and the industry's speed of discovery.

papers.title: Market Structure and Innovation: A Reformulation
papers.note: 研发成本可以随尚未结束的竞赛持续发生。对手加速研发会缩短预计支出期，从而改变自己的最优投入反应。
papers.noteEn: Costs can accrue while a race remains open. Faster research by a rival shortens the expected spending period and changes a firm's optimal investment response.

papers.title: Preemptive Patenting and the Persistence of Monopoly
papers.authors: Richard J. Gilbert · David M. G. Newbery
papers.note: 当新专利可能让竞争者进入，在位者抢先获得它的价值包括避免竞争侵蚀既有利润；在模型条件下，甚至可能取得并搁置专利。
papers.noteEn: When a patent can facilitate entry, an incumbent values winning partly because it prevents competition from eroding existing profits. Under the model's conditions, it may acquire a patent and leave it unused.

papers.title: Uncertain Innovation and the Persistence of Monopoly
papers.note: 在随机发现的竞赛中，在位者在等待期间仍获得既有利润。若胜者能夺取足够大的市场，进入者可以投入更多并更可能获胜。
papers.noteEn: An incumbent keeps earning existing profits while waiting in a stochastic race. When the winner can capture enough of the market, an entrant can invest more and win more often.

papers.title: On the Division of Profit in Sequential Innovation
papers.note: 后续改进既依赖早期发明，也可能侵蚀其利润。专利保护范围与许可谈判时点决定两代发明人能分得多少收益。
papers.noteEn: Improvements build on an earlier invention but may erode its profits. Patent scope and the timing of licensing negotiations determine how returns are split between generations of inventors.

papers.title: Optimal Patent Length and Breadth
papers.note: 为了给发明人同样的总回报，政策可调整保护期限或范围。在文中的条件下，最优方案可由期限很长而范围较窄的专利实现。
papers.noteEn: A given reward to the inventor can be supplied by varying duration or breadth. Under the paper's conditions, an indefinitely long patent of appropriately limited breadth is optimal.

papers.title: How Broad Should the Scope of Patent Protection Be?
papers.note: 较宽的专利能减少购买者转向较差模仿品的扭曲，但也可能提高价格，使买家退出整个产品类别。最佳保护范围取决于两种损失的大小。
papers.noteEn: Broader patents can reduce distorted substitution toward imitations but support higher prices that push buyers out of the product class. Optimal breadth depends on these two losses.

papers.title: Competition, Imitation and Growth with Step-by-Step Innovation
papers.authors: Philippe Aghion · Christopher Harris · Peter Howitt · John Vickers
papers.note: 落后企业须先追平领先者，再竞争技术领先。竞争或模仿的增长效应取决于企业是在追赶还是在摆脱势均力敌的竞争。
papers.noteEn: Laggards must catch up before they can compete for leadership. Growth effects of competition or imitation depend on whether firms are catching up or trying to escape neck-and-neck rivalry.

papers.title: Competition and Innovation: An Inverted-U Relationship
papers.authors: Philippe Aghion · Nick Bloom · Richard Blundell · Rachel Griffith · Peter Howitt
papers.role: 竞争与创新的倒 U 形
papers.roleEn: The inverted U in competition and innovation
papers.note: 竞争可激励技术接近的企业创新以摆脱对手，却削弱落后企业的追赶收益。理论把两种效应与行业构成结合，并用面板数据检验预测。
papers.noteEn: Competition can encourage neck-and-neck firms to innovate to escape rivals while discouraging laggards. The theory combines these forces with industry composition and tests its predictions in panel data.

papers.title: Rewarding Sequential Innovators: Prizes, Patents, and Buyouts
papers.authors: Hugo Hopenhayn · Gerard Llobet · Matthew Mitchell
papers.role: 面向后续发明人的买断
papers.note: 在序贯创新的机制设计问题中，最优专利菜单可以由买断条款实施。发明人预先承诺未来出售权利时可收取的价格上限。
papers.noteEn: In a mechanism-design model of sequential innovation, a buyout implements the optimal patent menu. An inventor commits in advance to a ceiling on the price charged to a later inventor.

papers.title: Intellectual Property Rights Policy, Competition and Innovation
papers.role: 随技术差距变化的产权
papers.note: 在阶梯式创新环境中比较统一保护与依领先程度变化的保护，研究领先者与追赶者的研发激励。
papers.roleEn: IP rights contingent on technology gaps
papers.noteEn: In a step-by-step innovation economy, protection can depend on technological leadership, affecting research incentives for leaders and followers.

papers.title: Patent Policy and Costly Imitation
papers.note: 竞争者可以付成本绕开现有专利，是否值得模仿取决于剩余保护期及保护范围，因此期限和宽度共同影响重复研发与专利回报。
papers.noteEn: Rivals can pay to invent around a patent. Whether imitation pays depends on remaining duration and scope, making both instruments matter for duplicative research and patent rewards.

papers.title: Patent Breadth, Patent Life, and the Pace of Technological Progress
papers.authors: Ted O’Donoghue · Suzanne Scotchmer · Jacques-François Thisse
papers.role: 前沿保护范围与有效寿命
papers.roleEn: Leading breadth and effective patent life
papers.note: 后续改进能否在现有专利有效期内替代原产品，取决于专利对改进品的保护范围。法定期限与被竞争性发明取代前的有效寿命因而可能不同。
papers.noteEn: Whether an improvement can displace a patented product depends on how protection extends to later inventions. Statutory duration can therefore differ from the effective life before competitive replacement.

papers.title: Sequential Innovation, Patents, and Imitation
papers.note: 创新既有先后依赖，又允许不同研究者沿互补路线继续推进。此时模仿也可能为早期发明人打开后续改进机会。
papers.noteEn: When innovation is sequential and researchers pursue complementary paths, imitation may also open opportunities for the original inventor to build on subsequent improvements.

papers.title: Antitrust in Innovative Industries
papers.note: 政策可同时改变竞争者进入前的研发收益与获胜后作为在位者赚取的利润。创新激励取决于跨时期的收益流，而非仅看当前竞争。
papers.noteEn: Policy changes both challengers' incentives before entry and the profits that today's winner will later earn as an incumbent. Innovation incentives depend on this stream of returns.

papers.title: Scarcity of Ideas and Optimal R&D Policy
papers.authors: Suren Basov · Nisvan Erkal · Deborah Minehart · Suzanne Scotchmer
papers.role: 稀缺创意与等待的期权价值
papers.roleEn: Scarce ideas and the option value of waiting
papers.note: 研究者随机获得彼此替代的创意，再决定是否投入研发。等待可保留将来采用更好创意的机会；若下一项创意落到别人手中，私人投入时机可能偏离社会最优。
papers.noteEn: Substitute ideas arrive randomly to different people, who decide whether to invest. Waiting preserves the option of a better idea, but its recipient may differ from today's inventor, separating private and social timing.

edges.label: 让在位者和进入者争夺专利
edges.note: 在谁先发现会影响利润的基础上，引入在位者避免竞争的额外动机，得出抢先获取专利的条件。
edges.noteEn: When the order of discovery matters for profits, an incumbent's additional incentive to avoid competition can support preemptive patenting.
edges.labelEn: Introduce incumbents and entrants into the patent race

edges.label: 改变成本支付时间
edges.note: 把竞赛前就已沉没的支出换成随竞赛持续的研发成本，企业对竞争对手加大投入的反应可以反转。
edges.noteEn: Replacing sunk initial expenditure with costs paid for the duration of the race can reverse the response to more intense research by a rival.
edges.labelEn: Change when R&D costs are incurred

edges.label: 加入在位者的既有利润
edges.note: 在随机竞赛中区分已在销售的企业与挑战者，研发到达率不同会同时改变等待时间与胜出概率。
edges.noteEn: Distinguishing an established seller from a challenger in a stochastic race makes differences in discovery rates affect both waiting times and winning probabilities.
edges.labelEn: Give the incumbent an existing profit stream

edges.label: 放松发现时点可控的假设
edges.note: 在确定性技术下可以抢先夺取专利；加入成功时点的不确定性后，在位者维持既有利润的愿望也可能减慢研发。
edges.noteEn: Deterministic innovation can support preemption. When timing is uncertain, the incumbent's desire to preserve current profits can also slow research.
edges.labelEn: Relax control over the date of discovery

edges.label: 从发明时机到多代利润分配
edges.note: 两篇论文都分析发明人能取得多少收益。后者把问题扩展到连续多代创新，考察初始发明与派生改进之间的许可和分成。
edges.noteEn: Both papers ask how much of the return an inventor captures. With successive innovation, licenses and the division of profits between original and follow-on inventors become central.
edges.labelEn: From timing to how generations share profits

edges.label: 从创新时机到固定奖励的政策设计
edges.labelEn: From innovation timing to designing a fixed reward
edges.note: 如果市场给予发明人的奖励会改变研发时机，下一步便是比较达到同一奖励时各种保护结构造成的福利损失。
edges.noteEn: If an inventor's reward affects research timing, different protection structures can be compared by the welfare loss incurred in delivering a given reward.

edges.label: 用消费者替代解释保护宽度的损失
edges.labelEn: Explain the cost of breadth through substitution
edges.note: 都在给定研发回报下比较保护方案，此处进一步拆分消费者在同类产品间替代与退出品类的效应。
