edges.noteEn: Holding the research reward fixed, this model distinguishes switching within the product class from switching away from the class altogether.

edges.label: 把一次竞争改为连续追赶
edges.labelEn: Replace a one-off race with repeated catch-up
edges.note: 在位者与进入者的创新收益不同；逐步创新进一步让两家的相对技术位置随每次成功而变化。
edges.noteEn: Incumbents and challengers value innovation differently. In a step-by-step race, each success also changes their technological positions in future races.

edges.label: 从技术距离推导可检验的形状
edges.labelEn: Derive testable predictions from technology gaps
edges.note: 区分并驾齐驱与落后企业后，可以推导竞争强度、行业技术距离与创新活动如何共同变化。
edges.noteEn: Separating neck-and-neck firms from laggards yields joint predictions for competition, technological gaps and innovation.

edges.label: 将代际分成写成机制设计
edges.labelEn: Design a mechanism for intergenerational rewards
edges.note: 研究对象从既定专利下的利润分配，扩展到应给最初发明人什么权利及如何允许后继者买断。
edges.noteEn: Move from dividing profits under an existing patent to designing the initial right and the terms under which a successor may acquire it.

edges.label: 让保护取决于竞争位置
edges.note: 累积创新下的保护取舍还随领先差距变化，单一保护期限不能刻画全部设计。
edges.noteEn: Protection in cumulative innovation can vary with the technology gap, adding a design dimension beyond a uniform term.

edges.label: 将模仿决策内生化
edges.note: 比较同一奖励的不同专利组合时，还需计入竞争者为进入市场而实际耗费的模仿成本。
edges.noteEn: Comparing policies delivering a given reward must also account for the real resources rivals spend to enter through imitation.

edges.label: 把下一次成功创新的时间纳入收益
edges.labelEn: Account for the timing of the next successful innovation
edges.note: 两代发明人如何分成，也取决于新成果何时越过保护范围并终止前一代的有效垄断期。
edges.noteEn: The division of rewards across inventors also depends on when a later innovation crosses the protection boundary and ends the incumbent's effective monopoly.

edges.label: 让先行者也受益于模仿者的成果
edges.labelEn: Let pioneers benefit from imitators' later advances
edges.note: 除考虑后续产品侵蚀早期利润，也把其他研究者发现新路线后先行者可继续利用的知识计入。
edges.noteEn: In addition to lost pioneering profits, account for knowledge generated along others' research paths that the first inventor can subsequently exploit.

edges.label: 把当前挑战者变成未来在位者
edges.labelEn: Let today's challengers become future incumbents
edges.note: 对在位行为的限制既改变当前进入竞争，也改变创新成功后的奖励，不能只用一次抢先专利的利润比较判断政策效果。
edges.noteEn: Restrictions on incumbent conduct change both current entry and the prize after successful innovation, so a one-off preemption comparison cannot settle the policy effect.

edges.label: 把创意到达与研发投入分开
edges.labelEn: Separate arrival of an idea from investment in it
edges.note: 在研究创新时机时，不仅要比较早投和晚投的成本，还要考虑未来更好创意由谁获得、能否订约分享。
edges.noteEn: Beyond the costs of investing earlier or later, timing now depends on who will receive a better future idea and whether its value can be shared.

resources.title: The Timing of Innovation: Research, Development, and Diffusion
Standing on the Shoulders of Giants: Cumulative Research and the Patent Law
Economic Welfare and the Allocation of Resources for Invention

branches.questionEn: Who invests more in research, incumbents or entrants? How does investment change when success is stochastic or later inventions build on earlier ones?
branches.boundaryEn: Distinguish the gain from adopting a known invention, the effort to win priority, and the division of profits between successive inventors. Results depend on when costs are incurred, whether discovery is stochastic, and how licensing works.

branches.name: 银行中介、流动性与挤兑
branches.en: Financial intermediation, liquidity and bank runs
branches.question: 可随时取出的存款怎样为长期项目融资？资产恶化、债权人的协调失败与银行自身的激励分别会造成什么后果？
branches.boundary: 流动性保险解释活期存款的好处，委托监督解释贷款为什么集中到中介。比较挤兑模型时，要分别看谁掌握资产信息、谁能提前撤资，以及债务结构承担何种承诺功能。

papers.title: Bank Runs, Deposit Insurance, and Liquidity
papers.authors: Douglas W. Diamond · Philip H. Dybvig
papers.role: 流动性保险与多重均衡
papers.note: 储户何时需要消费是私人信息，长期投资提前变现会损失收益。活期存款提供流动性保险，也可能因储户预期别人先取款而引发自我实现的挤兑。
papers.noteEn: Depositors privately learn when they need to consume. Liquidating long-term investment early sacrifices returns. Demand deposits insure liquidity needs but can sustain a self-fulfilling run if depositors expect others to withdraw first.

papers.title: Financial Intermediation and Delegated Monitoring
papers.note: 把监督借款人的工作委托给中介，可以节省多个出资人重复监督的成本。分散化贷款组合有助于降低出资人约束中介的成本。
papers.noteEn: An intermediary can save lenders the cost of duplicating their monitoring of borrowers. A diversified loan portfolio can lower the cost to lenders of disciplining the intermediary.

papers.title: Distinguishing Panics and Information-Based Bank Runs: Welfare and Policy Implications
papers.note: 银行观察不到储户的真实流动性需求，储户对资产质量掌握的信息也不同。知情储户提前取款可以反映资产消息，从而有别于单纯恐慌。
papers.noteEn: The bank cannot observe depositors’ true liquidity needs, and depositors differ in their information about asset quality. Early withdrawals by informed depositors can convey asset news, distinguishing them from pure panic.

papers.title: Liquidity Risk, Liquidity Creation, and Financial Fragility: A Theory of Banking
papers.authors: Douglas W. Diamond · Raghuram G. Rajan
papers.note: 银行拥有收回关系贷款的专门能力，因而可能在事后讨价还价。可随时取回的存款约束银行，把难变现的贷款收益转成可以承诺给储户的流动性。
papers.noteEn: A bank’s specialized skill in collecting relationship loans gives it ex post bargaining power. Demandable deposits discipline the bank and turn illiquid loan returns into liquidity it can promise depositors.
papers.roleEn: Fragile liabilities as a commitment device

papers.title: Coordination Failures and the Lender of Last Resort: Was Bagehot Right after All?
papers.role: 银行间协调与最后贷款人
papers.note: 融资者根据各自信号决定是否撤资。即便选出唯一均衡，有偿付能力的银行仍可能因债权人协调失败陷入困境，从而产生最后贷款人的作用。
papers.noteEn: Funders decide whether to withdraw on the basis of private signals. Even with a unique equilibrium, creditor coordination failures can distress a solvent bank and create a role for a lender of last resort.

papers.title: Demand–Deposit Contracts and the Probability of Bank Runs
papers.note: 储户分别观察有关基本面的噪声信号。模型由此把挤兑概率与存款合同联系起来，可以比较更好的流动性保险与更高的挤兑损失。
papers.noteEn: Depositors receive different noisy signals about fundamentals. Run probabilities then depend on the contract, allowing a comparison of improved liquidity insurance and increased expected losses from runs.
papers.roleEn: Deposit contracts and endogenous run probabilities

papers.title: A Model of Reserves, Bank Runs, and Deposit Insurance
papers.note: 在储户面临流动性需要、项目要较晚变现的环境中，研究准备金、可取款存款与公共保险。
papers.noteEn: Studies reserves, withdrawable deposits and public insurance when depositors need liquidity before investments mature.

papers.title: Another Attempt to Explain an Illiquid Banking System: The Diamond and Dybvig Model With Sequential Service Taken Seriously
papers.note: 银行服务正在排队的储户时还不知道后来者的提款要求。这限制银行能以哪些信息为条件分配资源。
papers.noteEn: When serving depositors in sequence, the bank has yet to see later withdrawal requests. This limits the information on which allocations can depend.

papers.title: Equilibrium Bank Runs
papers.role: 最优机制仍可发生挤兑
papers.note: 在允许暂停兑付的广泛顺序服务机制中构造例子，事前最优安排可以与正概率挤兑并存。
papers.noteEn: Examples with a broad class of sequential contracts allowing suspension show that ex ante optimal arrangements can coexist with runs of positive probability.

papers.title: Financial Contagion
papers.note: 地区间流动性需求不同，使交叉存款有保险价值；小的地区性冲击可能通过银行间索取权传播。
papers.noteEn: Cross-regional bank deposits insure imperfectly correlated liquidity needs. Interbank claims can also propagate a small regional shock.

papers.title: Bank Runs and Institutions: The Perils of Intervention
papers.note: 当局不能承诺事后政策时，挤兑已发生后可能愿意额外准许提款；储户预见这一反应，会改变事前提款激励。
papers.noteEn: Without policy commitment, authorities may permit more withdrawals once a run begins. Depositors anticipate this response when deciding whether to run.

papers.title: Bailouts and Financial Fragility
papers.note: 预期救助使中介选择过度缺乏流动性的组合。禁止救助可能减少保险；论文比较对短期负债征税的政策。
papers.noteEn: Expected bailouts induce intermediaries to choose excessively illiquid positions. A ban may reduce insurance, motivating a comparison with taxation of short-term liabilities.

papers.title: Financial Intermediaries and Liquidity Creation
papers.note: 中介分拆现金流，发行价值较不依赖私人信息的负债，降低缺乏信息者在交易中遭遇的损失。
papers.noteEn: Intermediaries split cash flows to create claims less sensitive to private information, mitigating trading losses for the uninformed.

papers.title: Financial Fragility, Liquidity, and Asset Prices
papers.role: 流动性市场与资产价格
papers.note: 少量额外提款怎样引发大幅资产价格变化？模型中银行为筹现出售资产，买方可用的流动资金决定价格对冲击的反应。
papers.noteEn: How can a small increase in withdrawals cause a large price movement? Banks sell assets to raise cash, and the liquid funds available to buyers govern the price response.

papers.title: Banking, Liquidity, and Bank Runs in an Infinite Horizon Economy
papers.note: 把银行挤兑嵌入无限期经济。中介的净值决定其融资能力；挤兑发生后，中介部门收缩，实体活动也会受到影响。
papers.noteEn: Places runs in an infinite-horizon economy. Intermediary net worth limits financing, so a run contracts intermediation and affects real activity after the crisis.

papers.title: Banks as Secret Keepers
papers.authors: Tri Vi Dang · Gary Gorton · Bengt Holmström · Guillermo Ordoñez
papers.role: 银行资产的保密与支付
papers.note: 银行债如果要按面值流通，交易者就不应有太强的动机去调查其背后的贷款。银行会限制信息披露，必要时也会牺牲流动性来抑制私人调查。
papers.noteEn: Debt that circulates at par must give traders little reason to investigate its backing. Banks limit disclosures and may sacrifice liquidity to deter private information acquisition.

papers.title: Central bank digital currency: Stability and information
papers.role: 数字货币流入与银行压力
papers.roleEn: CBDC inflows as a signal of bank stress
papers.note: 可兑换为央行数字货币会为储户提供另一种退出方式。在模型中，银行也会调整期限转换，监管者还能从流入数字货币的资金更早发现压力。
papers.noteEn: Convertibility into central bank digital currency gives depositors another exit option. In the model, banks also adjust maturity transformation and authorities can learn about stress from inflows into digital currency.

papers.title: Central bank digital currency: When price and bank stability collide
papers.authors: Linda Schilling · Jesús Fernández-Villaverde · Harald Uhlig
papers.roleEn: Three objectives of central bank intermediation
papers.note: 当央行参与期限转换，名义偿付能力不能消除实际流动性约束。在模型中，效率、无挤兑与价格稳定三个目标不能同时实现。
papers.noteEn: If the central bank intermediates across maturities, nominal solvency does not eliminate real liquidity constraints. In the model efficiency, the absence of runs and price stability cannot all be attained.

edges.label: 让资产质量信息不对称
edges.note: 把对其他储户提款的预期和对资产回报的消息分开，可以比较两种提款动机的福利后果。
edges.noteEn: Separating expectations of other withdrawals from news about asset returns allows the welfare effects of two withdrawal motives to be compared.

edges.label: 从监督借款人到约束银行
edges.note: 贷款需要中介专门技能时，融资者还要约束中介事后重新议价。容易被提走的存款成为一种承诺安排。
edges.noteEn: When collection requires an intermediary’s specialized skill, lenders must also constrain renegotiation by the intermediary. Demandable deposits provide commitment.
edges.labelEn: From monitoring borrowers to disciplining banks

edges.label: 解释银行为何选择脆弱负债
edges.note: 两种机制都产生可被挤兑的存款。前者从储户流动性需求出发，后者考察贷款回收技能与银行对外承诺。
edges.noteEn: Both mechanisms generate runnable deposits. The first begins with depositors’ liquidity needs, while the second examines loan-collection skills and the bank’s ability to make commitments to outsiders.
edges.labelEn: Explain the choice of fragile liabilities

edges.label: 由均衡并存到计算概率
edges.note: 给定存款合同时，异质信号把基本面与提款阈值相连，进而可以比较不同合同下的预期福利。
edges.noteEn: Given a deposit contract, heterogeneous signals connect fundamentals to withdrawal thresholds and allow expected welfare to be compared across contracts.
edges.labelEn: From multiple equilibria to a run probability

edges.label: 转向银行间融资与央行
edges.note: 把挤兑中的协调问题放入银行间融资市场，分析央行何时能帮助有偿付能力但融资中断的银行。
edges.noteEn: Placing the coordination problem in an interbank market identifies when a central bank can assist a solvent bank whose funding is interrupted.
edges.labelEn: Move to interbank funding and central banking

edges.label: 把提前消费写入合约
edges.note: 两者都分析短期提款与长期资产的错配。后者明确比较提供流动性保险的存款均衡与协调失败的挤兑均衡。
edges.labelEn: Model early consumption through a contract
edges.noteEn: Both examine withdrawals against longer-lived assets. Diamond and Dybvig explicitly compare a liquidity-insuring deposit equilibrium with a run driven by coordination failure.

edges.label: 把排队顺序施加到机制上
edges.note: 让每次支付只能取决于届时可得的信息，检验标准流动性模型的配置可否顺序实施。
edges.noteEn: Requiring payments to depend only on information available at service tests which allocations in the liquidity model can be implemented sequentially.

edges.label: 扩展银行可选合同
edges.note: 检验挤兑是否仅仅来自事先限定简单存款合同；放宽支付机制后，答案取决于储户偏好和提款协调。
edges.labelEn: Expand the menu of deposit contracts
edges.noteEn: The wider contract class tests whether runs are merely an artifact of simple demand deposits. Depositor preferences and withdrawal coordination still matter.

edges.label: 把单行风险扩展到网络
edges.note: 地区彼此持有存款，使各地的提款和清算互相影响；银行间连接结构决定损失传播方式。
edges.labelEn: Extend bank liquidity to a network
edges.noteEn: Cross-holdings connect withdrawals and liquidation across regions, making the pattern of interbank claims relevant to contagion.

edges.label: 让暂停兑付服从事后激励
edges.note: 原模型中阻止挤兑的安排须进一步满足当局在每个提款历史上的激励。
edges.noteEn: A proposed suspension policy must also satisfy the authorities’ incentives at each withdrawal history.

edges.label: 把危机政策引入合同选择
edges.note: 两种分析都把脆弱性内生化。这里中介预期政府将救助，因而改变危机之前选择的流动性。
edges.labelEn: Introduce crisis policy into funding choices
edges.noteEn: Both analyses endogenize fragility. Here expectations of government rescues alter intermediaries’ pre-crisis choices of liquidity.

edges.label: 从委托监督到证券结构
edges.note: 即使关注的是交易时的信息劣势，中介创造特定负债的方式也能形成流动性。
edges.labelEn: From delegated monitoring to claim design
edges.noteEn: When trading exposes investors to informed counterparties, the structure of intermediary liabilities can itself create liquidity.

edges.label: 从跨行债权到清算价格
edges.labelEn: From interbank claims to liquidation prices
edges.note: 较早的模型追踪地区银行交叉存款如何传递冲击。这里即使着眼于资产市场，小的流动性需求变化也可能意味着价格剧烈波动、银行违约，或两者兼有。
edges.noteEn: The earlier model follows shocks through interregional deposits. Here the asset market itself can translate a small liquidity-demand shock into volatile prices, bank defaults, or both.

edges.label: 把一次挤兑接入后续经济周期
edges.labelEn: Trace a run into the subsequent business cycle
edges.note: 在一次性提款协调问题中加入不断变化的银行资产负债表，可以追问哪些经济状态容易发生挤兑，以及挤兑之后信贷如何恢复。
edges.noteEn: Adding evolving bank balance sheets to a withdrawal-coordination problem lets the model ask which states are vulnerable and how credit recovers afterward.

edges.label: 安全负债需要怎样的信息结构
edges.labelEn: Identify the information structure behind safe debt
edges.note: 前作解释中介如何发行对信息不敏感的债务；本文考察贷款细节是否公开，并揭示项目透明度与债务支付功能之间的权衡。
edges.noteEn: The earlier model explains why intermediaries issue information-insensitive debt. This paper studies disclosure of loan details and identifies a trade-off between transparency and the debt’s usefulness in payments.

edges.label: 让政策制定者观察资金去向
edges.labelEn: Let policymakers observe where withdrawals go
edges.note: 危机干预的效果取决于当局何时行动。可观测的数字货币流入改变当局发现问题的时间，储户会在决定是否提款时预期这种反应。
edges.noteEn: Crisis intervention depends on when authorities act. Observable inflows change when authorities detect distress, and depositors anticipate the response when deciding whether to withdraw.

edges.label: 把存款保险放入名义价格体系
edges.labelEn: Embed liquidity insurance in a nominal price system
edges.note: 即使央行可以发行名义货币满足提款，提前消费仍需要实际资源。价格水平与提款激励因此要在同一个均衡中确定。
edges.noteEn: A central bank can issue nominal currency to meet withdrawals, but early consumption still requires real resources. The price level and withdrawal incentives must therefore be determined together.

branches.questionEn: How can deposits withdrawable on demand finance long-term projects? What are the separate consequences of deteriorating assets, coordination failures among creditors, and banks’ own incentives?
branches.boundaryEn: Liquidity insurance explains the benefits of demand deposits, and delegated monitoring explains why intermediaries hold loans. Run models differ in who knows asset quality, who can withdraw early, and what commitment the liability structure provides.

branches.name: 合谋、进入与动态竞争
branches.question: 价格战可能惩罚偏离、传递成本信息，或者源于逐期削价。哪些信号和状态变量能区分这些机制？
branches.boundary: 重复合谋关注偏离后的延续收益；进入模型关注潜在进入者的信念；动态寡头模型还允许投资改变企业状态与产业结构。

papers.title: A Non-cooperative Equilibrium for Supergames
papers.note: 在持续重复的市场中，偏离触发未来惩罚。当未来收益权重足够大时，企业可以自愿执行一次博弈中难以维持的行为。
papers.noteEn: In a repeated market, deviation triggers future punishment. When firms place enough weight on future profits, they can enforce conduct that is hard to sustain in a one-shot game.

papers.title: Limit Pricing and Entry under Incomplete Information: An Equilibrium Analysis
papers.note: 在位企业有私人成本信息，潜在进入者从进入前价格推断获利空间。由此可以区分分离、混同等不同形式的限价。
papers.noteEn: The incumbent privately knows its cost. Prospective entrants infer profitability from its pre-entry price, giving rise to separating and pooling forms of limit pricing.

papers.title: Noncooperative Collusion under Imperfect Price Information
papers.authors: Edward J. Green · Robert H. Porter
papers.note: 需求波动使低价难以揭示是哪家企业扩产。企业按共同观察到的价格启动惩罚期，即使各家都履约，也会出现价格战。
papers.noteEn: Demand fluctuations make a low price an ambiguous signal of which firm expanded output. Firms start punishment phases on the basis of the public price, so price wars can occur even when all comply.

papers.title: Optimal Cartel Equilibria with Imperfect Monitoring
papers.authors: Dilip Abreu · David Pearce · Ennio Stacchetti
papers.note: 在文中的数量竞争环境下，刻画对称卡特尔均衡可实现的最高利润，以及支撑它的奖惩安排。
papers.noteEn: In the paper’s quantity-setting environment, the analysis characterizes the highest profit attainable in a symmetric cartel equilibrium and the rewards and punishments supporting it.

papers.title: A Theory of Dynamic Oligopoly, II: Price Competition, Kinked Demand Curves, and Edgeworth Cycles
papers.note: 企业交替调价，并根据当前价格行动。马尔可夫完美均衡可以产生稳定的焦点价格，也可以产生交替削价与提价的周期。
papers.noteEn: Firms adjust prices in turn and react to current prices. Markov-perfect equilibria can sustain focal prices as well as cycles of alternating undercutting and price increases.

papers.title: Markov-Perfect Industry Dynamics: A Framework for Empirical Work
papers.note: 企业投资影响未来状态，进入和退出改变竞争者集合。均衡将企业价值与产业状态的转移规律联立起来。
papers.noteEn: Investment affects future firm states, and entry and exit alter the set of competitors. Equilibrium jointly determines firm values and the transition law for industry states.

papers.title: A Theory of Oligopoly
papers.note: 合谋企业须从自身观察到的销售变化判断竞争者是否暗中偏离；识别偏离的难度影响合谋。
papers.noteEn: Colluding firms must infer secret deviations from the sales changes they observe. The ease of detecting a price cut matters for collusion.

papers.title: A Supergame-Theoretic Model of Price Wars during Booms
papers.note: 需求旺盛时短期抢占市场的利润提高。为使偏离不划算，默契合谋者可能在繁荣期降低价格。
papers.noteEn: High demand raises the immediate profit from capturing the market. Colluding firms may reduce boom-time prices to deter deviations.

papers.title: Optimal Collusion with Private Information
papers.note: 各厂商私下观察当期成本。把未来市场份额补给当期让出销售的厂商，可以支持由低成本者生产。
papers.noteEn: Each firm privately observes its current cost. Promising future market share to a firm that gives up current sales can support production by low-cost firms.

papers.title: Collusion and Price Rigidity
papers.authors: Susan Athey · Kyle Bagwell · Chris Sanchirico
papers.role: 刚性价格与最优对称合谋
papers.note: 在重复价格竞争与独立私人成本冲击下，论文给出最优对称合谋使用刚性价格、路径上不发生价格战的条件。
papers.noteEn: In repeated price competition with private independent cost shocks, the paper gives conditions for optimal symmetric collusion to entail rigid prices without on-path price wars.

papers.title: Markov Perfect Industry Dynamics With Many Firms
papers.authors: Gabriel Y. Weintraub · C. Lanier Benkard · Benjamin Van Roy
papers.note: 遗忘均衡让企业用自身状态和长期平均产业状态决策；当行业足够分散并满足相应条件时，可以逼近跟踪全体竞争者的收益。
papers.noteEn: In oblivious equilibrium firms use their own state and a long-run industry average. In sufficiently diffuse industries the approximation loss can vanish under stated conditions.

papers.title: Dynamic Games with Asymmetric Information: A Framework for Empirical Work
papers.note: 允许企业状态含有持续的私人信息，提出经验型均衡概念和计算框架，用于分析信息不对称的动态寡头。
papers.noteEn: Allows persistent private information in firm states and develops an experience-based equilibrium and computational framework for dynamic oligopoly.

papers.title: Artificial Intelligence, Algorithmic Pricing, and Collusion
papers.authors: Emilio Calvano, Giacomo Calzolari, Vincenzo Denicolò & Sergio Pastorello
papers.role: 学习算法与合谋型价格
papers.note: 在重复定价模型的计算实验中，检验独立 Q 学习定价程序是否形成高于竞争水平的价格和偏离后的惩罚。
papers.noteEn: Computational experiments in repeated pricing test whether independent Q-learning algorithms sustain supracompetitive prices and punish deviations.

papers.title: Extremal equilibria of oligopolistic supergames
papers.note: 在重复数量竞争中，为每次单独偏离设计一个可信惩罚路径。惩罚本身也必须能抵抗偏离，这限制了合谋可实现的利润。
papers.noteEn: Constructs credible punishment paths for unilateral deviations in repeated quantity competition. The punishments must themselves deter deviations, which bounds attainable collusive profits.

papers.title: Cartel Pricing Dynamics in the Presence of an Antitrust Authority
papers.note: 合谋者既要防成员暗中降价，也要防价格变化暴露卡特尔。论文刻画了卡特尔成立后价格为何可能分阶段接近长期水平。
papers.noteEn: Cartel members must deter secret discounts while avoiding price movements that alert enforcers. The model explains why prices may adjust gradually after a cartel forms.

papers.title: Competition in Pricing Algorithms
papers.role: 反应速度不同的价格竞争
papers.roleEn: Price competition at different response speeds
papers.note: 企业可以按不同频率调价，也可选择对竞争者价格自动作出反应的规则。这种技术能够使竞争均衡的价格高于同时定价基准。
papers.noteEn: Firms can revise prices at different frequencies and choose automated responses to rivals’ prices. These technologies can raise competitive-equilibrium prices above the simultaneous-pricing benchmark.

papers.title: Algorithmic Pricing and Competition: Empirical Evidence from the German Retail Gasoline Market
papers.authors: Stephanie Assad · Robert Clark · Daniel Ershov · Lei Xu
papers.role: 加油站算法采用的实证检验
papers.note: 从德国加油站的高频价格变化识别可能的算法采用，再比较不同竞争结构下的利润率变化。双寡头市场中，结果随两家是否都采用算法而异。
papers.noteEn: Infers likely algorithm adoption from high-frequency German gasoline prices and estimates margin changes across market structures. In duopolies the results depend on whether both stations adopt.

papers.title: Collusion by Algorithm: Does Better Demand Prediction Facilitate Coordination Between Sellers?
papers.note: 更准确的预测既能协调未来的行为，也让企业更清楚何时单独降价最有利。论文给出预测改进使价格下降、消费者剩余上升的情形。
papers.noteEn: Better forecasts inform future conduct but also tell a firm when undercutting is particularly attractive. The paper gives conditions under which better prediction lowers prices and raises consumer surplus.

edges.label: 从观察行动到观察价格
edges.note: 把可识别的单方偏离换成带需求噪声的共同价格信号，守约时也可能进入惩罚阶段。
edges.noteEn: Replacing identifiable unilateral deviations with a public price signal subject to demand noise permits punishment even after compliance.
edges.labelEn: From observed actions to observed prices

edges.label: 从给定惩罚到最优惩罚
edges.note: 在价格不能揭示个体行动时，进一步比较所有可自我实施的对称奖惩方案。
edges.noteEn: When prices do not reveal individual actions, the analysis compares symmetric reward and punishment schemes that firms can enforce themselves.

edges.label: 价格战的另一种机制
edges.note: 两篇论文都产生价格波动。前者由带噪监测触发惩罚，后者直接从交替定价与当前价格状态构造周期。
edges.noteEn: Both papers produce price fluctuations. In the first, noisy monitoring triggers punishment. In the second, alternating price choices and the current price state directly generate cycles.

edges.label: 比较两种进入模型
edges.note: 前者由进入者依据历史价格推断成本，后者把进入与投资、退出共同写入产业状态的演化。
edges.noteEn: In the first, entrants infer costs from historical prices. In the second, entry, investment and exit jointly determine how industry states evolve.

edges.label: 扩大马尔可夫状态
edges.note: 从最近报价刻画竞争，转向跟踪竞争者集合与企业生产状态；状态选择改变能够解释的产业动态。
edges.noteEn: Moving from recent posted prices to competitors’ identities and productive states changes the industry dynamics the model can explain.

edges.label: 把侦测难题写成均衡
edges.note: 从秘密削价难以识别的观察，推进到用随机需求下的公共价格信号触发惩罚。
edges.labelEn: Model the detection problem in equilibrium
edges.noteEn: The noisy-monitoring model turns the difficulty of detecting secret deviations into punishments triggered by a public price signal under random demand.

edges.label: 给逐期偏离收益加入需求波动
edges.note: 重复博弈只要求当前得益不超过未来惩罚；令当前得益随需求变化，便可得到顺周期的偏离诱惑。
edges.noteEn: The repeated-game constraint compares an immediate gain with a future punishment. Varying the gain with demand makes the temptation cyclical.

edges.label: 引入成本报告的激励
edges.note: 噪声公共信号下的奖惩问题变为私人边际成本下的生产组织问题，未来收益同时用于约束报告和偏离。
edges.noteEn: With private marginal costs the cartel must allocate production as well as deter deviations. Future rents help discipline cost reports and pricing.

edges.label: 比较对称定价与跨期份额
edges.note: 为低成本者让出份额可以节约生产成本，却带来激励代价。限制为对称延续时，统一价格有时最优。
edges.labelEn: Compare symmetric pricing with intertemporal market shares
edges.noteEn: Routing sales to low-cost producers saves costs but creates incentive costs. Under symmetric continuation arrangements a common price can be optimal.

edges.label: 压缩竞争者状态
edges.note: 在投资、进入、退出的动态模型中放弃逐家跟踪对手，用大市场近似控制计算负担。
edges.noteEn: The approximation reduces the cost of solving investment, entry and exit models by dispensing with firm-by-firm tracking of competitors.

edges.label: 放宽共同观察产业状态
edges.note: 当对手的状态不可完全观察，企业不能照搬完全信息的马尔可夫决策规则，须利用自身信息与历史经验。
edges.labelEn: Relax common observation of industry states
edges.noteEn: When rival states are imperfectly observed, firms cannot apply the full-information Markov policy directly and must use their own information and experience.

edges.label: 从可持续到可学习
edges.note: 重复均衡解释价格如何维持，计算实验进一步问特定学习规则是否会发现这种行为。
edges.noteEn: Repeated equilibrium explains how prices can be sustained. A specified learning rule tests whether such behavior is discovered.

edges.label: 从永久惩罚到最优惩罚
edges.labelEn: From permanent reversion to optimal penal codes
edges.note: 回到静态纳什均衡只是一种惩罚。比较具有激励相容性的不同惩罚路径，可以扩大可维持的合谋集合。
edges.noteEn: Reversion to the static Nash equilibrium is one punishment. Optimizing over credible punishment paths can sustain collusion that reversion alone cannot support.

edges.label: 把执法者加入监控问题
edges.labelEn: Add an enforcer to the monitoring problem
edges.note: 在秘密削价模型中，企业试图发现成员偏离。这里同时有一个外部观察者试图从价格识别合谋，因而卡特尔调价本身会产生成本。
edges.noteEn: Firms in the secret-discount model try to detect members’ deviations. Here an outside observer also tries to infer collusion from prices, making the cartel’s own price adjustments costly.

edges.label: 把轮流调价改为选择反应规则
edges.labelEn: Replace alternating moves with chosen response rules
edges.note: 两篇论文都让定价时序影响竞争。本研究进一步让企业选择自动反应规则，可以区分技术带来的承诺效应与维持合谋所需的惩罚。
edges.noteEn: Both papers make pricing timing consequential. Choosing automated response rules adds a commitment channel that can be studied separately from punishments sustaining collusion.

edges.label: 从模拟中合谋到市场中的可观测预测
edges.labelEn: From simulated collusion to observable market predictions
edges.note: 模拟可观察学习规则与偏离后的策略；加油站数据只能观察定价行为。比较一家与两家都采用时的差异提供了市场检验，但不能仅凭利润率判定惩罚策略。
edges.noteEn: Simulations reveal learning rules and post-deviation play. Station data reveal pricing behavior. Comparing one and two adopters tests a market prediction, while margins alone do not identify a punishment strategy.

edges.label: 让企业预测偏离有利的时机
edges.note: 繁荣期抢夺市场的收益较高。把当期及未来需求的信息精度作为变量后，可以比较精确预测如何改变合谋定价的激励约束。
edges.noteEn: Capturing the market is especially valuable in a boom. Varying the accuracy of demand information makes it possible to trace how forecasting changes the incentive constraint for collusive prices.

resources.title: Collusion, Mergers, and Related Antitrust Issues

branches.questionEn: Price wars may punish deviations, convey cost information, or arise from successive undercutting. Which signals and state variables distinguish these mechanisms?
branches.boundaryEn: Repeated collusion focuses on continuation payoffs after a deviation. Entry models examine potential entrants’ beliefs. Dynamic oligopoly models also allow investment to change firm states and industry structure.

branches.name: 最优税收与再分配
branches.question: 能力难以观察、税收会改变行为时，怎样组合商品税与所得税？哪些数据和价值判断决定最优边际税率？
branches.boundary: 商品税规则取决于可用税种与替代关系；所得税模型还需说明哪些收入可观察，以及政府如何权衡不同纳税人的福利。

papers.title: A Contribution to the Theory of Taxation
papers.note: 在给定筹资额下选择不同商品的税率，从需求反应推导减少福利损失的税收条件。
papers.noteEn: For a fixed revenue requirement, choose rates on different goods. Demand responses yield conditions under which taxation minimizes welfare losses.

papers.title: Optimal Taxation and Public Production I: Production Efficiency
papers.authors: Peter A. Diamond · James A. Mirrlees
papers.note: 即使必须使用扭曲性税收，只要可用税种、利润处理等满足条件，最优税制仍可维持总量生产效率。
papers.noteEn: Even with distortionary taxes, an optimal system can preserve aggregate production efficiency under appropriate conditions on available tax instruments and the treatment of profits.

papers.title: An Exploration in the Theory of Optimum Income Taxation
papers.note: 政府观察劳动收入，劳动生产率由个人掌握。最优非线性所得税须兼顾再分配、劳动供给与不同类型自行选择的约束。
papers.noteEn: The government observes earnings, while workers know their own productivity. An optimal nonlinear income tax must balance redistribution, labor supply and the constraints imposed by self-selection.

papers.title: The Design of Tax Structure: Direct versus Indirect Taxation
papers.authors: Anthony B. Atkinson · Joseph E. Stiglitz
papers.note: 若消费者共享同一商品子效用，且商品与劳动弱可分，在可自由设计非线性所得税的模型中，无须依靠差别商品税改善配置。
papers.noteEn: When consumers share the same subutility over goods and goods are weakly separable from labor, differentiated commodity taxes cannot improve on an unrestricted nonlinear income tax.

papers.title: Using Elasticities to Derive Optimal Income Tax Rates
papers.note: 将最优边际税率写成联系收入分布、行为弹性与社会福利权重的公式，从而明确哪些量需要估计。
papers.noteEn: Optimal marginal rates are expressed in terms of the income distribution, behavioral elasticities and social welfare weights, clarifying which quantities must be estimated.

papers.title: Generalized Social Marginal Welfare Weights for Optimal Tax Theory
papers.note: 直接给定个体增加一单位可支配收入的社会边际价值，用这些权重评估预算中性的局部税改，并纳入不同公平判断。
papers.noteEn: Assign a social marginal value to an additional unit of disposable income for each individual. These weights evaluate budget-neutral local reforms and can accommodate different views of fairness.

papers.title: Self-selection and Pareto Efficient Taxation
papers.note: 将所得税看成不同能力类型自行选择收入与消费组合的问题，以自我选择约束刻画帕累托有效税制。
papers.noteEn: Treats income taxation as self-selection among earnings and consumption bundles and uses the corresponding constraints to characterize Pareto-efficient taxation.

papers.title: Optimal Income Taxation: An Example with a U-Shaped Pattern of Optimal Marginal Tax Rates
papers.note: 在准线性偏好下，分析何种能力分布与福利权重使最优边际税率在众数附近下降、在较高收入处上升。
papers.noteEn: Under quasilinear preferences, conditions on the skill distribution and welfare weights can make optimal marginal rates decline near the mode and rise at high incomes.

papers.title: Optimal Income Transfer Programs: Intensive versus Extensive Labor Supply Responses
papers.note: 把工作与否同已就业者的收入调整分开。主导的行为边际会改变低收入补贴和福利退出率的设计。
papers.noteEn: Separates entry into work from earnings adjustments among workers. Which behavioral margin dominates matters for low-income subsidies and benefit phase-outs.

papers.title: The Desirability of Commodity Taxation under Non-linear Income Taxation and Heterogeneous Tastes
papers.note: 在最优所得税之上考察小额商品税。当不同收入群体对某物有不同偏好，或消费随闲暇变化时，商品税可能改善福利。
papers.noteEn: Evaluates a small commodity tax on top of an optimal income tax. Taste differences across earners or complementarity with leisure can make the tax desirable.

papers.title: Optimal Taxation and Social Insurance with Endogenous Private Insurance
papers.role: 私人保险与财政外部性
papers.note: 私人保险包含道德风险时，政府保险的最优公式须核算私人合约引致的财政外部性；不同形式的私人保险会有不同修正。
papers.noteEn: When private insurance generates moral hazard, optimal public insurance formulas must include a fiscal externality. The correction depends on how private insurance operates.

papers.title: A Theory of Optimal Inheritance Taxation
papers.note: 在代际遗赠环境中，用遗赠对税率的反应、遗产分布及社会权重表达最优遗产税，区分继承与劳动所得。
papers.noteEn: Derives inheritance tax formulas in a bequest environment using bequest responses, the inheritance distribution and social weights, distinguishing inherited from earned resources.

papers.title: Progressive Estate Taxation
papers.note: 在父母关心子女、社会也直接关心后代的环境中分析最优遗产税及其累进性。
papers.noteEn: With altruistic parents and direct social concern for descendants, the model studies optimal estate taxation and progressivity.

papers.title: Redistributive Taxation in the Roy Model
papers.note: 个人拥有多种技能，可以选择部门。即使税务部门只观察总收入，一张非线性所得税表也能实现模型中的受约束帕累托前沿。
papers.noteEn: Individuals have multiple skills and choose a sector. Even when the tax authority observes only earnings, a single nonlinear income tax can implement the model’s constrained Pareto frontier.

papers.title: Optimal Taxation and Human Capital Policies over the Life Cycle
papers.role: 生命周期中的人力资本补贴
papers.roleEn: Human-capital subsidies over the life cycle
papers.note: 个人能力会变化，教育投入的回报也有风险。在特定工资弹性条件下，最优教育支出抵扣低于全额，补贴率随年龄下降。
papers.noteEn: Abilities evolve and returns to education are risky. Under a condition on wage elasticities, optimal policy allows less than full deductibility of education costs and subsidies fall with age.

papers.title: Nonlinear Tax Incidence and Optimal Taxation in General Equilibrium
papers.authors: Dominik Sachs · Aleh Tsyvinski · Nicolas Werquin
papers.note: 在连续技能、工资内生的经济中，一组人的劳动供给变化会影响其他组的工资。论文把这种转嫁纳入局部税改和最优税的计算。
papers.noteEn: With a continuum of skills and endogenous wages, one group’s labor supply changes wages elsewhere. The paper incorporates this incidence into local reform and optimal-tax calculations.

papers.title: Optimal Taxation with Behavioral Agents
papers.note: 选择偏差使观察到的需求反应与当事人的福利变化分离。模型说明忽视税价、错误判断等行为如何改变商品税、所得税和纠正性税收。
papers.noteEn: Behavioral biases separate observed demand responses from changes in the decision maker’s welfare. The framework studies how inattention and mistaken judgments modify commodity, income and corrective taxes.

papers.title: The Optimal Income Taxation of Couples
papers.authors: Henrik Jacobsen Kleven · Claus Thustrup Kreiner · Emmanuel Saez
papers.role: 夫妻收入的交叉税收激励
papers.note: 把家庭看成选择两位成员劳动收入的决策单位。次要收入者只决定是否工作时，论文刻画主要收入者收入如何影响其配偶的就业税楔。
papers.noteEn: Treats the couple as choosing two earnings margins. When the secondary earner makes a binary participation choice, the paper characterizes how the primary earner’s income changes the spouse’s participation wedge.

edges.label: 引入生产部门
edges.note: 把最终商品的筹资扭曲与生产活动是否有效分开，明确维持生产效率所需的税收工具。
edges.noteEn: Distinguishing revenue distortions on final goods from production efficiency identifies the tax instruments needed to preserve efficient production.

edges.label: 所得税改变商品税作用
edges.note: 当税制可以同时使用非线性所得税时，差别商品税的价值取决于消费选择是否提供额外的类型信息。
edges.noteEn: When a nonlinear income tax is also available, the value of differentiated commodity taxes depends on whether consumption choices reveal additional information about type.
edges.labelEn: Income taxation changes the role of commodity taxes

edges.label: 加入商品税工具
edges.note: 在所得税自我选择约束之外追问消费税能否帮助筛选类型，得到与偏好可分性有关的判别条件。
edges.noteEn: With income tax self-selection constraints in place, asking whether consumption taxes can further screen types yields a condition tied to preference separability.

edges.label: 把最优条件写成弹性
edges.note: 保留异质能力与劳动供给反应，用可估计的弹性和收入分布表达边际税率。
edges.noteEn: With heterogeneous ability and endogenous labor supply, estimable elasticities and the income distribution characterize marginal rates.

edges.label: 改变社会评价标准
edges.note: 沿用边际税改的收入效应与行为反应分析，将再分配评价推广为可表达多种公平观的局部权重。
edges.noteEn: Retaining revenue and behavioral responses to marginal reforms, the analysis generalizes redistribution judgments to local weights compatible with different notions of fairness.

edges.label: 改用有限类型刻画
edges.note: 两类能力的设定将模仿另一类型的得失直接写成约束，有助于检验谁的激励约束起作用。
edges.noteEn: With two ability types, the gain from mimicking the other type becomes an explicit constraint whose incidence can be studied.

edges.label: 选取可分析的偏好与分布
edges.note: 同一自我选择问题在特定分布下能产生 U 形，而不能直接推出单调税率。
edges.labelEn: Specialize preferences and the skill distribution
edges.noteEn: The same self-selection problem can generate a U shape under particular distributions, illustrating why monotonic marginal rates do not follow in general.

edges.label: 从单一弹性到两种劳动反应
edges.note: 低收入区间税改既改变就业者努力，也改变参加工作的人数，两种效应对应不同转移安排。
edges.noteEn: A low-income reform changes both incumbent workers’ earnings and the number entering work. These effects favor different transfer schedules.

edges.label: 放宽共同消费偏好
edges.note: 原有税种冗余结论依赖偏好结构；异质消费选择可额外反映收入类型。
edges.noteEn: The redundancy result depends on the preference structure. Heterogeneous consumption choices may contain information about earnings types.

edges.label: 允许私人保险随税改调整
edges.note: 税收福利计算还须说明私人保险如何改变行为和政府预算，单看受益者的机械收入变化并不充分。
edges.noteEn: Welfare accounting must track how private coverage changes behavior and the public budget as well as beneficiaries’ mechanical income gains.

edges.label: 改变税基与行为反应
edges.note: 把弹性方法从劳动收入转到代际转移，估计对象随之变为遗赠对税收的反应。
edges.labelEn: Change the tax base and behavioral response
edges.noteEn: Moving the elasticity approach from earnings to intergenerational transfers makes the response of bequests to taxation central.

edges.label: 把再分配扩展至后代
edges.note: 家庭权重和社会给后代的权重可以不同，这为跨代转移增加福利理由。
edges.noteEn: Private and social weights on descendants can differ, adding a welfare motive for intervention in intergenerational transfers.

edges.label: 加入部门自选与交叉工资效应
edges.labelEn: Add sector selection and cross-wage effects
edges.note: 税率变化既改变工时，也改变部门间的人员配置及均衡工资。因而劳动收入的激励约束取决于税改对其他部门的影响。
edges.noteEn: Tax changes affect hours, occupational sorting and equilibrium wages. Earnings incentives therefore depend on how reforms feed through other sectors.

edges.label: 让收入能力受早期选择影响
edges.labelEn: Let earlier choices affect earning ability
edges.note: 静态所得税模型把技能视为给定。允许教育支出改变未来工资以后，政府须联合设计当期补贴、未来所得税与跨期保险。
edges.noteEn: A static earnings-tax problem takes skill as given. When education changes future wages, current subsidies, later income taxes and intertemporal insurance must be designed together.

edges.label: 把收入反应分成直接与工资效应
edges.labelEn: Separate direct responses from wage effects
edges.note: 按收入区间计算边际税改时，除该组在固定工资下的反应，还要计入要素替代使其他组的工资与税基如何变化。
edges.noteEn: For a local tax change one must account both for responses at fixed wages and for substitution across types that moves other groups’ wages and tax bases.

edges.label: 区分影响行为与影响福利的价格
edges.labelEn: Distinguish prices guiding behavior from welfare effects
edges.note: 弹性仍描述税改怎样改变行为，但福利计算还要识别个人对税收的感知及其选择失误，不能只代入估计的需求斜率。
edges.noteEn: Elasticities still describe behavioral responses. Welfare calculations also require how agents perceive taxes and the mistakes in their choices, so a measured demand slope alone does not suffice.

edges.label: 将参与边际放入家庭税表
edges.labelEn: Embed participation in a household tax schedule
edges.note: 个人模型区分工时与是否就业。联合税制还要决定一方就业是否改变另一方的边际税率，从而形成跨配偶激励。
edges.noteEn: An individual model separates hours and participation. A joint tax schedule must also determine whether one spouse’s employment changes the marginal rate faced by the other.

branches.questionEn: How should commodity and income taxes be combined when ability is hard to observe and taxes change behavior? Which data and value judgments determine optimal marginal tax rates?
branches.boundaryEn: Commodity tax rules depend on the instruments available and substitution patterns. Income tax models also specify which incomes can be observed and how the government weighs different taxpayers’ welfare.

branches.name: 不平等度量与公平分配
branches.question: 怎样评价两种收入分布？资源换成课程、住房或随机名额时，个人如何比较自己的份额与他人的份额？
branches.boundary: 收入排序先规定对分配的社会评价。公平分配允许个人对物品持有不同排序，需另行规定效率、无嫉妒、预算或随机化要求。

papers.title: The Measurement of the Inequality of Incomes
papers.note: 从社会福利讨论收入不平等。总收入固定时，在不颠倒贫富次序的范围内，由较富者转移给较穷者应降低不平等。
papers.noteEn: Inequality is examined through social welfare. With fixed total income, a transfer from a richer to a poorer individual that preserves their ranks should reduce inequality.

papers.title: On the Measurement of Inequality
papers.note: 用能产生相同社会福利的均等收入与平均收入相比，把评价者对不平等的厌恶程度显式写进指标。
papers.noteEn: Comparing the equal income delivering the same social welfare with mean income makes the evaluator’s degree of inequality aversion explicit.

papers.title: Equity, Envy, and Efficiency
papers.note: 每个人用自己的偏好比较本人和他人的消费束。在相应的交换经济条件下，等收入竞争均衡给出无嫉妒且有效的配置。
papers.noteEn: Each individual uses their own preferences to compare their bundle with other people’s bundles. Under the relevant exchange-economy conditions, competitive equilibrium from equal incomes is envy-free and efficient.

papers.title: Ranking Income Distributions
papers.note: 逐步累加从贫到富各分位的收入，兼顾均值与分配。曲线支配可给出一类递增、厌恶不平等的社会评价共同认可的福利排序。
papers.noteEn: Accumulating income from poorest to richest combines the mean with its distribution. Curve dominance yields a ranking shared by a class of increasing, inequality-averse social evaluations.

papers.title: A New Solution to the Random Assignment Problem
papers.note: 以随机份额分配不可分物品。在严格偏好下，按概率序列机制得到的分配满足无嫉妒与序数效率；诚实申报仍有激励限制。
papers.noteEn: Indivisible objects are assigned in probability shares. Under strict preferences, probabilistic serial delivers envy-freeness and ordinal efficiency, with limits on truthful reporting incentives.

papers.title: The Combinatorial Assignment Problem: Approximate Competitive Equilibrium from Equal Incomes
papers.note: 个人可能需要成套物品，例如能排进同一课表的课程。以近似均等的预算和有界的出清误差构造近似竞争配置。
papers.noteEn: Individuals may demand bundles, such as courses that fit a timetable. Nearly equal budgets and bounded market-clearing errors yield an approximate competitive allocation.

papers.title: Methods of Measuring the Concentration of Wealth
papers.note: 按财富由低到高排序，比较人口累计份额与所持财富累计份额，呈现财富集中程度。
papers.noteEn: Ranks individuals by wealth and plots cumulative wealth shares against cumulative population shares to depict concentration.

papers.title: Notes on the Measurement of Inequality
papers.authors: Partha Dasgupta · Amartya Sen · David Starrett
papers.role: 洛伦兹排序的福利基础
papers.note: 在相同平均收入下，研究洛伦兹比较何时与一类对称、凹的社会福利函数给出的判断一致。
papers.noteEn: Studies when Lorenz comparisons at a common mean agree with the judgments of symmetric, concave social welfare functions.

papers.title: A Class of Decomposable Poverty Measures
papers.authors: James Foster · Joel Greer · Erik Thorbecke
papers.note: 按各人的收入相对贫困线的缺口构造一族指标，可用人口份额加权加总各组贫困程度。
papers.noteEn: Constructs measures from income shortfalls relative to a poverty line. Overall poverty is a population-share-weighted average of subgroup poverty levels.

papers.title: The Efficient Allocation of Individuals to Positions
papers.note: 每人获得相同的人工预算购买岗位概率。基数效用描述个人如何在更大中签概率和更喜欢的岗位之间权衡。
papers.noteEn: Equal artificial budgets buy probabilities of assignments. Cardinal utilities describe how agents trade off better positions against higher assignment probabilities.

papers.title: The Unreasonable Fairness of Maximum Nash Welfare
papers.authors: Ioannis Caragiannis · David Kurokawa · Hervé Moulin · Ariel D. Procaccia · Nisarg Shah · Junxing Wang
papers.role: 不可分物品与近似无嫉妒
papers.note: 在可加估值下，最大化纳什福利的分配同时满足帕累托效率和去除一件物品后的无嫉妒。
papers.noteEn: With additive valuations, maximizing Nash welfare yields Pareto efficiency and envy-freeness up to one good.

papers.title: Lorenz Dominance and the Variance of Logarithms
papers.authors: James E. Foster · Efe A. Ok
papers.role: 常用离散度与转移原则
papers.note: 对数收入方差可能与洛伦兹支配给出相反排名。论文刻画这种分歧的程度及出现可能性。
papers.noteEn: The variance of log incomes can rank distributions against Lorenz dominance. The paper investigates how large and how frequent discrepancies can be.

papers.title: Poverty: An Ordinal Approach to Measurement
papers.note: 以公理构造贫困指标，兼顾低于贫困线的人数、贫困缺口和贫困者之间的分配。
papers.roleEn: Ranking deprivations below a poverty line
papers.noteEn: An axiomatic poverty measure combines incidence, poverty gaps, and distribution among those below the poverty line.

papers.title: The Class of Additively Decomposable Inequality Measures
papers.note: 把人口分组后，哪些不平等指标能将总体差距分解为组间项和各组内部差距的加权和？论文刻画满足这种可加分解要求的指标类。
papers.noteEn: Which inequality measures allow an exact decomposition into a between-group term and weighted within-group terms? The paper characterizes the measures satisfying this requirement.

papers.title: A Little Charity Guarantees Almost Envy-Freeness
papers.authors: Bhaskar Ray Chaudhury · Telikepalli Kavitha · Kurt Mehlhorn · Alkmini Sgouritsa
papers.role: 少量物品留空的公平保证
papers.roleEn: Fairness with a small unallocated pool
papers.note: 有 n 个参与者时，可以把少于 n 件物品暂不分配，实现移去被嫉妒方任意一件物品后的无嫉妒；每个人都至少与其看待留置物品一样看重自己的组合。
papers.noteEn: With n agents, setting aside fewer than n goods permits envy-freeness up to any good. Every agent values her own bundle at least as much as the entire unallocated pool.

papers.title: EFX Exists for Three Agents
papers.authors: Bhaskar Ray Chaudhury · Jugal Garg · Kurt Mehlhorn
papers.role: 三名参与者的完整分配
papers.note: 对三名具有可加估值的参与者，即使物品不可分，也能构造一项分完所有物品的 EFX 分配。
papers.noteEn: For three agents with additive valuations, the paper constructs an EFX allocation of all indivisible goods.

papers.title: EFX Exists for Three Types of Agents
papers.authors: Vishwa Prakash H. V. · Pratik Ghosal · Prajakta Nimbhorkar · Nithin Varma
papers.role: 三种估值类型，不限人数
papers.roleEn: Three valuation types with any number of agents
papers.note: 人数可以任意多，只要可加估值至多有三种类型，就存在一项完整的 EFX 分配。同一类型的参与者可以有不同的分配结果。
papers.noteEn: A complete EFX allocation exists for any number of agents if their additive valuations come in at most three types. Agents of the same type can receive different bundles.

papers.title: Counting and multidimensional poverty measurement
papers.note: 先按各维度的阈值判定个人有哪些剥夺，再按加权剥夺数量识别贫困者。由此可以分别描述贫困发生率和贫困者平均承受的剥夺强度。
papers.noteEn: First applies a deprivation cutoff within each dimension, then a cutoff on the weighted deprivation count to identify poor individuals. This separates the incidence of poverty from the intensity of deprivation among the poor.

edges.label: 把转移原则写成福利指标
edges.note: 从判断单次累进转移，推进到通过等价收入衡量整组收入之间的福利差距。
edges.noteEn: Equivalent income extends the evaluation of one progressive transfer to welfare differences across whole distributions.
edges.labelEn: Turn a transfer principle into a welfare index

edges.label: 从指定指标到一致排序
edges.note: 把总体收入的变化与分位份额相结合，比较一类福利准则能一致排序的分布，而曲线交叉时可保留分歧。
edges.noteEn: Combining changes in total income and quantile shares reveals when a class of welfare criteria agrees. When curves cross, disagreement can remain.
edges.labelEn: From a chosen index to unanimous rankings

edges.label: 从消费束到随机份额
edges.note: 将同伴间无嫉妒的比较移到对不可分物品的概率份额上，并须规定仅凭序数偏好如何比较彩票。
edges.noteEn: Applying no-envy comparisons to chances of receiving indivisible goods requires a rule for comparing lotteries using ordinal preferences alone.
edges.labelEn: From consumption bundles to random shares

edges.label: 从可分物品到物品组合
edges.note: 保留等收入竞争配置的出发点，在互补性和不可分性可能阻碍精确出清时，给出预算与出清的近似办法。
edges.noteEn: The equal-income competitive benchmark is retained, while budgets and market clearing are approximated when complementarities and indivisibility can prevent exact clearing.

edges.label: 为曲线引入平均收入
edges.note: 原曲线关注相对份额。广义洛伦兹曲线把平均收入也纳入比较，从而区分相对分布相同、总体收入不同的经济。
edges.labelEn: Scale the curve by mean income
edges.noteEn: The original curve records relative shares. The generalized curve also incorporates mean income and can distinguish economies with identical shares but different income levels.

edges.label: 放宽福利函数的可加性
edges.note: 把原先由个人效用相加所得的判据扩展到更广的社会福利函数类。
edges.noteEn: Extends the criterion beyond welfare functions that sum individual utilities to a broader class of social evaluations.

edges.label: 把分配评价聚焦到贫困线以下
edges.note: 从整个分布的福利损失转向低收入者的短缺程度，并通过参数改变对最贫困者的权重。
edges.labelEn: Focus distributional evaluation below a poverty line
edges.noteEn: The focus shifts from welfare loss over an entire distribution to shortfalls among the poor, with a parameter controlling sensitivity to deeper poverty.

edges.label: 把等收入分配用于概率份额
edges.note: 当岗位不可分时，把抽签机会当作可交易的份额，再用等额预算比较个人可选的彩票。
edges.labelEn: Apply equal budgets to probability shares
edges.noteEn: When positions are indivisible, trading assignment probabilities makes it possible to compare the lotteries people can afford at equal budgets.

edges.label: 把无嫉妒条件放宽一件物品
edges.note: 不可分性会让精确无嫉妒无法实现。允许在比较时移去对方所得的一件物品，可恢复与效率兼容的保证。
edges.noteEn: Indivisibility can preclude exact envy-freeness. Removing one good from the envied bundle for the comparison restores a fairness guarantee compatible with efficiency.

edges.label: 检验统计指标是否保持洛伦兹排序
edges.note: 一个易于计算的方差指标并不自动保留洛伦兹曲线体现的转移判断。
edges.labelEn: Test an index against Lorenz rankings
edges.noteEn: A convenient variance measure need not preserve the judgments about transfers encoded by Lorenz curves.

edges.label: 从整体不平等转向贫困
edges.note: 相同贫困人数并不代表相同程度的剥夺，对贫困者内部转移的反应提供新的区分标准。
edges.noteEn: The same headcount can hide different deprivation, so sensitivity to transfers among the poor supplies additional comparisons.

edges.label: 从福利解释到可加分解
edges.labelEn: From welfare interpretation to additive decomposition
edges.note: 一个指标即使有福利解释，也未必能回答总体差距中多少来自组内。分组后的精确加总是额外的函数约束。
edges.noteEn: A welfare interpretation alone does not tell us how much inequality comes from within groups. Exact aggregation after partitioning the population imposes an additional functional restriction.

edges.label: 用不完全分配换取更强的无嫉妒
edges.labelEn: Trade full allocation for stronger envy-freeness
edges.note: 最大纳什福利保证比较时存在一件可移除物品。这里要求任意一件都足够，同时明确为此最多要留下多少物品。
edges.noteEn: Maximum Nash welfare guarantees that some good can be removed for the comparison. This result asks that any good suffice and quantifies how many items may need to be set aside.

edges.label: 在三人情形消除留置物品
edges.labelEn: Remove the unallocated pool in the three-agent case
edges.note: 先前的存在性保证允许留有少量物品。把人数固定为三人，可以在保留任意一件移除保证的同时分完所有物品。
edges.noteEn: The earlier existence result allows a small unallocated pool. Fixing the population at three makes it possible to assign every item while retaining envy-freeness up to any good.

edges.label: 从限制人数转向限制类型数
edges.labelEn: Replace the bound on people with a bound on types
edges.note: 三名参与者可以有三种不同偏好。新结果保留三种估值的上限，却允许每种类型有任意多个参与者。
edges.noteEn: Three people can have three different preferences. The new result retains the limit on distinct valuations but allows arbitrarily many agents of each type.

edges.label: 从单项收入缺口到多个维度
edges.labelEn: Move from an income gap to multiple dimensions
edges.note: 单一收入贫困线能够同时完成识别和计量；引入教育、健康等维度后，必须另行规定怎样将不同剥夺组合判定为贫困。
edges.noteEn: One income line can identify poverty and measure shortfalls. With dimensions such as education and health, an additional rule must decide which combinations of deprivations constitute poverty.

branches.questionEn: How should two income distributions be compared? When resources consist of courses, housing or chances of admission, how do individuals compare their shares with others’ shares?
branches.boundaryEn: Income rankings start with a social evaluation of distributions. Fair division permits heterogeneous rankings of goods and requires separate choices about efficiency, envy, budgets and randomization.

branches.name: 代际福利与无限效用流
branches.en: Intergenerational welfare and infinite utility streams
branches.question: 当一项政策使今天的一代受益，此后每代人受损，怎样比较整条福利路径？这样的排序能否既平等对待代际身份，又尊重帕累托改进？
branches.boundary: 每代人的效用已经给定，研究对象是跨代的规范排序；同一人面对消费时间选择属于跨期选择。

papers.title: Stationary Ordinal Utility and Impatience
papers.note: 对无限消费流施加平稳性、连续性等公理，推出至少某些消费水平上的时间偏好；这一表示可用来检查给远期较低权重的依据。
papers.noteEn: Axioms such as stationarity and continuity on infinite consumption streams imply time preference at least at certain consumption levels. The representation clarifies the grounds for assigning lower weight to the distant future.

papers.title: The Evaluation of Infinite Utility Streams
papers.note: 在无限效用流上，要求交换两代身份不改变评价、尊重帕累托改进并满足特定连续性，会导致不可能性。
papers.noteEn: On infinite utility streams, invariance under an exchange of two generations’ identities conflicts with Pareto improvements when a particular continuity requirement is imposed.

papers.title: An axiomatic approach to sustainable development
papers.note: 将可持续性写成两项限制：有限的当代和遥远的未来都不能单方面决定所有比较，并构造满足约束的福利准则。
papers.noteEn: Sustainability is expressed through two requirements: neither a finite present nor the distant future can dictate every comparison. The paper constructs criteria satisfying them.
papers.roleEn: The present and the distant future both matter

papers.title: Aggregating Infinite Utility Streams with Intergenerational Equity: The Impossibility of Being Paretian
papers.note: 即使撤去连续性，只要每代的效用可以取至少两个值，也无法用实值福利函数同时满足代际匿名与帕累托原则。
papers.noteEn: Even without continuity, a real-valued welfare function cannot satisfy both intergenerational anonymity and the Pareto principle when each generation’s utility has at least two possible values.

papers.title: Sustainable recursive social welfare functions
papers.authors: Geir B. Asheim, Tapan Mitra & Bertil Tungodden
papers.note: 在递归框架内加入面向未来的弱 Hammond 公平条件，刻画一类存在的社会福利函数。
papers.noteEn: A weak form of Hammond equity for the future is introduced into a recursive framework, yielding a characterization of an existing class of welfare functions.

papers.title: A Mathematical Theory of Saving
papers.note: 以相对于幸福上界的损失衡量无限期的储蓄路径，讨论如何评价不为纯时间偏好打折的未来效用。
papers.roleEn: Optimal saving over an infinite horizon
papers.noteEn: Evaluates an infinite saving path through shortfalls from a bliss level, asking how to count future utility without pure time discounting.

papers.title: Equity among Generations
papers.note: 放宽连续性条件后，考察无限效用流能否在保留效率、对有限次交换世代保持无差别的同时取得完整排序。
papers.noteEn: Studies the existence of complete orders over infinite streams that respect efficiency and are invariant to finite permutations once continuity requirements are relaxed.

papers.title: Resolving Distributional Conflicts between Generations
papers.note: 把对无限效用流的判断与足够长的有限截断联系起来，讨论代际平等要求如何支持不同的福利准则。
papers.noteEn: Relates judgments on infinite streams to long finite truncations and studies the welfare criteria that can respect intergenerational equity.

papers.title: Can Intergenerational Equity Be Operationalized?
papers.note: 研究满足效率及代际对称性的排序在测度意义下能区分多少效用流，揭示实数表示之外的困难。
papers.noteEn: Studies how many pairs of streams an efficient, generation-symmetric order can distinguish in a measure-theoretic sense, identifying difficulties beyond real-valued representation.

papers.title: Ordering Infinite Utility Streams Comes at the Cost of a Non-Ramsey Set
papers.role: 代际排序的集合论代价
papers.note: 具有代际匿名性和效率性质的完整排序蕴含非拉姆齐集合的存在，说明抽象存在性与给出具体排序规则之间的距离。
papers.noteEn: The existence of complete anonymous and efficient orders implies the existence of a non-Ramsey set, exposing the distance between abstract existence and an explicit rule.

papers.title: Sustainability and Discounted Utilitarianism in Models of Economic Growth
papers.note: 在增长模型中修正折现功利主义，限制已较富裕的当代人对未来福利的支配，并研究相应最优路径。
papers.noteEn: Modifies discounted utilitarianism to restrict the influence of a present generation already better off than its successors, and studies optimal growth paths.

papers.title: Justifying Social Discounting: The Rank-discounted Utilitarian Approach
papers.note: 按每一代在福利排序中的位置给权重。在福利随时间上升的路径上，位次折现与通常的时间折现可以一致。
papers.noteEn: Discounts utilities by their rank in the distribution. On paths with rising welfare, rank discounting can coincide with ordinary time discounting.

papers.title: Intertemporal Equity and the Extension of the Ramsey Criterion
papers.note: 利用滤子与超滤子讨论如何扩展 Ramsey 型比较，区分可同时保留的公平与效率条件。
papers.noteEn: Filters and ultrafilters organize extensions of Ramsey-type comparisons and distinguish compatible equity and efficiency conditions.

papers.title: Utilitarianism for infinite utility streams: A new welfare criterion and its axiomatic characterization
papers.role: 对无限效用流进行部分比较
papers.note: 用帕累托性、匿名性和部分单位可比性来刻画无限效用流上的功利主义排序关系，并比较它与赶超准则的差异。
papers.noteEn: Uses Pareto, anonymity and partial unit comparability to characterize a utilitarian relation on infinite utility streams and compares it with overtaking criteria.

papers.title: Evaluating intergenerational risks
papers.role: 未来世代面对的社会风险
papers.note: 政策不仅改变一条确定的福利路径，也改变未来世代可能出生于何种社会的概率。论文据此研究如何把不同世代和不同状态纳入同一评价。
papers.noteEn: Policies change the probability of the societies into which future generations are born as well as their welfare levels. The paper develops a way to evaluate outcomes across states and generations.

papers.title: Fundamental utilitarianism and intergenerational equity with extinction discounting
papers.authors: Graciela Chichilnisky · Peter J. Hammond · Nicholas Stern
papers.note: 在可能灭绝的人口中，条件于一代确实存在，其成员仍得到平等对待。在效用有界、预期总人口有限等条件下，可以用生存概率加权的总效用作动态一致的评价。
papers.noteEn: Conditional on a generation existing, individuals are treated equally. With bounded utilities and finite expected total population, extinction-adjusted total utility can give a dynamically consistent evaluation.

papers.title: Universal social welfare orderings and risk
papers.role: 未来人口及偏好也不确定
papers.roleEn: Uncertainty over future people and preferences
papers.note: 社会前景可以同时包含资源、未来人口和个人偏好三种不确定性。论文比较期望效用型的社会排序与通过个人确定性等价进行事前评价的准则。
papers.noteEn: Social prospects may involve uncertainty about resources, who will exist and what they will prefer. The paper compares expected-utility social orderings with ex ante criteria using individual certainty equivalents.

papers.title: Unequal inequality aversion within and among countries and generations
papers.role: 代内与代际差距的不同权重
papers.roleEn: Different weights for within- and between-generation inequality
papers.note: 如果同代人的差距比不同时代人的差距更令人介意，怎样把这一偏好写入一致的社会评价？论文考察能表示这种局部优先的条件及其适用限制。
papers.noteEn: How can a social ordering regard inequality among contemporaries as more objectionable than inequality across periods? The paper examines conditions for representing this local priority and the limits of doing so.

edges.label: 引入代际匿名
edges.note: 无限序列的连续福利排序一旦还要求互换两代效用不影响评价，便会遇到与帕累托敏感性的冲突。
edges.noteEn: Requiring a continuous ranking of infinite streams to be invariant to exchanging two generations’ utilities conflicts with Pareto sensitivity.

edges.label: 撤去连续性条件
edges.note: 把问题限定为能否用一个实数打分后，仅保留代际匿名与帕累托原则也足以推出不可能性。
edges.noteEn: Once the question concerns representation by a real number, anonymity and the Pareto principle alone are enough to yield impossibility.

edges.label: 改用非独裁要求
edges.note: 换一种公平概念，分别排除现在独裁和未来独裁，可以构造同时对两端敏感的福利排序。
edges.noteEn: Ruling out dictatorship by either the present or the future gives a different notion of fairness and permits rankings sensitive to both.

edges.label: 加入未来公平条件
edges.note: 在平稳递归的分析中显式约束当期与远期福利的取舍，得到区别于通常折现加总的可持续准则。
edges.noteEn: Explicit restrictions on trade-offs between present and future welfare in stationary recursive analysis yield criteria distinct from standard discounted sums.

edges.label: 为跨期偏好提出公理
edges.note: 储蓄模型须先决定跨期福利怎样比较。后续公理刻画哪些偏好允许用平稳的跨期评价表示。
edges.noteEn: A saving problem needs a rule for comparing welfare across time. The later axiomatic model asks which preferences admit a stationary intertemporal evaluation.

edges.label: 从连续表示转向排序存在
edges.note: 不可能性依赖对排序施加哪些正则性要求。去掉连续性后，排序的存在与数值表示成为不同问题。
edges.labelEn: Move from continuous representation to order existence
edges.noteEn: The impossibility depends on the regularity imposed. Once continuity is removed, existence of an order and existence of a numerical representation are distinct questions.

edges.label: 用有限代际比较刻画无限判断
edges.note: 有限人口中的优先照顾最差者和效用加总有不同分配含义，把这些比较延伸到无限路径需要额外条件。
edges.labelEn: Link infinite judgments to finite comparisons
edges.noteEn: Priority for the worst off and summing utilities give different finite-population judgments. Extending these comparisons to infinite paths requires additional conditions.

edges.label: 检验排序能否实际区分路径
edges.note: 即使只要求排序，仍可用外测度检验其无差异集合有多大，从而考察实际比较能力。
edges.labelEn: Test whether an order distinguishes paths
edges.noteEn: Even for an ordinal ranking, outer measure provides a way to examine the size of its indifference set and its power to distinguish streams.

edges.label: 追问存在性证明的构造内容
edges.note: 即使可证明存在排序，也须考察其存在意味着什么集合论对象，以及能否明确构造。
edges.labelEn: Examine the constructive content of existence
edges.noteEn: An existence theorem raises a further question about which set-theoretic objects the order entails and whether it can be constructed explicitly.

edges.label: 把代际保护落实到增长路径
edges.note: 将防止当代压倒未来的要求落实为条件式折现评价，再检验该准则支持哪些资源配置。
edges.labelEn: Apply intergenerational protection to growth paths
edges.noteEn: A conditional discounted criterion gives operational content to protecting the future and lets one ask which allocations the criterion supports.

edges.label: 把日期权重改为福利位次权重
edges.note: 交换两个世代的日期不必改变福利。若较早世代恰较贫，按位次折现仍会呈现熟悉的时间折现形式。
edges.labelEn: Replace date weights with welfare-rank weights
edges.noteEn: Exchanging dates need not affect welfare. When earlier generations are poorer, rank discounting can nevertheless look like familiar time discounting.

edges.label: 从不可能性到明确的排序
edges.note: 在公理冲突已知时，进一步比较牺牲不同条件能构造哪些跨代排序。
edges.noteEn: Once axioms conflict, alternative constructions show which intergenerational orderings remain under different sacrifices.

edges.label: 放宽为未必完整的福利关系
edges.labelEn: Work with an ordering that need not be complete
edges.note: 实数福利指标会迫使任意两条路径都可比较。允许某些无限路径无法排序后，可以保留一批能由有限效用变动和帕累托改进支持的判断。
edges.noteEn: A numerical welfare index ranks every pair of paths. Leaving some infinite paths incomparable retains comparisons supported by finite utility changes and Pareto improvements.

edges.label: 把世代福利位次置于风险之下
edges.labelEn: Introduce risk over intergenerational welfare ranks
edges.note: 在确定性路径上可以直接按福利给世代排序。有共同风险时，社会排序还须规定在怎样的概率下哪些世代会处于不利位置。
edges.noteEn: A deterministic path assigns welfare ranks directly to generations. Under shared risk the social ordering must also account for the probabilities with which people occupy disadvantaged positions.

edges.label: 区分出生得晚与可能不出生
edges.labelEn: Separate a later birth from a birth that may never occur
edges.note: 拉姆齐反对仅因未来较远而降低福利权重。若一代可能根本不出现，即使对所有实际存在的人一视同仁，计算期望福利时仍会产生折现。
edges.noteEn: Ramsey objected to giving less weight merely because welfare arrives later. Equal treatment of everyone who exists can still produce discounting in expectation if a generation may never exist.

edges.label: 放宽未来参与者和偏好已知的设定
edges.labelEn: Allow uncertainty about identities and preferences
edges.note: 从比较不同世代面对的社会风险，推进到连未来有哪些人、这些人如何评价配置都不确定的政策问题。
edges.noteEn: Moves from evaluating the social risks facing generations to policies where both the population that will exist and how its members value allocations are uncertain.

edges.label: 允许同一福利差距因群体而异
edges.labelEn: Let group membership matter for inequality comparisons
edges.note: 按福利位次赋权只需知道谁较贫困。若同代或同国身份也改变对平等化转移的评价，就要检查这些判断能否被同一福利函数表示。
edges.noteEn: Rank weights need only identify who is worse off. If generation or country membership also changes the evaluation of equalizing transfers, those judgments must be checked for joint representability.

resources.title: Intergenerational equity and infinite-population ethics: A survey

branches.questionEn: How should two welfare paths be compared when a policy helps the present generation but harms every later one? Can a ranking treat generations’ identities equally and respect Pareto improvements?
branches.boundaryEn: Each generation’s utility is given. The object is a normative ranking across generations. Choices over consumption dates by one individual belong to intertemporal choice.

branches.name: 货币搜寻与交换媒介
branches.en: Monetary search and media of exchange
branches.question: 陌生人随机相遇，恰好想要彼此产品的情况很少。什么资产仍会被接受？一单位货币能换多少，交易记录能否替代它？
branches.boundary: 关注接受、转手和购买力如何在分散交易中产生；职位搜寻和劳动力匹配另有分支。

papers.title: On Money as a Medium of Exchange
papers.note: 专业化生产者在随机双边会面中交易。即使自己不消费某种物品，也可能因预期下一位交易者接受它而收下。
papers.noteEn: Specialized producers trade in random bilateral meetings. An agent may accept a good they do not consume because they expect a subsequent trading partner to accept it.

papers.title: A Search-Theoretic Approach to Monetary Economics
papers.note: 以可求解的搜寻均衡刻画物物交换的配对困难，并分析专业化、法币接受与多种法币并存。
papers.noteEn: A tractable search equilibrium captures the matching difficulties of barter and examines specialization, acceptance of fiat money and coexistence of multiple fiat monies.

papers.title: Money and Prices: A Model of Search and Bargaining
papers.note: 让商品可分并在相遇时议价。即使人人都接受法币，购买力和产出仍可能因均衡不同而改变。
papers.noteEn: Goods are divisible and traders bargain when they meet. Even if everyone accepts fiat money, purchasing power and output can differ across equilibria.

papers.title: Money Is Memory
papers.note: 在文中无承诺的环境类中，货币可以实现的配置也可由交易历史记录实现；反方向的包含关系取决于环境。
papers.noteEn: In the paper’s class of environments without commitment, transaction histories can implement allocations attainable with money. Whether the reverse inclusion holds depends on the environment.

papers.title: A Unified Framework for Monetary Theory and Policy Analysis
papers.note: 每期把随机双边交易与集中交易连接起来，利用后一阶段的结构控制持币分布，从而可计算通胀的福利成本。
papers.noteEn: Each period combines random bilateral trade and a centralized market. The latter’s structure disciplines the money-holdings distribution and makes the welfare cost of inflation quantifiable.

papers.title: The Origin and Development of Media of Exchange
papers.note: 研究直接物物交换与借助中介商品的交易如何共存，以及他人接受某商品的预期如何影响个人选择。
papers.noteEn: Studies how direct barter can coexist with indirect trade and how expectations about others’ willingness to accept a commodity affect individual choices.

papers.title: Search, Bargaining, Money, and Prices
papers.role: 双边议价决定货币价格
papers.note: 令商品可分，使交易双方既决定是否接受货币，又通过议价确定一单位货币买到多少商品。
papers.noteEn: Divisible goods allow buyers and sellers to decide both whether to trade for money and how much a unit of money buys through bargaining.

papers.title: A Divisible Search Model of Fiat Money
papers.note: 在双边搜寻中让货币和商品都可分，研究货币增长如何改变交易与搜寻激励。
papers.noteEn: Makes both goods and money divisible in bilateral search and studies how money growth changes trading and search incentives.

papers.title: A Model of Commodity Money, with Applications to Gresham’s Law and the Debasement Puzzle
papers.authors: François R. Velde · Warren E. Weber · Randall Wright
papers.note: 轻重币并存且质量信息不完全时，双边议价均衡可能只有一种币流通，也可能两种同时流通。
papers.noteEn: With light and heavy coins and imperfect information about quality, bilateral bargaining equilibria may feature one type of coin in circulation or both.

papers.title: Money in Search Equilibrium, in Competitive Equilibrium, and in Competitive Search Equilibrium
papers.note: 在统一货币环境中比较议价、价格接受和竞争性搜寻，识别定价机制如何影响交易量、市场进入与福利。
papers.noteEn: Compares bargaining, price taking and competitive search in a common monetary environment to show how pricing rules affect quantities, entry and welfare.

papers.title: Money and Capital as Competing Media of Exchange
papers.role: 生产资本的流动性价值
papers.note: 资本既能生产又能支付。有效率的资本量若不足以满足交易的流动性需求，分散经济可能过度积累资本。
papers.noteEn: Capital can both produce and purchase goods. If the efficient capital stock falls short of liquidity needs, decentralized trade can induce excess capital accumulation.

papers.title: Liquidity, Monetary Policy, and the Financial Crisis: A New Monetarist Approach
papers.note: 把金融中介与公开市场操作置入有交易摩擦的模型，考察私人和政府提供的流动性如何相互作用。
papers.noteEn: Places financial intermediation and open-market operations in an economy with trading frictions to study the interaction of private and public liquidity.

papers.title: Liquidity in Asset Markets With Search Frictions
papers.note: 资产持有量会随下次能交易的预期而调整，影响均衡成交量、价差和交易延迟。
papers.noteEn: Anticipating the next trading opportunity changes desired asset positions, affecting volume, spreads, and delays in equilibrium.

papers.title: Incomplete Record-Keeping and Optimal Payment Arrangements
papers.note: 在随机配对且不能预先承诺的经济中，公共账本会延迟更新。作者比较货币余额同不完整交易记录提供的信息，以及两者结合时的最优支付安排。
papers.noteEn: In random matching without commitment, the public record updates with a lag. The paper compares the information conveyed by balances and incomplete histories and studies optimal payment arrangements using both.

papers.title: Money Is Privacy
papers.authors: Charles M. Kahn · James McAndrews · William Roberds
papers.role: 匿名支付保护交易隐私
papers.note: 信用支付会暴露购买者身份，货币支付则可保持匿名。在有道德风险的交易经济中，取得信息即使没有成本，隐私本身也能使货币有价值。
papers.noteEn: Credit reveals the purchaser’s identity while money can preserve anonymity. In a trading economy with moral hazard, privacy can make money useful even when information is costless.

papers.title: Assessing the Impact of Central Bank Digital Currency on Private Banks
papers.role: 公共支付资产与存款竞争
papers.roleEn: Public payment assets and deposit competition
papers.note: 在银行拥有存款市场势力的模型中，计息央行数字货币促使银行提高存款利率。更高的参与率和储蓄可扩大存款资金，贷款未必减少。
papers.noteEn: With a bank exercising deposit-market power, interest-bearing CBDC pressures it to raise deposit rates. Greater participation and saving can expand deposit funding, so lending need not fall.

papers.title: The economics of cryptocurrency: Bitcoin and beyond
papers.role: 防双花约束与加密支付
papers.note: 匿名验证者维护账本需要付出挖矿成本，交易还可能推迟结算。模型用阻止双花的激励约束计算支付系统的福利成本，并比较奖励验证者的方式。
papers.noteEn: Anonymous validators maintain the ledger through costly mining, and settlement can be delayed. An incentive constraint against double spending determines welfare costs and permits comparisons of validator rewards.

papers.title: Tokenomics: Dynamic Adoption and Valuation
papers.authors: Lin William Cong · Ye Li · Neng Wang
papers.note: 用户规模越大，平台交易对潜在用户越有价值。模型使采用率与代币价格共同演化，预期代币升值改变早期用户进入的吸引力。
papers.noteEn: A larger user base makes platform transactions more valuable to potential adopters. Adoption and token prices evolve jointly, and expected appreciation changes the appeal of joining early.

edges.label: 简化配对摩擦
edges.note: 把双重巧合的概率写进易分析的搜寻模型，比较交换制度、专业化与法币的接受程度。
edges.noteEn: Writing the probability of a double coincidence into a tractable search model permits comparisons of exchange institutions, specialization and acceptance of fiat money.

edges.label: 使每次交易量可谈判
edges.note: 即使货币被接受，可分商品和双边议价仍需要在均衡中确定每单位货币交换的数量。
edges.noteEn: Even when money is accepted, divisible goods and bilateral bargaining require equilibrium to determine the quantity purchased per unit of money.

edges.label: 与可记忆的交易历史比较
edges.note: 把接受货币的问题改写为可实施配置的比较，从而区分作为商品的货币与记录交易的功能。
edges.noteEn: Recasting the acceptance question as a comparison of implementable allocations distinguishes money as an object from its record-keeping function.

edges.label: 把双边交易嵌入政策模型
edges.note: 让分散交易和集中交易交替，保留货币在双边交换中的作用，并使持币和通胀福利可以量化。
edges.noteEn: Alternating decentralized and centralized trade preserves money’s role in bilateral exchange while permitting quantitative analysis of money holdings and inflation costs.
edges.labelEn: Embed bilateral trade in a policy model

edges.label: 把可销性置入配对搜寻
edges.note: 后续模型让持货人与他人随机相遇，以均衡中的接受策略解释为何特定商品充当货币。
edges.noteEn: The later model uses random meetings and equilibrium acceptance strategies to explain why particular commodities become money.

edges.label: 增加可议定的交易量
edges.note: 在配对和接受货币策略之外，交易量成为均衡对象，可以研究实物价格怎样随货币环境改变。
edges.noteEn: Beyond matching and acceptance, quantities become equilibrium objects, allowing the goods price of money to respond to the monetary environment.

edges.label: 放松货币单位不可分的限制
edges.note: 买方可选择支付多少货币，实际余额与交易机会的配置因而进入货币政策分析。
edges.noteEn: Buyers can choose how much money to spend, making real balances and the distribution of trading opportunities relevant to policy.

edges.label: 加入金属含量与识别摩擦
edges.note: 商品成为交换媒介的问题细化为交易者能否识别硬币质量、以及按面值还是按重量接受它。
edges.labelEn: Add metal content and quality uncertainty
edges.noteEn: The acceptance problem becomes one of recognizing coin quality and trading coins by face value or weight.

edges.label: 比较多种价格形成制度
edges.note: 保留货币的交换作用，同时改变双方如何相遇、定价，使制度差异的福利影响可比。
edges.noteEn: Holding money’s exchange role in place while changing matching and pricing makes the welfare consequences of trading institutions comparable.

edges.label: 让另一种资产承担支付职能
edges.note: 研究者可在同一搜寻环境里比较持有法币和持有生产性资产的交易服务及机会成本。
edges.labelEn: Let a second asset serve as payment
edges.noteEn: The same search environment can compare the transaction services and opportunity costs of fiat money and productive assets.

edges.label: 在交易需求上叠加金融中介
edges.note: 不同资产用于支付或抵押的能力影响中介可供给的流动性，并让资产购买政策改变信用配置。
edges.labelEn: Introduce intermediation into the liquidity problem
edges.noteEn: Differences in assets’ usefulness for payment or collateral affect intermediary liquidity and can make asset purchases change the allocation of credit.

edges.label: 从商品交换转向资产组合
edges.note: 摩擦不只是延迟既定交易，还会改变投资者希望在每次相遇时交易的数量。
edges.labelEn: From goods exchange to asset portfolios
edges.noteEn: Frictions do more than delay given trades. They change how much investors want to trade when a meeting occurs.

edges.label: 将完备记忆改成滞后记录
edges.labelEn: Replace perfect memory with delayed records
edges.note: 如果过去行为能及时公开，记忆可以支持货币所实现的配置。加入记录延迟后，交易当下可用的余额和事后才公开的信息发挥不同作用。
edges.noteEn: When past actions are immediately public, memory can support monetary allocations. With delayed reporting, balances observed at trade and information available only later play different roles.

edges.label: 由记得谁交易转向保护交易者身份
edges.labelEn: Move from recording transactions to protecting identity
edges.note: 记账理论强调历史信息能支持哪些交易。本文指出某些交易反而需要控制他人能够获知的信息，货币与信用因此有不同福利后果。
edges.noteEn: Record-keeping theory asks what trade can be supported by histories. This paper shows that controlling who learns about a purchase can itself matter for welfare, distinguishing money from credit.

edges.label: 把资产竞争落实为存款定价
edges.labelEn: Translate competition between assets into deposit pricing
edges.note: 货币与其他资产的可替代性会改变持仓。这里竞争者是央行发行的资产和垄断银行的存款，关键反应是存款利率与资金供给。
edges.noteEn: Substitution between monetary assets affects portfolios. Here the competitors are a central bank asset and monopoly bank deposits, making deposit-rate setting and funding supply central.

edges.label: 让维护交易记录成为激励问题
edges.labelEn: Make ledger maintenance an incentive problem
edges.note: 账本延迟模型将记录技术视为给定。加密货币模型进一步解释，为何支撑一份可信账本需要付费验证与等待确认。
edges.noteEn: The delayed-record model takes reporting technology as given. The cryptocurrency model asks why credible records require paid verification and waiting for confirmation.

edges.label: 把接受意愿扩展到平台进入
edges.note: 两种模型都关心他人是否愿意使用同一媒介。平台代币模型还使用户基数随时间变化，并让预期未来采用反映到今天的资产价格中。
edges.noteEn: Both models ask whether others will use the same medium. The token model makes the user base dynamic and allows expected future adoption to enter the current asset price.

resources.title: Liquidity: A New Monetarist Perspective
resources.authors: Ricardo Lagos, Guillaume Rocheteau & Randall Wright

branches.questionEn: Strangers meet at random and seldom want exactly what the other produces. Which assets will they accept? What will a unit of money buy, and can transaction records replace money?
branches.boundaryEn: The focus is on how acceptance, circulation and purchasing power arise in decentralized trade. Job search and labor market matching have their own branches.

branches.name: 有限承诺与动态风险分担
branches.en: Dynamic risk sharing with limited commitment
branches.question: 如果今天收入较高的家庭可以拒绝向邻居转移资源，未来的互助足以支撑多大程度的消费保险？
branches.boundary: 从家庭可退出保险安排的参与约束出发。收入可以是公开信息；动态私人类型的如实报告和外生资产不完备各有单独分支。

papers.title: Reciprocity without commitment: Characterization and performance of informal insurance arrangements
papers.note: 两个收入独立波动的家庭反复互动时，偏离后失去未来互助的代价限制当期转移；论文刻画可持续的最优互保安排。
papers.noteEn: Two households with independent income fluctuations interact repeatedly. Losing future support after deviation limits current transfers. The paper characterizes optimal sustainable insurance arrangements.

papers.title: Risk and Insurance in Village India
papers.note: 对印度三个村庄检验完整风险分担：控制全村消费后，家庭当期收入等个体冲击影响很小，但数据仍拒绝精确的完全保险。
papers.noteEn: Tests for three Indian villages find that individual shocks such as current household income have small effects after conditioning on village consumption. The data nevertheless reject exact full insurance.

papers.title: Implications of Efficient Risk Sharing without Commitment
papers.note: 在对称信息下刻画缺乏承诺时的有效配置，说明耐心程度和既往冲击如何决定长期能否实现完全分担。
papers.noteEn: Under symmetric information, the paper characterizes efficient allocations with limited commitment and shows how patience and past shocks determine the extent of long-run risk sharing.

papers.title: Informal Insurance Arrangements with Limited Commitment: Theory and Evidence from Village Economies
papers.authors: Ethan Ligon, Jonathan P. Thomas & Tim Worrall
papers.role: 村庄数据中的动态检验
papers.note: 用印度三个村庄的数据检验受参与约束的有效保险；模型能解释消费对收入的动态反应，但对家庭间消费分布解释较差。
papers.noteEn: Data from three Indian villages test efficient insurance subject to participation constraints. The model explains dynamic consumption responses to income better than the cross-household consumption distribution.

papers.title: Does Income Inequality Lead to Consumption Inequality? Evidence and Theory
papers.role: 内生借贷约束与不平等
papers.note: 结合美国消费数据与一般均衡模型，允许家庭交易状态依存索取权，同时让可执行程度内生地限制负债，比较收入与消费不平等。
papers.noteEn: US consumption data and a general-equilibrium model with tradable contingent claims and endogenously limited debt are used to examine how greater income dispersion translates into consumption inequality.

papers.title: Debt-Constrained Asset Markets
papers.authors: Timothy J. Kehoe · David K. Levine
papers.role: 以违约选择界定债务上限
papers.note: 允许个人违约后退出跨期资产交易，研究内生债务约束能支持的竞争均衡及其风险分担。
papers.roleEn: Debt limits from the default option
papers.noteEn: Allows a defaulter to lose access to intertemporal asset trading and studies competitive equilibria and risk sharing under the resulting endogenous debt constraints.

papers.title: Efficiency, Equilibrium, and Asset Pricing with Risk of Default
papers.note: 以足以防止违约的偿付约束分散化受约束有效配置，并研究这些约束如何改变资产价格。
papers.noteEn: Decentralizes constrained-efficient allocations using solvency constraints that prevent default, and studies how the constraints affect asset prices.

papers.title: Mutual Insurance, Individual Savings, and Limited Commitment
papers.authors: Ethan Ligon · Jonathan P. Thomas · Tim Worrall
papers.note: 允许个人把资源存到下一期，在有限承诺下比较自我保险和互助转移如何共同实现消费平滑。
papers.noteEn: Allows households to store goods across periods and studies how self-insurance and mutual transfers jointly smooth consumption under limited commitment.

papers.title: Group Formation in Risk-Sharing Arrangements
papers.role: 子联盟退出与保险群体
papers.note: 允许若干成员共同离开并形成能自我维持的保险团体，分析哪些群体规模可以稳定维持风险共担。
papers.noteEn: Allows members to leave jointly and form a self-enforcing subgroup, then characterizes which group sizes can sustain shared insurance.

papers.title: Consumption Risk-Sharing in Social Networks
papers.authors: Attila Ambrus · Markus Mobius · Adam Szeidl
papers.note: 把社会关系作为执行非正式支付的抵押品。最优受约束安排可在内生群体内部充分分担风险、在群体之间只部分分担。
papers.noteEn: Uses social ties as collateral for informal transfers. Under second-best arrangements, endogenous groups can fully share shocks internally while only partly insuring across groups.

papers.title: Consumption Smoothing in Island Economies: Can Public Insurance Reduce Welfare?
papers.role: 公共保险与私人自我执行
papers.note: 对共同冲击提供公共保险可能提高退出价值，从而削弱针对个体冲击的私人保险，整体福利可能下降。
papers.noteEn: Public insurance against common shocks can improve outside options, weaken private insurance against idiosyncratic shocks and reduce overall welfare.

papers.title: Distinguishing Barriers to Insurance in Thai Villages
papers.note: 不同摩擦对既往收入如何预测消费有不同限制；泰国村庄面板支持隐藏收入解释，拒绝文中的有限承诺与道德风险模型。
papers.noteEn: The models restrict how past income predicts consumption differently. Thai panel data favor hidden income over the tested commitment and moral-hazard models.

papers.title: Risk-sharing networks
papers.note: 两人建立分担关系时，保险收益可沿间接连接传给其他人。论文比较有效网络与个人愿意维持的网络，解释断开一条关系造成的外部损失。
papers.noteEn: A bilateral sharing link can benefit others through indirect connections. The paper compares efficient networks with those individuals will maintain and identifies external losses from severing a link.

papers.title: Temporary Migration and Endogenous Risk Sharing in Village India
papers.note: 临时外出就业可分散收入风险，也会改变村内成员继续互助的价值。论文将迁移选择内生化，利用印度村庄数据衡量迁移与转移支付的相互作用。
