papers.noteEn: Temporary work away from the village can diversify income and change the value of staying in its insurance arrangement. The paper endogenizes migration and uses Indian village data to quantify its interaction with transfers.

papers.title: Investments in social ties, risk sharing, and inequality
papers.role: 对社会关系投资与不平等
papers.roleEn: Investing in social ties and inequality
papers.note: 保险关系需要成本来建立与维持。模型中，某些有效且较不易瓦解的网络也造成更大的收益差距，尤其是不同群体之间的连接较昂贵时。
papers.noteEn: Insurance ties are costly to establish and maintain. In the model efficient networks that are especially stable can also generate more unequal payoffs, including when links between groups are costly.

papers.title: Informal Risk Sharing with Local Information
papers.authors: Attila Ambrus · Wayne Gao · Pau Milán
papers.role: 局部信息限制可订立的转移
papers.note: 转移合约只能依据局部可观察、可验证的信息。论文给出受限条件下帕累托有效的判据；在常绝对风险厌恶与正态禀赋下可刻画双边转移。
papers.noteEn: Transfers can condition only on locally observable or verifiable information. The paper derives efficiency conditions under such restrictions and characterizes bilateral transfers for CARA utilities and normal endowments.

papers.title: Informal Risk Sharing, Index Insurance, and Risk Taking in Developing Countries
papers.authors: Ahmed Mushfiq Mobarak · Mark R. Rosenzweig
papers.role: 降雨指数保险与既有互助
papers.roleEn: Rainfall index insurance and existing mutual aid
papers.note: 研究者在印度村庄随机提供降雨指数保险，并用原有互助网络资料区分不同的保障条件。指数赔付与家庭损失的错配影响正式保险和互助如何搭配。
papers.noteEn: Random offers of rainfall index insurance in Indian villages are combined with preexisting measures of mutual support. Mismatch between index payments and household losses shapes how formal and informal cover fit together.

edges.label: 刻画有效配置的历史依赖
edges.note: 把最优互惠转移推进为可检验的动态配置限制，考察不同耐心程度下长期风险分担的程度。
edges.noteEn: The analysis moves from optimal reciprocal transfers to testable restrictions on dynamic allocations and examines how patience affects long-run risk sharing.
edges.labelEn: Characterize history dependence in efficient allocations

edges.label: 解释完全保险检验的偏离
edges.note: 在村庄完全共担的经验基准上加入可退出的约束，检验家庭消费怎样随收入冲击和过往分配改变。
edges.noteEn: Adding the option to leave to a village-wide pooling benchmark yields tests of how consumption responds to income shocks and past allocations.

edges.label: 把动态限制带到数据
edges.note: 用有限承诺下的最优保险刻画，同时检验模型对收入变化的动态反应和跨家庭的消费分布。
edges.noteEn: The characterization of optimal insurance under limited commitment is tested against both responses to income changes and the cross-household consumption distribution.

edges.label: 转向一般均衡与不平等
edges.note: 将合同执行约束嵌入可交易状态索取权的经济，定量研究收入离散程度上升怎样传导至消费分布。
edges.noteEn: Contract enforcement constraints are embedded in an economy with tradable contingent claims to quantify how increasing income dispersion passes through to consumption.
edges.labelEn: Move to general equilibrium and inequality

edges.label: 比较金融市场与自愿风险分担
edges.note: 资产市场通过债务上限阻止违约，重复保险通过延续价值阻止退出；两者都把外部选择写进可行集。
edges.labelEn: Compare market enforcement with voluntary sharing
edges.noteEn: Debt limits deter default in markets, while continuation values deter exit in repeated insurance. Both approaches let outside options restrict feasible allocations.

edges.label: 把偿付边界同资产价格联系
edges.note: 在排除违约的边界以内，状态价格仍须支撑参与者的最优交易，从而连接配置、债务上限和价格。
edges.labelEn: Link solvency bounds to asset pricing
edges.noteEn: Within the bounds ruling out default, state prices must support optimal trades, linking allocations, borrowing limits and asset values.

edges.label: 给参与者加入跨期储蓄
edges.note: 储藏同时影响留在协议中的选择和退出后的消费机会，因而必须重新计算可执行的转移。
edges.noteEn: Storage affects both the options within the arrangement and consumption after exit, changing which transfers can be enforced.

edges.label: 从个体退出到可执行的群体偏离
edges.note: 即使无人愿意独立离开，若小群体内部可以维持保险，原群体的转移承诺仍可能失去可信性。
edges.noteEn: Even when no one wishes to leave alone, a viable subgroup insurance arrangement can undermine transfers in the original group.

edges.label: 以网络连接刻画执行能力
edges.note: 群体边界的来源从哪些成员能共同退出，转向哪些社会连接可用来执行承诺和跨群体转移。
edges.labelEn: Use network links to model enforcement
edges.noteEn: The source of group boundaries shifts from viable coalitional exits to the ties available for enforcing promises and cross-group transfers.

edges.label: 让公共政策改变退出价值
edges.note: 公共保险的效果既取决于政府直接平滑的风险，也取决于参与约束收紧后还能维持多少互助转移。
edges.labelEn: Let public policy shift the exit option
edges.noteEn: The policy’s effect depends both on the risk it insures directly and on how much mutual insurance survives the tighter participation constraints.

edges.label: 用历史模式区分机制
edges.note: 观察到不完全保险本身不能识别原因，消费对不同历史变量的反应则可作判别。
edges.noteEn: Incomplete insurance alone does not identify its cause. Responses of consumption to distinct histories help distinguish mechanisms.

edges.label: 从团体退出转向关系建立与断开
edges.labelEn: Move from coalitional exit to forming and severing links
edges.note: 团体模型问哪些子联盟可另立保险安排。网络模型问一条边能否由两端当事人维持，因而还能分析不直接相连的受益人。
edges.noteEn: Coalitional models ask which groups can sustain insurance after leaving. The network model asks whether the two endpoints maintain a link, bringing indirect beneficiaries into the analysis.

edges.label: 让外部选择随迁移机会变化
edges.labelEn: Make outside options depend on migration opportunities
edges.note: 在有限承诺的村庄模型中，退出待遇决定可执行的互助。外地就业机会同时改变自我保险与村内分担，不能把迁移人数视为政策不变的参数。
edges.noteEn: In limited-commitment village models outside options bound enforceable transfers. Migration opportunities change both self-insurance and village insurance, so migration cannot be held fixed in policy analysis.

edges.label: 给社会抵押引入投资成本
edges.labelEn: Introduce investment costs for social collateral
edges.note: 给定网络可判定哪些转移有足够社会关系支撑。把关系的建立内生化后，还须解释谁愿意付出跨群体联结的成本、谁取得保险收益。
edges.noteEn: A given network bounds transfers supported by social ties. Endogenizing ties adds the questions of who pays for cross-group connections and who receives the insurance gains.

edges.label: 把执行约束与信息约束区分开
edges.labelEn: Separate enforcement constraints from information constraints
edges.note: 社会抵押决定承诺能否兑现；局部信息决定承诺能写入哪些状态。后一机制能使中心成员承担更多保险责任，消费反而波动更大。
edges.noteEn: Social collateral governs whether promises are enforced. Local information governs which states the promises may mention. The latter mechanism can make central agents bear more risk and experience more volatile consumption.

edges.label: 将共同与个体风险带入田野检验
edges.labelEn: Bring common and idiosyncratic risk to a field test
edges.note: 模型指出公共保险会改变私人互助的激励。指数合约按观测降雨而非个人损失理赔，提供了一种比较现有网络怎样影响保险需求与冒险决策的场景。
edges.noteEn: The model shows how public coverage can change private sharing incentives. A contract tied to observed rainfall instead of household losses offers a setting for examining how existing networks affect demand for insurance and risk taking.

branches.questionEn: If a household with high income today can refuse to transfer resources to a neighbor, how much consumption insurance can future reciprocity sustain?
branches.boundaryEn: The starting point is the participation constraint of households free to leave an insurance arrangement. Income can be publicly observed. Dynamic truth-telling constraints and exogenously incomplete asset markets have separate branches.

branches.name: 拥堵博弈、路由与无政府代价
branches.en: Congestion games, routing, and the price of anarchy
branches.question: 人人都选择对自己最快的路，为什么所有人仍会比统一调度更慢？多一条路、更多信息或一笔通行费会怎样改变结果？
branches.boundary: 区分无原子的连续流与不能拆分需求的有限玩家，比较均衡总延误和最优总延误，并考察道路信息、时段收费与边收费。最坏比值取决于延误函数与玩家大小。
branches.boundaryEn: Distinguish nonatomic traffic from finite players with unsplittable demands. Compare total delay at equilibrium and at the optimum, then vary route information, time-dependent tolls, and link prices. Worst-case ratios depend on latency functions and player size.
branches.questionEn: If everyone takes their quickest route, why might all travelers be slower than under coordinated routing? What changes with another road, better route information, or a toll?

papers.title: Some Theoretical Aspects of Road Traffic Research
papers.role: 使用者均衡与系统最优
papers.note: 区分两种配流原则：同一起终点对上，实际使用的线路都具有最短时间；规划者则最小化所有车辆的总行程时间。
papers.noteEn: Distinguishes two assignments: all used routes for an origin–destination pair have minimum travel time at a user equilibrium, while a planner minimizes total travel time.

papers.title: Über ein Paradoxon aus der Verkehrsplanung
papers.note: 构造一个交通网络，加一条可选道路后，自行选路的均衡重新分流，每位使用者的行程时间反而上升。
papers.noteEn: Constructs a network in which adding an available road changes the equilibrium flow and increases every user's travel time.

papers.title: Congestion Theory and Transport Investment
papers.note: 在通勤者选择出发时刻的瓶颈模型中，随时段升降的收费可以消除队列，并保持原来抵达目的地的时刻分布。
papers.noteEn: In a bottleneck model with departure-time choice, a time-varying toll eliminates the queue while preserving the original distribution of arrival times at the destination.

papers.title: A Class of Games Possessing Pure-Strategy Nash Equilibria
papers.note: 每名玩家选一组资源，成本为各资源按使用人数计价之和。构造势函数，使单方偏离的成本变化等于势的变化，保证纯策略均衡。
papers.noteEn: Each player chooses a resource subset and pays the sum of load-dependent costs. An exact potential tracks unilateral cost changes, guaranteeing a pure equilibrium.

papers.title: Congestion Games with Player-Specific Payoff Functions
papers.note: 每人只选一项资源，收益随使用人数下降但可因人而异。即使共同成本的势函数不再适用，纯策略均衡仍存在。
papers.noteEn: When each player selects one resource, declining payoffs can depend on the player's identity. Pure equilibrium still exists without the original common-cost potential argument.

papers.title: How Bad Is Selfish Routing?
papers.note: 固定交通需求、边延误为非负仿射函数时，使用者均衡的总延误至多为系统最优的 4/3，并有网络达到该界。
papers.roleEn: An efficiency bound for nonatomic routing
papers.noteEn: For fixed traffic demands and nonnegative affine edge delays, total equilibrium latency is at most four thirds of optimal total latency. The bound is tight.

papers.title: Tolls for Heterogeneous Selfish Users in Multicommodity Networks and Generalized Congestion Games
papers.authors: Lisa Fleischer · Kamal Jain · Mohammad Mahdian
papers.role: 拥堵费与时间价值异质性
papers.note: 允许不同出行需求和不同的收费敏感度，刻画可由边收费诱导的配流；其中包括使总延误最小的配流。所引为 FOCS 论文集版本。
papers.roleEn: Tolls with heterogeneous values of time
papers.noteEn: With multiple commodities and heterogeneous sensitivity to tolls, the paper characterizes toll-inducible flows, including flows that minimize total delay. The linked version appeared in the FOCS proceedings.

papers.title: The Price of Routing Unsplittable Flow
papers.authors: Baruch Awerbuch · Yossi Azar · Amir Epstein
papers.note: 每个玩家把整份需求交给一条路径。线性成本下，未加权拥堵博弈的无政府代价为 5/2，加权情形为 (3+√5)/2。
papers.noteEn: Each player sends its full demand along one path. With linear costs, the price of anarchy is 5/2 in unweighted congestion games and (3+√5)/2 in the weighted case.

papers.title: Intrinsic Robustness of the Price of Anarchy
papers.role: 弱均衡也能使用的效率界
papers.note: 用平滑性不等式证明的无政府代价上界也适用于粗相关均衡和无外部后悔的长期平均成本。
papers.noteEn: Price-of-anarchy upper bounds certified by a smoothness inequality extend to coarse correlated equilibria and the long-run average cost of play with no external regret.

papers.title: Informational Braess’ Paradox: The Effect of Information on Traffic Congestion
papers.authors: Daron Acemoglu · Ali Makhdoumi · Azarakhsh Malekian · Asuman Ozdaglar
papers.note: 部分使用者多知道几条可行路线后，其均衡行程反而可能更慢；在单一起终点对下刻画能排除该悖论的网络。
papers.roleEn: A paradox of disclosing more routes
papers.noteEn: Telling a group about additional feasible routes can worsen that group's equilibrium travel time. For a single origin–destination pair, the paper characterizes which networks exclude the paradox.

papers.title: The Price of Anarchy in Routing Games as a Function of the Demand
papers.authors: Roberto Cominetti · Valerio Dose · Marco Scarsini
papers.role: 需求改变时的效率曲线
papers.note: 固定单一起终点网络并改变需求。仿射成本下均衡具有分段线性结构，实际使用的路径集合改变时出现断点。2021 年在线发表，2024 年编入期刊卷。
papers.noteEn: Holding a single origin–destination network fixed and varying demand gives a piecewise-linear equilibrium under affine costs, with breakpoints when the active paths change. Published online in 2021 and assigned to a 2024 volume.

papers.title: Optimal Traffic Conditions in Two-Link Parallel Networks with Polynomial Costs
papers.note: 对多项式延误的两条平行道路，研究哪些需求水平使均衡与最优配流一致，并对若干简单情形给出解数的锐界。
papers.roleEn: Demand levels at which equilibrium is efficient
papers.noteEn: For two parallel links with polynomial delays, studies which demand levels make equilibrium flows optimal and obtains sharp bounds on the number of solutions in several elementary cases.

papers.title: The Price of Anarchy Is Independent of the Network Topology
papers.role: 延迟函数与最坏效率损失
papers.note: 连续交通流中，给定满足论文条件的延迟函数类，单一起讫点的并行道路足以逼近任意网络的最坏效率损失。若该类包含所有常数函数，两条并行道路就够了。
papers.noteEn: For nonatomic traffic and an admissible class of latency functions, parallel routes between one origin and one destination suffice to approach the worst-case inefficiency of arbitrary networks. Two routes suffice when the class contains all constant functions.

edges.label: 让使用者重新选路
edges.note: 增加道路扩大规划者的可行集，同时也改变分散选路的诱因，所以均衡用时可能增加。
edges.noteEn: Adding a road enlarges the planner's feasible set but also changes private route incentives, so equilibrium times can rise.

edges.label: 从选路转向选择出发时刻
edges.note: 拥堵外部性也可能表现为瓶颈排队；以分时价格替代排队能减少真实的时间损失。
edges.labelEn: Move from route choice to departure time
edges.noteEn: Congestion can take the form of a bottleneck queue. Replacing queuing with a time-dependent price reduces the real time cost.

edges.label: 引入不可忽略的单个使用者
edges.note: 微小流量只比较当前路径成本；有限玩家改道时会改变资源负荷，存在性需重新证明。
edges.noteEn: Infinitesimal flows compare current route costs. A finite player changes resource loads when it switches, so existence requires a different argument.

edges.label: 让相同负荷产生不同个人成本
edges.note: 放弃共同资源成本后，限制每人只选一个资源仍能保住纯均衡。
edges.labelEn: Allow the same load to cost different players different amounts
edges.noteEn: After dropping common resource costs, restricting each player to one resource preserves pure equilibrium.

edges.label: 量化均衡与最优的差距
edges.note: 等时原则和总时间最小化定义了两个目标，仿射成本假设使两者的最坏比值可以精确求出。
edges.noteEn: The two Wardrop principles specify the comparison. Affine delays make it possible to calculate a tight worst-case ratio.

edges.label: 用收费对齐两种配流原则
edges.note: 当不同人以不同比例权衡时间与金钱时，仍可询问哪些均衡流量能用共同的边收费支持。
edges.labelEn: Use tolls to align the two assignments
edges.noteEn: Even when travelers trade off time and money differently, one can ask which equilibrium loads common edge tolls support.

edges.label: 把流量变成不可分割的需求
edges.note: 每个玩家走一条路且其偏离改变负荷；无原子线性成本的 4/3 效率界因而需要替换。
edges.noteEn: One player's route change now moves an entire demand and changes loads, so the nonatomic four-thirds guarantee must be replaced.

edges.label: 从有均衡到均衡表现多差
edges.note: 势函数给出纯均衡的存在性；与社会最优成本比较时，还要区分参与者权重与成本函数族。
edges.labelEn: From existence to worst equilibrium performance
edges.noteEn: A potential establishes existence. Comparing equilibrium costs with a social optimum also requires specifying player weights and the class of costs.

edges.label: 放宽均衡与长期行为假设
edges.note: 原子拥堵中的成本比较可从逐个单方偏离构造；平滑性说明何时相同的上界也约束学习轨迹。
edges.labelEn: Allow weaker equilibrium and learning assumptions
edges.noteEn: Costs in atomic games can be compared using unilateral deviations. Smoothness identifies when the same bounds govern learning trajectories.

edges.label: 保留道路而扩大可见路线
edges.note: 原悖论添加真实道路；信息版本保留交通网络，扩大某类使用者可辨认的路线集合。
edges.labelEn: Keep the roads and expand route information
edges.noteEn: The original paradox adds a physical road. Its informational analogue holds the roads fixed and expands the routes known to one user class.

edges.label: 从跨网络最坏值转向网络内变化
edges.note: 将总需求作为连续变化的参数，考察同一网络在最坏界之内能呈现哪些效率变化。
edges.labelEn: From a worst-case bound to variation within one network
edges.noteEn: Treating total demand as a continuous parameter shows how efficiency can vary within a fixed network beneath the worst-case bound.

edges.label: 计算效率曲线何时等于一
edges.note: 把需求依赖问题收窄到两条平行边与多项式成本，能进一步讨论均衡与最优重合的需求数目。
edges.labelEn: Locate where the efficiency ratio equals one
edges.noteEn: Restricting the demand analysis to two parallel links with polynomial costs permits counting demand levels at which equilibrium coincides with the optimum.

edges.label: 从仿射延迟的界到一般网络的归约
edges.note: 前作给出仿射延迟下的紧界 4/3。后作保留最短时路径选择和总出行时间准则，证明在更一般的延迟函数类下，只需研究并行道路即可求最坏效率比，从而也能处理有界次数的多项式延迟。
edges.labelEn: From the affine bound to a reduction across networks
edges.noteEn: The earlier paper gives the tight 4/3 bound for affine delays. The successor keeps minimum-latency route choice and total travel time, but reduces the worst-case ratio for broader latency classes to parallel links, yielding bounds for bounded-degree polynomial delays.

resources.title: Studies in the Economics of Transportation
resources.authors: Martin J. Beckmann · C. B. McGuire · Christopher B. Winsten

resources.title: Selfish Routing and the Price of Anarchy

branches.name: 先验独立拍卖、样本复杂度与收入保证
branches.en: Prior-independent auctions, sample complexity and revenue guarantees
branches.question: 卖家不知道估值分布时，一次历史观测、更多样本或多招几位买家，各能弥补多少收入损失？
branches.questionEn: When a seller does not know the value distribution, how much lost revenue can one observation, additional samples or additional buyers recover?
branches.boundary: 分别记录设计者能观察什么、可用的机制、收入比较基准和保证成立的分布类别。一次估值观测不同于一个历史价格的购买率。用额外买家弥补机制复杂度时，也必须注明买家人数、物品数及独立性条件。
branches.boundaryEn: Each result specifies the observations available, the mechanism class, the revenue benchmark and the admissible distributions. One value observation and a conversion rate at one historical price carry different information. Competition-complexity bounds also specify the numbers of buyers and goods and the relevant independence assumptions.

papers.title: Revenue maximization with a single sample
papers.authors: Peerapong Dhangwatnotai · Tim Roughgarden · Qiqi Yan
papers.note: 机制用来自竞标者的独立价格信息设定保留价，再结合 VCG 配置。在论文的正则性和可行性条件下，可对知道分布的最优收入给出常数比例保证。
papers.noteEn: Uses independent price information from bidders to set reserves in a VCG-based auction. Under the paper's regularity and feasibility conditions it guarantees a constant fraction of distribution-aware optimal revenue.

papers.title: Randomization Beats Second Price as a Prior-Independent Auction
papers.authors: Hu Fu · Nicole Immorlica · Brendan Lucier · Philipp Strack
papers.note: 对独立同分布且正则的单物品估值，以一定概率提高次高报价对应的成交门槛。两位买方时，最坏收入保证从无保留价二价拍卖的 50% 提高至至少 51.2%。
papers.noteEn: For a single item with i.i.d. regular values, randomly raises the sale threshold above the second bid. For two buyers the worst-case guarantee improves on the 50% reserve-free second-price benchmark to at least 51.2%.

papers.title: On the Pseudo-Dimension of Nearly Optimal Auctions
papers.note: 构造分层拍卖，在独立估值下以较少层数近似最优收入。伪维数控制使用样本选择层次结构时产生的学习误差。
papers.noteEn: Constructs level auctions that approximate optimal revenue under independent values with few levels. Pseudo-dimension controls the learning error from choosing the auction on a sample.

papers.title: Efficient empirical revenue maximization in single-parameter auction environments
papers.note: 给定每位买方的估值样本，在多种单参数环境中以多项式时间学习收入近似最优的拍卖，涵盖拟阵、广告位和公共项目。
papers.noteEn: Given samples from each bidder, learns an approximately revenue-maximizing auction in polynomial time in several single-parameter environments, including matroids, positions and public projects.

papers.title: The Competition Complexity of Auctions: A Bulow-Klemperer Result for Multi-Dimensional Bidders
papers.authors: Alon Eden · Michal Feldman · Ophir Friedler · Inbal Talgam-Cohen · S. Matthew Weinberg
papers.note: 多维买家争夺若干物品时，问有多少额外买家能让简单的 VCG 拍卖在期望收入上达到原人数下的最优机制，并给出人数界。
papers.noteEn: For multidimensional bidders and several items, bounds how many extra buyers make the simple VCG auction match the expected revenue of the optimal mechanism with the original bidder count.

papers.title: Making the Most of Your Samples
papers.authors: Zhiyi Huang · Yishay Mansour · Tim Roughgarden
papers.role: 少量样本的最优定价精度
papers.roleEn: Optimal pricing accuracy from small samples
papers.note: 向一位买方定价，样本是同一未知分布的独立估值观测。在单调风险率类中，接近最优到乘数 1−ε 所需样本量为 ε 的 −3/2 次幂量级，忽略对数因子。
papers.noteEn: Sets a price for one buyer from independent draws of the unknown value distribution. For monotone hazard rates, a multiplicative 1−ε guarantee needs order ε to the power −3/2 samples up to logarithmic factors.

papers.title: Settling the sample complexity of single-parameter revenue maximization
papers.authors: Chenghao Guo · Zhiyi Huang · Xinzhi Zhang
papers.note: 对单参数收入最大化给出样本算法及信息论下界。在论文研究的正则、单调风险率和有界分布类别中，上下界相差至多对数因子。
papers.noteEn: Gives algorithms and information-theoretic lower bounds for single-parameter revenue maximization. The bounds agree up to logarithmic factors for the regular, monotone-hazard-rate and bounded distribution classes studied.

papers.title: Optimal auctions vs. anonymous pricing
papers.authors: Saeed Alaei · Jason Hartline · Rad Niazadeh · Emmanouil Pountourakis · Yang Yuan
papers.role: 对所有买方报同一价格
papers.roleEn: Posting one price to all buyers
papers.note: 在买方估值独立而可不同分布的正则环境，比较最优匿名价格和事前放松问题的收入，刻画统一报价牺牲的最坏比例。
papers.noteEn: For independent, possibly nonidentical regular buyer values, compares the best anonymous price with revenue from the ex ante relaxation, characterizing the worst-case loss from a common price.

papers.title: Prior-Independent Optimal Auctions
papers.role: 不知先验时的最优拍卖
papers.note: 在两位独立同分布买方模型中，按相对知道分布的卖家的收入比例评价机制。若只知风险率不减，二价拍卖最优，且保证至少约 71.53% 的基准收入。
papers.noteEn: Evaluates two-bidder i.i.d. mechanisms by their revenue relative to a seller who knows the distribution. With a monotone hazard rate, second price is optimal and guarantees at least about 71.53% of that benchmark.

papers.title: The Sample Complexity of Up-to-ε Multi-dimensional Revenue Maximization
papers.authors: Yannai A. Gonczarowski · S. Matthew Weinberg
papers.role: 从样本学习多维近优机制
papers.note: 多位可加买家对多项商品的估值独立、取值有界时，多项式数量的样本足以学习近似贝叶斯激励相容、期望收入接近最优的机制。
papers.noteEn: For multiple additive bidders with independent bounded item values, polynomially many samples suffice to learn an approximately Bayesian incentive-compatible auction with near-optimal expected revenue.

papers.title: Optimal Pricing with a Single Point
papers.authors: Amine Allouah · Achraf Bahamou · Omar Besbes
papers.note: 卖家知道一个历史价格下的购买概率，或只知道其置信区间。论文按相对于知道需求分布的最优定价收入的最坏比例，刻画可达保证。
papers.noteEn: The seller knows a purchase probability at one historical price, or a confidence interval for it. Characterizes the best worst-case revenue ratio relative to pricing with known demand.

papers.title: Settling the Competition Complexity of Additive Buyers over Independent Items
papers.authors: Mahsa Derakhshan · Emily Ryu · S. Matthew Weinberg · Eric Xue
papers.role: 多维竞争复杂度的紧界
papers.note: 各买家独立同分布、每人对正则且独立的各项价值可加时，若 2≤m<n，逐项二价出售要达到原有 n 位买家的最优收入，最坏情形所需的额外买家数为 √(nm) 量级。
papers.noteEn: For i.i.d. additive bidders with independent regular item values and 2≤m<n, the worst-case number of extra bidders needed by separate second-price auctions to match optimal revenue with n original bidders is of order √(nm).

edges.label: 把随机性用于成交门槛
edges.note: 单样本机制用他人的报价校准保留价；随机加价机制进一步问，不知道先验时，有意改动次高价能否提高最坏收入比例。
edges.noteEn: The single-sample mechanism uses other bids to calibrate reserves. Random markup asks whether deliberately altering the second bid can improve the worst-case ratio without knowing the prior.

edges.label: 将样本量作为变量
edges.note: 固定一条来自同一分布的独立观测可给出基准保证，改问接近最优到误差 ε 至少需要多少条独立观测。
edges.noteEn: A single independent observation gives a benchmark guarantee. Varying the sample size asks how many draws are necessary to reach a chosen error ε.

edges.label: 从固定机制到可学习的机制类
edges.labelEn: From a fixed mechanism to a learnable class
edges.note: 前者预先指定用样本设置保留价的方法；后者允许据样本选择分层规则，并单独控制选择规则的统计误差。
edges.noteEn: One specifies a reserve-setting rule in advance; the other selects among level auctions from data and controls the statistical cost of that selection.

edges.label: 从存在性到有效计算
edges.note: 有限容量的机制类能控制样本外误差；进一步要求在多项式时间从样本生成机制，就必须处理实际优化问题。
edges.noteEn: A class of bounded capacity can control out-of-sample error. Requiring polynomial-time construction adds a computational optimization problem.

edges.label: 补足必要样本数
edges.note: 高效学习先给出可达到的保证；单参数样本复杂度的后续工作用下界比较不同分布类，并收紧误差对样本量的要求。
edges.noteEn: An efficient learner gives achievable guarantees. Subsequent lower bounds compare distribution classes and sharpen the dependence of sample size on accuracy.

edges.label: 增加每位买家的类型维度
edges.note: 同一买家对多个物品的私有估值不能由一个标量概括；学习目标转为接近最优的多维贝叶斯激励相容机制。
edges.noteEn: A scalar no longer summarizes a buyer's values for several items. The learning target becomes a near-optimal multidimensional Bayesian incentive-compatible auction.

edges.label: 改变可见数据
edges.note: 独立估值样本含有价格分布的信息；只在一个历史价格观察购买率只锁定需求曲线的一点，两类保证不可直接互换。
edges.noteEn: Independent value samples provide distributional information. A conversion rate at one price identifies just one point on demand, so the guarantees are not interchangeable.

edges.label: 变更允许的分布类别
edges.note: 在一般正则类，随机门槛可以改善二价的保证；把条件收紧为风险率不减，两买方模型下的最优结论会改变。
edges.noteEn: A random markup can improve on second price for regular distributions. Restricting distributions to monotone hazard rates changes the optimum in the two-buyer setting.

edges.label: 机制简单性与先验信息
edges.note: 最优匿名报价可依据估值分布选择；先验独立的拍卖必须事先选好，并在同一分布类中统一保证收入。
edges.noteEn: The best anonymous price can be chosen for the distribution. A prior-independent auction must be chosen beforehand and deliver a guarantee across the class.

edges.label: 用竞争弥补简单机制
edges.note: 固定买家人数时比较同价销售和最优收入；允许增加买家后，比较对象换成简单拍卖能否追平原人数下的基准。
edges.noteEn: Anonymous pricing compares revenue at a fixed bidder count. With additional bidders the question is whether a simple auction can reach the original optimum.

edges.label: 给竞争复杂度建立紧界
edges.note: 在可加、各项独立的特例中，后文给出多买家情形的同阶上下界，说明最坏情况下所需的新增竞争者数量。
edges.noteEn: In the additive independent-items case, matching bounds pin down the number of extra competitors needed in the many-bidder regime.

branches.name: 有成本的搜索与保留值规则
branches.question: 每次询价、查看选项或了解产品属性都要付费时，应先看什么、何时停止？允许直接选择尚未查看的选项，会怎样改变策略？
branches.questionEn: When it costs money to obtain a quote, inspect an alternative, or learn a product attribute, what should be inspected first and when should search stop? What changes when an uninspected option may be chosen?
branches.boundary: 本支研究为一次最终选择收集信息的成本、次序与停止规则。工资发布与匹配把工资和接触机会置于市场均衡中；多臂实验则研究反复操作收益来源时的学习与收益。
branches.boundaryEn: This branch follows the cost, order, and stopping rules of information gathering for a terminal choice. Wage posting and matching endogenize wages and opportunities for contact. Bandit experimentation studies learning and payoffs from operating an arm repeatedly.

papers.title: The Economics of Information
papers.note: 购买同质商品时，多问一家可以降低预期成交价。买方在看到报价前选择询价家数，把再问一次的预期节省与询价成本比较。
papers.noteEn: For a homogeneous good, one more quote can reduce the expected purchase price. The buyer chooses a sample size in advance by comparing expected savings with the cost of another inquiry.

papers.title: Searching for the Lowest Price When the Distribution of Prices Is Unknown
papers.note: 买方面对依次出现且不能追回的报价，却不完全知道价格分布。每个报价既提供一次购买机会，也改变对后续报价的信念，进而改变继续搜索的价值。
papers.noteEn: A buyer receives sequential offers without recall and does not fully know their distribution. Each quote offers a chance to buy and revises beliefs about future quotes, changing the value of continued search.

papers.title: Optimal Search for the Best Alternative
papers.note: 各选项的收益独立，分布和查看成本已知，查看后可以回选。按保留值从高到低查看，一旦当前最优收益达到剩余选项的最高保留值，就停止。
papers.noteEn: With independent prizes, known distributions and inspection costs, and recall of inspected prizes, inspect in descending order of reservation value. Stop once the best available payoff reaches the highest remaining reservation value.

papers.title: Prominence and Consumer Search
papers.authors: Mark Armstrong · John Vickers · Jidong Zhou
papers.note: 当所有顾客都先访问同一家企业，且各企业没有系统性质量差异时，先被访问的企业会定出更低的价格。论文另分析质量不同的卖家争取首访位置的激励。
papers.noteEn: When everyone samples the same firm first and firms have no systematic quality differences, that firm charges less than its rivals. With heterogeneous quality, firms also differ in how much they stand to gain from the first visit.

papers.title: Optimal Search for Product Information
papers.authors: Fernando Branco · Monic Sun · J. Miguel Villas-Boas
papers.note: 消费者逐步了解同一产品的属性，更新购买后的预期效用。预期估值达到上界时购买，降至下界时退出，只有在两界之间才继续花钱了解产品。
papers.noteEn: A consumer learns about attributes of one product over time. Expected valuation reaching the upper boundary triggers purchase, reaching the lower boundary triggers exit, and only intermediate valuations justify further investigation.

papers.title: A Theory of Delegated Search for the Best Alternative
papers.note: 当由代理人承担搜索且存在道德风险时，最优合约用截止期限和提前完成奖励来激励搜索。绩效能否写入合约，还决定委托人能用何种支付安排实施搜索。
papers.noteEn: When a principal entrusts search to an agent under moral hazard, the optimal contract uses deadlines and rewards for early completion. Contractibility of performance also determines which payment arrangements can implement search.

papers.title: A More General Pandora Rule?
papers.role: 多个已知结果共同进入效用
papers.note: 允许效用取决于全部已揭示的奖品。如果一种广义潘多拉规则要对所有成本和分布都最优，作者证明这类问题必须可以转换成一个具有原始潘多拉效用形式的问题。
papers.noteEn: Allowing all discovered prizes to enter utility limits the reach of reservation rankings. If a generalized Pandora rule is optimal for every configuration of costs and distributions, the problem can be solved through a transformed problem with Weitzman’s payoff form.

papers.title: Descending Price Optimally Coordinates Search
papers.authors: Robert Kleinberg · Bo Waggoner · E. Glen Weyl
papers.note: 竞买人要先花钱了解自己的估值。在降价拍卖中，决定查看时面对的是可立即成交的价格，论文据此把查看时机和出价联系起来，并说明其他拍卖形式为何可能诱发重复或不足的查看。
papers.noteEn: Bidders must pay to learn their values. A Dutch clock offers a price at which the good can be secured when a bidder inspects, linking the timing of inspection to the decision to buy. Other formats can induce redundant or insufficient inspection.

papers.title: Whether or Not to Open Pandora’s Box
papers.note: 停止时允许直接拿走一个尚未查看的选项。查看它能避免买到低收益，却要付出成本并失去盲选的机会；作者给出可刻画最优策略的充分条件，并展示查看次序和停止规则都可能改变。
papers.noteEn: At stopping, the decision maker may take an unopened box. Inspection can reveal a poor draw but costs money and removes the option of taking that box sight unseen. Sufficient conditions yield a policy characterization, and both ordering and stopping can change.

papers.title: Optimal Search and Discovery
papers.role: 发现新品与查看已知商品
papers.note: 消费者起初只知道少数商品，可以查看已知商品，也可以先花钱发现新商品。模型用保留值刻画两种活动与购买之间的选择，因而把扩大备选集合与加深对已有选项的了解区分开来。
papers.noteEn: A consumer initially knows only a few products and can inspect a known one or pay to discover additional products. Reservation values characterize these choices and purchase, distinguishing expansion of the consideration set from closer inspection of its members.

papers.title: Pandora’s Problem with Nonobligatory Inspection: Optimal Structure and a PTAS
papers.role: 可盲选时的两阶段次序
papers.note: 若允许直接领取未开箱的奖品，仍存在只用两种预设查看次序、最多切换一次的最优策略。作者利用这个结构给出多项式时间近似方案。
papers.noteEn: When an unopened prize can be claimed, some optimal policy uses only two predetermined inspection orders and switches between them at most once. This structure yields a polynomial-time approximation scheme.

papers.title: Pandora’s Problem with Combinatorial Cost
papers.authors: Ben Berger · Tomer Ezra · Michal Feldman · Federico Fusco
papers.role: 查看成本取决于整组选项
papers.note: 将逐项相加的成本改为已查看集合的成本函数。当成本函数次模时，仍存在使用固定查看次序的最优策略，何时停止则取决于已观察到的奖品。
papers.noteEn: Inspection costs depend on the whole set opened. For submodular costs, some optimal strategy follows a fixed inspection order, while the decision to stop still depends on the prizes observed.

edges.label: 看到报价后再决定
edges.note: 询价家数可以事前决定。若要逐个接受或拒绝报价且分布未知，先前的报价还会通过更新信念影响下一次询价。
edges.noteEn: A sample size can be chosen in advance. With sequential accept-or-reject decisions and an unknown distribution, the history also enters the next search decision through beliefs.

edges.label: 从询价数量到查看次序
edges.note: 事前比较再问一个报价的价值，留下了异质选项应先看谁的问题。已知各自的独立分布、可回选时，每项的保留值同时给出排序和停止条件。
edges.noteEn: A marginal comparison for one more quote leaves open which heterogeneous source to inspect first. With independent known distributions and recall, reservation values determine both priority and stopping.

edges.label: 谁先被消费者看到
edges.note: 把个体挑选查看对象的问题放进卖家定价的市场。给一家卖家外生的首访位置后，消费者的后续搜索影响各卖家的价格激励。
edges.noteEn: Move from an individual choosing which option to inspect to sellers setting prices. Giving one seller the first visit changes the pricing incentives created by subsequent consumer search.

edges.label: 同一选项可以继续了解
edges.note: 一次查看揭示一个新奖品时，状态包括目前最佳奖品。若信息逐次揭示同一产品的属性，消费者要比较购买、退出和再了解一个属性。
edges.noteEn: A one-shot inspection reveals a new prize. When information instead accumulates about attributes of one product, the relevant alternatives are buying, exiting, and learning more about that same product.

edges.label: 把查看权交给代理人
edges.note: 自己支付成本并获得收益时可以直接求最优次序。把搜索交给代理人后，委托人必须用可执行的支付安排激励搜索努力和完成时机。
edges.noteEn: An owner-searcher can directly optimize the sequence of inspections. Delegation requires enforceable payments that give the agent incentives to search and to complete the task at the desired time.

edges.label: 改变停止时的收益函数
edges.note: 原规则在停止时只计最好的奖品。让多个奖品都影响效用后，对所有实例都有效的广义规则需要效用满足更强的结构条件。
edges.noteEn: The original stopping payoff uses only the best prize. When several prizes enter utility, a generalized ordering rule valid for every instance requires substantial restrictions on utility.

edges.label: 不同人掌握不同选项
edges.note: 集中决策者可以用保留值排列查看次序。若每位竞买人只决定是否查看自己的估值，拍卖格式就要协调不同人的查看时机。
edges.noteEn: One planner can rank inspections by reservation values. When each bidder decides whether to inspect their own value, the auction format has to coordinate inspection across people.

edges.label: 取消先查看再领取的约束
edges.note: 允许直接领取未查看的选项会给未知奖品一个备用价值。打开它既创造信息，也消除盲选机会，因此原有的单一次序不再普遍最优。
edges.noteEn: An unopened prize gains a fallback value when it can be claimed directly. Opening it both produces information and eliminates the blind choice, so the original ordering need not be optimal.

edges.label: 起初只知道部分备选项
edges.note: 已知所有盒子时只需比较查看与停止。如果还需要先发现新产品，就要把扩展商品集合的价值和深入查看已有商品的价值放在同一决策中。
edges.labelEn: Expanding the set of known alternatives
edges.noteEn: When all boxes are known, the choice concerns inspection and stopping. Limited awareness adds the option of expanding the set, whose value must be compared with closer inspection of a known product.

edges.label: 保留备用选项时的策略结构
edges.note: 盲选打破了经典固定次序。后续研究证明，虽然需要按观察结果调整，仍可用两套预定次序并最多切换一次来实现最优。
edges.noteEn: Selection without inspection can defeat a single fixed order. The subsequent result limits the required adaptation to at most one switch between two predetermined orders.

edges.label: 允许多次查看分摊成本
edges.note: 按箱相加的成本允许逐项计算保留值。若打开某一箱的边际成本随已开集合变化，次模性仍能保证存在预先排好的最优查看次序。
edges.noteEn: Additive costs allow each box to be valued separately. When marginal inspection cost depends on the boxes already opened, submodularity still guarantees that an optimal ordering can be fixed in advance.

branches.name: 纵向市场、合约与转售限制
branches.en: Vertical markets, contracting and resale restraints
branches.question: 制造商通过独立零售商销售时，批发价、转售价和独家交易怎样改变最终价格、售前服务与竞争者的进入机会？
branches.questionEn: When manufacturers sell through independent retailers, how do wholesale prices, resale price controls and exclusive dealing affect final prices, presale service and entry?
branches.boundary: 以不同生产或分销环节之间的合约为单位，比较双重加价、零售服务、秘密折扣及渠道封锁。当纵向一体化改变供货与定价条件时，也考察其后果。
branches.boundaryEn: The unit of analysis is the contract linking production or distribution stages. The branch compares double marginalization, retail service, secret discounts and foreclosure, including how vertical integration changes access and pricing.

papers.title: Vertical Integration and Antitrust Policy
papers.note: 上游按高于成本的批发价供货，下游再加价。两层垄断各自忽略降低自身加价给另一层带来的收益，一体化因而可能降低最终价格。
papers.noteEn: An upstream markup enters the downstream monopolist’s marginal cost. A fall in either markup benefits the other firm, so joint pricing can reduce the final price.

papers.title: Why Should Manufacturers Want Fair Trade?
papers.note: 顾客可以在一家店获得产品讲解，再到不提供服务的折扣店购买。制造商维持最低转售价，可为经销商提供服务保留利润空间。
papers.noteEn: A customer can obtain a demonstration at one store and buy from a discounter. Maintaining a minimum resale price can preserve the dealer margin that finances service.

papers.title: The Logic of Vertical Restraints
papers.role: 经销商信息与风险分担
papers.note: 当经销商掌握本地市场信息时，独家区域让其按当地状况调整价格，维持转售价则限制调整空间。需求与成本的不确定性改变两种安排的取舍。
papers.noteEn: Exclusive territories give informed retailers room to adjust prices to local conditions. Resale price maintenance limits that adjustment. Demand and cost uncertainty affect the trade-off.

papers.title: Naked Exclusion
papers.authors: Eric B. Rasmusen · J. Mark Ramseyer · John S. Wiley Jr.
papers.note: 进入者要获得足够多的买家才能收回进入成本。每个买家签署独家采购合同时，只承担阻碍进入给自身造成的损失，其余买家也会受损。
papers.noteEn: An entrant must attract enough buyers to recover entry costs. A buyer who signs an exclusive contract internalizes only its own share of the loss if entry becomes unviable.

papers.title: Vertical Control with Bilateral Contracts
papers.note: 制造商分别与竞争零售商签约时，向其中一家秘密让利可夺走别家的生意。经销商会预见这种动机，制造商限制总销量的承诺也因此受损。
papers.noteEn: A manufacturer contracting separately with competing retailers can gain from a secret concession that diverts sales from the others. Retailers anticipate this incentive, undermining the manufacturer’s commitment to restrict total sales.

papers.title: Opportunism in Multilateral Vertical Contracting: Nondiscrimination, Exclusivity, and Uniformity
papers.note: 单个买家担心上游与竞争对手另行调整合约。作者说明，保证同等待遇通常不足以消除这种机会主义，并分析排他交易与统一合同形式的承诺作用。
papers.noteEn: A buyer worries that the supplier may renegotiate a rival’s deal. A nondiscrimination promise can leave this incentive intact, motivating the analysis of exclusivity and uniform contracts as commitment devices.

papers.title: Exclusive Dealing and Entry, when Buyers Compete
papers.role: 零售竞争改变排他效果
papers.note: 在文中的定价与签约时序下，一个拒签的零售商可用进入者的低成本供货吸引更多顾客。零售竞争越激烈，进入者越有可能靠少数经销商达到必要规模。
papers.noteEn: Under the paper’s contracting and pricing assumptions, a retailer that rejects exclusivity can use the entrant’s low-cost supply to attract customers. Intense retail competition can let entry succeed with fewer distributors.

papers.title: Resale Price Maintenance and Interlocking Relationships
papers.note: 当多家制造商都向同一批零售商供货时，维持转售价能同时削弱品牌内和品牌间的价格竞争。在文中条件下，行业垄断价格可在单期交易中实现。
papers.noteEn: When multiple manufacturers supply the same retailers, resale price maintenance can soften competition both within and across brands. Under the model’s conditions, industry monopoly prices are attainable in a one-period setting.

papers.title: Raising Retailers’ Profits: On Vertical Practices and the Exclusion of Rivals
papers.role: 以未来零售利润排斥进入
papers.note: 若新企业进入会侵蚀既有零售利润，制造商可通过给经销商留利，使其主动拒绝协助进入。文中多种纵向安排都能产生这一动态激励。
papers.noteEn: Entry can erode the rents that incumbent manufacturers pass to retailers. A retailer may then decline to assist the entrant, a dynamic incentive shared by several vertical practices.

papers.title: Exclusive Dealing and Vertical Integration in Interlocking Relationships
papers.role: 排他交易与纵向一体化
papers.note: 在交叉供货的市场上，制造商和零售商可通过独家交易或一体化阻断竞争者的销售渠道。不同上下游组合改变封锁的可行性及消费者福利。
papers.noteEn: In an interlocking supply network, exclusive dealing or integration can close off a rival’s route to consumers. The pattern of upstream and downstream ties shapes the feasibility and welfare effects of foreclosure.

papers.title: The Welfare Effects of Vertical Integration in Multichannel Television Markets
papers.authors: Gregory S. Crawford · Robin S. Lee · Michael D. Whinston · Ali Yurukoglu
papers.note: 作者用美国地区体育频道和电视分销商的数据估计转播谈判与订阅需求模型，比较减少双重加价的收益与提高对手转播成本或拒绝供片造成的损失。
papers.noteEn: Using US regional sports networks and television distributors, the authors estimate bargaining and demand to weigh reduced double marginalization against withholding content or charging rival distributors more.

papers.title: Collusion Between Supply Chains under Asymmetric Information
papers.role: 供应链合谋与零售商信息租
papers.roleEn: Supply-chain collusion and retailer information rents
papers.note: 零售商私下观察每期需求，制造商须支付信息租。在重复竞争中，将关心未来利润的零售商纳入合谋，既可能放宽也可能收紧维持合谋的条件，方向取决于需求分布。
papers.noteEn: Retailers privately observe demand each period and earn information rents. Including forward-looking retailers in supply-chain collusion can make it easier or harder to sustain, depending on the distribution of demand.

edges.label: 两种纵向定价动机
edges.labelEn: Two motives for vertical price control
edges.note: 在连续垄断中，降低下游加价有利于增加销量。加入购前服务后，维持经销商的加价也可能有利于制造商。
edges.noteEn: Reducing the retail markup can expand sales in a successive monopoly. Introducing presale service gives the manufacturer a reason to protect that markup.

edges.label: 本地信息与价格调整
edges.note: 从零售服务转向经销商的本地信息，比较统一转售价和授权独家区域各自如何影响定价。
edges.noteEn: Moving from service incentives to informed retailers changes the comparison between resale price controls and exclusive territories.

edges.label: 销售区域与采购排他
edges.note: 限定经销商的销售区域会改变品牌内竞争。若独家条款改为限制买家向他人采购，进入者能否获得足够订单就成为核心问题。
edges.noteEn: A territorial restriction changes intrabrand rivalry. When a contract restricts the buyer’s alternative suppliers, the central question shifts to whether an entrant can secure sufficient demand.

edges.label: 引入多家下游竞争者
edges.note: 两层各一家的定价问题变成一对多的私下签约问题。向某家零售商作出的让步会影响其他零售商的销量。
edges.noteEn: A single pair of successive monopolists gives way to one supplier privately contracting with several retailers. A concession to one affects the others’ sales.

edges.label: 保证同等待遇是否有效
edges.note: 双边合同对其他客户造成的损失引出一个承诺问题。后文检验不歧视条款能否约束上游与另一买家的重新谈判。
edges.noteEn: The loss imposed on other buyers creates a commitment problem. McAfee and Schwartz ask whether nondiscrimination clauses can discipline subsequent bilateral renegotiation.

edges.label: 允许买家争夺相同顾客
edges.labelEn: Let buyers compete for the same consumers
edges.note: 将买家改成相互竞争的零售商后，拒签者能从签约者手中夺走销量。必要进入规模由可供货门店的销售量决定。
edges.noteEn: When buyers compete at retail, a buyer that rejects exclusivity can take sales from signatories. Entry viability now depends on the volume the remaining outlets can deliver.

edges.label: 交叉供货中的品牌间竞争
edges.note: 同一零售商销售多个品牌时，维持转售价还会改变不同制造商之间的竞争，无需依赖售前服务搭便车。
edges.noteEn: When a retailer carries competing brands, resale price controls affect competition across manufacturers even in the absence of service free riding.

edges.label: 从共同上游到共同零售商
edges.labelEn: From one supplier to shared retailers
edges.note: 在制造商分别与零售商签约的基础上，允许多家制造商共享经销商，追踪零售定价限制如何改变整个供货网络的均衡。
edges.noteEn: Allowing multiple manufacturers to share the same retailers extends bilateral contracting to a network and changes the equilibrium effect of retail price controls.

edges.label: 用持续利润诱导拒绝进入
edges.labelEn: Use continuing rents to discourage entry
edges.note: 签订独家采购合同可以阻碍进入。如果零售商在进入后将失去未来利润，留利也能诱使其拒绝接纳新品牌。
edges.noteEn: Exclusive contracts can block entry. If retailers stand to lose future rents after entry, granting those rents can also induce them to turn away a new brand.

edges.label: 替换交叉供货中的合约工具
edges.labelEn: Change the instrument in an interlocking network
edges.note: 保留多个制造商共享零售商的市场结构，将转售价约束换为独家交易或一体化，考察何时会切断竞争者的渠道。
edges.noteEn: Holding on to the interlocking network, the analysis changes the instrument from resale price controls to exclusivity or integration and asks when a rival’s distribution is foreclosed.

edges.label: 将加价与供货谈判同时量化
edges.note: 地区体育频道一体化既可能消除链内加价，也可能改变竞争分销商的转播条件。结构模型利用转播与订阅数据比较两种作用。
edges.noteEn: Integration may remove an internal markup while changing rival distributors’ carriage terms. The structural model uses carriage and subscription data to quantify these effects.

edges.label: 经销商信息进入重复竞争
edges.note: 在零售商掌握需求信息的设定上加入供应链之间的重复竞争，使链内的信息租影响链间合谋的可持续性。
edges.noteEn: Adding repeated rivalry between supply chains makes the rents paid to informed retailers matter for the sustainability of collusion across chains.

bridges.label: 谁拥有最后决定权
bridges.note: 固定由接收者行动时，廉价沟通的精度受偏好冲突限制；把决策权也作为选择，便能比较沟通损失与授权后的决策偏差。
bridges.labelEn: Who has the final say?
bridges.noteEn: Preference conflict limits communication when the receiver decides. Allowing delegation trades the loss of information against bias in the delegated decision.

bridges.label: 把后验分布换成市场细分
bridges.note: 两者都受后验分布平均回到先验的约束。在市场细分中，后续行动具体为卖家针对每组选择利润最大化价格，因而可以研究消费者与生产者剩余。
bridges.labelEn: From posteriors to market segments
bridges.noteEn: Both models require posteriors to average to the prior. Under market segmentation the subsequent decision is a profit-maximizing price, which pins down attainable consumer and producer surplus.

bridges.label: 从绩效水平到相对名次
bridges.note: 把奖励所依据的信号从个人绩效换成相对名次，继续问隐藏努力如何被激励，并检验共同冲击如何改变比较结果。
bridges.labelEn: From performance levels to relative ranks
bridges.noteEn: Replace individual output with rank as the basis for pay. This changes how common shocks affect the cost of motivating hidden effort.

bridges.label: 把激励延伸到未来
bridges.note: 在重复隐藏行动下，未来承诺的效用也可以奖惩当期表现，跨期保险与当期激励必须同时满足。
bridges.labelEn: Extending incentives into the future
bridges.noteEn: With repeated hidden action, promised future utility can reward current performance. Intertemporal insurance must be consistent with incentives today.

bridges.label: 从消费者检验到企业检验
bridges.note: 两者都从有限观测数据出发构造可检验限制。消费者端问是否存在理性化其选择的偏好，企业端改问哪些价格与投入产出数据能由优化行为解释。
bridges.labelEn: From consumer tests to producer tests
bridges.noteEn: Both derive restrictions on finite observations. One asks which preferences rationalize chosen bundles, the other which optimizing technologies rationalize prices and input–output data.

bridges.label: 让信息获取也接受显示偏好检验
bridges.note: 观测对象从商品束改为不同决策问题中的状态依存选择概率，用这些选择检验是否存在统一的信息获取成本。
bridges.labelEn: Revealed preference for information acquisition
bridges.noteEn: The observable changes from bundles to state-dependent choice probabilities across decisions. These can test whether a common information cost rationalizes behavior.

bridges.label: 家庭内部的威胁点
bridges.note: 消费和家务等家庭选择可以当作合作剩余的分配；个人在谈判破裂时能得到什么，会进入家庭资源配置。
bridges.labelEn: The household disagreement point
bridges.noteEn: Household bargaining treats consumption and domestic work as a division of cooperative surplus. Each partner’s outside option influences the allocation.

bridges.label: 从协调博弈到银行挤兑
bridges.note: 把私人噪声信号放进债权人是否撤资的问题，区分基本面恶化与债权人行动互补对挤兑的作用。
bridges.labelEn: From coordination to bank runs
bridges.noteEn: Add noisy private signals to creditors’ withdrawal decisions to distinguish deteriorating fundamentals from strategic complementarity.

bridges.label: 稳定匹配进入学校分配
bridges.note: 学生偏好与学校优先权共同约束分配；把学校名额的分配规则看作机制，还须检验家庭是否有动机如实填志愿。
bridges.labelEn: Stable matching in school assignment
bridges.noteEn: Student preferences and school priorities constrain assignment. An admissions mechanism also shapes incentives for families to report their preferences.

bridges.label: 从静态类型到类型路径
bridges.note: 静态收入设计中要为私有类型留下信息租；类型跨期相关时，还须追踪今天的信息如何影响未来的报告和分配。
bridges.labelEn: From static types to type paths
bridges.noteEn: Static revenue design leaves information rents to private types. With serially correlated types, current information also affects future reports and allocations.

bridges.label: 从一维排序到多维聚束
bridges.note: 单一质量维度下的菜单筛选提供参照；当消费者沿多个维度异质时，不能沿一条类型轴排序，最优菜单可能把不同类型聚在一起。
bridges.labelEn: From sorting to multidimensional bunching
bridges.noteEn: A one-dimensional quality menu provides a sorting benchmark. With multiple dimensions of heterogeneity, optimal screening can pool distinct types.

bridges.label: 从双边交替报价到议会联盟
bridges.note: 提案、拒绝与继续谈判仍决定今天能分到多少；通过议案所需的多数联盟改变了提案人的外部选项。
bridges.labelEn: From alternating offers to legislative coalitions
bridges.noteEn: Proposals, rejection and continuation values still determine current shares. The majority needed for passage changes the proposer’s outside options.

bridges.label: 企业边界与自我执行
bridges.note: 产权分配改变事后议价条件；关系合同把重复合作加入分析，比较不同所有权安排下可维持的非正式承诺。
bridges.labelEn: Firm boundaries and self-enforcement
bridges.noteEn: Ownership changes ex post bargaining positions. Repeated cooperation then allows a comparison of the informal promises sustained by different ownership structures.

bridges.label: 战略互补与撤资门槛
bridges.note: 两种应用均以对其他参与者行动的预期为关键；在银行模型中，信号和偿付能力共同约束债权人撤资的临界点。
bridges.labelEn: Strategic complementarity and withdrawal thresholds
bridges.noteEn: Expectations about others’ actions are central in both applications. In banking, signals and solvency together shape the threshold at which a creditor withdraws.

bridges.label: 信息外部性的两种来源
bridges.note: 策略实验中，个人决定是否付出学习成本，其他人共享研究带来的信息；网络社会学习则追问观察哪些前人的行动足以汇集私人信息。
bridges.labelEn: Two sources of informational externalities
bridges.noteEn: In strategic experimentation others benefit from information an individual pays to acquire. Network learning instead asks which predecessors’ actions suffice to aggregate private signals.

bridges.label: 从序贯理性到声誉回报
bridges.note: 不仅要在每段历史之后选择最优行动，长期玩家还可以用今天的行动影响短期对手对其类型的信念。
bridges.labelEn: From sequential rationality to reputational returns
bridges.noteEn: A long-lived player must act optimally after each history and can use current actions to shape future opponents’ beliefs about its type.

bridges.label: 最坏情形在谁的目标里
bridges.note: 多重先验决策刻画同一决策者面对模糊性的选择；稳健机制设计进一步改变设计者对参与者信念能作的假设，并检验机制的实施要求。
bridges.labelEn: Whose objective contains the worst case?
bridges.noteEn: Multiple-prior choice models describe one decision maker’s response to ambiguity. Robust implementation varies what the designer can assume about participants’ beliefs.

bridges.label: 企业以价格传递成本信息
bridges.note: 劳动者可以用教育传递私人类型；在进入博弈中，在位企业的价格也能向潜在进入者传递成本信息。
bridges.labelEn: Prices as signals of costs
bridges.noteEn: Education can signal a worker’s private type. An incumbent’s price can likewise signal costs to a prospective entrant.

bridges.label: 从已知行动集到最坏利润保障
bridges.note: 隐藏努力依然需要激励。当委托人还要防备未列入模型的行动时，评价同一支付规则的准则变为它在相容技术中的最坏利润。
bridges.labelEn: From known actions to guaranteed profit
bridges.noteEn: Hidden effort still requires incentives. If the principal must allow for unknown actions, a contract is evaluated by its worst profit across compatible technologies.

bridges.label: 最坏情形来自哪一组支付规则
bridges.note: 多重先验模型用最坏期望评价选择。模糊合约把这种评价作用于委托人提供的一组支付规则，还加入目标行动下支付规则之间的一致性。
bridges.labelEn: Which payment rules determine the worst case?
bridges.noteEn: Multiple priors evaluate choices by worst-case expectations. An ambiguous contract applies a worst-case evaluation to payment rules and imposes consistency at the target action.

bridges.label: 把单个信号实验换成模糊通信装置
bridges.note: 标准贝叶斯说服由一项实验诱导后验分布；在模糊说服中，接收者面对一组可能实验，行动取决于如何评价这种模糊性。
bridges.labelEn: From a single experiment to an ambiguous device
bridges.noteEn: One experiment induces a distribution of posteriors in Bayesian persuasion. A set of possible experiments makes the receiver’s response depend on how ambiguity is evaluated.

bridges.label: 拥堵结构为何保证纯策略均衡
bridges.labelEn: Why congestion structure yields a pure equilibrium
bridges.note: 有限博弈的一般存在定理允许随机化。资源成本的特殊结构使每次有利偏离都降低同一个势函数，保证存在纯策略均衡。
bridges.noteEn: General finite-game existence allows mixing. The structure of congestion costs makes every profitable deviation decrease a common potential, guaranteeing a pure equilibrium.

bridges.label: 从后悔学习的收敛到社会成本
bridges.labelEn: From regret learning to social cost
bridges.note: 后悔匹配约束经验联合分布，而平滑性直接约束其社会成本。外部后悔趋零便足以在相应博弈中得到长期平均效率界。
bridges.noteEn: Regret matching constrains the empirical distribution. Smoothness instead bounds its social cost: vanishing external regret suffices for a long-run average efficiency guarantee in the applicable games.

bridges.label: 额外竞争者与多维筛选
bridges.labelEn: Additional competition under multidimensional screening
bridges.note: 单物品正则独立同分布基准中，一个额外买家可让无保留价二价拍卖追平已知分布的最优拍卖。多物品下，买家能表达复杂需求，所需额外人数成为待刻画的量。
bridges.noteEn: In the i.i.d. regular one-item benchmark, one extra bidder lets a reserve-free second-price auction match the distribution-aware optimum. With multiple goods bidders can express richer demand, and the number of extra bidders becomes an object of analysis.

bridges.label: 从样本学习拍卖到紧样本界
bridges.labelEn: From learning auctions to tight sample bounds
bridges.note: Cole 与 Roughgarden 用历史估值样本代替已知先验，后续工作对相同的单参数学习问题给出上、下界，明确哪些分布类更难学习。
bridges.noteEn: Cole and Roughgarden replace known priors with historical values. Subsequent upper and lower bounds for single-parameter learning identify which distribution classes require more data.

bridges.label: 从搜索成本到首访位置
bridges.note: 差异化产品市场中，搜索成本影响均衡定价。让所有顾客优先访问同一家卖家，又能检验访问次序本身如何使卖家的价格发生分化。
bridges.labelEn: From search costs to the first visit
bridges.noteEn: Search costs affect equilibrium prices in differentiated-product markets. Assigning all consumers the same first seller isolates the additional effect of visit order on pricing differences across sellers.

bridges.label: 委托人只知道一个可搜索项目
bridges.note: 委托搜索需要给代理人正确的搜索激励。若委托人只知道一个可行项目并按最坏情形评价合约，稳健最优合约要求奖品超过门槛才支付代理人。
bridges.labelEn: When the principal knows only one available project
bridges.noteEn: Delegated search requires incentives for the agent to investigate. When the principal knows just one feasible project and evaluates contracts by their worst-case payoff, robustly optimal contracts pay the agent only above a prize threshold.

bridges.label: 从资产控制到销售渠道控制
bridges.labelEn: From asset control to control of distribution
bridges.note: 产权理论考察剩余控制权如何改变专用投资。一旦合并企业能决定是否供货，还需考虑封锁其他销售渠道的机会及其福利后果。
bridges.noteEn: Property-rights theory links residual control to relationship-specific investment. When integration also confers control over supply, it creates opportunities to foreclose competing distribution channels.

bridges.label: 将合谋约束移入供应链
bridges.labelEn: Bring collusion constraints inside the supply chain
bridges.note: Green 与 Porter 用不完全价格信息研究寡头如何维持合谋。Yehezkel 转向零售商私下观察需求时的链间合谋，同时考察制造商如何激励零售商。
bridges.noteEn: Green and Porter examine how oligopolists sustain collusion with imperfect price information. Yehezkel studies colluding supply chains when retailers privately observe demand, adding incentive constraints within each chain.
